-- dispatch
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function executeMemory(self: Fpu, cpu: any, opcode: number, e: any)
	const group = opcode - 0xD8
	const reg = e.reg
	if group == 0 then -- D8: m32 arithmetic
		if reg == 0 then
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM32(cpu, e))
			binaryTopConstant(self, 0, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 1 then
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM32(cpu, e))
			binaryTopConstant(self, 2, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM32(cpu, e))
			doFcom(self, false, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM32(cpu, e))
			doFcom(self, false, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		elseif reg == 4 then
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM32(cpu, e))
			binaryTopConstant(self, 1, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM32(cpu, e))
			binaryTopConstant(self, 1, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM32(cpu, e))
			binaryTopConstant(self, 3, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		else
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM32(cpu, e))
			binaryTopConstant(self, 3, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		end
	elseif group == 1 then -- D9: m32 load/store, environment, control word
		if reg == 0 then
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM32(cpu, e))
			doFld(self, d1, d2, d3, d4)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			doFstNarrow(self, cpu, e, true, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			doFstNarrow(self, cpu, e, true, true)
		elseif reg == 4 then
			readEnvironment(self, cpu, e)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			self.control = cpu:read16(memoryAddress(cpu, e, 2))
			refreshPending(self)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			writeEnvironment(self, cpu, e)
		elseif reg == 7 then
			cpu:write16(memoryAddress(cpu, e, 2), self.control)
		else
			invalid(self)
		end
	elseif group == 2 then -- DA: m32 integer arithmetic
		const address = memoryAddress(cpu, e, 4)
		const raw = cpu:read32(address)
		const value = if raw >= 0x80000000 then raw - TWO32 else raw
		local d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromInt(value)
		if reg == 0 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 0, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 1 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 2, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			doFcom(self, false, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			doFcom(self, false, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		elseif reg == 4 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 1, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 1, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 3, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		else
			binaryTopConstant(self, 3, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		end
	elseif group == 3 then -- DB: m32 integer, m80 load/store
		if reg == 0 then
			const address = memoryAddress(cpu, e, 4)
			const raw = cpu:read32(address)
			const value = if raw >= 0x80000000 then raw - TWO32 else raw
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromInt(value)
			doFld(self, d1, d2, d3, d4)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			storeInteger(self, cpu, e, 32, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			storeInteger(self, cpu, e, 32, true)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = readM80(cpu, e)
			push(self, d1, d2, d3, d4)
		elseif reg == 7 then
			if ensureStack(self, 1) then
				const s, exp, hi, lo = getStPacked(self, 0)
				writeM80(cpu, e, s, exp, hi, lo)
				pop(self)
			end
		else
			invalid(self)
		end
	elseif group == 4 then -- DC: m64 arithmetic
		const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM64(cpu, e))
		if reg == 0 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 0, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 1 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 2, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			doFcom(self, false, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			doFcom(self, false, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		elseif reg == 4 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 1, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 1, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 3, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		else
			binaryTopConstant(self, 3, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		end
	elseif group == 5 then -- DD: m64 load/store, state, status word
		if reg == 0 then
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromDouble(readM64(cpu, e))
			doFld(self, d1, d2, d3, d4)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			doFstNarrow(self, cpu, e, false, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			doFstNarrow(self, cpu, e, false, true)
		elseif reg == 4 then
			frstor(self, cpu, e)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			fnsave(self, cpu, e)
		elseif reg == 7 then
			cpu:write16(memoryAddress(cpu, e, 2), band(self.status, 0xFFFF))
		else
			invalid(self)
		end
	elseif group == 6 then -- DE: m16 integer arithmetic
		const raw = cpu:read16(memoryAddress(cpu, e, 2))
		const value = if raw >= 0x8000 then raw - 0x10000 else raw
		const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromInt(value)
		if reg == 0 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 0, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 1 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 2, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			doFcom(self, false, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			doFcom(self, false, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		elseif reg == 4 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 1, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 1, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			binaryTopConstant(self, 3, d1, d2, d3, d4, true)
		else
			binaryTopConstant(self, 3, d1, d2, d3, d4, false)
		end
	else -- DF: m16/m64 integer, BCD load/store
		if reg == 0 then
			const raw = cpu:read16(memoryAddress(cpu, e, 2))
			const value = if raw >= 0x8000 then raw - 0x10000 else raw
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromInt(value)
			doFld(self, d1, d2, d3, d4)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			storeInteger(self, cpu, e, 16, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			storeInteger(self, cpu, e, 16, true)
		elseif reg == 4 then
			const bh, bl = readBcd(cpu, e)
			local neg = bh >= 0x80000000
			local d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromInt64(bh % 0x80000000, bl, neg)
			doFld(self, d1, d2, d3, d4)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			const address = memoryAddress(cpu, e, 8)
			const lo = cpu:read32(address)
			const hi = cpu:read32(address + 4)
			const d1, d2, d3, d4 = fromInt64(hi, lo, hi >= 0x80000000)
			doFld(self, d1, d2, d3, d4)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			writeBcd(self, cpu, e)
		elseif reg == 7 then
			storeInteger(self, cpu, e, 64, true)
		else
			invalid(self)
		end
	end
end

local function executeRegister(self: Fpu, cpu: any, opcode: number, e: any)
	const group = opcode - 0xD8
	const reg = e.reg
	const index = e.rm
	if group == 0 then -- D8: ST0,ST(i)
		if reg == 0 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 0, false, 0, false)
		elseif reg == 1 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 2, false, 0, false)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			fcomRegister(self, index, false, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			fcomRegister(self, index, true, false)
		elseif reg == 4 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 1, false, 0, false)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 1, true, 0, false)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 3, false, 0, false)
		else
			topArithmetic(self, index, 3, true, 0, false)
		end
	elseif group == 1 then -- D9: register and transcendental opcodes
		if reg == 0 then
			if stackTag(self, index) == TAG_EMPTY then
				stackFault(self)
				return
			end
			const s, exp, hi, lo = getStPacked(self, index)
			push(self, s, exp, hi, lo)
		elseif reg == 1 then
			fxch(self, index)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			if index ~= 0 then
				invalid(self)
			end
		elseif reg == 4 then
			if index == 0 then
				if ensureStack(self, 1) then
					const s = self.rSign[self.top]
					setStPacked(
						self,
						0,
						bxor(s, 1),
						self.rExp[self.top],
						self.rHi[self.top],
						self.rLo[self.top]
					)
				end
			elseif index == 1 then
				if ensureStack(self, 1) then
					setStPacked(
						self,
						0,
						0,
						self.rExp[self.top],
						self.rHi[self.top],
						self.rLo[self.top]
					)
				end
			elseif index == 4 then
				ftst(self)
			elseif index == 5 then
				fxam(self)
			else
				invalid(self)
			end
		elseif reg == 5 then
			if index == 0 then
				push(self, 0, 0x3FFF, 0x80000000, 0)
			elseif index == 1 then
				push(self, 0, 0x4000, 0xD49A784B, 0xCD1B8AFE)
			elseif index == 2 then
				push(self, 0, 0x3FFF, 0xB8AA3B29, 0x5C17F0BC)
			elseif index == 3 then
				push(self, 0, 0x4000, 0xC90FDAA2, 0x2168C235)
			elseif index == 4 then
				push(self, 0, 0x3FFD, 0x9A209A84, 0xFBCFF799)
			elseif index == 5 then
				push(self, 0, 0x3FFE, 0xB17217F7, 0xD1CF79AC)
			elseif index == 6 then
				push(self, 0, 0, 0, 0)
			else
				invalid(self)
			end
		elseif reg == 6 then
			if index == 0 then
				f2xm1(self)
			elseif index == 1 then
				fyl2x(self)
			elseif index == 2 then
				fptan(self)
			elseif index == 3 then
				fpatan(self)
			elseif index == 4 then
				fxtract(self)
			elseif index == 5 then
				fprem(self, true)
			elseif index == 6 then
				self.top = (self.top + 7) % 8
				syncTop(self)
			elseif index == 7 then
				self.top = (self.top + 1) % 8
				syncTop(self)
			end
		elseif reg == 7 then
			if index == 0 then
				fprem(self, false)
			elseif index == 1 then
				fyl2xp1(self)
			elseif index == 2 then
				fsqrt(self)
			elseif index == 3 then
				fsincos(self)
			elseif index == 4 then
				frndint(self)
			elseif index == 5 then
				fscale(self)
			elseif index == 6 then
				fsin(self)
			elseif index == 7 then
				fcos(self)
			end
		else
			invalid(self)
		end
	elseif group == 2 then -- DA: FCMOV / FUCOMPP
		if reg <= 3 then
			const condition = if reg == 0
				then band(cpu.flags, 0x0001) ~= 0
				elseif reg == 1 then band(cpu.flags, 0x0040) ~= 0
				elseif reg == 2 then band(cpu.flags, bor(0x0001, 0x0040)) ~= 0
				else band(cpu.flags, 0x0004) ~= 0
			fcmov(self, index, condition)
		elseif reg == 5 and index == 1 then
			if ensureStack(self, 2) then
				const sa, ea, ha, la = getStPacked(self, 0)
				const sb, eb, hb, lb = getStPacked(self, 1)
				compareEngine(self, true, sa, ea, ha, la, sb, eb, hb, lb)
				pop(self)
				pop(self)
			end
		else
			invalid(self)
		end
	elseif group == 3 then -- DB: FNCLEX/FNINIT/FCOMI/FUCOMI
		if reg == 4 and index == 2 then
			self.status = band(self.status, bit32.bnot(EXCEPTION_MASK))
			self.pendingMf = false
		elseif reg == 4 and index == 3 then
			fninit(self)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			compareAndSetFlags(self, cpu, index, true, false)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			compareAndSetFlags(self, cpu, index, false, false)
		else
			invalid(self)
		end
	elseif group == 4 then -- DC: ST(i),ST0 arithmetic
		if reg == 0 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 0, true, index, false)
		elseif reg == 1 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 2, true, index, false)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			fcomRegister(self, index, false, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			fcomRegister(self, index, true, false)
		elseif reg == 4 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 1, true, index, false)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 1, false, index, false)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 3, false, index, false)
		else
			topArithmetic(self, index, 3, true, index, false)
		end
	elseif group == 5 then -- DD: stack/register move and unordered compare
		if reg == 0 then
			const physical = (self.top + index) % 8
			self.tags[physical] = TAG_EMPTY
		elseif reg == 1 then
			fxch(self, index)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			if not ensureStack(self, 1) then
				return
			end
			const s, exp, hi, lo = getStPacked(self, 0)
			setStPacked(self, index, s, exp, hi, lo)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			if not ensureStack(self, 1) then
				return
			end
			const s, exp, hi, lo = getStPacked(self, 0)
			setStPacked(self, index, s, exp, hi, lo)
			pop(self)
		elseif reg == 4 then
			fcomRegister(self, index, false, true)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			fcomRegister(self, index, true, true)
		else
			invalid(self)
		end
	elseif group == 6 then -- DE: arithmetic with pop
		if reg == 0 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 0, true, index, true)
		elseif reg == 1 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 2, true, index, true)
		elseif reg == 2 then
			fcomRegister(self, index, true, false)
		elseif reg == 3 then
			if index == 1 then
				if ensureStack(self, 2) then
					const sa, ea, ha, la = getStPacked(self, 0)
					const sb, eb, hb, lb = getStPacked(self, 1)
					compareEngine(self, false, sa, ea, ha, la, sb, eb, hb, lb)
					pop(self)
					pop(self)
				end
			else
				invalid(self)
			end
		elseif reg == 4 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 1, true, index, true)
		elseif reg == 5 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 1, false, index, true)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			topArithmetic(self, index, 3, false, index, true)
		else
			topArithmetic(self, index, 3, true, index, true)
		end
	else -- DF: FNSTSW AX / FCOMI(P) / FUCOMI(P)
		if reg == 4 and index == 0 then
			cpu:wr(0, band(self.status, 0xFFFF))
		elseif reg == 5 then
			compareAndSetFlags(self, cpu, index, true, true)
		elseif reg == 6 then
			compareAndSetFlags(self, cpu, index, false, true)
		else
			invalid(self)
		end
	end
end

function Fpu.reset(self: Fpu)
	self.invalidCount = 0
	self.stackFaultCount = 0
	self.lastOpcode = 0
	fninit(self)
end

function Fpu.st(self: Fpu, index: number): number
	const s, e, hi, lo = getStPacked(self, index)
	return toDoubleNearest(self, s, e, hi, lo)
end

function Fpu.tagWord(self: Fpu): number
	local word = 0
	for index = 0, 7 do
		word = bor(word, lshift(band(self.tags[index], 3), index * 2))
	end
	return word
end

local function ignoresPending(opcode: number, e: any): boolean
	if opcode == 0xDB and e.reg == 4 then
		return e.rm == 2 or e.rm == 3 -- FNCLEX / FNINIT
	elseif opcode == 0xDF and e.reg == 4 and e.rm == 0 then
		return true -- FNSTSW AX
	elseif opcode == 0xD9 and (e.reg == 4 or e.reg == 6 or e.reg == 7) then
		return true -- FLDENV / FNSTENV / FNSTCW
	elseif opcode == 0xDD and (e.reg == 4 or e.reg == 6 or e.reg == 7) then
		return true -- FRSTOR / FNSAVE / FNSTSW m16
	end
	return false
end

function Fpu.wait(self: Fpu, cpu: any)
	if self.pendingMf then
		cpu:fault(16)
	end
end

function Fpu.execute(self: Fpu, cpu: any, opcode: number, e: any)
	self.lastOpcode = opcode
	if self.pendingMf and not ignoresPending(opcode, e) then
		cpu:fault(16)
		return
	end
	const environmentOp = (opcode == 0xD9 and (e.reg == 4 or e.reg == 6))
		or (opcode == 0xDD and (e.reg == 4 or e.reg == 6))
	if not environmentOp then
		self.instIP = cpu.opIP or cpu.ip
		self.instCS = cpu.cs
		self.fop = band(opcode, 0x7FF)
		if e.mod ~= 3 then
			self.dataIP = e.off or 0
			self.dataDS = cpu[e.seg or "ds"] or 0
		end
	end
	if e.mod == 3 then
		executeRegister(self, cpu, opcode, e)
	else
		executeMemory(self, cpu, opcode, e)
	end
end

function Fpu.new()
	local self = setmetatable({}, Fpu) :: any
	self.rSign = {}
	self.rExp = {}
	self.rHi = {}
	self.rLo = {}
	self.tags = {}
	self.top = 0
	self.control = DEFAULT_CONTROL
	self.status = 0
	self.invalidCount = 0
	self.stackFaultCount = 0
	self.pendingMf = false
	self.lastOpcode = 0
	self.instIP = 0
	self.instCS = 0
	self.dataIP = 0
	self.dataDS = 0
	self.fop = 0
	for index = 0, 7 do
		self.rSign[index] = 0
		self.rExp[index] = 0
		self.rHi[index] = 0
		self.rLo[index] = 0
		self.tags[index] = TAG_EMPTY
	end
	syncTop(self)
	return self
end

return Fpu

--!strict

local json = require("@std/json")
local process = require("@std/process")
local Lute = require("../tools/vendor/verify/src/lute")
local Json = require("../tools/facet/lib/json")
local Retained = require("../tools/facet/lib/perf_retained")
local perf_runner = require("./perf_runner")
local perf_scenes = require("./perf_scenes")
local perf_profiles = require("./perf_profiles")
local nativeApp = require("./native_app")

type Scene = {
	name: string,
	samples: number,
	warmup: number,
	timing: () -> unknown,
	setup: (profile: perf_profiles.Profile) -> nativeApp.State,
	run: (state: perf_scenes.SceneState) -> unknown,
	afterRun: (state: perf_scenes.SceneState) -> (),
	teardown: (state: perf_scenes.SceneState) -> (),
}
type MemoryState = { world: nativeApp.State, fixture: perf_scenes.SceneState }

local function emit(fields: { [string]: json.Value })
	print("@@" .. json.serialize(fields))
end

local name = assert(process.args[2], "a paired scene name is required")
local memoryOnly = process.args[3] == "--memory-only"
local plantedBytes = tonumber(process.args[4] or "0")
local plantedOnlyWhileMounted = process.args[5] == "released"
assert(plantedBytes ~= nil and plantedBytes >= 0 and plantedBytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024 and plantedBytes % 1 == 0)
assert(memoryOnly or plantedBytes == 0, "retained allocation controls require the memory-only diagnostic")

local function findScene(sceneName: string, profile: perf_profiles.Profile): Scene?
	for _, candidate in perf_scenes do
		if candidate.name == sceneName then
			local source: unknown = candidate
			local samples, warmup = candidate.samples, candidate.warmup
			assert(
				type(samples) == "number" and type(warmup) == "number",
				"a paired scene needs declared sampling counts"
			)
			return {
				name = candidate.name,
				samples = samples,
				warmup = warmup,
				timing = function(): unknown
					return perf_runner.runScene(source, profile)
				end,
				setup = candidate.setup,
				run = candidate.run,
				afterRun = candidate.afterRun,
				teardown = candidate.teardown,
			}
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local profile = perf_profiles.get(perf_profiles.REFERENCE)
local scene = findScene(name, profile)
if scene == nil then
	emit({ scene = name, status = "missing" })
	process.exit(0)
end
assert(scene ~= nil)
local chosen: Scene = scene
local fields: { [string]: json.Value } = { scene = name, status = "ok", profile = profile.name }

local ok, problem = pcall(function()
	local record = chosen.timing()
	local total = Json.field(Json.field(record, "phases"), "total")
	fields.p50 = assert(Json.numberField(total, "p50_ms"))
	fields.p95 = assert(Json.numberField(total, "p95_ms"))
	fields.p99 = assert(Json.numberField(total, "p99_ms"))
	fields.samples = assert(Json.numberField(total, "samples"))
	local planted: { buffer } = {}
	local memory = Lute.memory.measure({
		setup = function()
			local state = chosen.setup(profile)
			if plantedBytes > 0 then
				table.insert(planted, buffer.create(plantedBytes))
			end
			local fixture: perf_scenes.SceneState =
				{ workload = state.workload, target = state.target, dispose = state.dispose }
			return { world = state, fixture = fixture }
		end,
		run = function(state: MemoryState)
			chosen.run(state.fixture)
		end,
		afterRun = function(state: MemoryState)
			chosen.afterRun(state.fixture)
		end,
		teardown = function(state: MemoryState)
			chosen.teardown(state.fixture)
			if plantedOnlyWhileMounted then
				table.clear(planted)
			end
		end,
		warmup = chosen.warmup,
		iterations = chosen.samples,
		rehearsals = 2,
	}, { cycles = Retained.CYCLES })
	for _, allocation in planted do
		assert(buffer.len(allocation) == plantedBytes)
	end
	fields.memory = {
		method = memory.method,
		cycles = memory.baseline.cycles,
		baselineHeapKb = memory.baseline.heapKb,
		mountedHeapKb = memory.mounted.heapKb,
		teardownHeapKb = memory.teardown.heapKb,
		mountedKb = memory.mountedKb,
		releasedKb = memory.releasedKb,
		teardownRetainedKb = memory.teardownRetainedKb,
		baselineAllocations = memory.baseline.allocations,
		mountedAllocations = memory.mounted.allocations,
		teardownAllocations = memory.teardown.allocations,
	}
	return true
end)
if not ok then
	emit({ scene = name, status = "failed", error = string.sub(tostring(problem), 1, 1000) })
	process.exit(0)
end
emit(fields)
process.exit(0)

-- Hud: owns the client HUD: cash and income readouts, carry panel, status lines, storm banner, and alert cards.
-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: Hud.build, Hud.update, Hud.tick, Hud.basePosition, Hud.setStorm, Hud.setLock, Hud.alert, Hud.setHint, Hud.start
--!strict
-- ============================================================================
-- Module contract (derived from the code below)
--
-- Owns:
--   * The "PulauHud" ScreenGui under the local player's PlayerGui (one copy;
--     Hud.build destroys any existing "PulauHud" before creating a new one).
--   * Every widget in it: the cash plate and cash label, the income label, the
--     "Carrying" panel (holding and carry income labels), the "Status" frame
--     (rebirth, storm, lock labels), the hint label, the "StormBanner" frame,
--     and the "Alerts" stack of fading alert cards.
--   * Client-side display state only: the storm countdown (nextStormAt,
--     serverStormIn, lastStormText), the lock countdown (lockUntil), the banner
--     hide time (bannerHideAt), the cached cash text (lastCashText), the last
--     base position the server reported (basePosition), and the single
--     RenderStepped connection (ticker).
--
-- Refuses:
--   * Gameplay authority: it never changes cash, carry, rebirths, storms or
--     locks. It only shows what the server sends through Hud.update,
--     Hud.setStorm, Hud.setLock and Hud.alert.
--   * Drawing before Hud.build: Hud.update returns at once when no gui exists,
--     every other writer checks its label is set, and pushAlert returns when
--     there is no alert stack.
--   * Badly typed payload fields: cash, rebirths and seconds go through
--     tonumber with defaults; carrying must be a table, basePosition a
--     Vector3, stormIn a number, and an alert color a Color3, or they are
--     ignored or replaced with a default.
--   * Running two tickers: Hud.start disconnects the old RenderStepped
--     connection before it connects a new one.
--
-- Returns:
--   * The Hud table. Hud.build returns Hud, Hud.basePosition returns the last
--     reported base position (Vector3?), Hud.start returns nil, and every
--     other public function returns nothing.
-- ============================================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Hud = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local gui: ScreenGui? = nil
local cashLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local cashPlate: Frame? = nil
local incomeLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local carryLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local carryIncomeLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local rebirthLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local stormLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local lockLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local hintLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local tutorialLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local bannerFrame: Frame? = nil
local bannerLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local alertStack: Frame? = nil
local carryingPanel: Frame? = nil

local nextStormAt: number? = nil
local serverStormIn: number? = nil
local lastStormText = ""
local lockUntil: number? = nil
local bannerHideAt: number? = nil
local lastCashText = ""
local basePosition: Vector3? = nil

-- === formatting ===
-- Formats a number as a whole number with commas every three digits, keeping a leading minus sign.
-- Returns the formatted string, e.g. 1234567.8 becomes "1,234,567" and -1500 becomes "-1,500".
local function comma(value: number): string
	local whole = math.floor(math.abs(value))
	local text = tostring(whole)
	local out = ""
	local count = 0
	for i = #text, 1, -1 do
		out = string.sub(text, i, i) .. out
		count += 1
		if count % 3 == 0 and i > 1 then
			out = "," .. out
		end
	end
	if value < 0 then
		out = "-" .. out
	end
	return out
end

-- Turns a number of seconds into a minutes:seconds clock, with negatives clamped to zero.
-- Returns a string like "3:05"; whole minutes are not wrapped into hours.
local function clock(seconds: number): string
	local total = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	local minutes = total // 60
	local secs = total % 60
	return string.format("%d:%02d", minutes, secs)
end

-- === label helper ===
-- Creates a transparent, centred GothamBlack TextLabel with a black stroke and parents it to parent.
-- Returns the new TextLabel so the caller can change alignment, font or text afterwards.
local function makeLabel(parent: Instance, name: string, size: UDim2, position: UDim2, textSize: number, color: Color3): TextLabel
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.Size = size
	label.Position = position
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	label.TextSize = textSize
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	label.TextScaled = false
	label.Text = ""
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

-- === alert styling ===
local ALERT_STYLE: { [string]: { color: Color3, icon: string } } = {
	stolen = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 110), icon = "[THIEF]" },
	stole = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 90), icon = "[STEAL]" },
	locked = { color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255), icon = "[LOCK]" },
	["storm-warning"] = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), icon = "[STORM]" },
	storm = { color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 190, 255), icon = "[STORM]" },
	rebirth = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 120), icon = "[REBIRTH]" },
}

-- === alert stack ===
-- Adds an alert card (icon and colour from ALERT_STYLE by data.kind) to the stack, fading and destroying it after 4 seconds.
-- Returns nothing; it does nothing if Hud.build has not created the alert stack yet.
local function pushAlert(data: { [string]: any })
	local stack = alertStack
	if not stack then
		return
	end
	local kind = tostring(data.kind or "")
	local style = ALERT_STYLE[kind]
	local color = data.color
	if typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then
		color = if style then style.color else Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	end
	local icon = if style then style.icon else "[!]"
	local card = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	card.Name = "Alert"
	card.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
	card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 40)
	card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	card.TextColor3 = color
	card.TextSize = 22
	card.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	card.TextWrapped = true
	card.TextScaled = false
	card.Text = icon .. " " .. tostring(data.text or "")
	card.LayoutOrder = math.floor((os.clock() * 1000) % 1000000)
	card.Parent = stack

	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
	padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
	padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
	padding.Parent = card

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = card

	task.delay(4, function()
		if not card.Parent then
			return
		end
		local tween = TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1 })
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Wait()
		card:Destroy()
	end)
end

-- === public api ===
-- Destroys any old "PulauHud" and builds a fresh ScreenGui with every HUD widget, saving them in module locals.
-- Returns the Hud table so calls can be chained.
function Hud.build()
	local existing = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	local container = existing and existing:FindFirstChild("PulauHud")
	if container then
		container:Destroy()
	end

	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "PulauHud"

	screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	gui = screen

	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Scale = 1
	scale.Parent = screen

	cashPlate = Instance.new("Frame")
	cashPlate.Name = "CashPlate"
	cashPlate.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 74)
	cashPlate.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 12)
	cashPlate.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 10, 16)
	cashPlate.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	cashPlate.BorderSizePixel = 0
	cashPlate.Parent = screen
	local plateCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	plateCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	plateCorner.Parent = cashPlate
	local plateStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	plateStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 210, 120)
	plateStroke.Thickness = 1.5
	plateStroke.Transparency = 0.55
	plateStroke.Parent = cashPlate

	cashLabel = makeLabel(screen, "Cash", UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 16), 34, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 150))
	cashLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	cashLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	cashLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
	incomeLabel = makeLabel(screen, "Income", UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 20), UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 50), 17, Color3.fromRGB(110, 240, 140))
	incomeLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	incomeLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "Carrying"
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 60)
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -78)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 32)
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Parent = screen
	carryingPanel = panel

	local panelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	panelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	panelCorner.Parent = panel

	carryLabel = makeLabel(panel, "Holding", UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 32), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4), 22, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	carryLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	carryIncomeLabel = makeLabel(panel, "CarryIncome", UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 36), 18, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 150))
	carryIncomeLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

	local info = Instance.new("Frame")
	info.Name = "Status"
	info.Size = UDim2.new(0, 232, 0, 78)
	info.Position = UDim2.new(1, -246, 0, 12)
	info.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 10, 16)
	info.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	info.BorderSizePixel = 0
	info.Parent = screen
	local infoCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	infoCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	infoCorner.Parent = info
	local infoStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	infoStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 160, 220)
	infoStroke.Thickness = 1.5
	infoStroke.Transparency = 0.6
	infoStroke.Parent = info

	rebirthLabel = makeLabel(info, "Rebirth", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6), 16, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 120))
	rebirthLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

	stormLabel = makeLabel(info, "Storm", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 27), 18, Color3.fromRGB(160, 200, 255))
	stormLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

	lockLabel = makeLabel(info, "Lock", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50), 16, Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 150))
	lockLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

	hintLabel = makeLabel(screen, "Hint", UDim2.new(0, 620, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0.5, -310, 1, -46), 18, Color3.fromRGB(236, 240, 250))

	local tuto = Instance.new("Frame")
	tuto.Name = "Tutorial"
	tuto.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 46)
	tuto.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 1, -104)
	tuto.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 34, 52)

	tuto.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tuto.Visible = false
	tuto.Parent = screen
	local tutoCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	tutoCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

	banner.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	banner.Visible = false
	banner.Parent = screen

	return Hud
end

-- === inner updates ===
-- Sets the HUD's UIScale from the camera viewport width (1280px base), clamped between 0.7 and 1.0.
-- Returns nothing; it does nothing if the HUD has not been built.
local function updateScaling()
	local screen = gui
	if not screen then
		return
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
	local scale = screen:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if scale then
		local factor = math.clamp(viewport.X / 1280, 0.7, 1.0)
		scale.Scale = factor
	end
end

-- === storm text ===
-- Works out the seconds left until the next storm from the local countdown, or else the last server value.
-- Returns "Next storm: --" if unknown, "STORM IN n" for 10 seconds or less, otherwise "Next storm: m:ss".
local function stormText(): string
	local seconds: number? = nil
	if nextStormAt then
		seconds = math.max(0, nextStormAt - os.clock())
	elseif serverStormIn then
		seconds = serverStormIn
	end
	if not seconds then
		return "Next storm: --"
	end
	if seconds <= 10 then
		return "STORM IN " .. tostring(math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds)))
	end
	return "Next storm: " .. clock(seconds)
end

-- === inner updates ===
-- Writes stormText() to the storm label only when it changed, turning it red during the "STORM IN" countdown.
-- Returns nothing; it does nothing if the storm label has not been built.
local function refreshStorm()
	if not stormLabel then
		return
	end
	local text = stormText()
	if text ~= lastStormText then
		lastStormText = text
		stormLabel.Text = text
		if string.find(text, "STORM IN", 1, true) then
			stormLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		else
			stormLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 200, 255)
		end
	end
end

-- === public api ===
-- Renders a server state snapshot: cash, income, carry panel, rebirths, base position, storm countdown and lock text.
-- Returns nothing; it does nothing before Hud.build, and bad or missing fields fall back to defaults or are skipped.
function Hud.update(state: { [string]: any })
	if not gui then
		return
	end
	updateScaling()

	if cashLabel then
		local cash = math.floor(tonumber(state.cash) or 0)
		local text = "$" .. comma(cash)
		if text ~= lastCashText then
			cashLabel.Text = text
			lastCashText = text
		end
	end
	if incomeLabel then
		incomeLabel.Text = "+$" .. comma(state.incomeRate or 0) .. " / sec"
	end
	if carryLabel and carryIncomeLabel and carryingPanel then
		local carrying = state.carrying
		if carrying and typeof(carrying) == "table" then
			carryingPanel.Visible = true
			carryLabel.Text = "Carrying: " .. tostring(carrying.name or "?")
			carryIncomeLabel.Text = "+$" .. comma(carrying.income or 0) .. " / sec"
		else
			carryingPanel.Visible = false
		end
	end
	if rebirthLabel then
		local count = tonumber(state.rebirths) or 0
		local bonus = math.floor(count * 50)
		rebirthLabel.Text = "Rebirths: " .. tostring(count) .. "  (+" .. tostring(bonus) .. "%)"
	end
	if typeof(state.basePosition) == "Vector3" then
		basePosition = state.basePosition
	end
	if typeof(state.stormIn) == "number" then
		nextStormAt = os.clock() + state.stormIn
		serverStormIn = state.stormIn
	end
	refreshStorm()
	if lockLabel then
		if lockUntil then
			local remain = math.max(0, math.ceil(lockUntil - os.clock()))
			if remain > 0 then
				lockLabel.Text = "LOCKED  " .. tostring(remain) .. "s"
				lockLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 96, 96)
			else
				lockLabel.Text = "Base unlocked"
				lockLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 150)
			end
		else
			lockLabel.Text = "Base unlocked"
			lockLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 150)
		end
	end
	if tutorialLabel and tutorialLabel.Parent then
		local frame = tutorialLabel.Parent
		if state.tutorialDone == true then
			frame.Visible = false
		elseif state.carrying then
			frame.Visible = true
			tutorialLabel.Text = "Bawa ke base, tahan [E] di pedestal"
		elseif (state.incomeRate or 0) > 0 then
			frame.Visible = false
		else
			frame.Visible = true
			tutorialLabel.Text = "Ambil brainrot di dermaga (utara pulau)"
		end
	end
end

-- === public api ===
local ticker: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

-- Per-frame step: moves the storm countdown on, hides or recounts the storm banner, and counts down the base lock.
-- Returns nothing; it clears nextStormAt once it is more than 1 second past, and lockUntil once it runs out.
function Hud.tick()
	local now = os.clock()
	if stormLabel and nextStormAt then
		if nextStormAt - now < -1 then
			nextStormAt = nil
		end
		refreshStorm()
	end
	if bannerFrame and bannerLabel and bannerHideAt then
		if bannerFrame.Visible and now >= bannerHideAt then
			bannerFrame.Visible = false
		elseif bannerFrame.Visible then
			local left = math.max(0, math.ceil(bannerHideAt - now))
			if bannerLabel.Text:find("STORM INBOUND") then
				bannerLabel.Text = "STORM INBOUND - " .. tostring(left) .. "s"
			end
		end
	end
	if lockLabel and lockUntil then
		local remain = math.max(0, math.ceil(lockUntil - now))
		if remain <= 0 then
			lockUntil = nil
			lockLabel.Text = "Base unlocked"
		else
			lockLabel.Text = "Base locked: " .. tostring(remain) .. "s"
		end
	end
end

-- Reads the last base position the server sent through Hud.update.
-- Returns that Vector3, or nil if no valid position has arrived yet.
function Hud.basePosition(): Vector3?
	return basePosition
end

-- Handles a storm phase from the server: "warning" starts the countdown banner, "wave" shows the wave banner for 8s, "clear" hides it.
-- Returns nothing; it resets the next-storm countdown (default 10s on warning, 180s on clear) and refreshes the storm label.
function Hud.setStorm(payload: { [string]: any })
	local phase = payload.phase
	if phase == "warning" then
		local seconds = tonumber(payload.seconds) or 10
		nextStormAt = os.clock() + seconds
		serverStormIn = seconds
		if bannerFrame and bannerLabel then
			bannerFrame.Visible = true
			bannerLabel.Text = "STORM INBOUND - " .. tostring(seconds) .. "s"
			bannerHideAt = os.clock() + seconds
		end
	elseif phase == "wave" then
		nextStormAt = nil
		if bannerFrame and bannerLabel then
			bannerFrame.Visible = true
			bannerLabel.Text = "THE WAVE IS HERE"
			bannerHideAt = os.clock() + 8
		end
	elseif phase == "clear" then
		if bannerFrame then
			bannerFrame.Visible = false
		end
		nextStormAt = os.clock() + (tonumber(payload.seconds) or 180)
	end
	refreshStorm()
end

-- Starts the client lock countdown (payload.seconds, default 30) when payload.locked is truthy, otherwise clears it.
-- Returns nothing; the lock label itself is redrawn by Hud.tick and Hud.update.
function Hud.setLock(payload: { [string]: any })
	if payload.locked then
		lockUntil = os.clock() + (tonumber(payload.seconds) or 30)
	else
		lockUntil = nil
	end
end

-- Public entry for server alerts; passes data (kind, text, optional color) on to pushAlert.
-- Returns nothing; the alert is dropped if the HUD has not been built.
function Hud.alert(data: { [string]: any })
	pushAlert(data)
end

-- Sets the hint line under the carry panel to text, or clears it when text is nil.
-- Returns nothing; it does nothing if the hint label has not been built.
function Hud.setHint(text: string?)
	if hintLabel then
		hintLabel.Text = text or ""
	end
end

-- Applies viewport scaling once and connects Hud.tick to RenderStepped, disconnecting any earlier ticker first.
-- Returns nil.
function Hud.start()
	updateScaling()
	if ticker then
		ticker:Disconnect()
	end
	ticker = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		Hud.tick()
	end)
	return nil
end

return Hud

--!strict
-- FwCfg.lua -- minimal QEMU fw_cfg PIO interface for the prebuilt SeaBIOS ROM.
--
-- QEMU's SeaBIOS build asks fw_cfg for the initial e820 map before it falls
-- back to CMOS. Providing the file directory and etc/e820 is what lets the
-- firmware see the machine's RAM without QEMU's help. No DMA and no ACPI table
-- blobs are advertised; SeaBIOS falls back to its built-in ACPI/SMBIOS paths.

const band, bor, lshift, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const FwCfg = {}
FwCfg.__index = FwCfg

const PORT_SELECT = 0x510
const PORT_DATA = 0x511

const SIG = 0x0000
const ID = 0x0001
const UUID = 0x0002
const NOGRAPHIC = 0x0004
const NB_CPUS = 0x0005
const NUMA = 0x000D
const BOOT_MENU = 0x000E
const MAX_CPUS = 0x000F
const FILE_DIR = 0x0019
const ACPI_TABLES = 0x8000
const SMBIOS_ENTRIES = 0x8001
const IRQ0_OVERRIDE = 0x8002
const E820_TABLE = 0x8003

export type FwCfg = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		entries: { [number]: string },
		selector: number,
		offset: number,
		selectCount: number,
		lastSelector: number,
		in8: (self: FwCfg, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: FwCfg, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		in16: (self: FwCfg, port: number) -> number,
		out16: (self: FwCfg, port: number, value: number) -> (),
	},
	FwCfg
))

local function u16le(value: number): string
	return string.char(band(value, 0xFF), band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
end

local function u32le(value: number): string
	return string.char(
		band(value, 0xFF),
		band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF),
		band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFF),
		band(rshift(value, 24), 0xFF)
	)
end

local function u16be(value: number): string
	return string.char(band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF), band(value, 0xFF))
end

local function u32be(value: number): string
	return string.char(
		band(rshift(value, 24), 0xFF),
		band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFF),
		band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF),
		band(value, 0xFF)
	)
end

local function u64le(value: number): string
	return u32le(band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF))
		.. u32le(band(math.floor(value / 0x100000000), 0xFFFFFFFF))
end

local function e820Entry(address: number, length: number, kind: number): string
	return u64le(address) .. u64le(length) .. u32le(kind)
end

local function buildE820(memorySize: number): string
	const lowRam = 0x9FC00
	const parts = {
		e820Entry(0, lowRam, 1),
		e820Entry(lowRam, 0x400, 2),
		e820Entry(0xA0000, 0x60000, 2),
		e820Entry(0x100000, memorySize - 0x100000, 1),
		e820Entry(0xFFFC0000, 0x40000, 2),
	}
	return table.concat(parts)
end

local function padName(name: string): string
	if #name >= 56 then
		return string.sub(name, 1, 56)
	end
	return name .. string.rep("\0", 56 - #name)
end

local function buildDirectory(files: { { name: string, select: number, data: string } }): string
	local parts = { u32be(#files) }
	for _, file in files do
		parts[#parts + 1] = u32be(#file.data)
		parts[#parts + 1] = u16be(file.select)
		parts[#parts + 1] = u16be(0)
		parts[#parts + 1] = padName(file.name)
	end
	return table.concat(parts)
end

function FwCfg.new(memorySize: number, vgaRom: buffer?): FwCfg
	local self = setmetatable({}, FwCfg) :: any
	const e820 = buildE820(memorySize)
	-- SeaBIOS matches bootorder entries against enumerated /pci paths. These
	-- must be exact prefixes (the wildcard belongs in the enumerated path, not
	-- in the bootorder line). Put the slave ATAPI CD first, then the master HDD,
	-- so a blank disk cannot mask a bootable ISO.
	const bootOrder = "/pci@i0cf8/\n"
	const files = {
		{ name = "etc/e820", select = 0x20, data = e820 },
		{ name = "bootorder", select = 0x21, data = bootOrder },
		-- <0 disables the timed "Press ESC" wait and goes straight to the
		-- device list; useful for headless diagnostics.
		{ name = "etc/boot-menu-wait", select = 0x23, data = u32le(0xFFFFFFFF) },
		-- Skip the interactive device list entirely. The bootorder above puts
		-- the ATAPI CD first, so a headless machine boots it without a key.
		{ name = "etc/show-boot-menu", select = 0x24, data = u32le(0) },
		{ name = "etc/debuglevel", select = 0x25, data = u32le(1) },
	}
	if vgaRom then
		files[#files + 1] = {
			name = "vgaroms/vgabios-stdvga.bin",
			select = 0x22,
			data = buffer.tostring(vgaRom),
		}
	end
	self.entries = {
		[SIG] = "QEMU",
		[ID] = u32le(1), -- traditional PIO only
		[UUID] = string.rep("\0", 16),
		[NOGRAPHIC] = u16le(0),
		[NB_CPUS] = u16le(1),
		[NUMA] = u64le(0),
		[BOOT_MENU] = u16le(1),
		[MAX_CPUS] = u16le(1),
		[FILE_DIR] = buildDirectory(files),
		[ACPI_TABLES] = u16le(0),
		[SMBIOS_ENTRIES] = u16le(0),
		[IRQ0_OVERRIDE] = string.char(0),
		[E820_TABLE] = u32le(0),
	}
	for _, file in files do
		self.entries[file.select] = file.data
	end
	self.selector = 0
	self.offset = 0
	self.selectCount = 0
	self.lastSelector = 0
	return self
end

function FwCfg.out8(self: FwCfg, port: number, value: number)
	if port == PORT_SELECT then
		self.selector = band(value, 0xFF)
		self.offset = 0
	end
end

function FwCfg.out16(self: FwCfg, port: number, value: number)
	if port == PORT_SELECT then
		self.selector = band(value, 0xFFFF)
		self.offset = 0
		self.selectCount += 1
		self.lastSelector = self.selector
	end
end

function FwCfg.in8(self: FwCfg, port: number): number
	if port == PORT_SELECT then
		return band(self.selector, 0xFF)
	elseif port == PORT_DATA then
		const data = self.entries[self.selector] or ""
		if self.offset >= #data then
			return 0
		end
		const value = string.byte(data, self.offset + 1) :: number
		self.offset += 1
		return value
	end
	return 0xFF
end

function FwCfg.in16(self: FwCfg, port: number): number
	if port == PORT_SELECT then
		return self.selector
	end
	return bor(self:in8(port), lshift(self:in8(port), 8))
end

return FwCfg

local device_profiles = require("./profiles_data")

export type Profile = {
	name: string,
	title: string,
	viewport: { w: number, h: number },
	insets: { top: number, bottom: number, left: number, right: number },
	preferredInput: string,
	capabilities: { keyboard: boolean, mouse: boolean, touch: boolean, gamepad: boolean },
	displaySize: string,
	overscanInsets: { top: number, bottom: number, left: number, right: number },

	frameTargetHz: number,
	reference: boolean,
}

local perf_profiles = {}

local NO_OVERSCAN = { top = 0, bottom = 0, left = 0, right = 0 }

local FLOOR: Profile = {
	name = "floorAndroid",
	title = "Floor low-end Android (360×640, touch)",
	viewport = { w = 360, h = 640 },
	insets = { top = 24, bottom = 0, left = 0, right = 0 },
	preferredInput = "Touch",
	capabilities = { keyboard = false, mouse = false, touch = true, gamepad = false },
	displaySize = "Small",
	overscanInsets = NO_OVERSCAN,
	frameTargetHz = 30,
	reference = true,
}

perf_profiles.REFERENCE = FLOOR.name

local function fromDevice(deviceName: string, preferredInput: string, caps, frameTargetHz: number): Profile
	local base = device_profiles.get(deviceName)
	assert(base ~= nil, `perf_profiles: unknown device_profiles class '{deviceName}'`)
	local facts = (base :: any).facts
	assert(type(facts) == "table", `perf_profiles: device profile '{deviceName}' declares no facts`)
	assert(type(facts.displaySize) == "string", `perf_profiles: device profile '{deviceName}' declares no displaySize`)
	return {
		name = base.name,
		title = base.title,
		viewport = table.clone(base.viewport),
		insets = table.clone(base.insets),
		preferredInput = preferredInput,
		capabilities = caps,
		displaySize = facts.displaySize,
		overscanInsets = table.clone(facts.overscanInsets or NO_OVERSCAN),
		frameTargetHz = frameTargetHz,
		reference = false,
	}
end

local PROFILES: { [string]: Profile } = {
	floorAndroid = FLOOR,
	phone = fromDevice("phone", "Touch", { keyboard = false, mouse = false, touch = true, gamepad = false }, 60),
	tablet = fromDevice("tablet", "Touch", { keyboard = false, mouse = false, touch = true, gamepad = false }, 60),
	desktop = fromDevice(
		"desktop",
		"KeyboardAndMouse",
		{ keyboard = true, mouse = true, touch = false, gamepad = false },
		60
	),

	consoleTenFoot = fromDevice(
		"console",
		"Gamepad",
		{ keyboard = false, mouse = false, touch = false, gamepad = true },
		60
	),
}

PROFILES.consoleTenFoot.name = "consoleTenFoot"

local ORDER = { "floorAndroid", "phone", "tablet", "desktop", "consoleTenFoot" }

function perf_profiles.list(): { string }
	return table.clone(ORDER)
end

function perf_profiles.get(name: string): Profile
	local p = PROFILES[name]
	assert(p ~= nil, `perf_profiles: unknown profile '{name}' (have: {table.concat(ORDER, ", ")})`)
	return p
end

return perf_profiles

--!strict
local Compose = require("../src").Compose

local system = require("@std/system")
local Verify = require("../tools/vendor/verify/src/core")

local perf_runner = {}

local ENGINE = "lute 1.0.1 (Luau)"
local QUALITY = "headless (no engine render; property writes only)"
local HEADLESS_NOTE = "Headless Lute timing is trend screening only — NOT an authoritative device result (§14.3). "
	.. "deviceMeasurement is the empty slot a real on-device capture fills."

type DeviceRow = {
	evidenceClass: string,
	scene: string,
	metrics: { frameWorkMs: { measured: boolean?, p95_ms: number? }? }?,
}

type EvidenceClass = {
	id: string,
	level: string,
	instrument: string,
	proves: string,
	cannotProve: string,
	rows: number?,
}

local EVIDENCE_CLASSES: { EvidenceClass } = {
	{
		id = "lute",
		level = "E1",
		instrument = "headless Lute on the development host",
		proves = "deterministic regressions in Facet's own decision/commit cost",
		cannotProve = "engine frame work, GPU/paint cost, or any device performance claim",
	},
	{
		id = "studio-emulated",
		level = "E3",
		instrument = "Roblox Studio Play session with a simulated device profile",
		proves = "the integrated adapter's real Instance/connection cost and frame work ON THE HOST",
		cannotProve = "low-end CPU/GPU, memory pressure, thermal or battery behavior",
	},
	{
		id = "desktop-retail",
		level = "E4",
		instrument = "retail Roblox client on the development desktop",
		proves = "non-Studio client behavior and desktop frame work",
		cannotProve = "mobile or console hardware behavior",
	},
	{
		id = "phone-physical",
		level = "E4",
		instrument = "the weakest supported physical Android device",
		proves = "the supported device floor",
		cannotProve = "console/ten-foot behavior or subjective feel",
	},
	{
		id = "console-physical",
		level = "E4",
		instrument = "the supported physical console / ten-foot path",
		proves = "gamepad delivery, overscan and console frame work",
		cannotProve = "mobile device behavior or subjective feel",
	},
}

perf_runner.EVIDENCE_CLASSES = EVIDENCE_CLASSES

local noNumber: number? = nil

local DEVICE_CLASSES: { [string]: boolean } = {
	["desktop-retail"] = true,
	["phone-physical"] = true,
	["console-physical"] = true,
}
perf_runner.DEVICE_CLASSES = DEVICE_CLASSES

perf_runner.CLASS = "lute"
perf_runner.LEVEL = "E1"

local PHYSICAL_REQUIRED_METRICS = {
	{ "updateMs", "M2_updateMs" },
	{ "instances", "M3_instances" },
	{ "connections", "M4_connections" },
	{ "memoryKb", "M5_memory", "memory" },
	{ "inputToVisibleMs", "M6_inputToCommittedWrite" },
}

function perf_runner.provenanceProblems(row: any): { string }
	local problems = {}
	if type(row) ~= "table" then
		return { "row is not a table" }
	end
	if DEVICE_CLASSES[row.evidenceClass] ~= true then
		return problems
	end
	if row.evidenceLevel ~= "E4" then
		table.insert(
			problems,
			`evidenceLevel is {tostring(row.evidenceLevel)}; every physical class is published as E4 and E3 is the Studio level`
		)
	end

	local provenance = if type(row.provenance) == "table" then row.provenance else nil
	if provenance == nil then
		table.insert(
			problems,
			"carries no `provenance` block; a physical row has to say affirmatively what measured it"
		)
	else
		if provenance.isStudio ~= false then
			table.insert(problems, "provenance.isStudio must be the boolean false, stated, not absent")
		end
		if provenance.clientKind ~= "retail" then
			table.insert(problems, `provenance.clientKind is {tostring(provenance.clientKind)}; expected "retail"`)
		end
		for _, field in { "instrument", "deviceModel", "capturedAt", "attestedBy" } do
			local value = provenance[field]
			if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then
				table.insert(problems, `provenance.{field} is missing or empty`)
			end
		end
	end
	local identity = if type(row.identity) == "table" then row.identity else {}
	if identity.studioVersion ~= nil then
		table.insert(
			problems,
			`carries identity.studioVersion '{tostring(identity.studioVersion)}'; a retail client on real hardware has none`
		)
	end
	local device = if type(row.device) == "table" then row.device else {}
	local live = if type(device.live) == "table" then device.live else {}
	if live.deviceId ~= nil then
		table.insert(
			problems,
			`carries device.live.deviceId '{tostring(live.deviceId)}'; that is a Studio device-simulator preset id`
		)
	end
	if type(live.source) == "string" and string.find(live.source, "StudioDeviceSimulator", 1, true) ~= nil then
		table.insert(problems, `device.live.source names the Studio device simulator: '{live.source}'`)
	end

	if type(live.scalingMode) == "string" and string.find(live.scalingMode, "DeviceSimulator", 1, true) ~= nil then
		table.insert(problems, `device.live.scalingMode is a Studio simulator value: '{live.scalingMode}'`)
	end

	if
		provenance ~= nil
		and type(provenance.deviceModel) == "string"
		and provenance.deviceModel ~= ""
		and type(device.name) == "string"
		and device.name ~= ""
		and provenance.deviceModel ~= device.name
	then
		table.insert(
			problems,
			`provenance.deviceModel '{provenance.deviceModel}' disagrees with device.name '{device.name}'`
		)
	end
	local metrics = if type(row.metrics) == "table" then row.metrics else {}
	local frameWork = metrics.frameWorkMs or metrics.M1_frameWorkMs
	if type(frameWork) ~= "table" or frameWork.measured ~= true then
		table.insert(problems, "carries no MEASURED frame-work metric (M1)")
	else
		local p95 = frameWork.p95_ms
		if type(p95) ~= "number" or p95 ~= p95 or p95 < 0 then
			table.insert(problems, `M1 p95_ms is {tostring(p95)}; a device row needs a finite, non-negative number`)
		end
	end
	for _, names in PHYSICAL_REQUIRED_METRICS do
		local found = false
		for _, name in names do
			if metrics[name] ~= nil then
				found = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not found then
			table.insert(problems, `metric {names[1]} is absent; an absent metric reads as a free one`)
		end
	end
	return problems
end

local DEFAULT_WARMUP = 60
local DEFAULT_SAMPLES = 240

local function blind(reason: string): any
	return { measured = false, reason = reason }
end
perf_runner.blind = blind

local function nowIso(): string
	return os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") :: string
end

local function hostOs(): string
	return `{system.os}/{system.arch}`
end

local function slope(ys: { number }): number
	local n = #ys
	if n < 2 then
		return 0
	end
	local sx, sy, sxx, sxy = 0, 0, 0, 0
	for i = 1, n do
		local x = i
		sx += x
		sy += ys[i]
		sxx += x * x
		sxy += x * ys[i]
	end
	local denom = n * sxx - sx * sx
	if denom == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return (n * sxy - sx * sy) / denom
end

type AsyncStats = { dropped: number, stale: number, completed: number }
function perf_runner.runScene(scene: any, profile: any, opts: any?): any
	local warmup = (opts and opts.warmup) or scene.warmup or DEFAULT_WARMUP
	local samples: number = (opts and opts.samples) or scene.samples or DEFAULT_SAMPLES
	local afterRun: ((unknown) -> ())? = scene.afterRun
	local asyncStats: ((unknown) -> AsyncStats)? = scene.asyncStats
	local extrasOf: ((unknown) -> unknown)? = scene.extras
	local teardown: ((unknown) -> ())? = scene.teardown
	local auditing = opts ~= nil and opts.memory == true
	if auditing then
		Compose.inspect.start({ maxOwners = math.huge, maxNodes = math.huge })
	end

	local state = scene.setup(profile)

	for _ = 1, warmup do
		scene.run(state)
		if afterRun then
			afterRun(state)
		end
	end

	local phaseSamples: { [string]: { number } } = { total = table.create(samples, noNumber) }
	local heapSeries: { number } = table.create(samples, noNumber)
	local resourceSeries = {}
	local function resources(): { instances: number, connections: number, registrations: number }
		local native = state.engine.census()
		local snapshot = Compose.inspect.snapshot()
		assert(snapshot.active and snapshot.droppedOwners == 0 and snapshot.droppedNodes == 0)
		local registrations = 0
		for _, roots in { snapshot.mounts, snapshot.detached } do
			for _, owner in roots do
				registrations += owner.totalHolding
			end
		end
		return { instances = native.live, connections = native.connections, registrations = registrations }
	end
	local resourceStart = if auditing then resources() else nil

	local heapFloorKb = gcinfo()

	local wallStart = os.clock()
	for i = 1, samples do
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local phases = scene.run(state)
		local total = os.clock() - t0
		phaseSamples.total[i] = total * 1000
		if phases ~= nil then
			for name, seconds in phases do
				local bucket = phaseSamples[name]
				if bucket == nil then
					bucket = table.create(samples, noNumber)
					phaseSamples[name] = bucket
				end
				table.insert(bucket, seconds * 1000)
			end
		end
		if afterRun then
			local settleStart = os.clock()
			afterRun(state)
			local bucket = phaseSamples.settle or {}
			phaseSamples.settle = bucket
			table.insert(bucket, (os.clock() - settleStart) * 1000)
		end
		heapSeries[i] = gcinfo()
		if auditing then
			table.insert(resourceSeries, resources())
		end
	end
	local wallSeconds = os.clock() - wallStart
	local allocGrowthKb = gcinfo() - heapFloorKb

	local registrations: any = blind("the scene exposes no Compose application owner")
	local owner = if type(state.core) == "table" then state.core.owner else nil
	if type(owner) == "table" then
		registrations = Compose.owner.size(owner)
	end
	local instances: any = blind("scene exposes no native engine boundary")
	local adapterHandlers: any = blind("native engine connection allocation requires engine capture")
	local liveConnections: any = registrations
	if state.engine and state.target then
		instances = #state.target:GetDescendants()
		local environment = state.engine.environment
		local connections = environment.connectionsOf(state.engine.heartbeat)
			+ environment.connectionsOfInstance(state.target)
		for _, node in state.target:GetDescendants() do
			connections += environment.connectionsOfInstance(node)
		end
		liveConnections = connections
	end

	local async: AsyncStats = { dropped = 0, stale = 0, completed = 0 }
	if asyncStats ~= nil then
		async = asyncStats(state)
	end

	local extras: any = nil
	if extrasOf ~= nil then
		extras = extrasOf(state)
	end

	if teardown ~= nil then
		teardown(state)
	end
	local resourceEnd = if auditing then resources() else nil
	if auditing then
		Compose.inspect.stop()
	end

	local phases: { [string]: any } = {}
	for name, bucket in phaseSamples do
		local summary = Verify.performance.summarize({
			samples = bucket,
			unit = "ms",
			context = { environment = "facet-lute", signal = name, timing = "observed" },
		})
		phases[name] = {
			p50_ms = summary.p50 or 0,
			p95_ms = summary.p95 or 0,
			p99_ms = summary.p99 or 0,
			samples = #bucket,
		}
	end

	local inputToVisible: any
	if phases.inputToVisible ~= nil then
		inputToVisible = {
			measured = true,
			p50_ms = phases.inputToVisible.p50_ms,
			p95_ms = phases.inputToVisible.p95_ms,
			p99_ms = phases.inputToVisible.p99_ms,
			note = "action dispatch -> committed visible property write, one synchronous chain; "
				.. "no frame, no scan-out — an upper bound on Facet's share only",
		}
	else
		inputToVisible = blind("scene drives no input")
	end

	return {
		scene = scene.name,
		requirement = scene.requirement,
		dataset = scene.dataset,

		evidenceClass = perf_runner.CLASS,
		evidenceLevel = perf_runner.LEVEL,

		device = profile.name,
		deviceTitle = profile.title,
		viewport = table.clone(profile.viewport),
		preferredInput = profile.preferredInput,
		displaySize = profile.displaySize,
		frameTargetHz = profile.frameTargetHz,
		quality = QUALITY,

		engine = ENGINE,
		host = hostOs(),
		timestamp = nowIso(),

		warmup = warmup,
		samples = samples,
		samplingMs = wallSeconds * 1000,

		phases = phases,

		metrics = {
			frameWorkMs = blind("headless Lute renders no frame; M1 requires an engine session"),
			updateMs = {
				measured = true,
				instrumented = auditing,
				p50_ms = phases.total.p50_ms,
				p95_ms = phases.total.p95_ms,
				p99_ms = phases.total.p99_ms,
			},
			instances = instances,
			connections = {
				measured = false,
				reason = "Compose owns reactive registrations; native Engine connections require engine capture.",
				adapterHandlers = adapterHandlers,
				reactiveRegistrations = registrations,
				note = "Compose owns reactive registrations; engine connections require native capture.",
			},
			memoryKb = {
				measured = true,
				heapFloorKb = heapFloorKb,
				allocRateKbPerSec = if wallSeconds > 0 then allocGrowthKb / wallSeconds else 0,
				heapSlopeKbPerIter = slope(heapSeries),
			},
			inputToVisibleMs = inputToVisible,
			themeSwap = if extras ~= nil and extras.themeSwap ~= nil
				then extras.themeSwap
				else blind("scene swaps no theme"),
		},

		allocRateKbPerSec = if wallSeconds > 0 then allocGrowthKb / wallSeconds else 0,
		heapSlopeKbPerIter = slope(heapSeries),
		liveRegistry = { registrations = registrations },
		liveConnections = liveConnections,
		resources = if auditing
			then {
				method = "instrumented pass with the scene warmup, sample count, workload and afterRun unchanged",
				start = resourceStart,
				iterations = resourceSeries,
				teardown = resourceEnd,
				churn = scene.memoryChurn == true,
			}
			else nil,
		async = async,
		extras = extras,

		deviceRun = false,
		authoritative = false,
		deviceMeasurement = {
			measured = false,
			note = "on-device capture goes here (phase/percentile numbers + build)",
			phases = nil,
		},
		note = HEADLESS_NOTE,
	}
end

function perf_runner.run(scenes: { any }, profiles: { any }, opts: any?): any
	local auditOnly = opts and opts.timing == false
	assert(not auditOnly or opts.memory == true, "an audit-only run requires resource measurements")
	local runs = {}
	for _, scene in scenes do
		for _, profile in profiles do
			local settings = if opts then table.clone(opts) else nil
			if settings and not auditOnly then
				settings.memory = nil
			end
			local row = perf_runner.runScene(scene, profile, settings)
			if opts and opts.memory and not auditOnly then
				local settings = table.clone(opts)
				settings.memory = true
				row.resources = perf_runner.runScene(scene, profile, settings).resources
			end
			table.insert(runs, row)
		end
	end

	local present: { [string]: number } = {}
	for _, r in runs do
		present[r.evidenceClass] = (present[r.evidenceClass] or 0) + 1
	end
	local classes = {}
	for _, c in perf_runner.EVIDENCE_CLASSES do
		local entry = table.clone(c)
		entry.rows = present[c.id] or 0
		table.insert(classes, entry)
	end
	return {
		schema = "facet-perf/2",
		environment = {
			engine = ENGINE,
			host = hostOs(),
			quality = QUALITY,
			timestamp = nowIso(),
			evidenceClass = perf_runner.CLASS,
			evidenceLevel = perf_runner.LEVEL,
			deviceRun = false,
			authoritative = false,
			note = HEADLESS_NOTE,
		},

		evidenceClasses = classes,
		referenceProfile = nil,
		runs = runs,
	}
end

function perf_runner.ceilingMsFor(frameTargetHz: number, uiShare: number): number
	assert(frameTargetHz > 0, "frameTargetHz must be positive")
	return (1000 / frameTargetHz) * uiShare
end

function perf_runner.checkBudgets(report: any, budgets: any, referenceTiming: boolean?): any
	local ref = budgets.referenceProfile
	local violations: {
		{
			kind: "foreign-reference-row"
				| "trend"
				| "frame-ceiling"
				| "class-mismatch"
				| "unmeasured-device-row"
				| "device",
			scene: string,
			device: string,
			requirement: string,
			observedMs: number,
			budgetMs: number,
			hint: string,
		}
	} =
		{}
	local skipped = {}

	local byScene: { [string]: any } = {}
	local displaced: { any } = {}
	for _, r in report.runs do
		if referenceTiming == false then
			continue
		end
		if r.device == ref then
			if DEVICE_CLASSES[r.evidenceClass] == true then
				table.insert(displaced, { scene = r.scene, evidenceClass = r.evidenceClass })
			else
				assert(
					not (r.metrics and r.metrics.updateMs and r.metrics.updateMs.instrumented == true),
					"historical timing budgets require uninstrumented scene rows"
				)
				byScene[r.scene] = r
			end
		end
	end

	for _, d in displaced do
		table.insert(violations, {
			kind = "foreign-reference-row" :: "foreign-reference-row",
			scene = d.scene,
			device = ref,
			requirement = "UI-PERF-002",
			observedMs = -1,
			budgetMs = 0,
			hint = `a row of class '{tostring(d.evidenceClass)}' names the reference device '{ref}' for scene `
				.. `'{tostring(d.scene)}'. Only headless rows are the trend reference; a device row cannot stand in `
				.. `for the run it would displace.`,
		})
	end
	for scene, budget in budgets.scenes do
		if referenceTiming == false then
			continue
		end
		local run = byScene[scene]
		if run == nil then
			table.insert(violations, {
				kind = "trend" :: "trend",
				scene = scene,
				device = ref,
				requirement = budget.requirement,
				observedMs = -1,
				budgetMs = budget.total_p95_ms,
				hint = `no reference-device run recorded for scene '{scene}' — is it registered in bench/perf_scenes.luau?`,
			})
		else
			local observed = run.phases.total.p95_ms
			if observed > budget.total_p95_ms then
				table.insert(violations, {
					kind = "trend" :: "trend",
					scene = scene,
					device = ref,
					requirement = budget.requirement,
					observedMs = observed,
					budgetMs = budget.total_p95_ms,
					hint = budget.hint,
				})
			end

			if budget.ceilingMs ~= nil and observed > budget.ceilingMs then
				table.insert(violations, {
					kind = "frame-ceiling" :: "frame-ceiling",
					scene = scene,
					device = ref,
					requirement = budget.requirement,
					observedMs = observed,
					budgetMs = budget.ceilingMs,
					hint = `scene '{scene}' costs more than {budget.ceilingMs}ms — the share of a `
						.. `{budget.frameTargetHz}Hz frame Facet may occupy — on a host FASTER than every `
						.. `supported device, so it cannot hold the frame target anywhere. Fix the scene's `
						.. `hot path; re-baselining does not make this one go away.`,
				})
			end
		end
	end

	for className, budget in (budgets.deviceBudgets or {}) do
		local rows: { DeviceRow } = {}
		for _, r in report.runs do
			if r.evidenceClass == className then
				table.insert(rows, r)
			end
		end
		if budget.measured ~= true then
			table.insert(skipped, {
				class = className,
				reason = "budget declared but not yet measured on that hardware (PENDING_PHYSICAL)",
				budgetMs = budget.budgetMs,
			})
		elseif #rows == 0 then
			table.insert(violations, {
				kind = "class-mismatch" :: "class-mismatch",
				scene = "*",
				device = className,
				requirement = budget.requirement or "UI-PERF-002",
				observedMs = -1,
				budgetMs = budget.budgetMs,

				hint = `device budget '{className}' cannot be enforced: this report contains no rows of `
					.. `that evidence class (it has {#report.runs} rows, class `
					.. `'{if report.environment ~= nil then tostring(report.environment.evidenceClass) else "unstated"}'). `
					.. `Emulator or headless data must never fill a physical row.`,
			})
		else
			for _, r in rows do
				local frameWork = r.metrics and r.metrics.frameWorkMs
				local observed = if type(frameWork) == "table" and frameWork.measured == true
					then frameWork.p95_ms
					else nil

				if type(observed) == "number" and (observed ~= observed or observed < 0) then
					observed = nil
				end
				if type(observed) ~= "number" then
					table.insert(violations, {
						kind = "unmeasured-device-row" :: "unmeasured-device-row",
						scene = r.scene or "*",
						device = className,
						requirement = budget.requirement or "UI-PERF-002",
						observedMs = -1,
						budgetMs = budget.budgetMs,
						hint = `a row labelled '{className}' carries no usable measured frame work (absent, blind, `
							.. `negative or NaN), so it cannot satisfy `
							.. `that device's budget. A device budget is met by a NUMBER, not by an evidence-class `
							.. `string — relabelling a row has never been, and must never become, a way to pass.`,
					})
				elseif observed > budget.budgetMs then
					table.insert(violations, {
						kind = "device" :: "device",
						scene = r.scene,
						device = className,
						requirement = budget.requirement or "UI-PERF-002",
						observedMs = observed,
						budgetMs = budget.budgetMs,
						hint = `scene '{r.scene}' exceeded the {className} frame budget`,
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return { ok = #violations == 0, violations = violations, skipped = skipped }
end

return perf_runner
