8) const senderIp = readIp(frame, payload + 14) const targetIp = readIp(frame, payload + 24) self.arp[ipString(senderIp)] = senderMac if op ~= 1 or not sameIp(targetIp, self.ip) then return end const reply = buffer.create(28) writeBE16(reply, 0, 1) writeBE16(reply, 2, ETH_IPV4) buffer.writeu8(reply, 4, 6) buffer.writeu8(reply, 5, 4) writeBE16(reply, 6, 2) writeMac(reply, 8, self.mac) writeIp(reply, 14, self.ip) writeMac(reply, 18, senderMac) writeIp(reply, 24, senderIp) sendEther(self, senderMac, ETH_ARP, reply) end local function handleIcmp(self: Isp, srcMac: Mac, srcIp: Ip, payload: buffer) if buffer.len(payload) < 8 or buffer.readu8(payload, 0) ~= 8 then return end const reply = buffer.create(buffer.len(payload)) buffer.copy(reply, 0, payload, 0, buffer.len(payload)) buffer.writeu8(reply, 0, 0) buffer.writeu8(reply, 1, 0) writeBE16(reply, 2, 0) writeBE16(reply, 2, checksum(reply, 0, buffer.len(reply))) sendIpv4(self, srcMac, srcIp, IP_ICMP, reply) end local function dhcpReply(self: Isp, srcMac: Mac, payload: buffer, messageType: number) if buffer.len(payload) < 240 then return end const xid = readBE32(payload, 4) const flags = readBE16(payload, 10) const clientMac = readMac(payload, 28) const reply = buffer.create(300) buffer.writeu8(reply, 0, 2) buffer.writeu8(reply, 1, 1) buffer.writeu8(reply, 2, 6) buffer.writeu8(reply, 3, 0) writeBE32(reply, 4, xid) writeBE16(reply, 8, 0) writeBE16(reply, 10, flags) writeIp(reply, 12, { 0, 0, 0, 0 }) writeIp(reply, 16, self.clientIp) writeIp(reply, 20, self.ip) writeIp(reply, 24, { 0, 0, 0, 0 }) writeMac(reply, 28, clientMac) writeBE32(reply, 236, 0x63825363) local offset = 240 local function option(code: number, value: string) buffer.writeu8(reply, offset, code) buffer.writeu8(reply, offset + 1, #value) for index = 1, #value do buffer.writeu8(reply, offset + 1 + index, string.byte(value, index) :: number) end offset += 2 + #value end option(53, string.char(messageType)) option(54, string.char(self.ip[1], self.ip[2], self.ip[3], self.ip[4])) option(51, string.char(0, 0, 0x0E, 0x10)) option(1, string.char(self.netmask[1], self.netmask[2], self.netmask[3], self.netmask[4])) option(3, string.char(self.ip[1], self.ip[2], self.ip[3], self.ip[4])) option(6, string.char(self.dns[1], self.dns[2], self.dns[3], self.dns[4])) option(15, self.hostname) buffer.writeu8(reply, offset, 0) offset += 1 const out = buffer.create(offset) buffer.copy(out, 0, reply, 0, offset) sendUdp(self, srcMac, { 255, 255, 255, 255 }, 67, 68, out) end local function handleDhcp(self: Isp, srcMac: Mac, payload: buffer) if buffer.len(payload) < 240 or buffer.readu8(payload, 0) ~= 1 then return end local messageType = 0 local offset = 240 while offset < buffer.len(payload) do const code = buffer.readu8(payload, offset) if code == 0 then break end const length = buffer.readu8(payload, offset + 1) if code == 53 and length >= 1 then messageType = buffer.readu8(payload, offset + 2) break end offset += 2 + length end if messageType == 1 then dhcpReply(self, srcMac, payload, 2) -- OFFER elseif messageType == 3 then dhcpReply(self, srcMac, payload, 5) -- ACK end end local function readDnsName(buf: buffer, offset: number): (string, number) local labels: { string } = {} local cursor = offset while cursor < buffer.len(buf) do const length = buffer.readu8(buf, cursor) if length == 0 then cursor += 1 break end if band(length, 0xC0) == 0xC0 then cursor += 2 break end if cursor + 1 + length > buffer.len(buf) then break end local label = "" for index = 1, length do label ..= string.char(buffer.readu8(buf, cursor + index)) end labels[#labels + 1] = label cursor += 1 + length end return table.concat(labels, "."), cursor end local function handleDns(self: Isp, srcMac: Mac, srcIp: Ip, srcPort: number, payload: buffer) if buffer.len(payload) < 12 then return end const question, questionEnd = readDnsName(payload, 12) if question == "" or questionEnd + 4 > buffer.len(payload) then return end const qtype = readBE16(payload, questionEnd) if qtype ~= 1 then return end const answerStart = questionEnd + 4 const answer = buffer.create(answerStart + 16) buffer.copy(answer, 0, payload, 0, answerStart) writeBE16(answer, 2, 0x8180) writeBE16(answer, 4, 1) writeBE16(answer, 6, 1) writeBE16(answer, 8, 0) writeBE16(answer, 10, 0) buffer.writeu8(answer, answerStart, 0xC0) buffer.writeu8(answer, answerStart + 1, 0x0C) writeBE16(answer, answerStart + 2, 1) writeBE16(answer, answerStart + 4, 1) writeBE32(answer, answerStart + 6, 60) writeBE16(answer, answerStart + 10, 4) writeIp(answer, answerStart + 12, { 10, 0, 2, 80 }) sendUdp(self, srcMac, srcIp, 53, srcPort, answer) end local function seqAdd(seq: number, count: number): number return band(seq + count, 0xFFFFFFFF) end local function seqLess(a: number, b: number): boolean return band(a - b, 0xFFFFFFFF) > 0x80000000 end local function tcpChecksum(srcIp: Ip, dstIp: Ip, segment: buffer): number const length = buffer.len(segment) const pseudo = buffer.create(12 + length) writeIp(pseudo, 0, srcIp) writeIp(pseudo, 4, dstIp) buffer.writeu8(pseudo, 8, 0) buffer.writeu8(pseudo, 9, IP_TCP) writeBE16(pseudo, 10, length) buffer.copy(pseudo, 12, segment, 0, length) return checksum(pseudo, 0, 12 + length) end local function sendTcp( self: Isp, destMac: Mac, destIp: Ip, srcPort: number, dstPort: number, seq: number, ack: number, flags: number, window: number, payload: buffer ) const segment = buffer.create(20 + buffer.len(payload)) writeBE16(segment, 0, srcPort) writeBE16(segment, 2, dstPort) writeBE32(segment, 4, seq) writeBE32(segment, 8, ack) buffer.writeu8(segment, 12, 0x50) buffer.writeu8(segment, 13, flags) writeBE16(segment, 14, window) writeBE16(segment, 16, 0) writeBE16(segment, 18, 0) buffer.copy(segment, 20, payload, 0, buffer.len(payload)) writeBE16(segment, 16, tcpChecksum(self.ip, destIp, segment)) sendIpv4(self, destMac, destIp, IP_TCP, segment) end local function connectionKey( guestIp: Ip, guestPort: number, serverIp: Ip, serverPort: number ): string return ("%s:%d->%s:%d"):format(ipString(guestIp), guestPort, ipString(serverIp), serverPort) end local function bufferToString(buf: buffer): string local chars = table.create(buffer.len(buf)) for index = 1, buffer.len(buf) do chars[index] = string.char(buffer.readu8(buf, index - 1)) end return table.concat(chars) end local REASONS: { [number]: string } = { [200] = "OK", [400] = "Bad Request", [404] = "Not Found", [405] = "Method Not Allowed", [500] = "Internal Server Error", } local function defaultHttpResponse(self: Isp, request: HttpRequest): HttpResponse if request.method ~= "GET" and request.method ~= "HEAD" then return { status = 405, body = "Method Not Allowed", contentType = "text/plain" } end if request.path == "/" or request.path == "/index.html" then return { status = 200, body = self.httpBody, contentType = self.httpContentType } end return { status = 404, body = "Not Found", contentType = "text/plain" } end local function buildHttpResponse(self: Isp, request: HttpRequest): string local response: HttpResponse if self.httpHandler then response = self.httpHandler(request) else response = defaultHttpResponse(self, request) end const status = response.status or 200 const body = response.body or "" const contentType = response.contentType or "text/html" const reason = REASONS[status] or "Error" local text = ("HTTP/1.0 %d %s\r\n"):format(status, reason) text ..= ("Content-Type: %s\r\n"):format(contentType) text ..= ("Content-Length: %d\r\n"):format(#body) text ..= "Connection: close\r\n\r\n" if request.method ~= "HEAD" then text ..= body end return text end local function sendHttpResponse( self: Isp, conn: TcpConnection, destMac: Mac, destIp: Ip, text: string ) const payload = buffer.fromstring(text) sendTcp( self, destMac, destIp, conn.serverPort, conn.guestPort, conn.sndNxt, conn.rcvNxt, bor(TCP_ACK, TCP_PSH), TCP_WINDOW, payload ) conn.sndNxt = seqAdd(conn.sndNxt, buffer.len(payload)) sendTcp( self, destMac, destIp, conn.serverPort, conn.guestPort, conn.sndNxt, conn.rcvNxt, bor(TCP_ACK, TCP_FIN), TCP_WINDOW, buffer.create(0) ) conn.sndNxt = seqAdd(conn.sndNxt, 1) conn.state = "fin_wait" conn.httpSent = true conn.lastActivity = self.now end local function processHttp(self: Isp, conn: TcpConnection, destMac: Mac, destIp: Ip): boolean if conn.httpSent then return false end const marker = string.find(conn.requestText, "\r\n\r\n", 1, true) if not marker then return false end const head = string.sub(conn.requestText, 1, marker - 1) const requestLine = string.match(head, "^([^\r\n]*)") or "" const headerText = string.match(head, "^[^\r\n]*\r?\n(.*)$") or "" const method, rawPath, version = string.match(requestLine, "^(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)") if not method or not rawPath or not version then -- A malformed request still gets a deterministic HTTP error. const response = "HTTP/1.0 400 Bad Request\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: 11\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\nBad Request" sendHttpResponse(self, conn, destMac, destIp, response) return true end const headers: { [string]: string } = {} for line in string.gmatch(headerText or "", "([^\r\n]+)") do const name, value = string.match(line, "^([^:]+):%s*(.*)$") if name then headers[string.lower(name)] = value end end local path = string.match(rawPath, "^[^?]*") or rawPath const request: HttpRequest = { method = string.upper(method), path = path, version = version, headers = headers, } const text = buildHttpResponse(self, request) sendHttpResponse(self, conn, destMac, destIp, text) return true end local function sendDuplicateAck(self: Isp, conn: TcpConnection, destMac: Mac, destIp: Ip) sendTcp( self, destMac, destIp, conn.serverPort, conn.guestPort, conn.sndNxt, conn.rcvNxt, TCP_ACK, TCP_WINDOW, buffer.create(0) ) end local function sendReset(self: Isp, srcMac: Mac, srcIp: Ip, payload: buffer) if buffer.len(payload) < 20 then return end const srcPort = readBE16(payload, 0) const dstPort = readBE16(payload, 2) const seq = readBE32(payload, 4) const ack = readBE32(payload, 8) const dataOffset = rshift(buffer.readu8(payload, 12), 4) * 4 const flags = buffer.readu8(payload, 13) const dataLength = math.max(0, buffer.len(payload) - dataOffset) local seqOut, ackOut, flagsOut if band(flags, TCP_ACK) ~= 0 then seqOut, ackOut, flagsOut = ack, 0, TCP_RST else const consumed = dataLength + (if band(flags, TCP_SYN) ~= 0 then 1 else 0) + (if band(flags, TCP_FIN) ~= 0 then 1 else 0) seqOut, ackOut, flagsOut = 0, seqAdd(seq, consumed), bor(TCP_RST, TCP_ACK) end sendTcp( self, srcMac, srcIp, dstPort, srcPort, seqOut, ackOut, flagsOut, TCP_WINDOW, buffer.create(0) ) end local function handleTcp(self: Isp, srcMac: Mac, srcIp: Ip, payload: buffer) if buffer.len(payload) < 20 then return end const srcPort = readBE16(payload, 0) const dstPort = readBE16(payload, 2) const seq = readBE32(payload, 4) const ack = readBE32(payload, 8) const dataOffset = rshift(buffer.readu8(payload, 12), 4) * 4 if dataOffset < 20 or dataOffset > buffer.len(payload) then return end const flags = buffer.readu8(payload, 13) const window = readBE16(payload, 14) if tcpChecksum(srcIp, self.ip, payload) ~= 0 then return end const dataLength = buffer.len(payload) - dataOffset const data = buffer.create(dataLength) if dataLength > 0 then buffer.copy(data, 0, payload, dataOffset, dataLength) end const key = connectionKey(srcIp, srcPort, self.ip, dstPort) local conn = self.tcp[key] if band(flags, TCP_RST) ~= 0 then if conn then self.tcp[key] = nil end return end if not conn then if band(flags, TCP_SYN) ~= 0 and dstPort == TCP_HTTP_PORT then const serverSeq = self.nextTcpSeq self.nextTcpSeq = seqAdd(self.nextTcpSeq, 0x10000) conn = { guestIp = srcIp, guestPort = srcPort, serverIp = self.ip, serverPort = dstPort, state = "syn_received", sndUna = serverSeq, sndNxt = seqAdd(serverSeq, 1), sndWnd = TCP_WINDOW, rcvNxt = seqAdd(seq, 1), guestWnd = window, requestText = "", httpSent = false, lastActivity = self.now, } self.tcp[key] = conn sendTcp( self, srcMac, srcIp, conn.serverPort, conn.guestPort, serverSeq, conn.rcvNxt, bor(TCP_SYN, TCP_ACK), TCP_WINDOW, buffer.create(0) ) return end sendReset(self, srcMac, srcIp, payload) return end conn.lastActivity = self.now conn.guestWnd = window if conn.state == "syn_received" then if band(flags, TCP_SYN) ~= 0 then sendTcp( self, srcMac, srcIp, conn.serverPort, conn.guestPort, conn.sndUna, conn.rcvNxt, bor(TCP_SYN, TCP_ACK), TCP_WINDOW, buffer.create(0) ) return end if band(flags, TCP_ACK) ~= 0 and ack == conn.sndNxt then conn.state = "established" conn.sndUna = ack else return end end if band(flags, TCP_ACK) ~= 0 then if seqLess(conn.sndUna, ack) and not seqLess(conn.sndNxt, ack) then conn.sndUna = ack end if conn.state == "fin_wait" and ack == conn.sndNxt then conn.state = "time_wait" conn.lastActivity = self.now elseif conn.state == "last_ack" and ack == conn.sndNxt then conn.state = "closed" end end if dataLength > 0 then if seq == conn.rcvNxt then conn.rcvNxt = seqAdd(conn.rcvNxt, dataLength) conn.requestText ..= bufferToString(data) const responded = processHttp(self, conn, srcMac, srcIp) if not responded then sendDuplicateAck(self, conn, srcMac, srcIp) end else sendDuplicateAck(self, conn, srcMac, srcIp) end elseif band(flags, TCP_FIN) ~= 0 then if seq == conn.rcvNxt then conn.rcvNxt = seqAdd(conn.rcvNxt, 1) sendTcp( self, srcMac, srcIp, conn.serverPort, conn.guestPort, conn.sndNxt, conn.rcvNxt, TCP_ACK, TCP_WINDOW, buffer.create(0) ) if conn.state == "fin_wait" then conn.state = "time_wait" elseif conn.state == "established" then sendTcp( self, srcMac, srcIp, conn.serverPort, conn.guestPort, conn.sndNxt, conn.rcvNxt, bor(TCP_ACK, TCP_FIN), TCP_WINDOW, buffer.create(0) ) conn.sndNxt = seqAdd(conn.sndNxt, 1) conn.state = "last_ack" end else sendDuplicateAck(self, conn, srcMac, srcIp) end end end local function handleIpv4(self: Isp, frame: buffer) if buffer.len(frame) < 34 then return end const offset = 14 const version = band(buffer.readu8(frame, offset), 0xF0) if version ~= 0x40 then return end const headerLength = band(buffer.readu8(frame, offset), 0x0F) * 4 if headerLength < 20 or 14 + headerLength > buffer.len(frame) then return end if checksum(frame, offset, headerLength) ~= 0 then return end const totalLength = readBE16(frame, offset + 2) if totalLength < headerLength or 14 + totalLength > buffer.len(frame) then return end const protocol = buffer.readu8(frame, offset + 9) const srcIp = readIp(frame, offset + 12) const destIp = readIp(frame, offset + 16) const srcMac = readMac(frame, 6) const payload = buffer.create(totalLength - headerLength) buffer.copy(payload, 0, frame, offset + headerLength, totalLength - headerLength) if protocol == IP_ICMP then handleIcmp(self, srcMac, srcIp, payload) elseif protocol == IP_UDP then if buffer.len(payload) < 8 then return end const srcPort = readBE16(payload, 0) const dstPort = readBE16(payload, 2) const body = buffer.create(buffer.len(payload) - 8) buffer.copy(body, 0, payload, 8, buffer.len(body)) if dstPort == 67 then handleDhcp(self, srcMac, body) elseif dstPort == 53 then handleDns(self, srcMac, srcIp, srcPort, body) end elseif protocol == IP_TCP then if sameIp(destIp, self.ip) then handleTcp(self, srcMac, srcIp, payload) end end end function Isp.receive(self: Isp, frame: buffer) if buffer.len(frame) < 14 then return end const dest = readMac(frame, 0) if not sameMac(dest, self.mac) and not sameMac(dest, broadcastMac()) then return end const etherType = readBE16(frame, 12) if etherType == ETH_ARP then handleArp(self, frame) elseif etherType == ETH_IPV4 then handleIpv4(self, frame) end end return Isp

-- BrainrotFactory: owns building brainrot models from recipes, their signs and auras, idle part animation, and head-carry/pickup magic.
-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: Factory.animate, Factory.freeze, Factory.create, Factory.standOn, Factory.weldAboveHead, Factory.drop, Factory.remove, Factory.rehangSign
--!strict

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Cast = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Cast"))

type Entry = Cast.Entry

local SIGN_WIDTH = 7
local SIGN_HEIGHT = 3.4
local SIGN_DEPTH = 0.2
local SIGN_GAP = 9

local CHARCOAL = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 36)
local PLATE = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 64)
local INCOME = Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 130)
local NAME_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 248)

local RARITY_COLOR: { [string]: Color3 } = {
	Common = Color3.fromRGB(206, 210, 218),
	Uncommon = Color3.fromRGB(46, 184, 138),
	Rare = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 255),
	Epic = Color3.fromRGB(186, 110, 255),
	Legendary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 48),
	Mythic = Color3.fromRGB(230, 48, 48),
	["Ultra Rare"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 64),
}

local RAINBOW = ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 70)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, Color3.fromRGB(70, 220, 110)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, Color3.fromRGB(70, 150, 255)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(190, 90, 255)),
})

-- partAABB: measures one part's world-space bounding box from its eight corners.
-- Returns the (min, max) corner Vector3 pair.
local function partAABB(piece: BasePart): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local cf = piece.CFrame
	local half = piece.Size / 2
	local minV = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	local maxV = Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
	for x = -1, 1, 2 do
		for y = -1, 1, 2 do
			for z = -1, 1, 2 do
				local corner = cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(half.X * x, half.Y * y, half.Z * z))
				minV = Vector3.new(math.min(minV.X, corner.X), math.min(minV.Y, corner.Y), math.min(minV.Z, corner.Z))
				maxV = Vector3.new(math.max(maxV.X, corner.X), math.max(maxV.Y, corner.Y), math.max(maxV.Z, corner.Z))
			end
		end
	end
	return minV, maxV
end

-- bodyAABB: measures the combined world-space bounds of every model part except the NameSign.
-- Returns the (min, max) corner Vector3 pair.
local function bodyAABB(model: Model): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local minV = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	local maxV = Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Name ~= "NameSign" then
			local low, high = partAABB(descendant)
			minV = Vector3.new(math.min(minV.X, low.X), math.min(minV.Y, low.Y), math.min(minV.Z, low.Z))
			maxV = Vector3.new(math.max(maxV.X, high.X), math.max(maxV.Y, high.Y), math.max(maxV.Z, high.Z))
		end
	end
	return minV, maxV
end

-- scaleModel: uniformly scales every part's size and position about the origin.
-- Returns nothing; mutates the model in place.
local function scaleModel(model: Model, scale: number)
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Size *= scale
			descendant.CFrame = CFrame.new(descendant.Position * scale) * (descendant.CFrame - descendant.Position)
		end
	end
end

-- === display effects ===
-- addAura: builds the rarity aura particles on the anchor, plus gold light, rainbow trail and beam for kraken_emas.
-- Returns nothing; parents effects to the anchor.
local function addAura(anchor: BasePart, entry: Entry)
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "AuraAttachment"
	attachment.Parent = anchor

	local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	particles.Name = "Aura"
	particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(entry.aura)
	particles.LightEmission = 0.2
	particles.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.55, 1.3)
	particles.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.25, 1)
	particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.0, 1.4)
	particles.Rate = 10
	particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.3)
	particles.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25)
	particles.Parent = attachment

	if entry.id ~= "kraken_emas" then
		return
	end

	particles.Size = NumberSequence.new(1.8, 3.6)
	particles.Rate = 16
	particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.8)

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Name = "GoldLight"
	light.Color = GOLD
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Range = 10
	light.Parent = anchor

	local left = Instance.new("Attachment")
	left.Name = "TrailLeft"
	left.Position = Vector3.new(-0.4, -0.2, 1.5)
	left.Parent = anchor
	local right = Instance.new("Attachment")
	right.Name = "TrailRight"
	right.Position = Vector3.new(-0.4, -0.2, -1.5)
	right.Parent = anchor

	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Name = "RainbowTrail"
	trail.Attachment0 = left
	trail.Attachment1 = right
	trail.Lifetime = 1.6
	trail.MinLength = 0.05
	trail.FaceCamera = true
	trail.LightEmission = 0.4
	trail.LightInfluence = 0
	trail.Color = RAINBOW
	trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(1)
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.05, 1)
	trail.Parent = anchor

	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Name = "RainbowBeam"
	beam.Attachment0 = left
	beam.Attachment1 = right
	beam.Color = RAINBOW
	beam.LightEmission = 0.3
	beam.LightInfluence = 0
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.Width0 = 1.15
	beam.Width1 = 1.15
	beam.Segments = 12
	beam.CurveSize0 = 2.4
	beam.CurveSize1 = -2.4
	beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.3)
	beam.Parent = anchor
end

-- addFlame: builds the Paus Api blowhole flame emitter and orange point light.
-- Returns nothing; parents effects to the anchor.
local function addFlame(model: Model, anchor: BasePart)
	local hole = model:FindFirstChild("Blowhole")
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "BlowholeFlame"
	if hole and hole:IsA("BasePart") then
		attachment.Position = anchor.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hole.Position + Vector3.new(0, hole.Size.Y / 2, 0))
	else
		attachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, anchor.Size.Y / 2, 0)
	end
	attachment.Parent = anchor

	local flame = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	flame.Name = "Flame"
	flame.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 120), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 16))
	flame.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.55, 0.08)
	flame.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.05, 1)
	flame.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.7)
	flame.Rate = 16
	flame.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 4)
	flame.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(14, 14)
	flame.LightEmission = 0.3
	flame.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
	flame.Parent = attachment

	local glow = Instance.new("PointLight")
	glow.Name = "FlameLight"
	glow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40)
	glow.Brightness = 1
	glow.Range = 8
	glow.Parent = anchor
end

-- formatIncome: formats an income amount with comma thousands separators.
-- Returns the grouped digit string.
local function formatIncome(amount: number): string
	local digits = tostring(math.floor(amount))
	local grouped = digits:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()
	if string.sub(grouped, 1, 1) == "," then
		grouped = string.sub(grouped, 2)
	end
	return grouped
end

-- === name sign ===
-- makeLabel: builds one centred GothamBold TextLabel row for the name sign.
-- Returns the unparented TextLabel.
local function makeLabel(name: string, text: string, textSize: number, color: Color3, order: number): TextLabel
	local row = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	row.Name = name
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, textSize + 8)
	row.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	row.Text = text
	row.TextColor3 = color
	row.TextSize = textSize
	row.TextScaled = false
	row.TextWrapped = false
	row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	row.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	row.LayoutOrder = order
	return row
end

-- buildFace: builds one SurfaceGui face of the name sign (Locked strip, name, rarity, income).
-- Returns nothing; parents the gui to the sign.
local function buildFace(sign: BasePart, face: Enum.NormalId, entry: Entry)
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Name = if face == Enum.NormalId.Front then "Front" else "Back"
	gui.Face = face
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Brightness = 2
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	gui.PixelsPerStud = 150
	gui.Parent = sign

	local plate = Instance.new("Frame")
	plate.Name = "Plate"
	plate.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	plate.BackgroundColor3 = PLATE
	plate.BorderSizePixel = 0
	plate.Parent = gui

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = plate

	local locked = makeLabel("Locked", "LOCKED", 68, Color3.fromRGB(42, 28, 4), 1)
	locked.BackgroundColor3 = GOLD
	locked.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	locked.Visible = false
	locked.Parent = plate

	makeLabel("Name", entry.name, 104, NAME_COLOR, 2).Parent = plate
	makeLabel("Rarity", entry.rarity, 68, RARITY_COLOR[entry.rarity] or NAME_COLOR, 3).Parent = plate
	makeLabel("Income", string.format("+$%s/s", formatIncome(entry.income)), 68, INCOME, 4).Parent = plate
end

-- setLocked: sets the Locked attribute and shows or hides the LOCKED strip on both sign faces.
-- Returns nothing.
local function setLocked(model: Model, locked: boolean)
	model:SetAttribute("Locked", locked)
	local sign = model:FindFirstChild("NameSign")
	if not sign then
		return
	end
	for _, faceName in { "Front", "Back" } do
		local gui = sign:FindFirstChild(faceName)
		local plate = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Plate")
		local strip = plate and plate:FindFirstChild("Locked")
		if strip and strip:IsA("GuiObject") then
			strip.Visible = locked
		end
	end
end

-- showLocked: re-applies the model's current Locked attribute to its sign.
-- Returns nothing.
local function showLocked(model: Model)
	setLocked(model, model:GetAttribute("Locked") == true)
end

-- buildSign: builds the anchored NameSign part above the model's bounds with front and back faces.
-- Returns the sign BasePart.
local function buildSign(model: Model, entry: Entry, minV: Vector3, maxV: Vector3): BasePart
	local sign = Instance.new("Part")
	sign.Name = "NameSign"
	sign.Size = Vector3.new(SIGN_WIDTH, SIGN_HEIGHT, SIGN_DEPTH)
	sign.Color = CHARCOAL
	sign.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	sign.Anchored = true
	sign.CanCollide = false
	sign.CanQuery = false
	sign.Massless = true
	sign.CastShadow = false
	local centerX = (minV.X + maxV.X) / 2
	local centerZ = (minV.Z + maxV.Z) / 2
	sign.CFrame = CFrame.new(centerX, maxV.Y + SIGN_GAP + SIGN_HEIGHT / 2, centerZ)
	sign.Parent = model

	buildFace(sign, Enum.NormalId.Front, entry)
	buildFace(sign, Enum.NormalId.Back, entry)
	return sign
end

-- === welding ===
-- weldTo: welds another part to the root with a WeldConstraint.
-- Returns nothing.
local function weldTo(root: BasePart, other: BasePart)
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = other
	weld.Parent = root
end

-- weldAssembly: welds every other part in the model to the root.
-- Returns nothing.
local function weldAssembly(model: Model, root: BasePart)
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant ~= root then
			weldTo(root, descendant)
		end
	end
end

-- Factory: the module's public table.
-- Owns: building brainrot Models from a Cast entry's recipe (parts, height scale, NameSign with
--   Locked/name/rarity/income faces, rarity aura, kraken_emas gold light and rainbow trail/beam,
--   paus_api blowhole flame, welds); the idle animation registry (idleRecords, idleList) ticked
--   on one Heartbeat connection at most IDLE_BUDGET (200) models per step; head carry via the
--   CarryWeld Motor6D and CarryShadow disc; dropping back to workspace; sign rehanging.
-- Refuses: create errors (assert) when a recipe has no Body part; animate ignores models already
--   registered, a non-string BrainrotId or an id with no species animation; freeze ignores
--   unregistered models; weldAboveHead does nothing without a Head/HumanoidRootPart or a
--   PrimaryPart; rehangSign does nothing without a PrimaryPart or a Cast.getById entry.
--   It never reads player data, ownership, money or bases; its only dependency is Cast.
-- Returns: this Factory table; create returns the new Model, every other function returns nothing.
local Factory = {}

local IDLE_BUDGET = 200
local idleList: { Model } = {}

type Anim = {
	parts: { BasePart },
	bases: { CFrame },
	kind: string,
	speed: number,
	amp: number,
	ring: BasePart?,
	ringBase: CFrame?,
	spin: number,
}

type IdleRecord = {
	anim: Anim,
	model: Model,
}

local idleRecords: { [Model]: IdleRecord } = {}
local idleTicker: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

-- === geometry measurement ===
-- makeAnim: builds an idle animation record, capturing each part's base CFrame.
-- Returns the Anim table.
local function makeAnim(kind: string, parts: { BasePart }, speed: number, amp: number): Anim
	local bases: { CFrame } = {}
	for i, part in parts do
		bases[i] = part.CFrame
	end
	return {
		parts = parts,
		bases = bases,
		kind = kind,
		speed = speed,
		amp = amp,
		ring = nil,
		ringBase = nil,
		spin = 0,
	}
end

-- collect: finds the named BaseParts in the model, in name order, skipping missing ones.
-- Returns the list of found BaseParts.
local function collect(model: Model, names: { string }): { BasePart }
	local found: { BasePart } = {}
	for _, name in names do
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(found, part)
		end
	end
	return found
end

-- buildAnim: builds the species-specific idle animation for a brainrot id.
-- Returns the Anim, or nil for an unknown id.
local function buildAnim(model: Model, id: string): Anim?
	if id == "ikan_terbang" then
		return makeAnim("fish", collect(model, { "Body", "WingL", "WingR", "WingTipL", "WingTipR" }), 2.2, 1)
	elseif id == "kepiting_disco" then
		local anim = makeAnim("crab", collect(model, { "Body", "ClawL", "ClawR", "PincerLUp", "PincerLLo", "PincerRUp", "PincerRLo" }), 1.6, 1)
		local disco = model:FindFirstChild("DiscoBall")
		if disco and disco:IsA("BasePart") then
			anim.ring = disco
			anim.ringBase = disco.CFrame
			anim.spin = 2.4
		end
		return anim
	elseif id == "penyu_turbo" then
		return makeAnim("turtle", collect(model, { "Body", "FlipperFL", "FlipperFR", "FlipperBL", "FlipperBR" }), 0.9, 1)
	elseif id == "gurita_dj" then
		return makeAnim("octopus", collect(model, { "Body", "Tentacle1", "Tentacle2", "Tentacle3", "Tentacle4", "Tentacle5", "Tentacle6" }), 1.4, 1)
	elseif id == "hiu_bajak_laut" then
		return makeAnim("shark", collect(model, { "Body", "TailTop", "TailBot", "PecL", "PecR" }), 1.8, 1)
	elseif id == "paus_api" then
		return makeAnim("whale", collect(model, { "Body", "FinL", "FinR", "FlukeL", "FlukeR" }), 0.8, 1)
	elseif id == "kraken_emas" then
		local anim = makeAnim(
			"kraken",
			collect(model, {
				"Body",
				"Arm1a", "Arm1b", "Arm2a", "Arm2b", "Arm3a", "Arm3b",
				"Arm4a", "Arm4b", "Arm5a", "Arm5b", "Arm6a", "Arm6b",
			}),
			1.1,
			1
		)
		local crown = model:FindFirstChild("CrownBand")
		if crown and crown:IsA("BasePart") then
			anim.ring = crown
			anim.ringBase = crown.CFrame
			anim.spin = 1.2
		end
		return anim
	end
	return nil
end

local spinAccum: { [Anim]: number } = {}

-- tickSpin: advances the accumulated spin angle of an animation's ring part.
-- Returns the new angle in radians.
local function tickSpin(anim: Anim, dt: number): number
	local now = (spinAccum[anim] or 0) + dt * anim.spin
	spinAccum[anim] = now
	return now
end

-- tickAnim: poses one model's animated parts for time t and spins its ring.
-- Returns nothing.
local function tickAnim(anim: Anim, t: number, dt: number)
	local k = anim.kind
	local parts = anim.parts
	local bases = anim.bases
	local amp = anim.amp
	local s = t * anim.speed
	if k == "fish" then
		local flap = math.sin(s * 2) * 0.32
		local tilt = math.sin(s * 0.7) * 0.14
		for i = 1, #parts do
			local base = bases[i]
			local wobble = flap * amp
			if i == 1 then
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, tilt)
			else
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(wobble * (if i <= 3 then 1 else 1.4), 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, math.sin(s * 0.7) * 0.02)
			end
		end
	elseif k == "crab" then
		local open = (math.sin(s * 1.5) + 1) * 0.5
		local bob = math.sin(s * 0.6) * 0.06
		for i = 1, #parts do
			local base = bases[i]
			if i == 1 then
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, bob, 0)
			elseif i == 2 or i == 3 then
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(open * 10), 0, math.rad(open * (if i == 2 then 12 else -12)))
			else
				local sign = if string.find(parts[i].Name, "R", 1, true) then -1 else 1
				local vert = if string.find(parts[i].Name, "Up", 1, true) then 1 else -1
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(vert * open * 18 * sign), 0, 0)
			end
		end
	elseif k == "turtle" then
		local stroke = math.sin(s) * 0.35
		local sway = math.sin(s * 0.4) * 0.05
		for i = 1, #parts do
			local base = bases[i]
			if i == 1 then
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(0, sway, 0)
			else
				local side = if string.find(parts[i].Name, "R", 1, true) then -1 else 1
				local vert = if string.find(parts[i].Name, "F", 1, true) then 1 else 0.7
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.sin(s + vert) * 14 * amp), 0, math.rad(stroke * side * 10 * vert))
			end
		end
	elseif k == "octopus" then
		local pulse = math.sin(s * 1.2) * 0.08
		for i = 1, #parts do
			local base = bases[i]
			if i == 1 then
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, pulse, 0)
			else
				local wave = math.sin(s * 1.6 + (i - 2) * 0.9) * 0.32
				local side = if (i % 2) == 0 then 1 else -1
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(wave * amp, 0, side * wave * 0.5)
			end
		end
	elseif k == "shark" then
		local sway = math.sin(s) * 0.22
		for i = 1, #parts do
			local base = bases[i]
			if i == 1 then
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(0, sway * 0.4, 0)
			elseif i <= 3 then
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(0, sway * amp, 0)
			else
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(s + 0.5) * 0.12, sway * 0.5, 0)
			end
		end
	elseif k == "whale" then
		local bob = math.sin(s) * 0.18
		local fan = math.sin(s * 0.8) * 0.22
		for i = 1, #parts do
			local base = bases[i]
			if i == 1 then
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, bob, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(bob * 6), 0, 0)
			elseif i <= 3 then
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, fan * amp * (if i == 2 then 1 else -1))
			else
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.sin(s * 0.9) * 10), 0, 0)
			end
		end
	elseif k == "kraken" then
		local bob = math.sin(s * 0.5) * 0.1
		for i = 1, #parts do
			local base = bases[i]
			if i == 1 then
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, bob, 0)
			else
				local seq = math.sin(s * 1.3 - (i - 2) * 0.55)
				local curl = seq * 0.28 * amp
				parts[i].CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(curl, seq * 0.12, curl * 0.6) * CFrame.new(0, math.abs(seq) * 0.05, 0)
			end
		end
	end
	if anim.ring and anim.ringBase then
		local angle = tickSpin(anim, dt)
		anim.ring.CFrame = anim.ringBase * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)
	end
end

local spinAccum: { [Anim]: number } = {}
local idleCursor = 1

-- stepIdle: Heartbeat step that ticks idle models within IDLE_BUDGET and prunes dead entries.
-- Returns nothing.
local function stepIdle(dt: number)
	local budget = IDLE_BUDGET
	local t = os.clock()
	local visited = 0
	local total = #idleList
	if total == 0 then
		return
	end
	if idleCursor > total then
		idleCursor = 1
	end
	while visited < total and budget > 0 do
		local index = idleCursor
		local model = idleList[index]
		local record = idleRecords[model]
		visited += 1
		if record and model.Parent then
			tickAnim(record.anim, t, dt)
			budget -= 1
			idleCursor = index + 1
			if idleCursor > #idleList then
				idleCursor = 1
			end
		else
			if record then
				idleRecords[model] = nil
			end
			local last = #idleList
			if index ~= last then
				idleList[index] = idleList[last]
			else
				idleCursor = 1
			end
			idleList[last] = nil
			if idleCursor > #idleList then
				idleCursor = 1
			end
			total = #idleList
			if total == 0 then
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

-- === idle animation ===
-- startIdle: connects the Heartbeat idle ticker once.
-- Returns nothing.
local function startIdle()
	if idleTicker then
		return
	end
	idleTicker = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(stepIdle)
end

-- === public api ===
-- Factory.animate: registers a model for idle animation by its BrainrotId attribute.
-- Returns nothing.
function Factory.animate(model: Model)
	if idleRecords[model] then
		return
	end
	local id = model:GetAttribute("BrainrotId")
	if typeof(id) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local anim = buildAnim(model, id)
	if not anim then
		return
	end
	idleRecords[model] = { anim = anim, model = model }
	table.insert(idleList, model)
	startIdle()
end

-- Factory.freeze: stops a model's idle animation.
-- Returns nothing.
function Factory.freeze(model: Model)
	if not idleRecords[model] then
		return
	end
	idleRecords[model] = nil
end

-- Factory.create: builds the full brainrot Model for an entry (parts, scale, effects, sign, welds, idle).
-- Returns the new Model, placed on the given position.
function Factory.create(entry: Entry, position: Vector3): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = entry.name
	model:SetAttribute("BrainrotId", entry.id)
	model:SetAttribute("Rarity", entry.rarity)
	model:SetAttribute("Income", entry.income)
	model:SetAttribute("Locked", false)

	local root: BasePart? = nil
	for _, spec in entry.recipe do
		local piece = Instance.new("Part")
		piece.Name = spec.name
		piece.Shape = spec.shape
		piece.Size = spec.size
		piece.Color = spec.color
		piece.Material = spec.material
		piece.Anchored = true
		piece.CanCollide = false
		piece.CFrame = spec.offset
		piece.Parent = model
		if spec.name == "Body" then
			root = piece
		end
	end
	assert(root, "recipe needs a Body part")

	local minV, maxV = bodyAABB(model)
	local measured = math.max(maxV.Y - minV.Y, 0.001)
	scaleModel(model, entry.height / measured)

	if entry.id == "paus_api" then
		addFlame(model, root)
	end
	addAura(root, entry)

	minV, maxV = bodyAABB(model)
	local sign = buildSign(model, entry, minV, maxV)
	model.PrimaryPart = root

	local centerX = (minV.X + maxV.X) / 2
	local centerZ = (minV.Z + maxV.Z) / 2
	model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(position.X - centerX, position.Y - minV.Y, position.Z - centerZ))

	weldAssembly(model, root)
	sign.Anchored = false
	root.CanCollide = true

	model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Locked"):Connect(function()
		showLocked(model)
	end)
	setLocked(model, model:GetAttribute("Locked") == true)

	Factory.animate(model)

	return model
end

-- Factory.standOn: moves a model so its lowest point rests on top of a surface.
-- Returns nothing.
function Factory.standOn(model: Model, surface: BasePart)
	local minV = bodyAABB(model)
	local surfaceTop = surface.Position.Y + surface.Size.Y / 2
	model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, surfaceTop - minV.Y, 0))
end

-- addCarryShadow: builds the translucent black CarryShadow disc welded under a carried model.
-- Returns nothing.
local function addCarryShadow(model: Model)
	local anchor = model.PrimaryPart
	if not anchor then
		return
	end
	local old = model:FindFirstChild("CarryShadow")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local minV, maxV = bodyAABB(model)
	local shadow = Instance.new("Part")
	shadow.Name = "CarryShadow"
	shadow.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	shadow.Size = Vector3.new(0.04, math.max(maxV.X - minV.X, 1) * 0.9, math.max(maxV.Z - minV.Z, 1) * 0.9)
	shadow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	shadow.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	shadow.Transparency = 0.42
	shadow.Anchored = false
	shadow.CanCollide = false
	shadow.CanQuery = false
	shadow.CanTouch = false
	shadow.Massless = true
	shadow.CastShadow = false
	shadow.CFrame = CFrame.new((minV.X + maxV.X) / 2, minV.Y - 0.02, (minV.Z + maxV.Z) / 2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	shadow.Parent = model
	weldTo(anchor, shadow)
end

-- Factory.weldAboveHead: unanchors the model and attaches it above a character's head with a CarryWeld Motor6D.
-- Returns nothing; reparents the model to the character.
function Factory.weldAboveHead(model: Model, character: Model)
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not (head and head:IsA("BasePart")) then
		head = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end
	local anchor = model.PrimaryPart
	if not (head and head:IsA("BasePart")) or not anchor then
		return
	end
	local old = anchor:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local characterHead = character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
	if characterHead then
		local oldMotor = characterHead:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld")
		if oldMotor then
			oldMotor:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = false
		end
	end
	local minV, maxV = bodyAABB(model)
	local headTop = head.Position.Y + head.Size.Y / 2
	local delta = Vector3.new(head.Position.X - (minV.X + maxV.X) / 2, (headTop + 2) - minV.Y, head.Position.Z - (minV.Z + maxV.Z) / 2)
	model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() + delta)
	local carryMotor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	carryMotor.Name = "CarryWeld"
	carryMotor.Part0 = head
	carryMotor.Part1 = anchor
	carryMotor.C0 = CFrame.new(0, head.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(8), 0, 0)
	carryMotor.C1 = CFrame.identity
	carryMotor.Parent = anchor
	model.Parent = character
	addCarryShadow(model)
end

-- stripCarry: removes the CarryWeld joints and the CarryShadow from a carried model.
-- Returns nothing.
local function stripCarry(model: Model, anchor: BasePart)
	local carry = anchor:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld")
	if carry then
		carry:Destroy()
	end
	local head = anchor.Parent
	if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
		local leftover = head:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld")
		if leftover then
			leftover:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local shadow = model:FindFirstChild("CarryShadow")
	if shadow then
		shadow:Destroy()
	end
end

-- Factory.drop: releases a carried model, unanchors it and returns it to workspace.
-- Returns nothing.
function Factory.drop(model: Model)
	local anchor = model.PrimaryPart
	if anchor then
		stripCarry(model, anchor)
	end
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = false
		end
	end
	if anchor then
		anchor.CanCollide = true
	end
	model.Parent = workspace
end

-- Factory.remove: stops idle animation and destroys the model.
-- Returns nothing.
function Factory.remove(model: Model)
	Factory.freeze(model)
	model:Destroy()
end

-- Factory.rehangSign: rebuilds the NameSign above the model and welds it to the anchor.
-- Returns nothing.
function Factory.rehangSign(model: Model)
	local anchor = model.PrimaryPart
	local brainrotId = model:GetAttribute("BrainrotId")
	local entry = if typeof(brainrotId) == "string" then Cast.getById(brainrotId) else nil
	if not anchor or not entry then
		return
	end
	local existing = model:FindFirstChild("NameSign")
	if existing then
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	for _, child in anchor:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("WeldConstraint") and child.Name ~= "CarryWeld" and child.Part1 == nil then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local minV, maxV = bodyAABB(model)
	local sign = buildSign(model, entry, minV, maxV)
	local rotation = anchor.CFrame - anchor.CFrame.Position
	sign.CFrame = CFrame.new(sign.Position) * rotation
	sign.Anchored = false
	weldTo(anchor, sign)
	setLocked(model, model:GetAttribute("Locked") == true)
end

return Factory

type ComposeRuntime = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").ComposeRuntime)
type OrderedControls = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").OrderedControls)
type ReadOnlyValue<T> = typeof(require("@repo/src/vendor/compose/core").accumulator<<T, number>>(nil :: never))
type Use = <T>(ReadOnlyValue<T>) -> T
local Facet = require("../src")
local VerifyRoblox = require("../tools/vendor/verify/src/roblox")
local Compose: ComposeModule = Facet.Compose

type RampState = {
	read Host: RobloxHost,

	read frame: (number?) -> (),
}
type BenchRow = { id: string, name: string }
type BenchSort = { column: string, direction: "ascending" | "descending" }

export type Scenario = {
	name: string,
	requirement: string,
	setup: () -> any,
	run: (any) -> (),
	teardown: ((any) -> ())?,
	samples: number?,
	warmup: number?,
}

local scenarios: { Scenario } = {}
local function add(
	name: string,
	setup: () -> any,
	run: (any) -> (),
	options: { requirement: string?, teardown: ((any) -> ())?, samples: number?, warmup: number? }?
)
	local scenario: Scenario = {
		name = name,
		requirement = if options and options.requirement then options.requirement else "UI-PERF-001",
		setup = setup,
		run = run,
		teardown = options and options.teardown,
		samples = options and options.samples,
		warmup = options and options.warmup,
	}
	scenario.name = name
	scenario.requirement = scenario.requirement or "UI-PERF-001"
	scenario.setup = setup
	scenario.run = run
	scenario.teardown = scenario.teardown or function(state)
		state.dispose()
	end
	table.insert(scenarios, scenario)
end

local function reactive(setup: ({ [string]: any }) -> ()): { [string]: any }
	local state: { [string]: any } = {}
	local root = Compose.createRootOwner(function(owner)
		state.owner = owner
		setup(state)
	end)
	state.dispose = root.dispose
	return state
end

		local label = Compose.formula(function(use: Use)

		end)

		end)

add("collection-mutation", function()
	return reactive(function(state)
		state.items, state.keys, state.n = {}, {}, 50
		state.apply = function(keys: { string })
			local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
			for _, key in keys do
				wanted[key] = true
			end
			for key, owner in state.items do
				if not wanted[key] then
					Compose.owner.dispose(owner)
					state.items[key] = nil
				end
			end
			for _, key in keys do
				if state.items[key] == nil then
					local owner = Compose.owner.createChild(state.owner)
					Compose.withOwner(owner, function()
						Compose.cell(key)
					end)
					state.items[key] = owner
				end
			end
		end
		for index = 1, 50 do
			state.keys[index] = `item-{index}`
		end
		state.apply(state.keys)
	end)
end, function(state)
	local keys = state.keys
	table.insert(keys, table.remove(keys, 1))
	state.n += 1
	keys[#keys] = `item-{state.n}`
	state.apply(keys)
end, { requirement = "UI-RUNTIME-002" })

	local world = nativeApp()
	local items: { BenchRow } = {}

			from = rows,

local function rampTree(Host: RobloxHost, depth: number, index: number): GuiObject
	if depth == 0 then
		return Host.TextLabel { Name = `T{index}`, Text = "leaf" }
	end
	local children: { Name: string, [number]: Child } = { Name = `V{index}`, Host.UIListLayout {} }
	for child = 1, 3 do
		table.insert(children, rampTree(Host, depth - 1, child))
	end
	return Host.Frame((children :: unknown) :: FrameProps)
end
local rampSetup: () -> RampState = nativeApp
for _, inherited in { false, true } do
	add(if inherited then "mount-ramp-inherited" else "mount-ramp", rampSetup, function(state: RampState)
		local stop = state.runtime.mount(function(): ScreenGui
			local color = if inherited
				then state.types.Color3.fromRGB(119, 190, 255)
				else state.types.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			local group: CanvasGroup = state.Host.CanvasGroup {
				Interactable = not inherited,
				GroupColor3 = color,
				rampTree(state.Host, 7, 1),
			}
			return state.Host.ScreenGui { group }
		end, state.target)
		stop()
		state.frame()
		assert(#state.target:GetChildren() == 0, "mount ramp leaked a screen")
	end, { samples = 60, warmup = 5 })
end

local function descendant(node: Instance, className: string): Instance?
	for _, child in node:GetChildren() do
		if child.ClassName == className then
			return child
		end
		local found = descendant(child, className)
		if found then
			return found
		end
	end
	return nil
end
add("table-resize-drag", function()
	local world = tableState(true)
	world.drag = assert(descendant(world.tableNode, "UIDragDetector"), "Table resize detector is missing")
	world.engine.environment.poke(world.drag.Parent.Parent, "AbsoluteSize", world.types.Vector2.new(600, 40))
	return world
end, function(state)
	state.n += 1
	local direction = if state.n % 2 == 0 then 1 else -1
	local initialWidth = state.widths:peek().name
	state.engine.environment.poke(state.drag.Parent.Parent, "AbsoluteSize", state.types.Vector2.new(initialWidth, 40))
	state.drag.DragStart:Fire(state.types.Vector2.new(600, 10))
	for index = 1, 8 do
		state.drag.DragContinue:Fire(state.types.Vector2.new(600 + direction * index * 5, 10))
		state.frame()
	end
	state.drag.DragEnd:Fire(state.types.Vector2.new(600 + direction * 40, 10))
	assert(state.widths:peek().name == initialWidth + direction * 40, "resize workload did not update its column")
	state.frame()
end)

	local world = nativeApp()

	world.runtime.mount(function()
		local children: ScreenGuiProps = {}
		for index = 1, 64 do
			local timer = world.UI.Timer { start = 0 }
			children[index] = timer
			if index == 1 then
				label = timer
			end
		end
		return world.Host.ScreenGui(children)
	end, world.target)
	world.frame()
	return {
		frame = world.frame,
		now = assert(world.runtime.host.frames).now,
		label = assert(label),
		dispose = world.dispose,
	}
end, function(state)
	for _ = 1, 6 do
		state.frame(1 / 60)
	end
	assert(state.label.Text == Facet.format.duration(state.now()), "timer readout did not follow its clock")
end, { requirement = "UI-PERF-001", samples = 500, warmup = 50 })

add("zz-yardstick-cpu", function()
	return { buf = table.create(256, 0), dispose = function() end }
end, function(state)
	local buf, acc = state.buf, 0.0
	for _ = 1, 200 do
		for index = 1, 256 do
			acc += (index * 1.000173) / 3.7
			local remainder = index % 7
			if remainder == 0 then
				acc -= 0.5
			elseif remainder == 3 then
				acc += 0.25
			end
			buf[index] = buf[index] * 0.5 + acc
		end
		acc %= 1000000
	end
	buf[1] = if acc > 0 then 1.0 else -1.0
end)
for _, automatic in { false, true } do
	add(if automatic then "motion-declarative" else "motion-explicit", function()
		return authoringMotion(automatic)
	end, function(state)
		state.run()
	end)
end
table.sort(scenarios, function(a: Scenario, b: Scenario)
	return a.name < b.name
end)
return scenarios

--!strict
-- Kbc.lua -- 8042 keyboard controller with PS/2 keyboard and mouse.
--
-- The 8042 exposes status/data at 0x64/0x60. Host input is injected through
-- pressKey/releaseKey/mouseMove; the controller queues set-1 make/break codes
-- (or 3-byte PS/2 mouse packets) and raises IRQ1/IRQ12. Guest commands are
-- acknowledged with 0xFA so SeaBIOS's keyboard self-test and mouse init finish.

const band, bor = bit32.band, bit32.bor

const Kbc = {}
Kbc.__index = Kbc

const STATUS_OBF = 0x01
const STATUS_SYS = 0x04
const STATUS_AUX = 0x20

export type QueueEntry = {
	value: number,
	aux: boolean,
}

export type Kbc = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		queue: { QueueEntry },
		config: number,
		command: number?,
		pendingData: number?,
		keyboardEnabled: boolean,
		mouseEnabled: boolean,
		irq1: boolean,
		irq12: boolean,
		irq1Armed: boolean,
		irq12Armed: boolean,
		lastStatus: number,
		trace: { string },
		in8: (self: Kbc, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Kbc, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		pressKey: (self: Kbc, scancode: number) -> (),
		releaseKey: (self: Kbc, scancode: number) -> (),
		mouseMove: (self: Kbc, dx: number, dy: number, buttons: number?) -> (),
		takeIrq1: (self: Kbc) -> boolean,
		takeIrq12: (self: Kbc) -> boolean,
		reset: (self: Kbc) -> (),
	},
	Kbc
))

function Kbc.new(): Kbc
	local self = setmetatable({}, Kbc) :: any
	self.queue = {}
	self.config = 0x45 -- translation, keyboard and mouse IRQs enabled
	self.command = nil
	self.pendingData = nil
	self.keyboardEnabled = true
	self.mouseEnabled = true
	self.irq1 = false
	self.irq12 = false
	self.irq1Armed = false
	self.irq12Armed = false
	self.lastStatus = 0
	self.trace = {}
	return self
end

function Kbc.reset(self: Kbc)
	self.queue = {}
	self.config = 0x45
	self.command = nil
	self.pendingData = nil
	self.keyboardEnabled = true
	self.mouseEnabled = true
	self.irq1 = false
	self.irq12 = false
	self.irq1Armed = false
	self.irq12Armed = false
	self.lastStatus = 0
end

local function status(self: Kbc): number
	local value = STATUS_SYS
	if #self.queue > 0 then
		value = bor(value, STATUS_OBF)
	end
	const first = self.queue[1]
	if first and first.aux then
		value = bor(value, STATUS_AUX)
	end
	-- IBF is a momentary host->controller latch. The controller consumes a
	-- command/parameter before the next status read, so SeaBIOS must not see it
	-- stuck (its i8042_wait_write loop would never issue the parameter byte).
	return value
end

local function queueByte(self: Kbc, value: number, aux: boolean)
	self.queue[#self.queue + 1] = { value = band(value, 0xFF), aux = aux }
	if aux then
		if band(self.config, 0x02) ~= 0 then
			self.irq12 = true
			self.irq12Armed = true
		end
	else
		if band(self.config, 0x01) ~= 0 then
			self.irq1 = true
			self.irq1Armed = true
		end
	end
end

local function mousePacket(self: Kbc, dx: number, dy: number, buttons: number)
	local x = math.max(-128, math.min(127, math.floor(dx)))
	local y = math.max(-128, math.min(127, math.floor(dy)))
	local flags = bor(0x08, band(buttons, 0x07))
	if x < 0 then
		x += 256
		flags = bor(flags, 0x10)
	end
	if y < 0 then
		y += 256
		flags = bor(flags, 0x20)
	end
	queueByte(self, flags, true)
	queueByte(self, x, true)
	queueByte(self, y, true)
end

function Kbc.pressKey(self: Kbc, scancode: number)
	if not self.keyboardEnabled then
		return
	end
	queueByte(self, band(scancode, 0x7F), false)
end

function Kbc.releaseKey(self: Kbc, scancode: number)
	if not self.keyboardEnabled then
		return
	end
	queueByte(self, bor(0x80, band(scancode, 0x7F)), false)
end

function Kbc.mouseMove(self: Kbc, dx: number, dy: number, buttons: number?)
	if not self.mouseEnabled then
		return
	end
	mousePacket(self, dx, dy, buttons or 0)
end

function Kbc.takeIrq1(self: Kbc): boolean
	if band(self.config, 0x01) == 0 or not self.irq1Armed then
		return false
	end
	for _, entry in self.queue do
		if not entry.aux then
			self.irq1Armed = false
			return true
		end
	end
	self.irq1Armed = false
	return false
end

function Kbc.takeIrq12(self: Kbc): boolean
	if band(self.config, 0x02) == 0 or not self.irq12Armed then
		return false
	end
	for _, entry in self.queue do
		if entry.aux then
			self.irq12Armed = false
			return true
		end
	end
	self.irq12Armed = false
	return false
end

function Kbc.in8(self: Kbc, port: number): number
	if port == 0x64 then
		const value = status(self)
		self.lastStatus = value
		return value
	end
	if port == 0x60 then
		const entry = table.remove(self.queue, 1)
		if entry then
			if not entry.aux then
				-- One keyboard byte per IRQ1. If more make/break bytes are
				-- queued, arm the next edge now so it is delivered after EOI.
				for _, queued in self.queue do
					if not queued.aux then
						self.irq1Armed = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
			return entry.value
		end
		return 0xFF
	end
	return 0xFF
end

local function guestKeyboardByte(self: Kbc, value: number)
	if self.pendingData == 0xED then
		self.pendingData = nil
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
		return
	end
	if self.pendingData == 0xF0 then
		self.pendingData = nil
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
		return
	end
	if value == 0xED or value == 0xF0 then
		self.pendingData = value
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
	elseif value == 0xFF then
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
		queueByte(self, 0xAA, false)
		self.keyboardEnabled = true
	else
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
	end
end

local function guestMouseByte(self: Kbc, value: number)
	if value == 0xF4 or value == 0xFF then
		self.mouseEnabled = true
	elseif value == 0xF5 then
		self.mouseEnabled = false
	end
	queueByte(self, 0xFA, true)
end

function Kbc.out8(self: Kbc, port: number, value: number)
	value = band(value, 0xFF)
	if #self.trace < 200 then
		self.trace[#self.trace + 1] = ("W%02X=%02X"):format(port, value)
	end
	if port == 0x60 then
		const command = self.pendingData
		if command == 0x60 then
			self.config = value
			self.pendingData = nil
		elseif command == 0xD4 then
			self.pendingData = nil
			guestMouseByte(self, value)
		elseif self.command == 0xD2 then
			self.command = nil
			queueByte(self, value, false)
		elseif self.command == 0xD3 then
			self.command = nil
			queueByte(self, value, true)
		else
			guestKeyboardByte(self, value)
		end
		return
	end
	if port ~= 0x64 then
		return
	end
	self.command = value
	if value == 0x20 then
		queueByte(self, self.config, false)
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0x60 then
		self.pendingData = 0x60
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xAA then
		queueByte(self, 0x55, false)
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xAB then
		queueByte(self, 0x00, false)
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xA9 then
		queueByte(self, 0x00, true)
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xAD then
		self.keyboardEnabled = false
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xAE then
		self.keyboardEnabled = true
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xA7 then
		self.mouseEnabled = false
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xA8 then
		self.mouseEnabled = true
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xD2 or value == 0xD3 then
		self.command = value
	elseif value == 0xD4 then
		self.pendingData = 0xD4
		self.command = nil
	elseif value == 0xFE then
		self:reset()
		queueByte(self, 0xFA, false)
		queueByte(self, 0xAA, false)
	else
		self.command = nil
	end
end

return Kbc

--!strict

local Core = require("../tools/vendor/verify/src/core")
local Eval = require("../tools/vendor/verify/src/agent-eval")

export type Identity = {
	suite: string,
	task: string,
	agent: string,
	adapter: string,
	model: string,
	seed: number,
	judgeModel: string,
}

local DEFAULT_IDENTITY: Identity = {
	suite = "facetbench-run",
	task = "run",
	agent = "codex-sol",
	adapter = "codex",
	model = "gpt-6.1-sol",
	seed = 1,
	judgeModel = "gpt-6.1-sol",
}
table.freeze(DEFAULT_IDENTITY)

local devices = { "desktop", "phone-portrait", "phone-landscape", "tablet", "console" }
local outcomes = {
	"hub",
	"driving",
	"queue",
	"race",
	"scoreboard",
	"results",
	"shop",
	"garage",
	"loadout",
	"drivers",
	"crates",
	"daily-rewards",
	"codes",
	"boosts",
	"quests",
	"offer",
	"mechanic",
	"settings",
	"livery",
	"voting",
	"quick-chat",
	"upgrades",
	"party",
	"tutorial",
	"authority",
	"persistence",
	"adaptation",
	"stability",
	"progression",
}
local screens = { "hub", "shop", "garage", "livery", "race", "results", "tutorial" }

local function positive(value: number?): number
	assert(value ~= nil and value > 0 and value < math.huge, "a finite positive measurement is required")
	return value
end

local function cases(results: { Eval.RunResult }, judgments: { Eval.Judgment }, identity: Identity?): { Core.NamedCase }
	local expected = identity or DEFAULT_IDENTITY
	local collection: { Core.NamedCase } = {}
	local function add(id: string, body: (Core.Context) -> ())
		table.insert(collection, { id = id, name = id, timeoutSeconds = 30, run = body })
	end
	local function arm(id: string): Eval.RunResult
		local found: Eval.RunResult? = nil
		for _, result in results do
			if result.arm == id then
				assert(found == nil, "the comparison requires exactly one " .. id .. " run")
				found = result
			end
		end
		assert(found, "missing " .. id .. " run")
		return found
	end
	add("pair/identity", function(t)
		t:expect(#results):toBe(2)
		for _, id in { "plain", "facet" } do
			local run = arm(id)
			t:expect(run.suite):toBe(expected.suite)
			t:expect(run.task):toBe(expected.task)
			t:expect(run.agent):toBe(expected.agent)
			t:expect(run.adapter):toBe(expected.adapter)
			t:expect(run.model):toBe(expected.model)
			t:expect(run.seed):toBe(expected.seed)
			t:expect(run.parent):toBe(nil)
		end
	end)
	add("facet/completion", function(t)
		local run = arm("facet")
		t:expect(run.status):toBe("completed")
		t:expect(run.passed):toBe(true)
		t:expect(run.checksPassed):toBe(true)
		t:expect(#run.exceeded):toBe(0)
		t:expect(positive(run.metrics.wallSeconds) <= 1800):toBe(true)
		for _, id in { "submission", "submission-unchanged" } do
			local found: Eval.CheckResult? = nil
			for _, check in run.checks do
				if check.id == id then
					assert(found == nil, "duplicate submission check")
					found = check
				end
			end
			assert(
				found and found.required and found.kind == "verify" and found.passed,
				"missing submission integrity: " .. id
			)
			t:expect(#found.cases):toBe(1)
			t:expect(found.cases[1].id):toBe("submission/unchanged")
			t:expect(found.cases[1].status):toBe("passed")
		end
	end)
	for _, device in devices do
		add("facet/behavior/" .. device, function(t)
			local statuses: { [string]: string } = {}
			local play: Eval.CheckResult? = nil
			for _, check in arm("facet").checks do
				if check.id == "play" then
					assert(play == nil, "duplicate player-outcome check")
					play = check
				end
			end
			assert(play and play.required and play.kind == "verify", "required Verify player-outcome check is missing")
			for _, outcome in play.cases do
				assert(statuses[outcome.id] == nil, "duplicate outcome: " .. outcome.id)
				statuses[outcome.id] = outcome.status
			end
			for _, outcome in outcomes do
				local id = device .. "/play/" .. outcome
				t:expect(statuses[id] == "passed"):toBeTrueWith("required player outcome: " .. id)
			end
		end)
	end
	add("cost/complete-usage", function(t)
		for _, id in { "plain", "facet" } do
			local run = arm(id)
			t:expect(run.status):toBe("completed")
			t:expect(run.session.usageSource ~= "none"):toBe(true)
			t:expect(run.session.malformed):toBe(0)
			local metrics = run.metrics
			positive(metrics.totalTokens)
			t:expect(metrics.totalTokens)
				:toBe(
					metrics.inputTokens + metrics.cacheCreationTokens + metrics.cacheReadTokens + metrics.outputTokens
				)
		end
	end)
	add("cost/tokens", function(t)
		local ratio = positive(arm("facet").metrics.totalTokens) / positive(arm("plain").metrics.totalTokens)
		t:expect(ratio <= 0.5):toBeTrueWith("Facet total tokens / Plain total tokens = " .. tostring(ratio))
	end)
	add("cost/wall", function(t)
		local ratio = positive(arm("facet").metrics.wallSeconds) / positive(arm("plain").metrics.wallSeconds)
		t:expect(ratio <= 0.6):toBeTrueWith("Facet author wall / Plain author wall = " .. tostring(ratio))
	end)
	add("cost/turn-latency", function(t)
		local facet = positive(Eval.stats.median(arm("facet").metrics.turnLatencies))
		local plain = positive(Eval.stats.median(arm("plain").metrics.turnLatencies))
		t:expect(facet < plain):toBeTrueWith("Facet median turn latency / Plain = " .. tostring(facet / plain))
	end)
	for _, device in devices do
		add("runtime/" .. device, function(t)
			local prefix = "play.perf." .. device .. "."
			local plain, facet = arm("plain").scores, arm("facet").scores
			for _, scores in { plain, facet } do
				t:expect(scores[prefix .. "returned"]):toBe(1)
				t:expect(scores[prefix .. "mountTimedOut"]):toBe(0)
				for _, metric in { "heapReturnRatio", "guiReturnRatio" } do
					t:expect(positive(scores[prefix .. metric]) < 1.05):toBeTrueWith(metric .. " retains less than 5%")
				end
			end
			for _, state in { "idle", "shop", "race" } do
				for _, scores in { plain, facet } do
					t:expect(positive(scores[prefix .. state .. ".frames"]) >= 120)
						:toBeTrueWith(state .. " needs 120 frames")
				end
				for _, percentile in { "p50", "p95" } do
					local key = prefix .. state .. "." .. percentile
					local ratio = positive(facet[key]) / positive(plain[key])
					t:expect(ratio < 1.05)
						:toBeTrueWith(state .. " " .. percentile .. " frame ratio = " .. tostring(ratio))
				end
			end
			for _, metric in { "finalHeapKb", "finalGuiMb" } do
				local ratio = positive(facet[prefix .. metric]) / positive(plain[prefix .. metric])
				t:expect(ratio < 1.05):toBeTrueWith(metric .. " ratio = " .. tostring(ratio))
			end
		end)
	end
	add("visual/coverage", function(t)
		for _, id in { "plain", "facet" } do
			local captures: { [string]: boolean } = {}
			for _, capture in arm(id).captures do
				assert(capture.size > 0 and #capture.sha256 == 64, "capture bytes need a content hash")
				captures[capture.device .. "/" .. capture.label] = true
			end
			for _, device in devices do
				for _, screen in screens do
					t:expect(captures[device .. "/" .. screen] == true)
						:toBeTrueWith(id .. "/" .. device .. "/" .. screen)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	add("visual/preference", function(t)
		local scores: { [string]: number } = {}
		for _, judgment in judgments do
			assert(
				judgment.task == expected.task and judgment.agent == expected.agent and judgment.seed == expected.seed,
				"wrong judgment identity"
			)
			assert(scores[judgment.device] == nil, "duplicate device judgment")
			assert(judgment.status == "judged", "a skipped, failed, or forfeited comparison is not a visual win")
			assert(#judgment.presentations == 2, "both presentation orders are required")
			assert(
				judgment.presentations[1].first ~= judgment.presentations[2].first,
				"presentation order was not reversed"
			)
			local observed = 0
			for _, presentation in judgment.presentations do
				assert(
					presentation.model == expected.judgeModel and presentation.verdict ~= nil,
					"wrong or missing judge model"
				)
				local choice = presentation.verdict.overall
				observed += if choice == "tie"
					then 0.5
					elseif
						choice == "first" and presentation.first == "a"
						or choice == "second" and presentation.first == "b"
					then 1
					else 0
			end
			local score = judgment.scoreA
			assert(score ~= nil and score >= 0 and score <= 1, "missing visual preference score")
			assert(score == observed / 2, "preference score differs from the two recorded judgments")
			assert(
				judgment.a == "facet" and judgment.b == "plain" or judgment.a == "plain" and judgment.b == "facet",
				"wrong compared arms"
			)
			scores[judgment.device] = if judgment.a == "facet" then score else 1 - score
			t:attach(judgment.device .. "-judgment", "application/json", Eval.lute.encode(judgment))
		end
		local total = 0
		for _, device in devices do
			assert(scores[device] ~= nil, "missing judgment for " .. device)
			total += scores[device]
		end
		t:expect(#judgments):toBe(#devices)
		t:expect(total / #devices >= 0.7):toBeTrueWith("Facet blind preference = " .. tostring(total / #devices))
	end)
	return collection
end

return { DEFAULT_IDENTITY = DEFAULT_IDENTITY, cases = cases }

--!strict
-- Lpt.lua -- parallel port LPT1 at 0x378-0x37A with an injected print backend.
--
-- Data written to 0x378 is latched and emitted when the guest pulses STROBE
-- (control bit 0 high-to-low), matching how BIOS INT 17h and Windows' printer
-- drivers drive a Centronics port. INT 17h uses writeByte() directly.

const band, bor = bit32.band, bit32.bor

const Lpt = {}
Lpt.__index = Lpt

Lpt.BASE = 0x378

export type Backend = {
	write: ((backend: any, text: string) -> ())?,
}

export type Lpt = {
	backend: Backend?,
	data: number,
	control: number,
	bytes: number,
	new: (backend: Backend?) -> Lpt,
	reset: (self: Lpt) -> (),
	status: (self: Lpt) -> number,
	intStatus: (self: Lpt) -> number,
	emit: (self: Lpt, text: string) -> (),
	writeByte: (self: Lpt, value: number) -> (),
	writeText: (self: Lpt, text: string) -> (),
	initialize: (self: Lpt) -> (),
	strobe: (self: Lpt) -> (),
	in8: (self: Lpt, port: number) -> number,
	out8: (self: Lpt, port: number, value: number) -> (),
}

function Lpt.new(backend: Backend?): Lpt
	const self = setmetatable({}, Lpt) :: any
	self.backend = backend
	self:reset()
	return self
end

function Lpt.reset(self: Lpt)
	self.data = 0
	self.control = 0x0C -- SELECT and INIT asserted, STROBE low
	self.bytes = 0
end

-- Parallel-port status byte: ~BUSY, ~ACK, PE, SELECT, ~ERROR.
function Lpt.status(_self: Lpt): number
	return 0xDF -- ready, selected, no paper error
end

-- INT 17h AH status: not busy, selected, no error/timeout.
function Lpt.intStatus(_self: Lpt): number
	return 0x90
end

function Lpt.emit(self: Lpt, text: string)
	const backend = self.backend
	if backend and backend.write then
		backend.write(backend, text)
	end
	self.bytes += #text
end

-- INT 17h AH=00 prints a byte without a guest-visible strobe.
function Lpt.writeByte(self: Lpt, value: number)
	self.data = band(value, 0xFF)
	self:emit(string.char(self.data))
end

function Lpt.writeText(self: Lpt, text: string)
	for index = 1, #text do
		self.data = string.byte(text, index) :: number
	end
	if #text > 0 then
		self:emit(text)
	end
end

function Lpt.initialize(self: Lpt)
	-- INIT is active low; pulse it and leave the port selected.
	self.control = 0x08
	self.control = bor(self.control, 0x04)
end

function Lpt.strobe(self: Lpt)
	self:emit(string.char(self.data))
end

function Lpt.in8(self: Lpt, port: number): number
	const offset = band(port - Lpt.BASE, 0xFF)
	if offset == 0 then
		return self.data
	elseif offset == 1 then
		return self:status()
	elseif offset == 2 then
		return self.control
	end
	return 0xFF
end

function Lpt.out8(self: Lpt, port: number, value: number)
	const byte = band(value, 0xFF)
	const offset = band(port - Lpt.BASE, 0xFF)
	if offset == 0 then
		self.data = byte
	elseif offset == 2 then
		const previous = self.control
		self.control = byte
		-- Centronics latches on the falling edge of STROBE.
		if band(previous, 0x01) ~= 0 and band(byte, 0x01) == 0 then
			self:strobe()
		end
	end
end

return Lpt

-- Carry: owns the single brainrot a player holds above their head, its follow loop, and restoring it across respawns.
-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: Carry.isCarrying, Carry.modelOf, Carry.attach, Carry.release, Carry.takeModel, Carry.clear, Carry.restore, Carry.stop
-- contract:
--   Owns: the player->Model held map and one Heartbeat follow connection (lerps unwelded models to head + Config.carryHeight).
--   attach refuses (returns nil) when the player has no state, is already carrying, has no character, the slot id is not in Cast,
--   or the model has no PrimaryPart (a freshly built model is destroyed; a passed-in model is not).
--   On success it sets PlayerState carrying, welds the model above the character's head via Factory.weldAboveHead, and returns the model.
--   release drops the model, takeModel hands it back (nil if unparented), clear removes it; all three clear PlayerState carrying.
--!strict

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Cast = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Cast"))
local Factory = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("BrainrotFactory"))
local PlayerState = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("PlayerState"))

type Slot = PlayerState.Slot

local held: { [Player]: Model } = {}
local followConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

-- Carry module table.
-- Owns: the `held` map (Player -> carried Model) and the single `followConn` Heartbeat
--   connection that lerps unwelded carried models to head + Config.carryHeight.
-- Refuses: attach returns nil when PlayerState.get has no state, state.carrying is already set,
--   player.Character is missing, Cast.getById(slot.id) finds nothing, or the model has no PrimaryPart;
--   restore does nothing when there is no carrying state, a model is already held, or no character.
-- Returns: isCarrying -> boolean; modelOf, attach, release, takeModel -> Model?; clear, restore, stop -> nothing.
local Carry = {}

-- Starts the shared Heartbeat follow loop once, moving unwelded held models above each carrier's head.
-- Returns nothing; exits early if the follow connection already exists.
local function ensureFollow()
	if followConn then
		return
	end
	followConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		for player, model in held do
			local character = player.Character
			local anchor = model.PrimaryPart
			if not character or not anchor or not anchor.Parent or not model.Parent then
				continue
			end
			local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if not (head and head:IsA("BasePart")) then
				head = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			end
			if not (head and head:IsA("BasePart")) then
				continue
			end
			if anchor:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld") then
				continue
			end
			local goal = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, head.Size.Y / 2 + Config.carryHeight, 0)
			local alpha = math.clamp(0.35, 0, 1)
			anchor.CFrame = anchor.CFrame:Lerp(goal, alpha)
		end
		dropDetached()
	end)
end

-- Removes every held model that has lost its Parent and clears that player's PlayerState carrying.
-- Returns nothing.
local function dropDetached()
	for player, model in held do
		if not model.Parent then
			held[player] = nil
			PlayerState.setCarrying(player, nil)
		end
	end
end

-- Reports whether the player's PlayerState currently records a carried slot.
-- Returns true if state exists and state.carrying is non-nil, false otherwise.
function Carry.isCarrying(player: Player): boolean
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	return state ~= nil and state.carrying ~= nil
end

-- Looks up the Model this module holds for the player.
-- Returns the held Model, or nil if none.
function Carry.modelOf(player: Player): Model?
	return held[player]
end

-- Attaches a slot's brainrot (the passed-in parented model or a freshly built one) above the player's head and records carrying.
-- Returns the attached Model, or nil when refused (no state, already carrying, no character, unknown slot id, no PrimaryPart).
function Carry.attach(player: Player, slot: Slot, existing: Model?): Model?
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state then
		return nil
	end
	if state.carrying ~= nil then
		return nil
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = Cast.getById(slot.id)
	if not entry then
		return nil
	end
	if existing and not existing.Parent then
		existing = nil
	end
	local model = existing
	if not model then
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local at = if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0) else Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
		model = Factory.create(entry, at)
	end
	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		if not existing then
			model:Destroy()
		end
		return nil
	end
	PlayerState.setCarrying(player, {
		id = entry.id,
		name = entry.name,
		income = entry.income,
		price = entry.price,
	})
	held[player] = model
	Factory.weldAboveHead(model, character)
	ensureFollow()
	return model
end

-- Forgets the held model, clears PlayerState carrying, and drops the model via Factory.drop if it is still parented.
-- Returns the model that was held (possibly unparented), or nil if none.
function Carry.release(player: Player): Model?
	local model = held[player]
	held[player] = nil
	PlayerState.setCarrying(player, nil)
	if model and model.Parent then
		Factory.drop(model)
	end
	return model
end

-- Forgets the held model and clears PlayerState carrying without dropping or destroying it.
-- Returns the model for the caller to reuse, or nil if none was held or it is unparented.
function Carry.takeModel(player: Player): Model?
	local model = held[player]
	held[player] = nil
	PlayerState.setCarrying(player, nil)
	if model and not model.Parent then
		return nil
	end
	return model
end

-- Forgets the held model, clears PlayerState carrying, and removes the model via Factory.remove inside a pcall.
-- Returns nothing.
function Carry.clear(player: Player)
	local model = held[player]
	held[player] = nil
	PlayerState.setCarrying(player, nil)
	if model then
		pcall(function()
			Factory.remove(model)
		end)
	end
end

-- Re-attaches the slot recorded in PlayerState carrying (e.g. after respawn) when no model is held and a character exists.
-- Returns nothing; the result of Carry.attach is discarded.
function Carry.restore(player: Player)
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state or not state.carrying or held[player] then
		return
	end
	if not player.Character then
		return
	end
	Carry.attach(player, state.carrying, nil)
end

-- Disconnects the Heartbeat follow connection if it is running and clears it.
-- Returns nothing.
function Carry.stop()
	if followConn then
		followConn:Disconnect()
		followConn = nil
	end
end

return Carry

export type Configuration = { model: string, effort: string }
export type Options = {
	execute: (Eval.Command) -> Eval.Execution,
	files: Eval.Files,
	directory: string,
	deadlineSeconds: number?,
}

local DEFAULT_CONFIGURATION: Configuration = { model = "gpt-6.1-sol", effort = "medium" }
table.freeze(DEFAULT_CONFIGURATION)

local function transport(options: Options, configuration: Configuration?): Eval.JudgeTransport
	local selected = configuration or DEFAULT_CONFIGURATION
	assert(selected.model ~= "" and selected.effort ~= "", "judge model and effort must be explicit")
	assert(
		not options.files.exists(options.directory),
		"judge directory already exists; choose a new neutral directory"
	)
	options.files.makeDirectory(options.directory)
	return Eval.judge.codexCli({
		command = {
			"codex",
			"--enable",
			"skip_host_skill_discovery",
			"-c",
			"project_doc_max_bytes=0",
			"-c",
			"skills.include_instructions=false",
			"-c",
			"skills.bundled.enabled=false",
		},
		execute = options.execute,
		files = options.files,
		directory = options.directory,
		encode = Eval.lute.encode,
		decode = Eval.lute.decode,
		model = selected.model,
		effort = selected.effort,
		deadlineSeconds = options.deadlineSeconds,
	})
end

return { DEFAULT_CONFIGURATION = DEFAULT_CONFIGURATION, transport = transport }

--!strict
-- Machine.lua -- 486/Pentium-class PC skeleton for RVPC.
--
-- Owns 32-bit physical memory, the CPU, VGA, the 8259/8254/CMOS chipset and
-- optional serial/parallel ports. Host services are injected through deps; this
-- module never requires Roblox or the filesystem.

const band, bor, lshift, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const Machine = {}
Machine.__index = Machine

const PIC_MASTER_CMD = 0x20
const PIC_MASTER_DATA = 0x21
const PIC_SLAVE_CMD = 0xA0
const PIC_SLAVE_DATA = 0xA1
const PIT_BASE = 0x40
const CMOS_INDEX = 0x70
const CMOS_DATA = 0x71
const PORT_A20 = 0x92
const DEVICE_BATCH = 8
const PCI_ADDRESS = 0xCF8
const PCI_DATA = 0xCFC
-- The ISP side must not share the guest NIC's default MAC (52:54:00:12:34:56).
const DEFAULT_ISP_MAC = "52:54:00:12:34:57"

export type Deps = {
	Memory: any,

export type FloppyConfig = {

export type Config = {
	memorySize: number?,

	serial: any?,
	printer: any?,

	vgaRom: buffer?,

}

export type Machine = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		mem: any,
		cpu: any,
		vga: any?,
		pic: any?,
		pit: any?,
		cmos: any?,

		pciAddress: number,

		isaCommand: number,
		elcrMaster: number,
		elcrSlave: number,
		sb16Clock: number,
		ppi: number,
		lastInPort: number,
		lastOutPort: number,
		lastOutValue: number,
		irqCount: number,
		int19Count: number,
		-- Guest instructions retired per PIT/RTC clock tick (1 = the historic
		-- one-instruction-per-timer-cycle pacing, ~1 MIPS against the 1.19 MHz
		-- PIT). Win98 SETUP benchmarks IDIV against PIT channel 2 and refuses
		-- CPUs below 66 MHz, so hosts running it set 2 or more.
		timerDivisor: number,
		devPhase: number,
		timerPhase: number,
		atResetVector: boolean,
		booted: boolean,
		debugLog: { string },
		run: (self: Machine, maxSteps: number?) -> number,
