		mouseMove: (self: Machine, dx: number, dy: number, buttons: number?) -> (),
		injectBdaKey: (self: Machine, scan: number, ascii: number) -> boolean,
	},
	Machine
))

-- A tiny 440FX host bridge so SeaBIOS's northbridge probe finds something
-- plausible. There is no real PCI device behind it yet; absent devices read as
-- all-ones, which is what the configuration mechanism reports on an empty bus.
local function hostBridgeDword(machine: any, offset: number): number
	if offset == 0x00 then
		return 0x12378086 -- Intel 440FX, vendor 8086 device 1237
	elseif offset == 0x04 then
		return 0x00000006 -- I/O + memory space enabled
	elseif offset == 0x08 then
		return 0x06000002 -- host bridge, revision 2
	elseif offset == 0x0C then
		return 0x00000000 -- type 0 header
	elseif offset == 0x2C then
		return 0x11001AF4 -- Red Hat/QEMU subsystem, as SeaBIOS expects
	end
	-- PAM/PAM shadow-control bytes are written by SeaBIOS's
	-- make_bios_writable/make_bios_readonly paths.
	return machine.hostConfig[offset] or 0
end

-- Bochs/QEMU stdvga-compatible PCI VGA device at 00:02.0. The VGA BIOS option
-- ROM at C0000 is what installs INT 10h; the legacy VGA register model lives in
-- core/Vga.lua. BAR0 is intentionally absent (no linear framebuffer yet).
local function configDword(config: { [number]: number }, offset: number): number
	local value = 0
	for index = 0, 3 do
		value = bor(value, lshift(band(config[offset + index] or 0, 0xFF), index * 8))
	end
	return value
end

local function vgaDword(machine: any, offset: number): number
	if offset == 0x00 then
		return 0x11111234 -- Bochs VGA, vendor 1234 device 1111
	elseif offset == 0x04 then
		return bor(band(machine.vgaCommand or 7, 0xFFFF), 0x02000000)
	elseif offset == 0x08 then
		return 0x03000001 -- VGA controller, revision 1
	elseif offset == 0x0C then
		return 0x00000000 -- type 0 header
	elseif offset == 0x10 then
		return machine.vgaBar
	elseif offset == 0x2C then
		return 0x11001AF4
	elseif offset == 0x30 then
		if machine.vgaRomBarProbe then
			return 0xFFFFF800
		end
		return machine.vgaRomBar or 0
	elseif offset == 0x3C then
		-- Route VGA through the slot's INTC link (PIRQD on this PIIX3 table)
		-- so the $PIR link and the VGA interrupt line both resolve to IRQ 11.
		return bor(band(machine.vgaInterruptLine or 11, 0xFF), 0x0300)
	elseif offset == 0x40 then
		return band(machine.vgaLatency or 0, 0xFF)
	end
	return 0
end

-- PIIX3 topology: ISA bridge at 00:01.0 (multifunction), IDE at 00:01.1.
-- The IDE function advertises bus-master capability (prog_if 0x80) while both
-- channels remain in legacy mode, so SeaBIOS and the Win98 PIIX3 driver use
-- 0x1F0/0x3F6/IRQ14 and 0x170/0x376/IRQ15.
const IDE_BAR_DEFAULTS = { 0x1F0, 0x3F6, 0x170, 0x376, 0xC000 }
const IDE_BAR_SIZES = { 8, 2, 8, 2, 16 }

local function isaBridgeDword(machine: any, offset: number): number
	if offset == 0x00 then
		return 0x70008086 -- Intel PIIX3 ISA bridge
	elseif offset == 0x04 then
		return bor(band(machine.isaCommand or 0x0007, 0xFFFF), 0x02000000)
	elseif offset == 0x08 then
		return 0x06010000 -- ISA bridge, revision 0
	elseif offset == 0x0C then
		return 0x00800000 -- header type 0x80: multifunction device
	elseif offset == 0x2C then
		return 0x11001AF4 -- Red Hat/QEMU subsystem
	end
	return configDword(machine.isaConfig or {}, offset)
end

local function ideBarMask(index: number): number
	return bit32.bnot(IDE_BAR_SIZES[index] - 1)
end

local function ideBarDword(machine: any, index: number): number
	const mask = ideBarMask(index)
	if machine.ideBarProbe[index] then
		return bor(mask, 1)
	end
	const base = machine.ideBars[index] or IDE_BAR_DEFAULTS[index]
	return bor(band(base, mask), 1)
end

local function ideDword(machine: any, offset: number): number
	if offset == 0x00 then
		return 0x70108086 -- Intel PIIX3 IDE
	elseif offset == 0x04 then
		return bor(band(machine.ideCommand or 0x00000007, 0xFFFF), 0x02800000)
	elseif offset == 0x08 then
		return 0x01018000 -- IDE controller, bus-master programming interface
	elseif offset == 0x0C then
		return 0x00000000 -- type 0 header, single function
	elseif offset >= 0x10 and offset <= 0x20 and band(offset, 3) == 0 then
		const index = math.floor((offset - 0x10) / 4) + 1
		return ideBarDword(machine, index)
	elseif offset == 0x2C then
		return 0x11001AF4
	elseif offset == 0x3C then
		return 0x0000010E -- interrupt line 14, INTA#
	elseif offset == 0x40 then
		return band(machine.ideLatency or 0, 0xFF)
	end
	return 0
end

local function pciRead(machine: any, address: number): number
	if band(address, 0x80000000) == 0 then
		return 0xFFFFFFFF
	end
	const bus = band(rshift(address, 16), 0xFF)
	const device = band(rshift(address, 11), 0x1F)
	const functionNumber = band(rshift(address, 8), 0x07)
	const offset = band(address, 0xFC)
	if bus == 0 then
		if device == 0 and functionNumber == 0 then
			return hostBridgeDword(machine, offset)
		elseif device == 1 and functionNumber == 0 then
			return isaBridgeDword(machine, offset)
		elseif device == 1 and functionNumber == 1 then
			return ideDword(machine, offset)
		elseif device == 2 and functionNumber == 0 then
			return vgaDword(machine, offset)
		end
	end
	return 0xFFFFFFFF
end

local function pciWrite(machine: any, address: number, value: number)
	if band(address, 0x80000000) == 0 then
		return
	end
	const bus = band(rshift(address, 16), 0xFF)
	const device = band(rshift(address, 11), 0x1F)
	const functionNumber = band(rshift(address, 8), 0x07)
	const offset = band(address, 0xFC)
	if bus == 0 and device == 2 and functionNumber == 0 then
		if offset == 0x04 then
			machine.vgaCommand = band(value, 0xFFFF)
		elseif offset == 0x10 then
			-- VGA LFB BAR0: 4 MiB memory BAR at 0xE0000000.
			if value == 0xFFFFFFFF then
				machine.vgaBar = 0xFFC00000
			else
				machine.vgaBar = band(value, 0xFFC00000)
			end
		elseif offset == 0x30 then
			if value == 0xFFFFFFFF then
				machine.vgaRomBarProbe = true
			else
				machine.vgaRomBarProbe = false
				machine.vgaRomBar = bor(band(value, 0xFFFFF800), band(value, 1))
			end
		elseif offset == 0x3C then
			machine.vgaInterruptLine = band(value, 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 0x40 then
			machine.vgaLatency = band(value, 0xFF)
		end
		return
	end
	if bus == 0 and device == 1 and functionNumber == 0 then
		if offset == 0x04 then
			machine.isaCommand = band(value, 0xFFFF)
		elseif offset == 0x3C then
			machine.isaConfig[0x3C] = band(value, 0xFF)
		elseif offset >= 0x40 then
			for index = 0, 3 do
				machine.isaConfig[offset + index] = band(rshift(value, index * 8), 0xFF)
			end
		end
		return
	end
	if bus == 0 and device == 1 and functionNumber == 1 then
		if offset == 0x04 then
			machine.ideCommand = band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF)
			return
		end
		if offset >= 0x10 and offset <= 0x20 and band(offset, 3) == 0 then
			const index = math.floor((offset - 0x10) / 4) + 1
			const mask = ideBarMask(index)
			if value == 0xFFFFFFFF then
				machine.ideBarProbe[index] = true
				return
			end
			machine.ideBarProbe[index] = false
			const base = band(value, mask)
			machine.ideBars[index] = base
			if index == 5 then
				if machine.ide then
					machine.ide.bmBase = base
				end
				if machine.ide2 then
					machine.ide2.bmBase = base + 8
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if offset == 0x40 then
			machine.ideLatency = band(value, 0xFF)
		end
		return
	end
	if bus ~= 0 or device ~= 0 or functionNumber ~= 0 then
		return
	end
	if offset == 0x58 or offset == 0x5C then
		machine.hostConfig[offset] = band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF)
		-- PAM0 bit 4 set with read-only encoding (0x10/0x11) is SeaBIOS's
		-- "make_bios_readonly" state for F0000-FFFFF.
		const pam0 = band(rshift(machine.hostConfig[0x58] or 0, 8), 0xFF)
		machine.mem:lockLowRom(band(pam0, 0x30) == 0x10)
	end
end

function Machine.new(deps: Deps, config: Config?): Machine
	const cfg: Config = config or {}
	local self = setmetatable({}, Machine) :: any
	self.config = cfg
	self.mem = deps.Memory.new(cfg.memorySize or (16 * 1024 * 1024))
	if cfg.rom then
		self.mem:loadRom(cfg.rom)
	end
	if cfg.vgaRom then
		self.mem:loadOptionRom(cfg.vgaRom, 0xC0000)
	end
	if deps.Vga then
		self.vga = deps.Vga.new(self.mem)
		self.mem.aperture = self.vga
	end
	if deps.Pic then
		self.pic = deps.Pic.new()
	end
	if deps.Pit then
		self.pit = deps.Pit.new()
	end
	if deps.Cmos then
		local floppyType = 0
		if cfg.floppy and cfg.floppy.image then
			floppyType = bor(floppyType, 0x40) -- drive A: 1.44M
		end
		if cfg.floppy1 and cfg.floppy1.image then
			floppyType = bor(floppyType, 0x04) -- drive B: 1.44M
		end
		const cmos = deps.Cmos.new({ memorySize = self.mem.size, floppyType = floppyType })
		self.cmos = cmos
		self.rtcState = cmos.rtc
	end
	if deps.FwCfg then
		self.fwcfg = deps.FwCfg.new(self.mem.size, cfg.vgaRom)
	end
	if deps.Ide then
		self.ide = deps.Ide.new({
			hdd = cfg.hdd,
			cdrom = cfg.cdrom,
			mem = self.mem,
			bmBase = 0xC000,
		})
		self.ide2 = deps.Ide.new({
			hdd = cfg.hdd2,
			cdrom = cfg.cdrom2,
			base = 0x170,
			altBase = 0x376,
			irq = deps.Ide.IRQ_SECONDARY or 15,
			mem = self.mem,
			bmBase = 0xC008,
		})
	end
	const network = cfg.network
	const networkEnabled = network == nil or network.enabled ~= false
	if deps.Ne2000 and networkEnabled then
		self.ne2000 = deps.Ne2000.new({ mac = if network then network.mac else nil })
	end
	if deps.Isp and networkEnabled then
		local ispMac = if network then network.ispMac else nil
		if not ispMac and self.ne2000 then
			ispMac = DEFAULT_ISP_MAC
		end
		self.isp = deps.Isp.new({ mac = ispMac, ip = if network then network.ip else nil })
		if self.ne2000 then
			self.isp:attach(self.ne2000)
		end
	end
	if deps.Kbc then
		self.kbc = deps.Kbc.new()
	end
	if deps.Fpu then
		self.fpu = deps.Fpu.new()
	end
	if deps.Dma then
		self.dma = deps.Dma.new({
			read8 = function(address: number): number
				return self.mem:read8(address)
			end,
			read16 = function(address: number): number
				return self.mem:read16(address)
			end,
			write8 = function(address: number, value: number)
				self.mem:write8(address, value)
			end,
			write16 = function(address: number, value: number)
				self.mem:write16(address, value)
			end,
		})
	end
	if deps.Fdc then
		self.fdc = deps.Fdc.new({
			floppy = cfg.floppy and cfg.floppy.image,
			floppy1 = cfg.floppy1 and cfg.floppy1.image,
			writeProtected = cfg.floppy and cfg.floppy.writeProtected,
			writeProtected1 = cfg.floppy1 and cfg.floppy1.writeProtected,
			dirty = cfg.floppy and cfg.floppy.dirty,
			dirty1 = cfg.floppy1 and cfg.floppy1.dirty,
			dma = self.dma,
		})
	end
	if deps.Sb16 then
		self.sb16 = deps.Sb16.new({
			dma = self.dma,
			dmaChannel = 1,
			irq = 5,
			sink = cfg.audioSink or function(_samples: buffer) end,
		})
	end
	if deps.Uart then
		self.uart = deps.Uart.new(cfg.serial)
	end
	if deps.Lpt then
		self.lpt = deps.Lpt.new(cfg.printer)
	end
	self.pciAddress = 0
	self.vgaBar = 0xE0000000
	self.ideBars = { 0x1F0, 0x3F6, 0x170, 0x376, 0xC000 }
	self.ideBarProbe = { false, false, false, false, false }
	self.ideCommand = 0x00000007
	self.ideLatency = 0
	self.vgaCommand = 0x00000007
	self.vgaLatency = 0
	self.vgaRomBar = 0x000C0001 -- 32 KiB option ROM in the C0000 shadow window
	self.vgaRomBarProbe = false
	self.vgaInterruptLine = 11
	self.isaCommand = 0x00000007
	self.isaConfig = {}
	for index = 0, 0xFF do
		self.isaConfig[index] = 0
	end
	-- PIIX3 reset defaults: PIRQ[A-D] disabled until the firmware routes them.
	for index = 0x60, 0x63 do
		self.isaConfig[index] = 0x80
	end
	self.isaConfig[0x4E] = 0x03
	self.isaConfig[0x4F] = 0x00
	self.isaConfig[0x69] = 0x02
	self.isaConfig[0x70] = 0x80
	self.elcrMaster = 0
	self.elcrSlave = 0
	self.sb16Clock = 0
	self.ppi = 0
	self.hostConfig = {}
	self.lastInPort = 0
	self.lastOutPort = 0
	self.lastOutValue = 0
	self.irqCount = 0
	self.int19Count = 0
	self.timerDivisor = 1
	self.devPhase = 0
	self.timerPhase = 0
	self.atResetVector = false
	self.booted = false
	self.debugLog = {}

	local function pciAddressByte(index: number): number
		return band(rshift(self.pciAddress, index * 8), 0xFF)
	end
	local function pciDataByte(index: number): number
		return band(rshift(pciRead(self, self.pciAddress), index * 8), 0xFF)
	end

	local io: any
	io = {
		in8 = function(port: number): number
			self.lastInPort = port
			if self.fwcfg and (port == 0x510 or port == 0x511) then
				return self.fwcfg:in8(port)
			end
			if
				self.dma
				and (
					port <= 0x0F
					or (port >= 0xC0 and port <= 0xDF)
					or port == 0x81
					or port == 0x82
					or port == 0x83
					or port == 0x87
					or port == 0x89
					or port == 0x8A
					or port == 0x8B
				)
			then
				return self.dma:in8(port)
			end
			if
				self.sb16
				and ((port >= 0x220 and port <= 0x22F) or port == 0x388 or port == 0x389)
			then
				return self.sb16:in8(port)
			end
			if self.kbc and (port == 0x60 or port == 0x64) then
				return self.kbc:in8(port)
			end
			if self.fdc and ((port >= 0x3F0 and port <= 0x3F5) or port == 0x3F7) then
				return self.fdc:in8(port)
			end
			if self.ide and ((port >= 0x1F0 and port <= 0x1F7) or port == 0x3F6) then
				return self.ide:in8(port)
			end
			if self.ide2 and ((port >= 0x170 and port <= 0x177) or port == 0x376) then
				return self.ide2:in8(port)
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				return self.ide:bmIn8(port)
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				return self.ide2:bmIn8(port)
			end
			if self.ne2000 and port >= self.ne2000.base and port <= self.ne2000.base + 0x1F then
				return self.ne2000:in8(port)
			end
			if self.vga and (port == 0x1CE or port == 0x1CF or port == 0x1D0) then
				return self.vga:in8(port)
			end
			if self.vga and port >= 0x3C0 and port <= 0x3DF then
				return self.vga:in8(port)
			end
			if port == 0x4D0 then
				return self.elcrMaster
			elseif port == 0x4D1 then
				return self.elcrSlave
			end
			if
				self.pic
				and (
					port == PIC_MASTER_CMD
					or port == PIC_MASTER_DATA
					or port == PIC_SLAVE_CMD
					or port == PIC_SLAVE_DATA
				)
			then
				return self.pic:in8(port)
			end
			if self.pit and port >= PIT_BASE and port <= PIT_BASE + 3 then
				return self.pit:in8(port)
			end
			if self.cmos and port == CMOS_INDEX then
				return self.cmos:in8(port)
			end
			if self.cmos and port == CMOS_DATA then
				return self.cmos:in8(port)
			end
			if port == PORT_A20 then
				return if self.mem.a20 then 0x02 else 0x00
			end
			if port == 0x61 then
				-- PPI port B: bits 0/1 are the speaker gate/data latch; bit 4
				-- is the refresh toggle and bit 5 the timer-2 output. The AIC
				-- ASPI delay loop only needs bit 4 to keep changing; the BIOS
				-- TSC calibration waits on bit 5, so it must follow PIT 2.
				local tsc = self.cpu and self.cpu.tsc or 0
				return bor(
					band(self.ppi, 0x03),
					if band(rshift(tsc, 4), 1) ~= 0 then 0x10 else 0,
					if self.pit and self.pit.channels[3].output then 0x20 else 0
				)
			end
			if port >= PCI_ADDRESS and port <= PCI_ADDRESS + 3 then
				return pciAddressByte(port - PCI_ADDRESS)
			end
			if port >= PCI_DATA and port <= PCI_DATA + 3 then
				return pciDataByte(port - PCI_DATA)
			end
			if self.uart and port >= 0x3F8 and port <= 0x3FF then
				return self.uart:in8(port)
			end
			if self.lpt and port >= 0x378 and port <= 0x37A then
				return self.lpt:in8(port)
			end
			return 0xFF
		end,
		in16 = function(port: number): number
			if self.fwcfg and port == 0x510 then
				return self.fwcfg:in16(port)
			end
			if self.ide and port == 0x1F0 then
				return self.ide:in16(port)
			end
			if self.ide2 and port == 0x170 then
				return self.ide2:in16(port)
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				return self.ide:bmIn16(port)
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				return self.ide2:bmIn16(port)
			end
			if self.ne2000 and port >= self.ne2000.base and port <= self.ne2000.base + 0x1F then
				return self.ne2000:in16(port)
			end
			if self.vga and (port == 0x1CE or port == 0x1CF) then
				return self.vga:in16(port)
			end
			if port == PCI_ADDRESS then
				return band(self.pciAddress, 0xFFFF)
			elseif port >= PCI_DATA and port <= PCI_DATA + 2 then
				const lane = port - PCI_DATA
				return band(
					rshift(pciRead(self, band(self.pciAddress, 0xFFFFFFFC)), lane * 8),
					0xFFFF
				)
			end
			return bor(io.in8(port), lshift(io.in8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF)), 8))
		end,
		in32 = function(port: number): number
			if port == PCI_ADDRESS then
				return self.pciAddress
			elseif port == PCI_DATA then
				return pciRead(self, self.pciAddress)
			end
			if self.ide and port == 0x1F0 then
				return bor(self.ide:in16(port), lshift(self.ide:in16(port), 16))
			end
			if self.ide2 and port == 0x170 then
				return bor(self.ide2:in16(port), lshift(self.ide2:in16(port), 16))
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				return self.ide:bmIn32(port)
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				return self.ide2:bmIn32(port)
			end
			return bor(
				io.in8(port),
				lshift(io.in8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF)), 8),
				lshift(io.in8(band(port + 2, 0xFFFF)), 16),
				lshift(io.in8(band(port + 3, 0xFFFF)), 24)
			)
		end,
		out8 = function(port: number, value: number)
			self.lastOutPort = port
			self.lastOutValue = value
			if port == 0x402 then
				-- QEMU/SeaBIOS debug console (CONFIG_DEBUG_PORT).
				self.debugLog[#self.debugLog + 1] = string.char(band(value, 0xFF))
				return
			end
			if self.fwcfg and (port == 0x510 or port == 0x511) then
				self.fwcfg:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if
				self.dma
				and (
					port <= 0x0F
					or (port >= 0xC0 and port <= 0xDF)
					or port == 0x81
					or port == 0x82
					or port == 0x83
					or port == 0x87
					or port == 0x89
					or port == 0x8A
					or port == 0x8B
				)
			then
				self.dma:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if
				self.sb16
				and ((port >= 0x220 and port <= 0x22F) or port == 0x388 or port == 0x389)
			then
				self.sb16:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.kbc and (port == 0x60 or port == 0x64) then
				self.kbc:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.fdc and ((port >= 0x3F0 and port <= 0x3F5) or port == 0x3F7) then
				self.fdc:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ide and ((port >= 0x1F0 and port <= 0x1F7) or port == 0x3F6) then
				self.ide:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ide2 and ((port >= 0x170 and port <= 0x177) or port == 0x376) then
				self.ide2:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				self.ide:bmOut8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				self.ide2:bmOut8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ne2000 and port >= self.ne2000.base and port <= self.ne2000.base + 0x1F then
				self.ne2000:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.vga and (port == 0x1CE or port == 0x1CF or port == 0x1D0) then
				self.vga:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.vga and port >= 0x3C0 and port <= 0x3DF then
				self.vga:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if port == 0x4D0 then
				self.elcrMaster = band(value, 0xFF)
				return
			elseif port == 0x4D1 then
				self.elcrSlave = band(value, 0xFF)
				return
			end
			if
				self.pic
				and (
					port == PIC_MASTER_CMD
					or port == PIC_MASTER_DATA
					or port == PIC_SLAVE_CMD
					or port == PIC_SLAVE_DATA
				)
			then
				self.pic:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.pit and port >= PIT_BASE and port <= PIT_BASE + 3 then
				self.pit:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.cmos and port == CMOS_INDEX then
				self.cmos:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.cmos and port == CMOS_DATA then
				if self.cmos:out8(port, value) and self.pic then
					-- Enabling an interrupt whose status C flag is already set
					-- raises IRQ8 immediately, as on the real RTC.
					self.pic:raise(8)
				end
				return
			end
			if port == PORT_A20 then
				self.mem:setA20(band(value, 0x02) ~= 0)
				if band(value, 0x01) ~= 0 then
					self:reset()
				end
				return
			end
			if port == 0x61 then
				self.ppi = band(value, 0x03)
				return
			end
			if port >= PCI_ADDRESS and port <= PCI_ADDRESS + 3 then
				return
			end
			if port >= PCI_DATA and port <= PCI_DATA + 3 then
				const lane = port - PCI_DATA
				const address = band(self.pciAddress, 0xFFFFFFFC)
				const old = pciRead(self, address)
				const shift = lane * 8
				const mask = lshift(0xFF, shift)
				const updated = bor(band(old, bit32.bnot(mask)), lshift(band(value, 0xFF), shift))
				pciWrite(self, address, updated)
				return
			end
			if self.uart and port >= 0x3F8 and port <= 0x3FF then
				self.uart:out8(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.lpt and port >= 0x378 and port <= 0x37A then
				self.lpt:out8(port, value)
			end
		end,
		out16 = function(port: number, value: number)
			if self.fwcfg and port == 0x510 then
				self.fwcfg:out16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ide and port == 0x1F0 then
				self.ide:out16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ide2 and port == 0x170 then
				self.ide2:out16(port, value)
				return
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				self.ide:bmOut16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				self.ide2:bmOut16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ne2000 and port >= self.ne2000.base and port <= self.ne2000.base + 0x1F then
				self.ne2000:out16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if self.vga and (port == 0x1CE or port == 0x1CF) then
				self.vga:out16(port, value)
				return
			end
			if port == PCI_ADDRESS then
				self.pciAddress = bor(band(self.pciAddress, 0xFFFF0000), band(value, 0xFFFF))
				return
			elseif port >= PCI_DATA and port <= PCI_DATA + 2 then
				const lane = port - PCI_DATA
				const address = band(self.pciAddress, 0xFFFFFFFC)
				const old = pciRead(self, address)
				const shift = lane * 8
				const mask = lshift(0xFFFF, shift)
				pciWrite(
					self,
					address,
					bor(band(old, bit32.bnot(mask)), lshift(band(value, 0xFFFF), shift))
				)
				return
			end
			io.out8(port, band(value, 0xFF))
			io.out8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
		end,
		out32 = function(port: number, value: number)
			if port == PCI_ADDRESS then
				self.pciAddress = band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF)
				return
			elseif port == PCI_DATA then
				pciWrite(self, self.pciAddress, value)
				return
			end
			if self.ide and port == 0x1F0 then
				self.ide:out16(port, band(value, 0xFFFF))
				self.ide:out16(port, band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFFFF))
				return
			end
			if self.ide2 and port == 0x170 then
				self.ide2:out16(port, band(value, 0xFFFF))
				self.ide2:out16(port, band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFFFF))
				return
			end
			const bmBase = self.ideBars[5]
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide and port >= bmBase and port <= bmBase + 7 then
				self.ide:bmOut32(port, value)
				return
			end
			if bmBase ~= 0 and self.ide2 and port >= bmBase + 8 and port <= bmBase + 15 then
				self.ide2:bmOut32(port, value)
				return
			end
			io.out8(port, band(value, 0xFF))
			io.out8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
			io.out8(band(port + 2, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFF))
			io.out8(band(port + 3, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 24), 0xFF))
		end,
	}
	const cpuConfig = cfg.cpu or { cpuLevel = "486" }
	if self.fpu then
		cpuConfig.fpu = self.fpu
	end
	self.cpu = deps.Cpu.new(self.mem, io, cpuConfig)
	self.cpu:reset()
	if not self.mem:hasRom() then
		-- Hypervisor fallback for the DOS-era unit tests: every vector returns
		-- until the guest installs its own handler, and XMS can hook INT 2Fh.
		self.mem:write8(0xF0000 + 0x100, 0xCF)
		for vector = 0, 255 do
			self.mem:write16(vector * 4, 0x0100)
			self.mem:write16(vector * 4 + 2, 0xF000)
		end
		if deps.Xms then
			self.xms = deps.Xms.new(self)
		end
	end
	self.exitCode = nil
	return self
end

function Machine.reset(self: Machine)
	self.cpu:reset()
	self.mem:setA20(false)
	self.mem:lockLowRom(false)
	if self.pic then
		self.pic:reset()
	end
	if self.pit then
		self.pit:reset()
	end
	if self.ide then
		self.ide:reset()
	end
	if self.ide2 then
		self.ide2:reset()
	end
	if self.ne2000 then
		self.ne2000:reset()
	end
	if self.kbc then
		self.kbc:reset()
	end
	if self.dma then
		self.dma:reset()
	end
	if self.fdc then
		self.fdc:reset()
	end
	if self.sb16 then
		self.sb16:resetDsp()
	end
	self.sb16Clock = 0
	self.ppi = 0
	self.exitCode = nil
end

function Machine.deliverInterrupt(self: Machine): boolean
	if not self.pic then
		return false
	end
	if band(self.cpu.flags, 0x200) == 0 or self.cpu.irqDelay > 0 then
		return false
	end
	const vector = self.pic:nextPending()
	if vector == nil then
		return false
	end
	self.pic:acknowledge()
	self.cpu.halted = false
	self.irqCount += 1
	self.cpu:interrupt(vector, nil, false)
	return true
end

local function resetIdeChannels(self: Machine)
	if self.ide then
		self.ide:reset()
	end
	if self.ide2 then
		self.ide2:reset()
	end
end

function Machine.run(self: Machine, maxSteps: number?): number
	local steps = 0
	local idle = 0
	const budget = maxSteps or math.huge
	const cpu = self.cpu
	const pic = self.pic
	const pit = self.pit
	const kbc = self.kbc
	const ide = self.ide
	const ide2 = self.ide2
	const ne2000 = self.ne2000
	const sb16 = self.sb16
	const fdc = self.fdc
	const cmos = self.cmos
	const timerDivisor = self.timerDivisor
	local timerPhase = self.timerPhase
	local devPhase = self.devPhase
	-- The step loop runs under one pcall instead of one per instruction: a
	-- guest fault that must unwind a half-executed instruction (#GP/#PF raised
	-- from a memory access) throws the CPU's abort token, which retires that
	-- instruction here and resumes the loop.
	const abortToken = cpu.abortToken
	local function stepLoop()
		while steps < budget and not self.exitCode do
			devPhase += 1
			-- Devices are serviced every DEVICE_BATCH steps and on the first step of
			-- each run() call; `pending` steps are accounted to the timers at once.
			if devPhase >= DEVICE_BATCH or steps == 0 then
				const pending = devPhase
				devPhase = 0
				timerPhase += pending
				if timerPhase >= timerDivisor then
					const ticks = timerPhase // timerDivisor
					timerPhase -= ticks * timerDivisor
					if pit then
						if pit:advance(ticks) and pic then
							pic:raise(0)
						end
					end
					-- MC146818 clock and interrupt engine. The periodic tick is what
					-- SeaBIOS INT 15h/AH=86h counts down; update/alarm events raise
					-- IRQ8 through the same status C/IRQF path.
					if cmos then
						if cmos:advance(ticks) and pic then
							pic:raise(8)
						end
					end
				end
				-- Retire pending PIO write completions (BSY -> DRDY + INTRQ) so guest
				-- drivers observe the device-busy commit period of a real device.
				for _ = 1, pending do
					if ide and ide.writeDoneCycles > 0 then
						ide:advance()
					end
					if ide2 and ide2.writeDoneCycles > 0 then
						ide2:advance()
					end
				end
				if pic then
					-- Each takeIrq is side-effect free unless its own pending/armed
					-- field is set, so those fields are a cheap equivalent gate.
					if kbc then
						if kbc.irq1Armed and kbc:takeIrq1() then
							pic:raise(1)
						end
						if kbc.irq12Armed and kbc:takeIrq12() then
							pic:raise(12)
						end
					end
					if ide and ide.irqPending and ide:takeIrq() then
						pic:raise(14)
					end
					if ide2 and ide2.irqPending and ide2:takeIrq() then
						pic:raise(15)
					end
					if ne2000 and (ne2000.irqLine or band(ne2000.isr, ne2000.imr) ~= 0) then
						if ne2000:takeIrq() then
							pic:raise(10)
						end
					end
					if sb16 and sb16.irqPending and sb16:takeIrq() then
						pic:raise(5)
					end
					if fdc and fdc.irqPending and fdc:takeIrq() then
						pic:raise(6)
					end
					self.sb16Clock += pending
					if sb16 and self.sb16Clock % 1024 < pending then
						sb16:tick()
					end
				end
			end
			if cpu.halted then
				-- The TSC is a free-running counter. BIOS timer waits (notably
				-- INT 15h/AH=86h) use it to measure elapsed time; if it only
				-- advanced on retired instructions, a halted CPU would make those
				-- waits effectively infinite.
				if cpu.tsc then
					cpu.tsc += 1
				end
				if not self:deliverInterrupt() then
					idle += 1
					-- A halted CPU waits for the next timer tick; give a full 8254
					-- period (up to 65536 counts) before declaring the machine dead.
					if idle > 200000 then
						break
					end
				else
					idle = 0
				end
			else
				if
					pic
					and pic.master.irr ~= 0
					and band(cpu.flags, 0x200) ~= 0
					and cpu.irqDelay == 0
				then
					self:deliverInterrupt()
				end
				-- step() only wraps executeStep in tracing/paging support; skip the
				-- extra call in the common unpaged, untraced case.
				if not cpu.traceEnabled then
					cpu:executeStep()
				else
					cpu:step()
				end
				idle = 0
			end
			-- A guest warm boot can re-enter the BIOS via INT 19h or the reset
			-- vector without asserting IDE SRST. Reset the channels so a stale
			-- OAKCDROM probe error cannot hide the HDD from the next boot's
			-- SeaBIOS drive scan.
			if devPhase == 0 then
				-- Only just serviced: INT 19h is rare, so sample it per device pass.
				const int19 = cpu.intCounts[0x19] or 0
				if int19 > self.int19Count then
					self.int19Count = int19
					resetIdeChannels(self)
				end
			end
			const atResetVector = cpu.ip == 0xFFF0 and cpu.cs == 0xF000
			if atResetVector or self.atResetVector then
				if self.booted and atResetVector and not self.atResetVector then
					resetIdeChannels(self)
				end
				self.atResetVector = atResetVector
			end
			if not self.booted and not atResetVector then
				self.booted = true
			end
			steps += 1
		end
	end
	while true do
		const ok, err = pcall(stepLoop)
		if ok then
			break
		end
		if err ~= abortToken then
			error(err, 0)
		end
		cpu.aborting = false
		steps += 1
		idle = 0
	end
	-- Flush steps still pending since the last device pass so the timers stay
	-- exact at every run() boundary (IRQs raised here deliver on the next step).
	if devPhase > 0 then
		timerPhase += devPhase
		devPhase = 0
		if timerPhase >= timerDivisor then
			const ticks = timerPhase // timerDivisor
			timerPhase -= ticks * timerDivisor
			if pit and pit:advance(ticks) and pic then
				pic:raise(0)
			end
			if cmos and cmos:advance(ticks) and pic then
				pic:raise(8)
			end
		end
	end
	self.timerPhase = timerPhase
	self.devPhase = devPhase
	return steps
end

function Machine.bootPc(self: Machine): string
	return ("%04X:%08X"):format(self.cpu.cs, self.cpu.ip)
end

function Machine.debugText(self: Machine): string
	return table.concat(self.debugLog)
end

function Machine.pressKey(self: Machine, scancode: number)
	if self.kbc then
		self.kbc:pressKey(scancode)
	end
end

function Machine.releaseKey(self: Machine, scancode: number)
	if self.kbc then
		self.kbc:releaseKey(scancode)
	end
end

function Machine.mouseMove(self: Machine, dx: number, dy: number, buttons: number?)
	if self.kbc then
		self.kbc:mouseMove(dx, dy, buttons)
	end
end

-- Diagnostic input path for harnesses that need to drive SeaBIOS before its
-- own PS/2 IRQ handler is installed. Real host input should use pressKey.
function Machine.injectBdaKey(self: Machine, scan: number, ascii: number): boolean
	const head = self.mem:read16(0x41A)
	const tail = self.mem:read16(0x41C)
	local next = tail + 2
	if next > 0x3D then
		next = 0x1E
	end
	if next == head then
		return false
	end
	self.mem:write16(0x400 + tail, bor(band(ascii, 0xFF), lshift(band(scan, 0xFF), 8)))
	self.mem:write16(0x41C, next)
	return true
end

function Machine.outputText(self: Machine): string
	const vga = self.vga
	if not vga or not vga:isTextMode() then
		return ""
	end
	const rows: { string } = {}
	local lastNonEmpty = 0
	for row = 0, 24 do
		const chars: { string } = {}
		for column = 0, 79 do
			const cell = 0xB8000 + (row * 80 + column) * 2
			const code = self.mem:read8(cell)
			chars[column + 1] = string.char(if code >= 32 and code < 127 then code else 32)
		end
		local line = table.concat(chars)
		line = string.gsub(line, "%s+$", "")
		rows[row + 1] = line
		if #line > 0 then
			lastNonEmpty = row + 1
		end
	end
	local out: { string } = {}
	for row = 1, lastNonEmpty do
		out[#out + 1] = rows[row]
	end
	return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

return Machine

-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: Cast.entries, Cast.byId, Cast.byName, Cast.roll, Cast.getById, Cast.getByName
--!strict

export type Rarity = "Common" | "Uncommon" | "Rare" | "Epic" | "Legendary" | "Mythic" | "Ultra Rare"

export type PartSpec = {
	name: string,
	shape: Enum.PartType,
	size: Vector3,
	offset: CFrame,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material,
}

export type Entry = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	rarity: Rarity,
	price: number,
	income: number,
	threshold: number,
	aura: Color3,
	height: number,
	recipe: { PartSpec },
}

local BLOCK = Enum.PartType.Block
local BALL = Enum.PartType.Ball
local CYL = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
local WEDGE = Enum.PartType.Wedge

local PLASTIC = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
local METAL = Enum.Material.Metal
local NEON = Enum.Material.Neon

-- === part builders ===
-- part: packs name, shape, size, offset, color and optional material into one recipe record.
-- Returns a PartSpec table; material defaults to SmoothPlastic when omitted.
local function part(
	name: string,
	shape: Enum.PartType,
	size: Vector3,
	offset: CFrame,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?
): PartSpec
	return {
		name = name,
		shape = shape,
		size = size,
		offset = offset,
		color = color,
		material = material or PLASTIC,
	}
end

-- facing: builds an offset placed at pos whose front (LookVector) points along direction.
-- Returns a CFrame from CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + direction).
local function facing(pos: Vector3, direction: Vector3): CFrame
	return CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + direction)
end

-- along: builds an offset at pos whose X axis runs along direction (for cylinder length), using a stable up hint.
-- Returns a CFrame from CFrame.fromMatrix with the unit direction as its right vector.
local function along(pos: Vector3, direction: Vector3): CFrame
	local axis = direction.Unit
	local hint = if math.abs(axis.Y) > 0.85 then Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) else Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(pos, axis, axis:Cross(hint).Unit)
end

local SILVER = Color3.fromRGB(214, 220, 230)

local DEEP_SKY = Color3.fromRGB(42, 128, 198)

local BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26)

-- === catalogue ===
-- tier table

-- Kraken Emas     Ultra Rare   50000     10000       1000
local ENTRIES: { Entry } = {
	{

		height = 4,

			part("Snout", WEDGE, Vector3.new(0.72, 0.5, 1.15), facing(Vector3.new(2.15, 2.02, 0), Vector3.new(1, 0.05, 0)), SKY),
			part("WingL", WEDGE, Vector3.new(1.45, 0.12, 2.5), facing(Vector3.new(-0.15, 2.08, 1.55), Vector3.new(-0.1, 0.08, 1)), DEEP_SKY),
			part("WingR", WEDGE, Vector3.new(1.45, 0.12, 2.5), facing(Vector3.new(-0.15, 2.08, -1.55), Vector3.new(-0.1, 0.08, -1)), DEEP_SKY),
			part("WingTipL", WEDGE, Vector3.new(0.85, 0.1, 1.35), facing(Vector3.new(-0.45, 2.22, 3.15), Vector3.new(-0.25, 0.12, 1)), SKY),
			part("WingTipR", WEDGE, Vector3.new(0.85, 0.1, 1.35), facing(Vector3.new(-0.45, 2.22, -3.15), Vector3.new(-0.25, 0.12, -1)), SKY),
			part("TailTop", WEDGE, Vector3.new(0.85, 0.12, 1.25), facing(Vector3.new(-2.35, 2.35, 0), Vector3.new(-1, 0.75, 0)), DEEP_SKY),

local idLookup: { [string]: Entry } = {}
local nameLookup: { [string]: Entry } = {}
for _, entry in ENTRIES do
	idLookup[entry.id] = entry
	nameLookup[entry.name] = entry
end

-- === module table ===
-- Owns: the static ENTRIES catalogue (seven species with id, name, rarity, price, income,
--   roll threshold, aura colour, height and part recipe) plus the idLookup / nameLookup
--   indexes built from it once at load time.
-- Refuses: building any Instance (recipes are plain PartSpec data for other modules to
--   assemble), mutating or adding entries at runtime (no setter exists), and resolving
--   unknown ids or names (getById / getByName return nil instead of guessing).
-- Returns: the Cast table exposing entries, byId, byName, and the roll / getById /
--   getByName functions defined below.
local Cast = {
	entries = ENTRIES,
	byId = idLookup,
	byName = nameLookup,
}

-- === public api ===
-- roll: draws n in 1..1000 and returns the first entry (in table order) whose threshold >= n,
-- so Common 1-450, Uncommon 451-700, Rare 701-880, Epic 881-960, Legendary 961-988, Mythic 989-998, Ultra Rare 999-1000.
-- Cast.roll: picks one catalogue species by weighted rarity, using the given Random or math.random.
-- Returns an Entry; falls back to the last entry (Kraken Emas) if no threshold matches.
function Cast.roll(rng: Random?): Entry
	local n = if rng then rng:NextInteger(1, 1000) else math.random(1, 1000)
	for _, entry in ENTRIES do
		if n <= entry.threshold then
			return entry
		end
	end
	return ENTRIES[#ENTRIES]
end

-- Cast.getById: looks up a catalogue species by its snake_case id (e.g. "paus_api").
-- Returns the matching Entry, or nil when the id is unknown.
function Cast.getById(id: string): Entry?
	return idLookup[id]
end

-- Cast.getByName: looks up a catalogue species by its display name (e.g. "Paus Api").
-- Returns the matching Entry, or nil when the name is unknown.
function Cast.getByName(name: string): Entry?
	return nameLookup[name]
end

return Cast

--!strict

local Core = require("../tools/vendor/verify/src/core")
local Lute = require("../tools/vendor/verify/src/lute")
local Evidence = require("../tools/vendor/verify/src/evidence")
local Files = require("../tools/facet/lib/files")
local Hash = require("../tools/facet/lib/hash")
local Json = require("../tools/facet/lib/json")
local PowerShell = require("../tools/vendor/verify/src/lute/powershell")
local Run = require("../tools/facet/lib/run")
local system = require("@std/system")

local SAVE = [[
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type @'
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
public static class SealWindow {
	[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(IntPtr window);
	[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
	[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsIconic(IntPtr window);
	[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool ShowWindow(IntPtr window, int command);
	[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern void keybd_event(byte key, byte scan, uint flags, UIntPtr extra);
}
'@
$place = '%s'
$studio = Get-Process -Id %d
$window = $studio.MainWindowHandle
if ($window -eq [IntPtr]::Zero) { throw 'the kept Studio has no main window' }
$before = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $place).LastWriteTimeUtc
if ([SealWindow]::IsIconic($window)) { [void][SealWindow]::ShowWindow($window, 3) }
$attempt = 0
while ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $place).LastWriteTimeUtc -le $before) {
	$attempt += 1
	if ($attempt -gt 5) { throw 'Studio did not save the place' }
	$deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(10)
	while ([SealWindow]::GetForegroundWindow() -ne $window) {
		if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) { throw 'the kept Studio did not take focus' }
		[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x12, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
		[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x12, 0, 2, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
		[void][SealWindow]::SetForegroundWindow($window)
		Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
	}
	[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x11, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
	[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x53, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
	[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x53, 0, 2, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
	[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x11, 0, 2, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
	$deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(30)
	while (((Get-Item -LiteralPath $place).LastWriteTimeUtc -le $before) -and ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline)) {
		Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
	}
}
$size = -1
while ($size -ne (Get-Item -LiteralPath $place).Length) {
	$size = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $place).Length
	Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
}
]]

local SAVE_MACOS = [[
place="$1"
pid="$2"
before=$(stat -f %m "$place") || exit 1
attempt=0
while [ "$(stat -f %m "$place")" -le "$before" ]; do
	attempt=$((attempt + 1))
	if [ "$attempt" -gt 5 ]; then
		echo "Studio did not save the place" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
	osascript \
		-e 'on run argv' \
		-e 'tell application "System Events"' \
		-e 'set kept to first process whose unix id is ((item 1 of argv) as integer)' \
		-e 'set frontmost of kept to true' \
		-e 'delay 0.5' \
		-e 'if not (frontmost of kept) then error "the kept Studio did not take focus"' \
		-e 'keystroke "s" using command down' \
		-e 'end tell' \
		-e 'end run' "$pid" || exit 1
	waited=0
	while [ "$(stat -f %m "$place")" -le "$before" ] && [ "$waited" -lt 120 ]; do
		sleep 0.25
		waited=$((waited + 1))
	done
done
size=-1
while [ "$size" != "$(stat -f %z "$place")" ]; do
	size=$(stat -f %z "$place")
	sleep 1
done
]]

export type Platform = "windows" | "macos" | "other"

local function platform(): Platform
	if system.win32 then
		return "windows"
	end
	return if system.macos then "macos" else "other"
end

local function saveCommand(on: Platform, place: string, pid: number): { string }
	if on == "windows" then
		return PowerShell.command(SAVE:format(string.gsub(string.gsub(place, "/", "\\"), "'", "''"), pid))
	elseif on == "macos" then
		return { "/bin/sh", "-c", SAVE_MACOS, "seal", place, tostring(pid) }
	end
	error(
		"this platform has no way to save the kept Studio place. Save it in Studio, then run facetbench snapshot --place PATH",
		0
	)
end

local function save(evidence: string): string
	local kept = Json.decode(Files.read(evidence .. "/studio-place.json"))
	local place = Files.absolute((assert(Json.stringField(kept, "place"), "the kept Studio has no place")))
	local pid = assert(Json.numberField(kept, "pid"), "the kept Studio has no process")
	local on = platform()
	local saved = Run.capture(saveCommand(on, place, pid))
	if not saved.ok and on == "macos" then
		error(
			"could not save the kept Studio place: "
				.. saved.stderr
				.. saved.stdout
				.. "\nSystem Events sends the Command-S. Allow the program that runs lute under Privacy & Security, Accessibility, "
				.. "or save the place in the kept Studio and run facetbench snapshot --place PATH. The author's place is not changed by a failed save.",
			0
		)
	end
	assert(saved.ok, "could not save the kept Studio place: " .. saved.stderr .. saved.stdout)
	return place
end

local function read(directory: string): Core.Report
	local envelope = Lute.parse(Files.read(directory .. "/submission.verify.json"))
	return Core.decode(Json.field(envelope, "report"))
end

local function subject(report: Core.Report): Core.ArtifactProvenance
	assert(report.total == 1 and report.passed == 1, "submission capture did not pass")
	local evidence = report.results[1].evidence
	assert(evidence and #evidence.checkpoints == 1, "submission checkpoint is missing")
	local artifact = evidence.checkpoints[1].artifacts[1]
	assert(artifact and artifact.provenance, "submission provenance is missing")
	return artifact.provenance
end

local function validate(place: string?, directory: string): Core.Report
	return Core.runCases({
		{
			id = "submission/unchanged",
			name = "submission/unchanged",
			timeoutSeconds = 120,
			run = function(t: Core.Context)
				local saved = read(directory)
				local provenance = subject(saved)
				local verified = Lute.evidenceStore.validate(saved, {
					runId = provenance.runId,
					build = { digest = provenance.build.digest },
					requireClean = false,
					directory = directory .. "/objects",
					maxAgeSeconds = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60,
					required = {
						{
							caseId = "submission/capture",
							actors = { "author" },
							checkpoints = { "place" },
							devices = { "studio" },
						},
					},
				})
				t:expect(verified.ok):toBeTrueWith(Evidence.explain(verified))
				t:expect(Hash.sha256(Files.read(directory .. "/game.rbxl"))):toBe(provenance.build.digest)
				if place ~= nil then
					t:expect(Hash.sha256(Files.read(place))):toBe(provenance.build.digest)
				end
			end,
		},
	}, { executor = "submission-integrity" }, os.clock)
end

local function capture(place: string, directory: string, runId: string): Core.Report
	place, directory = Files.absolute(place), Files.absolute(directory)
	assert(Files.isFile(place), "save the authored Studio place before capturing it")
	assert(
		string.sub(string.lower(place), 1, #directory + 1) ~= string.lower(directory) .. "/",
		"capture needs the saved original place"
	)
	if Files.exists(directory .. "/submission.verify.json") then
		return validate(place, directory)
	end
	assert(not Files.exists(directory), "an incomplete snapshot already exists; do not replace submitted bytes")
	local bytes = Files.read(place)
	assert(
		string.sub(bytes, 1, 8) == "<roblox!" or string.find(bytes, "<roblox", 1, true) ~= nil,
		"submission is not a Roblox place"
	)
	local digest = Hash.sha256(bytes)
	local report = Core.runCases({
		{
			id = "submission/capture",
			name = "submission/capture",
			run = function(t: Core.Context)
				t:checkpoint("author", "place")
			end,
		},
	}, {
		executor = "submission-place",
		capabilities = { "capture" },
		bind = function(): Core.CaseHost
			return {
				name = "submission-place",
				capabilities = { "capture" },
				environment = {},
				now = os.clock,
				invoke = function(): unknown
					return nil
				end,
				capture = function(): { Core.Artifact }
					return { { name = "game.rbxl", reference = place, mediaType = "application/octet-stream" } }
				end,
			}
		end,
	}, os.clock)
	local sealed = Lute.evidenceStore.seal(report, {
		runId = runId,
		device = "studio",
		directory = directory .. "/objects",
		build = { commit = "unversioned", tree = digest, clean = false, digest = digest },
	})
	assert(#sealed.issues == 0, "Verify could not seal the place: " .. Lute.encode(sealed.issues))
	local evidence = assert(sealed.report.results[1].evidence)
	local store = Lute.evidenceStore.localDirectory(directory .. "/objects")
	local frozen, problem = store.get(evidence.checkpoints[1].artifacts[1].reference)
	assert(frozen, problem or "sealed place is unavailable")
	assert(Hash.sha256(Files.read(place)) == digest, "the place changed while capturing the submission")
	assert(Hash.sha256(frozen) == digest, "the frozen place differs from the submission")
	Files.write(directory .. "/game.rbxl", frozen)
	Lute.gate.writeReport(directory .. "/submission.verify.json", runId, sealed.report)
	return validate(place, directory)
end

local function seal(evidence: string, runId: string): Core.Report
	local directory = evidence .. "/submission"
	if Files.exists(directory .. "/submission.verify.json") then
		return validate(nil, directory)
	end
	return capture(save(evidence), directory, runId)
end

return { capture = capture, validate = validate, seal = seal, saveCommand = saveCommand, platform = platform }

--!strict
-- Memory.lua -- 32-bit physical memory for a 486/Pentium-class PC.
--
-- The RAM buffer is a flat byte array (16/32/64 MiB by default), but the first
-- megabyte follows the PC memory map:
--
--   00000-9FFFF  conventional RAM
--   A0000-AFFFF  VGA graphics aperture (routed to the VGA device)
--   B0000-B7FFF  monochrome text (unused on VGA)
--   B8000-BFFFF  colour text aperture (plain RAM; VGA text reads B8000)
--   C0000-DFFFF  option ROM / expansion space (open bus when a BIOS is present)
--   E0000-FFFFF  BIOS ROM (256 KiB SeaBIOS image; reset vector at FFFF0)
--
-- With no ROM installed the E0000-FFFFF window stays backed by RAM so the old
-- legacy hypervisor stubs (IVT trampolines at F000:0100, XMS entry at F100:00C0)
-- keep working. Once loadRom() is called, ROM reads are served from the image
-- and writes to ROM are ignored.
--
-- A20M is applied before the memory map: while the gate is closed address bit
-- 20 is forced low, so the 1-2 MiB range folds onto 0-1 MiB. Higher address
-- bits are not folded (0x200000 stays 0x200000), which is what a real 486
-- chipset does.
--
-- There is no wrap at the top of RAM. Addresses outside RAM/ROM/aperture are
-- open bus: reads return 0xFF and writes are dropped.

const band, bor, bnot, lshift, rshift =
	bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bnot, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const Memory = {}
Memory.__index = Memory

Memory.SIZE = 16 * 1024 * 1024
Memory.ROM_BASE = 0xE0000
Memory.ROM_SIZE = 0x40000
Memory.ROM_ALIAS = 0xF0000 -- legacy entry point inside the 256 KiB image
const A20_BIT = 0x100000
const APERTURE_START = 0xA0000
const APERTURE_END = 0xAFFFF
const VBE_LFB_START = 0xE0000000
const VBE_LFB_END = 0xE0400000
const TEXT_START = 0xB0000
const TEXT_END = 0xBFFFF
const ONE_MIB = 0x100000

export type Aperture = {
	read8: (self: any, addr: number) -> number,
	write8: (self: any, addr: number, value: number) -> (),
	read16: (self: any, addr: number) -> number,
	write16: (self: any, addr: number, value: number) -> (),
}

export type Memory = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		buf: buffer,
		size: number,
		mask: number,
		a20: boolean,
		protectStart: number?,
		protectEnd: number?,
		aperture: Aperture?,
		rom: buffer?,
		romBase: number,
		romSize: number,
		romLowOffset: number,
		romHighBase: number,
		romShadowed: boolean,
		lowRomLockMask: number,
	},
	Memory
))

function Memory.new(size: number?): Memory
	const bytes = size or Memory.SIZE
	if bytes < 1024 or band(bytes, bytes - 1) ~= 0 then
		error(("memory size must be a power of two >= 1024 (got %d)"):format(bytes))
	end
	if bytes > 0x100000000 then
		error(("memory size must fit the 32-bit physical bus (got %d)"):format(bytes))
	end
	return setmetatable({
		buf = buffer.create(bytes),
		size = bytes,
		mask = bytes - 1,
		a20 = false,
		rom = nil,
		romBase = Memory.ROM_BASE,
		romSize = 0,
		romLowOffset = 0,
		romHighBase = 0,
		romShadowed = false,
		lowRomLockMask = 0,
	}, Memory)
end

-- Load a BIOS image. QEMU/SeaBIOS's 256 KiB build is linked for the top of the
-- 32-bit address space (0xFFFC0000-0xFFFFFFFF) and its last 128 KiB are
-- mirrored at E0000-FFFFF for the legacy reset/BIOS window. The reset vector's
-- far jump to F000:E05B therefore lands in the low mirror while the main body
-- can also be fetched through the high mapping by 32-bit code.
function Memory:loadRom(image: buffer, base: number?)
	const length = buffer.len(image)
	if length == 0 or length > Memory.ROM_SIZE then
		error(("BIOS image must be 1..%d bytes (got %d)"):format(Memory.ROM_SIZE, length))
	end
	const start = base or Memory.ROM_BASE
	if start < Memory.ROM_BASE or start + math.min(length, 0x20000) > 0x100000 then
		error(("BIOS low window %d bytes does not fit E0000-FFFFF (base %X)"):format(length, start))
	end
	self.rom = image
	self.romBase = start
	self.romSize = length
	-- The legacy window is the last 128 KiB of the image, placed linearly at
	-- E0000. For a 256 KiB image that is offset 0x20000.
	self.romLowOffset = math.max(0, length - 0x20000)
	self.romHighBase = 0x100000000 - length
	-- Real chipsets shadow the BIOS into RAM before POST finishes. SeaBIOS's
	-- 32-bit flat code/BSS and F-segment allocator live in E0000-FFFFF, so the
	-- legacy alias is a writable copy of the image's last 128 KiB. The 256 KiB
	-- high mapping at 0xFFFC0000 remains the read-only ROM.
	if self.size >= 0x100000 then
		const shadowLength = math.min(length, 0x20000)
		buffer.copy(self.buf, 0xE0000, image, length - shadowLength, shadowLength)
		self.romShadowed = true
	end
	return start
end

function Memory:hasRom(): boolean
	return self.rom ~= nil
end

-- SeaBIOS locks the legacy BIOS shadow through the i440FX PAM registers just
-- before boot. The F-segment holds the running firmware and must become
-- read-only. E0000-EFFFF is BIOS extension RAM, and SeaBIOS keeps its
-- real-mode IRQ stack there (SS=DA80, SP=F9xx lands at EA1EC), so it must stay
-- writable after the lock.
-- The i440FX PAM registers protect individual 32 KiB chunks of
-- C0000-FFFFF. The VGA option ROM uses E8000-EFFFF as a writable stack even
-- after the BIOS locks its own F-segment, so this must be a bitmask, not one
-- global boolean.
function Memory:setLowRomLockMask(mask: number)
	self.lowRomLockMask = band(mask, 0xFF)
end

function Memory:lockLowRom(locked: boolean)
	self.lowRomLockMask = if locked then 0xC0 else 0
end

function Memory:isLowRomLocked(addr: number): boolean
	if self.lowRomLockMask == 0 or addr < 0xC0000 or addr > 0xFFFFF then
		return false
	end
	const chunk = band(rshift(addr - 0xC0000, 15), 7)
	return band(self.lowRomLockMask, lshift(1, chunk)) ~= 0
end

function Memory:hasLockedLowRom(addr: number, length: number): boolean
	for index = 0, length - 1 do
		if self:isLowRomLocked(addr + index) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Option ROMs are shadowed into the C0000-DFFFF expansion window. The window
-- is already plain RAM, so a copy is enough for SeaBIOS's option-ROM scanner.
function Memory:loadOptionRom(image: buffer, base: number?)
	const length = buffer.len(image)
	const start = base or 0xC0000
	if length == 0 or start < 0xC0000 or start + length > 0xE0000 then
		error(("option ROM %d bytes does not fit C0000-DFFFF (base %X)"):format(length, start))
	end
	if self.size < start + length then
		error("option ROM exceeds configured RAM")
	end
	buffer.copy(self.buf, start, image, 0, length)
	return start
end

-- Physical translation: A20M first, then the 32-bit bus. No wrap at RAM size.
function Memory:translate(addr: number): number
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bit32.bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	return addr
end

-- A20 is exposed both as a plain field (mem.a20 = true, used by XMS) and as a
-- gate helper so chipset code can share the port-0x92 path.
function Memory:setA20(on: boolean)
	self.a20 = on
end

function Memory:isProtected(addr: number): boolean
	const start = self.protectStart
	const stop = self.protectEnd
	return start ~= nil and stop ~= nil and addr >= start and addr <= stop
end

-- True when [addr, addr+length) is plain RAM with no aperture or ROM shadow.
function Memory:isRam(addr: number, length: number): boolean
	if length <= 0 or addr + length > self.size then
		return false
	end
	const last = addr + length - 1
	if addr < APERTURE_START then
		return last < APERTURE_START
	elseif addr < ONE_MIB then
		if addr >= TEXT_START and addr <= TEXT_END then
			return last <= TEXT_END
		end
		-- C0000-DFFFF is option-ROM/shadow RAM. SeaBIOS copies its 32-bit
		-- decompression stub there before switching to flat protected mode.
		if addr >= 0xC0000 and last <= 0xDFFFF then
			return true
		end
		if self.romShadowed and addr >= 0xE0000 and last <= 0xFFFFF then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function Memory:read8(addr: number): number
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	-- Hot path: plain conventional/RAM, away from the VGA aperture, option-ROM
	-- shadow and BIOS windows. isProtected is only ever configured by host
	-- tooling, never by the guest, so a nil check preserves the slow path.
	if self.protectStart == nil then
		if
			(addr < APERTURE_START and addr < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and addr < self.size)
		then
			return buffer.readu8(self.buf, addr)
		end
	end
	const rom = self.rom
	if rom then
		if addr >= self.romHighBase then
			const offset = addr - self.romHighBase
			if offset < self.romSize then
				return buffer.readu8(rom, offset)
			end
		end
		const romBase: number = self.romBase
		if addr >= romBase and addr <= 0xFFFFF then
			const shadowed = self.romShadowed and addr >= 0xE0000
			if not shadowed then
				const lowBase: number = self.romLowOffset
				const lowOffset: number = lowBase + addr - romBase
				if lowOffset < self.romSize then
					return buffer.readu8(rom, lowOffset)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 1) then
		return buffer.readu8(self.buf, addr)
	end
	if addr >= APERTURE_START and addr <= APERTURE_END and self.aperture then
		return self.aperture:read8(addr)
	end
	if addr >= VBE_LFB_START and addr < VBE_LFB_END and self.aperture then
		return self.aperture:read8(addr)
	end
	-- No ROM installed: preserve the legacy hypervisor's writable high segment.
	if not rom and addr >= Memory.ROM_BASE and addr <= 0xFFFFF and addr < self.size then
		return buffer.readu8(self.buf, addr)
	end
	return 0xFF
end

function Memory:read16(addr: number): number
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	const last = addr + 1
	if
		self.protectStart == nil
		and ((last < APERTURE_START and last < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and last < self.size))
	then
		return buffer.readu16(self.buf, addr)
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 2) then
		return buffer.readu16(self.buf, addr)
	end
	if addr >= APERTURE_START and addr + 1 <= APERTURE_END and self.aperture then
		return self.aperture:read16(addr)
	end
	if addr >= VBE_LFB_START and addr + 1 < VBE_LFB_END and self.aperture then
		return self.aperture:read16(addr)
	end
	return bor(self:read8(addr), lshift(self:read8(addr + 1), 8))
end

function Memory:read32(addr: number): number
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	const last = addr + 3
	if
		self.protectStart == nil
		and ((last < APERTURE_START and last < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and last < self.size))
	then
		return buffer.readu32(self.buf, addr)
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 4) then
		return buffer.readu32(self.buf, addr)
	end
	return bor(self:read16(addr), lshift(self:read16(addr + 2), 16))
end

function Memory:write8(addr: number, value: number)
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	if
		self.protectStart == nil
		and ((addr < APERTURE_START and addr < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and addr < self.size))
	then
		buffer.writeu8(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFF))
		return
	end
	if self:isProtected(addr) then
		return
	end
	if self:isLowRomLocked(addr) then
		return
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 1) then
		buffer.writeu8(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFF))
		return
	end
	if addr >= APERTURE_START and addr <= APERTURE_END and self.aperture then
		self.aperture:write8(addr, value)
		return
	end
	if addr >= VBE_LFB_START and addr < VBE_LFB_END and self.aperture then
		self.aperture:write8(addr, value)
		return
	end
	-- No ROM installed: keep the hypervisor stub window writable.
	if not self.rom and addr >= Memory.ROM_BASE and addr <= 0xFFFFF and addr < self.size then
		buffer.writeu8(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFF))
	end
	-- ROM, option ROM and open bus are read-only.
end

function Memory:write16(addr: number, value: number)
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	const last = addr + 1
	if
		self.protectStart == nil
		and ((last < APERTURE_START and last < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and last < self.size))
	then
		buffer.writeu16(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFFFF))
		return
	end
	if self:isProtected(addr) then
		return
	end
	if self:hasLockedLowRom(addr, 2) then
		self:write8(addr, band(value, 0xFF))
		self:write8(addr + 1, band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
		return
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 2) then
		buffer.writeu16(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFFFF))
		return
	end
	if addr >= APERTURE_START and addr + 1 <= APERTURE_END and self.aperture then
		self.aperture:write16(addr, value)
		return
	end
	if addr >= VBE_LFB_START and addr + 1 < VBE_LFB_END and self.aperture then
		self.aperture:write16(addr, value)
		return
	end
	self:write8(addr, value)
	self:write8(addr + 1, rshift(value, 8))
end

function Memory:write32(addr: number, value: number)
	addr = band(addr, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	if not self.a20 then
		addr = band(addr, bnot(A20_BIT))
	end
	const last = addr + 3
	if
		self.protectStart == nil
		and ((last < APERTURE_START and last < self.size) or (addr >= ONE_MIB and last < self.size))
	then
		buffer.writeu32(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF))
		return
	end
	if self:isProtected(addr) then
		return
	end
	if self:hasLockedLowRom(addr, 4) then
		for index = 0, 3 do
			self:write8(addr + index, band(rshift(value, index * 8), 0xFF))
		end
		return
	end
	if self:isRam(addr, 4) then
		buffer.writeu32(self.buf, addr, band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF))
		return
	end
	self:write16(addr, band(value, 0xFFFF))
	self:write16(addr + 2, band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFFFF))
end

-- Copy a Luau buffer into memory at a physical address. This bypasses MMIO but
-- still respects ROM shadows and memory bounds.
function Memory:copyFrom(addr: number, src: buffer)
	const length = buffer.len(src)
	addr = self:translate(addr)
	if self:isRam(addr, length) and not self:isProtected(addr) then
		buffer.copy(self.buf, addr, src, 0, length)
		return
	end
	for index = 0, length - 1 do
		self:write8(addr + index, buffer.readu8(src, index))
	end
end

-- Copy a region of memory out as a new buffer.
function Memory:copyTo(addr: number, length: number): buffer
	local out = buffer.create(length)
	addr = self:translate(addr)
	if self:isRam(addr, length) then
		buffer.copy(out, 0, self.buf, addr, length)
		return out
	end
	for index = 0, length - 1 do
		buffer.writeu8(out, index, self:read8(addr + index))
	end
	return out
end

function Memory:writeString(addr: number, str: string)
	const base: number = self:translate(addr)
	for index = 1, #str do
		const byte = string.byte(str, index) :: number
		self:write8(base + index - 1, byte)
	end
end

function Memory:readString(addr: number, length: number): string
	const base: number = self:translate(addr)
	local parts: { string } = {}
	for index = 0, length - 1 do
		const byte: number = self:read8(base + index)
		parts[index + 1] = string.char(byte)
	end
	return table.concat(parts)
end

-- 8086-style segment:offset helper (20-bit wrap). 386 code should use the
-- CPU's segment caches instead; this remains for legacy callers and tests.
function Memory.phys(seg: number, off: number): number
	return band(lshift(seg, 4) + off, 0xFFFFF)
end

return Memory

-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: Config (the table's fields: startingCash, incomeTickRate, sellFraction, lockDuration, rebirthBaseCost, rebirthGrowth, rebirthIncomeBonus, cashAfterRebirth, dockSpawnCap, dockSpawnInterval, stealHold, stealCooldown, statePushRate, slotCount, baseCount, carryHeight, tiers)

--   rebirthIncomeBonus 0.5, cashAfterRebirth 100, dockSpawnCap 6, dockSpawnInterval 8, stealHold 2.5, stealCooldown 4, statePushRate 0.25,
--   slotCount 6, baseCount 8, carryHeight 4; tiers (rarity/threshold): Common 450, Uncommon 700, Rare 880, Epic 960, Legendary 988, Mythic 998, Ultra Rare 1000.
-- module block:
--   Owns: the single literal Config table (sixteen scalar tunables plus the ordered tiers list of seven rarity/threshold pairs).
--   Refuses: any behaviour at all; it requires no other module, defines no functions, holds no runtime state,
--   does not validate, clamp or freeze its values, and does not touch players, instances or the client.
--   Returns: the Config table itself (a plain mutable table shared by reference with every requiring module).

		{ rarity = "Legendary", threshold = 988 },

}

--!strict
-- Ne2000.lua -- DP8390-compatible NE2000 Ethernet controller.
--
-- The guest sees the classic 16-bit ISA card at 0x300/IRQ10: 16 register
-- bytes, a remote-DMA data port, a reset port, and 32 KiB of packet memory
-- (the top 16 KiB is the receive/transmit ring). The host injects and receives
-- Ethernet frames through callbacks, so the core stays environment-pure.

const band, bor, lshift, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const Ne2000 = {}
Ne2000.__index = Ne2000

Ne2000.BASE = 0x300
Ne2000.IRQ = 10
Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET = 0x10
Ne2000.RESET_OFFSET = 0x1F
Ne2000.MEM_SIZE = 0x8000
Ne2000.PMEM_START = 0x4000
Ne2000.MAX_FRAME = 1514

-- Page-0 command bits.
const CR_STOP = 0x01
const CR_TXP = 0x04
const CR_RREAD = 0x08
const CR_RWRITE = 0x10
const CR_NODMA = 0x20
const CR_PAGE1 = 0x40
const CR_PAGE2 = 0x80

const ISR_RX = 0x01
const ISR_TX = 0x02
const ISR_TX_ERR = 0x08
const ISR_OVER = 0x10
const ISR_RDC = 0x40
const ISR_RESET = 0x80

const TSR_PTX = 0x01

export type Config = {
	mac: string?,
	base: number?,
	irq: number?,
	transmit: ((frame: buffer) -> ())?,
}

export type Ne2000 = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		base: number,
		irq: number,
		mem: buffer,
		cmd: number,
		start: number,
		stop: number,
		boundary: number,
		curpag: number,
		tsr: number,
		tpsr: number,
		tcnt: number,
		rsar: number,
		rcnt: number,
		rsr: number,
		rxcr: number,
		isr: number,
		dcfg: number,
		imr: number,
		phys: { number },
		mult: { number },
		transmit: ((frame: buffer) -> ())?,
		irqLine: boolean,
		new: (config: Config?) -> Ne2000,
		reset: (self: Ne2000) -> (),
		in8: (self: Ne2000, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Ne2000, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		in16: (self: Ne2000, port: number) -> number,
		out16: (self: Ne2000, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		irqPending: (self: Ne2000) -> boolean,
		takeIrq: (self: Ne2000) -> boolean,
		receive: (self: Ne2000, frame: buffer) -> boolean,
		macString: (self: Ne2000) -> string,
	},
	Ne2000
))

local function parseMac(text: string?): { number }
	const source = text or "52:54:00:12:34:56"
	const out = { 0x52, 0x54, 0, 0x12, 0x34, 0x56 }
	local index = 0
	for part in string.gmatch(source, "[^:%-]+") do
		if index < 6 then
			out[index + 1] = band(tonumber(part, 16) or 0, 0xFF)
			index += 1
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function macText(phys: { number }): string
	return string.format(
		"%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X",
		phys[1],
		phys[2],
		phys[3],
		phys[4],
		phys[5],
		phys[6]
	)
end

function Ne2000.new(config: Config?): Ne2000
	const cfg: Config = config or {}
	local self = setmetatable({}, Ne2000) :: any
	self.base = cfg.base or Ne2000.BASE
	self.irq = cfg.irq or Ne2000.IRQ
	self.mem = buffer.create(Ne2000.MEM_SIZE)
	self.phys = parseMac(cfg.mac)
	self.mult = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 }
	self.transmit = cfg.transmit
	self.irqLine = false
	self:reset()
	return self
end

function Ne2000.reset(self: Ne2000)
	self.cmd = bor(CR_STOP, CR_NODMA)
	self.start = 0x46 * 256
	self.stop = 0x80 * 256
	self.boundary = 0x46
	self.curpag = 0x46
	self.tsr = 0
	self.tpsr = 0
	self.tcnt = 0
	self.rsar = 0
	self.rcnt = 0
	self.rsr = 0
	self.rxcr = 0
	self.dcfg = 0
	self.imr = 0
	self.isr = ISR_RESET
	buffer.fill(self.mem, 0, Ne2000.MEM_SIZE, 0)
	for index = 1, 6 do
		buffer.writeu8(self.mem, index - 1, self.phys[index])
		buffer.writeu8(self.mem, (index - 1) * 2, self.phys[index])
		buffer.writeu8(self.mem, (index - 1) * 2 + 1, self.phys[index])
	end
	buffer.writeu8(self.mem, 14, 0x57)
	buffer.writeu8(self.mem, 15, 0x57)
	self.irqLine = false
end

function Ne2000.macString(self: Ne2000): string
	return macText(self.phys)
end

local function updateIrq(self: Ne2000)
	-- irqLine is the edge/latched state consumed by Machine.takeIrq. A new
	-- pending bit does not set it; takeIrq raises it once, and clearing ISR
	-- through the mask arms it for the next interrupt.
	if band(self.isr, self.imr) == 0 then
		self.irqLine = false
	end
end

function Ne2000.irqPending(self: Ne2000): boolean
	return band(self.isr, self.imr) ~= 0
end

-- One-shot line read for a machine that raises IRQ10 on a rising edge.
function Ne2000.takeIrq(self: Ne2000): boolean
	if not self:irqPending() then
		self.irqLine = false
		return false
	end
	if self.irqLine then
		return false
	end
	self.irqLine = true
	return true
end

local function page(self: Ne2000): number
	return band(self.cmd, 0xC0)
end

local function localIndex(pageNumber: number): number
	return band(pageNumber, 0x7F) * 256
end

local function ringNext(self: Ne2000, pageNumber: number): number
	local nextPage = pageNumber + 1
	if nextPage >= rshift(self.stop, 8) then
		nextPage = rshift(self.start, 8)
	end
	return nextPage
end

local function transmitPacket(self: Ne2000)
	const index = localIndex(self.tpsr)
	if self.tcnt == 0 or self.tcnt > Ne2000.MAX_FRAME then
		self.tsr = 0x20 -- FIFO underrun
		self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_TX_ERR)
		updateIrq(self)
		return
	end
	local frame = buffer.create(self.tcnt)
	buffer.copy(frame, 0, self.mem, index, self.tcnt)
	self.tsr = TSR_PTX
	self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_TX)
	self.cmd = band(self.cmd, bit32.bnot(CR_TXP))
	if self.transmit then
		self.transmit(frame)
	end
	updateIrq(self)
end

function Ne2000.receive(self: Ne2000, frame: buffer): boolean
	const length = buffer.len(frame)
	if length < 14 or length > Ne2000.MAX_FRAME then
		return false
	end
	local target = self.curpag
	local address = localIndex(target)
	local nextPage = ringNext(self, target)
	while true do
		const needed = 4 + length
		const room = if nextPage > target
			then localIndex(nextPage) - address
			else self.stop - address + self.start - localIndex(rshift(self.start, 8))
		if needed + 4 <= room then
			break
		end
		target = nextPage
		address = localIndex(target)
		nextPage = ringNext(self, target)
		if target == self.curpag then
			self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_OVER)
			updateIrq(self)
			return false
		end
	end
	buffer.writeu8(self.mem, address, ISR_RX)
	buffer.writeu8(self.mem, address + 1, nextPage)
	buffer.writeu16(self.mem, address + 2, length)
	buffer.copy(self.mem, address + 4, frame, 0, length)
	self.curpag = nextPage
	self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_RX)
	updateIrq(self)
	return true
end

local function dmaReadByte(self: Ne2000): number
	if band(self.cmd, CR_RREAD) == 0 or self.rcnt == 0 then
		return 0xFF
	end
	local value = 0xFF
	if self.rsar >= Ne2000.PMEM_START and self.rsar < Ne2000.MEM_SIZE then
		value = buffer.readu8(self.mem, self.rsar)
	end
	self.rsar = band(self.rsar + 1, 0xFFFF)
	self.rcnt = if self.rcnt > 0 then self.rcnt - 1 else 0
	if self.rcnt == 0 then
		self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_RDC)
		updateIrq(self)
	end
	return value
end

local function dmaWriteByte(self: Ne2000, value: number)
	if band(self.cmd, CR_RWRITE) == 0 or self.rcnt == 0 then
		return
	end
	if self.rsar >= Ne2000.PMEM_START and self.rsar < Ne2000.MEM_SIZE then
		buffer.writeu8(self.mem, self.rsar, band(value, 0xFF))
	end
	self.rsar = band(self.rsar + 1, 0xFFFF)
	self.rcnt = if self.rcnt > 0 then self.rcnt - 1 else 0
	if self.rcnt == 0 then
		self.isr = bor(self.isr, ISR_RDC)
		updateIrq(self)
	end
end

local function readRegister(self: Ne2000, offset: number): number
	const current = page(self)
	if offset == 0 then
		return self.cmd
	end
	if current == 0 then
		if offset == 1 then
			return band(self.rsar, 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 2 then
			return band(rshift(self.rsar, 8), 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 3 then
			return self.boundary
		elseif offset == 4 then
			return self.tsr
		elseif offset == 5 then
			return 0
		elseif offset == 6 then
			return 0
		elseif offset == 7 then
			return self.isr
		elseif offset == 8 then
			return band(self.rsar, 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 9 then
			return band(rshift(self.rsar, 8), 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 10 then
			return band(self.rcnt, 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 11 then
			return band(rshift(self.rcnt, 8), 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 12 then
			return self.rsr
		elseif offset == 13 or offset == 14 or offset == 15 then
			return 0
		end
	elseif current == CR_PAGE1 then
		if offset >= 1 and offset <= 6 then
			return self.phys[offset]
		elseif offset == 7 then
			return self.curpag
		elseif offset >= 8 and offset <= 15 then
			return self.mult[offset - 7]
		end
	elseif current == CR_PAGE2 then
		if offset == 1 then
			return band(rshift(self.start, 8), 0xFF)
		elseif offset == 2 then
			return band(rshift(self.stop, 8), 0xFF)
		end
	end
	return 0
end

local function writeRegister(self: Ne2000, offset: number, value: number)
	value = band(value, 0xFF)
	if offset == 0 then
		self.cmd = value
		if band(value, CR_STOP) ~= 0 then
			-- Stop/reset the chip without clearing the packet RAM.
			self.tsr = 0
		end
		if band(value, CR_TXP) ~= 0 then
			transmitPacket(self)
		end
		return
	end
	const current = page(self)
	if current == 0 then
		if offset == 1 then
			self.start = value * 256
		elseif offset == 2 then
			self.stop = value * 256
		elseif offset == 3 then
			self.boundary = value
		elseif offset == 4 then
			self.tpsr = value
		elseif offset == 5 then
			self.tcnt = bor(band(self.tcnt, 0xFF00), value)
		elseif offset == 6 then
			self.tcnt = bor(band(self.tcnt, 0x00FF), lshift(value, 8))
		elseif offset == 7 then
			self.isr = band(self.isr, bit32.bnot(value))
			updateIrq(self)
		elseif offset == 8 then
			self.rsar = bor(band(self.rsar, 0xFF00), value)
		elseif offset == 9 then
			self.rsar = bor(band(self.rsar, 0x00FF), lshift(value, 8))
		elseif offset == 10 then
			self.rcnt = bor(band(self.rcnt, 0xFF00), value)
		elseif offset == 11 then
			self.rcnt = bor(band(self.rcnt, 0x00FF), lshift(value, 8))
		elseif offset == 12 then
			self.rxcr = value
		elseif offset == 13 then
			-- transmit configuration: loopback is not modelled
		elseif offset == 14 then
			self.dcfg = value
		elseif offset == 15 then
			self.imr = value
			updateIrq(self)
		end
	elseif current == CR_PAGE1 then
		if offset >= 1 and offset <= 6 then
			self.phys[offset] = value
			buffer.writeu8(self.mem, (offset - 1) * 2, value)
			buffer.writeu8(self.mem, (offset - 1) * 2 + 1, value)
		elseif offset == 7 then
			self.curpag = value
		elseif offset >= 8 and offset <= 15 then
			self.mult[offset - 7] = value
		end
	end
end

function Ne2000.in8(self: Ne2000, port: number): number
	const offset = band(port - self.base, 0xFF)
	if offset == Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET then
		return dmaReadByte(self)
	elseif offset == Ne2000.RESET_OFFSET then
		return 0
	elseif offset < Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET then
		return readRegister(self, offset)
	end
	return 0xFF
end

function Ne2000.out8(self: Ne2000, port: number, value: number)
	const offset = band(port - self.base, 0xFF)
	if offset == Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET then
		dmaWriteByte(self, value)
	elseif offset == Ne2000.RESET_OFFSET then
		self:reset()
	elseif offset < Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET then
		writeRegister(self, offset, value)
	end
end

function Ne2000.in16(self: Ne2000, port: number): number
	const offset = band(port - self.base, 0xFF)
	if offset == Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET then
		if band(self.dcfg, 0x01) == 0 then
			return self:in8(port)
		end
		const low = dmaReadByte(self)
		const high = dmaReadByte(self)
		return bor(low, lshift(high, 8))
	end
	return self:in8(port)
end

function Ne2000.out16(self: Ne2000, port: number, value: number)
	const offset = band(port - self.base, 0xFF)
	if offset == Ne2000.DATA_OFFSET and band(self.dcfg, 0x01) ~= 0 then
		dmaWriteByte(self, band(value, 0xFF))
		dmaWriteByte(self, band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
		return
	end
	self:out8(port, band(value, 0xFF))
end

return Ne2000
