-- Dock: owns the pier spawn spots, timed restocking of docked brainrot, rare spawn announcements, and the take prompt.
-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: Dock.standing, Dock.freeSpot, Dock.spawnOne, Dock.stock, Dock.init, Dock.start, Dock.stop, Dock.spots
-- contract
-- Owns: the pier spots and the docked brainrot on them, restocked up to Config.dockSpawnCap every Config.dockSpawnInterval seconds.
-- Refuses: spawning past the cap or without a free spot; refuses a take when the player already carries something or the model is not docked.
-- Never: spawns more than the cap per restock pass, hands out an unknown brainrot id, or loses a docked model when Carry.attach fails.
--!strict

local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local Config = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Cast = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Cast"))
local Factory = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("BrainrotFactory"))
local PlayerState = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("PlayerState"))
local Carry = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Carry"))

local RARE_OR_BETTER: { [string]: boolean } = {
	Epic = true,
	Legendary = true,
	Mythic = true,
	["Ultra Rare"] = true,
}

local RARITY_COLOR: { [string]: Color3 } = {
	Common = Color3.fromRGB(198, 204, 214),
	Uncommon = Color3.fromRGB(64, 200, 140),
	Rare = Color3.fromRGB(64, 150, 255),
	Epic = Color3.fromRGB(186, 110, 255),
	Legendary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 48),
	Mythic = Color3.fromRGB(230, 48, 48),
	["Ultra Rare"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 64),
}

local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 64)

export type Anchors = {
	pierSpawns: { BasePart },
	plotCentres: { BasePart },
	pedestals: { { BasePart } },
	rebirth: BasePart,
	centre: BasePart,
}

type Spot = {
	part: BasePart,
	pier: number,
	index: number,
	model: Model?,
}

local spots: { Spot } = {}
local running = false
local folder: Folder? = nil
local alertRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil

-- === module table: Dock ===
-- Owns: the `spots` list (one invisible DockSpot marker per position along each pier, with its docked Model),
--   the "Docked" folder, the `running` restock loop flag, the cached Net.Alert RemoteEvent, and every
--   "TakePrompt" ProximityPrompt it puts on a docked brainrot's root part.
-- Refuses: Dock.spawnOne when Dock.standing() >= Config.dockSpawnCap, when no spot is free, or before Dock.init
--   has created the folder; Dock.start when the loop is already running; a take (onTake) when the prompt is not
--   "TakePrompt", its parent is not a BasePart, the model is not Docked, the player has no PlayerState, the
--   player is already carrying something, or the BrainrotId attribute is not a string or not known to Cast.getById.
-- Returns: the Dock table with standing (number), freeSpot (Spot?), spawnOne (Model?), stock, init, start,
--   stop (nothing) and spots (the live spots table, not a copy).
local Dock = {}

-- === rare announcements ===
-- Finds or creates the Net.Alert remote and caches it.
-- Returns: the Alert RemoteEvent, or nil if the Net folder is missing.
local function alertEvent(): RemoteEvent?
	if alertRemote then
		return alertRemote
	end
	local net = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Net")
	if not net then
		return nil
	end
	alertRemote = net:FindFirstChild("Alert") :: RemoteEvent?
	if not alertRemote then
		local event = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		event.Name = "Alert"
		event.Parent = net
		alertRemote = event
	end
	return alertRemote
end

-- Tells every client about a rare spawn, plus a burst at its position when it has a root.
-- Returns: nothing.
local function announce(model: Model, entry: Cast.Entry)
	alertRemote = alertEvent()
	local remote = alertRemote
	if not remote then
		return
	end
	local color = RARITY_COLOR[entry.rarity] or GOLD
	local isUltra = entry.rarity == "Ultra Rare"
	remote:FireAllClients({
		kind = if isUltra then "rare-ultra" else "rare",
		text = string.format("%s  -  %s", entry.name, entry.rarity),
		color = color,
		rarity = entry.rarity,
		name = entry.name,
		flash = isUltra,
	})
	if model.PrimaryPart then
		remote:FireAllClients({
			kind = "rare-burst",
			position = model.PrimaryPart.Position,
			color = color,
			flash = isUltra,
		})
	end
end

-- Plays a short particle and light flourish over a rare spawn, then announces it.
-- Returns: nothing.
local function flourish(model: Model, entry: Cast.Entry)
	alertEvent()
	local color = RARITY_COLOR[entry.rarity] or GOLD
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then
		announce(model, entry)
		return
	end

	local anchorPart = Instance.new("Part")
	anchorPart.Name = "RareFlourish"
	anchorPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4)
	anchorPart.Transparency = 1
	anchorPart.Anchored = true
	anchorPart.CanCollide = false
	anchorPart.CanQuery = false
	anchorPart.CanTouch = false
	anchorPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
	anchorPart.Parent = folder or workspace

	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = "RareRise"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.LightInfluence = 0
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.1),
	})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.9, 1.4)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 24)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(6, 6)
	emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = anchorPart
	emitter:Emit(70)

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Name = "RareFlash"
	light.Color = color
	light.Brightness = 6
	light.Range = 22
	light.Parent = anchorPart

	Debris:AddItem(anchorPart, 1.8)
	task.delay(0.25, function()
		if light.Parent then
			local tween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(light, TweenInfo.new(1.4), { Brightness = 0 })
			tween:Play()
		end
	end)

	announce(model, entry)
end

-- === dock spots ===
-- Adds a floating name and rarity plate above a docked brainrot so players can read the tier from the pier.
-- Returns: the new BillboardGui.
local function makeTierLabel(host: BasePart, entry: Cast.Entry): BillboardGui
	local accent = RARITY_COLOR[entry.rarity] or Color3.fromRGB(198, 204, 214)
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = "TierLabel"
	billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 108, 0, 34)
	local stagger = (math.floor(math.abs(host.Position.X) * 3) % 3) * 1.4
	billboard.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, (entry.height or 4) + 2.0 + stagger, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = false
	billboard.MaxDistance = 78
	billboard.LightInfluence = 0
	billboard.ResetOnSpawn = false
	billboard.Adornee = host
	billboard.Parent = host

	local plate = Instance.new("Frame")
	plate.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	plate.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 20)
	plate.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
	plate.BorderSizePixel = 0
	plate.Parent = billboard
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = plate
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = accent
	stroke.Thickness = 1.6
	stroke.Transparency = 0.15
	stroke.Parent = plate

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 20)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 2)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextScaled = false
	title.TextSize = 15
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(244, 246, 252)
	title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	title.Text = entry.name
	title.Parent = plate

	local tier = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	tier.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 16)
	tier.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 21)
	tier.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tier.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	tier.TextSize = 13
	tier.TextColor3 = accent
	tier.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
	tier.Text = string.upper(entry.rarity)
	tier.Parent = plate

	return billboard
end

-- Adds an instant "Take" prompt to a docked brainrot's root part.
-- Returns: the new ProximityPrompt.
local function makePrompt(host: BasePart): ProximityPrompt
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "TakePrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Take"
	prompt.ObjectText = host.Parent and host.Parent.Name or "Brainrot"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = host
	return prompt
end

-- === dock spots ===
-- Rebuilds the spot list with invisible markers spaced 8 studs apart along each pier.
-- Returns: nothing.
local function layoutSpots(anchors: Anchors)
	table.clear(spots)
	for pierIndex, spawn in anchors.pierSpawns do
		local origin = spawn.Position
		for i = 1, math.ceil(Config.dockSpawnCap / math.max(#anchors.pierSpawns, 1)) + 1 do
			local along = (i - 1) * 8
			local marker = Instance.new("Part")
			marker.Name = "DockSpot"
			marker.Size = Vector3.new(3, 0.2, 3)
			marker.Anchored = true
			marker.CanCollide = false
			marker.Transparency = 1
			marker.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, -along))
			marker.Parent = spawn.Parent
			table.insert(spots, {
				part = marker,
				pier = pierIndex,
				index = i,
				model = nil,
			})
		end
	end
end

-- === public api ===
-- Counts docked brainrot still in the world, clearing spots whose model is gone.
-- Returns: the number of occupied spots.
function Dock.standing(): number
	local n = 0
	for _, spot in spots do
		if spot.model and spot.model.Parent then
			n += 1
		else
			spot.model = nil
		end
	end
	return n
end

-- Finds the first spot with no live model, clearing its stale reference.
-- Returns: that Spot, or nil if every spot is taken.
function Dock.freeSpot(): Spot?
	for _, spot in spots do
		if spot.model == nil or spot.model.Parent == nil then
			spot.model = nil
			return spot
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Rolls and docks one brainrot on a free spot with a take prompt, flourishing rare ones.
-- Returns: the new Model, or nil if at the cap, no spot is free, or not initialised.
function Dock.spawnOne(rng: Random?): Model?
	if Dock.standing() >= Config.dockSpawnCap then
		return nil
	end
	local spot = Dock.freeSpot()
	if not spot or not folder then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = Cast.roll(rng)
	local model = Factory.create(entry, spot.part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
	model.Parent = folder
	Factory.standOn(model, spot.part)
	model:SetAttribute("Docked", true)
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if root then
		root.Anchored = true
		makePrompt(root)
		makeTierLabel(root, entry)
	end
	spot.model = model
	if RARE_OR_BETTER[entry.rarity] then
		flourish(model, entry)
	end
	return model
end

-- Spawns brainrot until the dock reaches Config.dockSpawnCap, at most that many attempts.
-- Returns: nothing.
function Dock.stock(rng: Random?)
	local guard = 0
	while Dock.standing() < Config.dockSpawnCap and guard < Config.dockSpawnCap do
		guard += 1
		if not Dock.spawnOne(rng) then
			break
		end
	end
end

-- Handles a take: refuses if the player already carries something, else attaches the brainrot and restores the dock on failure.
-- Returns: nothing.
local function onTake(prompt: ProximityPrompt, player: Player)
	if prompt.Name ~= "TakePrompt" then
		return
	end
	local root = prompt.Parent
	if not (root and root:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return
	end
	local model = root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if not model or model:GetAttribute("Docked") ~= true then
		return
	end
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if state.carrying ~= nil then
		return
	end
	local id = model:GetAttribute("BrainrotId")
	if typeof(id) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local entry = Cast.getById(id)
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	for _, spot in spots do
		if spot.model == model then
			spot.model = nil
		end
	end
	model:SetAttribute("Docked", false)
	prompt:Destroy()
	local slot = PlayerState.slotFromEntry(entry)
	local attached = Carry.attach(player, slot, nil)
	if not attached then
		model:SetAttribute("Docked", true)
		for _, spot in spots do
			if spot.part == root.Parent then
				spot.model = model
				break
			end
		end
		if root.Parent then
			makePrompt(root)
		end
		return
	end
	if model.Parent and model ~= Carry.modelOf(player) then
		Factory.remove(model)
	end
end

-- Creates the Docked folder, lays out the pier spots and connects take prompts.
-- Returns: nothing.
function Dock.init(anchors: Anchors, parent: Instance?)
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Docked"
	folder.Parent = parent or workspace
	layoutSpots(anchors)
	ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, player)
		if prompt.Name == "TakePrompt" then
			onTake(prompt, player)
		end
	end)
end

-- Starts the restock loop, running Dock.stock every Config.dockSpawnInterval seconds (once only).
-- Returns: nothing.
function Dock.start()
	if running then
		return
	end
	running = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while running do
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				Dock.stock(nil)
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Dock] spawn failed: " .. tostring(err))
			end
			task.wait(Config.dockSpawnInterval)
		end
	end)
end

-- Signals the restock loop to stop after its current wait.
-- Returns: nothing.
function Dock.stop()
	running = false
end

-- Exposes the live spot list.
-- Returns: the spots table itself (not a copy).
function Dock.spots(): { Spot }
	return spots
end

--!strict

local fs = require("@std/fs")
local process = require("@std/process")
local Audit = require("../../../../tools/vendor/verify/src/roblox/ui-audit")
local Core = require("../../../../tools/vendor/verify/src/core")
local Lute = require("../../../../tools/vendor/verify/src/lute")
local Actions = require("../../../../tools/play/host/actions")
local Check = require("../../../../tools/play/host/check")
local Play = require("../../../../tools/play/host/play")
local QA = require("../../../../tools/play/host/qa")
local Space = require("../../../../tools/play/host/space")

local routes = {
	{ "shop", "Shop", "Store" },
	{ "garage", "Garage", "Karts" },
	{ "inventory", "Inventory", "Parts" },
	{ "drivers", "Drivers", "Driver" },
	{ "crates", "Crates", "Crate" },
	{ "daily-rewards", "Daily Rewards", "Daily", "Rewards" },
	{ "codes", "Codes", "Redeem" },
	{ "settings", "Settings", "Options" },
	{ "boosts", "Boosts", "Boost" },
	{ "quests", "Quests", "Missions" },
	{ "offer", "Offer", "Offers" },
	{ "play", "Play", "Race" },
	{ "livery", "Livery", "Customize" },
	{ "track-vote", "Track Vote", "Vote" },
	{ "quick-chat", "Quick Chat", "Chat" },
	{ "upgrades", "Upgrades", "Upgrade" },
	{ "party", "Party", "Friends" },
	{ "tutorial", "Tutorial", "Help" },
}

local function signature(qa: QA.QA): string
	local values = qa:texts()
	for index, value in values do
		values[index] = string.gsub(string.lower(value), "%d+", "#")
	end
	table.sort(values)
	return table.concat(values, "\n")
end

local function stability(qa: QA.QA, context: Core.Context, screen: string)
	local actions: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, action in qa:find({ role = "button" }, 1000) do
		if action.interactable then
			actions[action.path] = true
		end
	end
	qa:call("frameStability", { action = "begin" })
	context:defer(function()
		qa:call("frameStability", { action = "end" })
	end)
	qa:sleep(2)
	local observed = qa:call("frameStability", { action = "end" })
	context:attach(screen .. "-idle-geometry", "application/json", Lute.encode(observed))
	Check.that(context, Check.number(observed, "frames") >= 30, "idle geometry has at least 30 rendered frames")
	local faults = Check.field(observed, "faults")
	assert(type(faults) == "table", "idle geometry needs native observations")
	for _, fault in faults :: { unknown } do
		local path = Check.field(fault, "path")
		assert(type(path) == "string", "idle geometry needs an object path")
		local object = string.gsub(path, "#%d+$", "")
		Check.that(context, actions[object] ~= true, "idle action geometry moved: " .. object)
	end
end

local function observe(qa: QA.QA, context: Core.Context, screen: string)
	qa:dump(screen)
	qa:capture("navigation-" .. screen)
	local output: string? = nil
	for index, word in process.args do
		if word == "--outputs" then
			output = process.args[index + 1]
		end
	end
	assert(output, "navigation observation needs --outputs")
	local dump =
		Audit.decode(Lute.parse(fs.readFileToString(output .. "/dumps/" .. qa.device.id .. "/" .. screen .. ".json")))
	local audit = Audit.analyze(dump, { touch = qa.device.mode == "touch", gamepad = qa.device.mode == "gamepad" })
	context:attach(screen .. "-audit", "application/json", Lute.encode(audit))
	for _, rule in
		{
			"text-truncated",
			"text-clipped",
			"contrast-low",
			"offscreen",
			"outside-safe-area",
			"touch-target-small",
			"interactive-overlap",
			"focus-hidden",
		}
	do
		local summary = audit.rules[rule]
		Check.that(context, summary == nil or summary.count == 0, screen .. ": " .. rule)
	end
	Check.that(context, Space.textClear(dump), "text does not overlap")
	Check.that(context, Space.safeContent(dump), "content clears core UI and cutouts")
	Check.that(context, Space.visibleScrimsCover(dump), "visible scrims cover the screen")
	Check.that(context, Space.selectionValid(dump), "selection is valid")
	for _, element in dump.elements do
		if element.visible and element.text ~= nil and element.text.content ~= "" then
			Check.that(context, element.text.size >= 14, "visible text has a readable size")
		end
	end
	if qa.device.mode == "touch" then
		local controls = qa:call("touchControls")
		Check.that(context, Check.field(controls, "available") == true, "native touch controls are observable")
		local raw = Check.field(controls, "rectangles")
		assert(type(raw) == "table", "native touch rectangles are required")
		local rectangles: { Space.TouchRect } = {}
		for _, item in raw :: { unknown } do
			local path = Check.field(item, "path")
			table.insert(rectangles, {
				path = if type(path) == "string" then path else nil,
				x = Check.number(item, "rect", "x"),
				y = Check.number(item, "rect", "y"),
				width = Check.number(item, "rect", "width"),
				height = Check.number(item, "rect", "height"),
			})
		end
		context:attach(screen .. "-touch-controls", "application/json", Lute.encode(controls))
		Check.that(context, Space.touchControlsClear(dump, rectangles), "content clears actual touch controls")
	end
end

local scenario: Play.Scenario = { sessions = {} }
for _, device in { "desktop", "phone-portrait", "phone-landscape", "tablet", "console" } do
	local cases: { Play.Case } = {}
	for _, route in routes do
		local screen = route[1]
		table.insert(cases, {
			id = "navigation/" .. screen,
			tier = "universal" :: "universal",
			screen = screen,
			shot = "navigation-" .. screen,
			run = function(qa, context)
				local root = Actions.captureRoot(qa)
				context:defer(function()
					local recovered, detail = Actions.returnToRoot(qa, root)
					Check.that(context, recovered, "return after " .. screen .. ": " .. detail)
				end)
				local target: QA.Query? = nil
				for index = 2, #route do
					local candidate: QA.Query = { role = "button", text = string.lower(route[index]) }
					if Actions.reveal(qa, candidate) then
						target = candidate
						break
					end
				end
				Check.that(context, target ~= nil, "a player can discover " .. screen)
				local before = signature(qa)
				Check.tap(qa, context, target :: QA.Query, "open " .. screen)
				local settled = qa:call("perf", { action = "settle", quiet = 0.1, limit = 20 })
				Check.that(context, Check.field(settled, "timedOut") == false, screen .. " settles")
				Check.that(
					context,
					signature(qa) ~= before,
					screen .. " changes visible content beyond a running counter"
				)
				stability(qa, context, screen)
				observe(qa, context, screen)
				local returned, detail = Actions.returnToRoot(qa, root)
				Check.that(context, returned, "return from " .. screen .. ": " .. detail)
				local reachable, reason = Actions.returned(qa, target :: QA.Query, nil, root)
				Check.that(context, reachable, "restore the opener: " .. reason)
			end,
		})
	end
	table.insert(scenario.sessions, { device = device, cases = cases })
end

Play.main(scenario, debug.info(1, "s"))

--!strict
-- Pic.lua -- 8259A master/slave pair.
--
-- The PC's two 8259s are initialized by the BIOS with ICW1-ICW4, remapped away
-- from the 8086 vectors, then driven by the PIT/RTC/keyboard. This model keeps
-- the architectural IRR/ISR/IMR state and the master/slave cascade (IRQ2), but
-- does not simulate interrupt-acknowledge bus timing: Machine takes a pending
-- vector, delivers it to the CPU, and the guest's EOI clears the ISR bit.

const band, bor, bnot, lshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bnot, bit32.lshift

const Pic = {}
Pic.__index = Pic

type Chip = {
	irr: number,
	isr: number,
	imr: number,
	vectorBase: number,
	initStep: number,
	icw4: boolean,
	single: boolean,
	readIsr: boolean,
	level: boolean,
	poll: boolean,
}

export type Pic = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		master: Chip,
		slave: Chip,
		pendingVector: number?,
		in8: (self: Pic, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Pic, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		raise: (self: Pic, irq: number) -> (),
		syncCascade: (self: Pic) -> (),
		acknowledge: (self: Pic) -> (number?, number?),
		eoi: (self: Pic, irq: number?) -> (),
		nextPending: (self: Pic) -> number?,
		reset: (self: Pic) -> (),
	},
	Pic
))

local function newChip(vectorBase: number): Chip
	return {
		irr = 0,
		isr = 0,
		imr = 0xFF,
		vectorBase = vectorBase,
		initStep = 0,
		icw4 = false,
		single = false,
		readIsr = false,
		level = false,
		poll = false,
	}
end

function Pic.new(): Pic
	local self = setmetatable({}, Pic) :: any
	self.master = newChip(0x08)
	self.slave = newChip(0x70)
	self.pendingVector = nil
	return self
end

function Pic.reset(self: Pic)
	self.master = newChip(0x08)
	self.slave = newChip(0x70)
	self.pendingVector = nil
end

local function highestIsr(chip: Chip): number?
	for bit = 0, 7 do
		if band(chip.isr, lshift(1, bit)) ~= 0 then
			return bit
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- The 8259 fixed-priority resolver: an in-service IRQ blocks itself and all
-- lower-priority IRQs. Only a higher-priority request may preempt it. Ignoring
-- ISR here would redeliver the same level and nest handlers incorrectly.
local function bestIrq(chip: Chip): number?
	local eligible = band(chip.irr, bnot(chip.imr))
	const inService = highestIsr(chip)
	if inService ~= nil then
		eligible = band(eligible, lshift(1, inService) - 1)
	end
	if eligible == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	for bit = 0, 7 do
		if band(eligible, lshift(1, bit)) ~= 0 then
			return bit
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function setBit(mask: number, bit: number, on: boolean): number
	if on then
		return bor(mask, lshift(1, bit))
	end
	return band(mask, bnot(lshift(1, bit)))
end

function Pic.raise(self: Pic, irq: number)
	if irq < 0 or irq > 15 then
		return
	end
	if irq < 8 then
		self.master.irr = setBit(self.master.irr, irq, true)
		return
	end
	const slaveIrq = irq - 8
	self.slave.irr = setBit(self.slave.irr, slaveIrq, true)
	self:syncCascade()
end

-- The master's IR2 input is wired to the slave's INT output, which is high
-- exactly while the slave holds an unmasked request. Derive it instead of
-- latching it at raise time: a request raised while the slave is masked must
-- surface when the guest unmasks the slave (the Win9x ATAPI drivers mask
-- IRQ14 around data phases and unmask afterwards).
function Pic.syncCascade(self: Pic)
	const request = band(self.slave.irr, bnot(self.slave.imr))
	self.master.irr = setBit(self.master.irr, 2, request ~= 0)
end

function Pic.nextPending(self: Pic): number?
	const masterIrq = bestIrq(self.master)
	if masterIrq == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if masterIrq == 2 then
		const slaveIrq = bestIrq(self.slave)
		if slaveIrq ~= nil then
			return self.slave.vectorBase + slaveIrq
		end
	end
	return self.master.vectorBase + masterIrq
end

function Pic.acknowledge(self: Pic): (number?, number?)
	const masterIrq = bestIrq(self.master)
	if masterIrq == nil then
		return nil, nil
	end
	if masterIrq == 2 then
		const slaveIrq = bestIrq(self.slave)
		if slaveIrq ~= nil then
			self.slave.irr = setBit(self.slave.irr, slaveIrq, false)
			self.slave.isr = setBit(self.slave.isr, slaveIrq, true)
			-- The slave's INT output may stay high when another request is
			-- already queued behind the one being acknowledged.
			self:syncCascade()
			self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, 2, true)
			return self.slave.vectorBase + slaveIrq, 8 + slaveIrq
		end
	end
	self.master.irr = setBit(self.master.irr, masterIrq, false)
	self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, masterIrq, true)
	return self.master.vectorBase + masterIrq, masterIrq
end

function Pic.eoi(self: Pic, irq: number?)
	if irq ~= nil then
		if irq >= 8 then
			self.slave.isr = setBit(self.slave.isr, irq - 8, false)
			-- Only release the cascade line once the slave has no in-service
			-- interrupts left.
			if self.slave.isr == 0 then
				self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, 2, false)
			end
			self:syncCascade()
		else
			self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, irq, false)
		end
		return
	end
	-- Non-specific EOI clears the highest-priority in-service bit.
	const masterBit = highestIsr(self.master)
	if masterBit == nil then
		return
	end
	self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, masterBit, false)
	if masterBit == 2 then
		const slaveBit = highestIsr(self.slave)
		if slaveBit ~= nil then
			self.slave.isr = setBit(self.slave.isr, slaveBit, false)
		end
	end
	self:syncCascade()
end

-- A non-specific EOI written to the slave command port clears the slave, not
-- the master. This is the normal end of an IRQ8-15 handler sequence.
local function eoiSlave(self: Pic)
	const slaveBit = highestIsr(self.slave)
	if slaveBit == nil then
		return
	end
	self.slave.isr = setBit(self.slave.isr, slaveBit, false)
	if self.slave.isr == 0 then
		self.master.isr = setBit(self.master.isr, 2, false)
	end
	self:syncCascade()
end

local function writeChip(self: Pic, chip: Chip, port: number, value: number)
	if port == 0 then
		if band(value, 0x10) ~= 0 then
			chip.initStep = 1
			chip.icw4 = band(value, 0x01) ~= 0
			chip.single = band(value, 0x02) ~= 0
			chip.level = band(value, 0x08) ~= 0
			chip.irr = 0
			chip.isr = 0
			self:syncCascade()
			return
		end
		if band(value, 0x08) ~= 0 then
			-- OCW3: RR (bit 1) selects the register the next command-port read
			-- returns and RIS (bit 0) picks ISR over IRR; a write with RR clear leaves
			-- the selection alone. P (bit 2) makes the next read a poll command.
			-- Win98's VPICD reads IRR with 0Ah and polls during init.
			if band(value, 0x02) ~= 0 then
				chip.readIsr = band(value, 0x01) ~= 0
			end
			chip.poll = band(value, 0x04) ~= 0
			return
		end
		-- OCW2: end-of-interrupt (specific when bit 6 is set).
		if band(value, 0x20) ~= 0 then
			if band(value, 0x40) ~= 0 then
				self:eoi(band(value, 7) + (if chip == self.slave then 8 else 0))
			elseif chip == self.slave then
				eoiSlave(self)
			else
				self:eoi(nil)
			end
		end
		return
	end
	if chip.initStep == 1 then
		chip.vectorBase = band(value, 0xF8)
		chip.initStep = if chip.single then (if chip.icw4 then 4 else 0) else 2
		return
	end
	if chip.initStep == 2 then
		-- ICW3: master cascade mask / slave cascade identity. The single bit in
		-- IRQ2 is the only cascade route this machine exposes.
		chip.initStep = if chip.icw4 then 4 else 0
		return
	end
	if chip.initStep == 4 then
		chip.initStep = 0
		return
	end
	chip.imr = band(value, 0xFF)
	self:syncCascade()
end

function Pic.out8(self: Pic, port: number, value: number)
	if port == 0x20 or port == 0x21 then
		writeChip(self, self.master, port - 0x20, value)
	elseif port == 0xA0 or port == 0xA1 then
		writeChip(self, self.slave, port - 0xA0, value)
	end
end

function Pic.in8(self: Pic, port: number): number
	local chip, isCommand
	if port == 0x20 then
		chip, isCommand = self.master, true
	elseif port == 0x21 then
		chip, isCommand = self.master, false
	elseif port == 0xA0 then
		chip, isCommand = self.slave, true
	elseif port == 0xA1 then
		chip, isCommand = self.slave, false
	else
		return 0xFF
	end
	if not isCommand then
		return chip.imr
	end
	if chip.poll then
		-- Poll command: acknowledge the highest pending request like INTA would and
		-- return bit 7 plus its level; 0 when nothing is pending.
		chip.poll = false
		const irq = bestIrq(chip)
		if irq == nil then
			return 0
		end
		chip.irr = setBit(chip.irr, irq, false)
		chip.isr = setBit(chip.isr, irq, true)
		self:syncCascade()
		return bor(0x80, irq)
	end
	return if chip.readIsr then chip.isr else chip.irr
end

return Pic

-- Pedestal: owns pedestal slots: placed models, rarity showcases, place/sell prompts, and passive income ticks.
-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: Pedestal.init, Pedestal.visual, Pedestal.sync, Pedestal.clearBase, Pedestal.tryPlace, Pedestal.trySell, Pedestal.tickIncome, Pedestal.bind, Pedestal.start, Pedestal.stop
-- contract
-- Owns: pedestal visuals per base slot; placing moves the carried brainrot into an empty slot, selling pays price * Config.sellFraction.
-- Refuses: place or sell unless the player owns the base (ownership is checked); place without a carry or onto a filled slot; sell of an empty slot.
-- Never: pays income except via the tick (placed income * multiplier * Config.incomeTickRate every Config.incomeTickRate s), or shows a model the owner's state lacks.
--!strict

local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Cast = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Cast"))
local Factory = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("BrainrotFactory"))
local PlayerState = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("PlayerState"))
local Carry = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Carry"))
local Bases = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Bases"))

type Slot = PlayerState.Slot

type Visual = {
	baseIndex: number,
	slotIndex: number,
	top: BasePart,
	model: Model?,
	placePrompt: ProximityPrompt,
	sellPrompt: ProximityPrompt,
	showcase: Model?,
}

local RARITY_TIER: { [string]: number } = {
	Rare = 1,
	Epic = 2,
	Legendary = 3,
	Mythic = 4,
	["Ultra Rare"] = 5,
}

local RARITY_COLOR: { [string]: Color3 } = {
	Rare = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 255),
	Epic = Color3.fromRGB(186, 110, 255),
	Legendary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 48),
	Mythic = Color3.fromRGB(230, 48, 48),
	["Ultra Rare"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 64),
}

local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 64)

type Ring = {
	part: BasePart,
	spin: number,
}

local showcases: { Model } = {}
local rings: { [Model]: { Ring } } = {}
local showcaseTicker: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local showcaseClock = 0

local visuals: { Visual } = {}
local ticking = false

-- === module table ===
-- Owns: the visuals list (one Visual per base pedestal: top part, placed model, PlacePrompt, SellPrompt,
--   showcase), the showcases list and rings map spun by the single Heartbeat showcaseTicker, and the
--   ticking flag that drives the income loop started by Pedestal.start.
-- Refuses: place when record.owner ~= player, when state.carrying is nil, or when the slot is already
--   filled; sell when record.owner ~= player, when there is no state, or when the slot is empty;
--   tryPlace/trySell on an unknown base/slot pair; prompt triggers whose parent is not a known pedestal
--   BasePart; a second income loop while ticking; showcases for rarities missing from RARITY_TIER.
-- Returns: this Pedestal table; Pedestal.visual returns Visual?, tryPlace returns boolean, trySell
--   returns the cash payout (0 when refused), and every other public function returns nothing.
local Pedestal = {}

-- === showcase effect ===
-- Connects one Heartbeat ticker that spins showcase rings and prunes destroyed showcases.
-- Returns: nothing.
local function startShowcaseTicker()
	if showcaseTicker then
		return
	end
	showcaseTicker = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if #showcases == 0 then
			return
		end
		showcaseClock += dt
		for i = #showcases, 1, -1 do
			local effect = showcases[i]
			if not effect.Parent then
				table.remove(showcases, i)
				continue
			end
			local list = rings[effect]
			if list then
				for _, ring in list do
					if ring.part.Parent then
						local base = ring.part:GetAttribute("BasePosition")
						if typeof(base) == "Vector3" then
							ring.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(base) * CFrame.Angles(0, showcaseClock * ring.spin, 0)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Builds a thin translucent ring part above a pedestal top inside the showcase model.
-- Returns: a Ring record holding the part and its spin speed.
local function makeRing(effect: Model, top: BasePart, radius: number, height: number, color: Color3, spin: number)
	local ring = Instance.new("Part")
	ring.Name = "ShowcaseRing"
	ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.06, radius * 2, radius * 2)
	ring.Color = color
	ring.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	ring.Transparency = 0.65
	ring.Anchored = true
	ring.CanCollide = false
	ring.CanQuery = false
	ring.CanTouch = false
	ring.CastShadow = false
	local base = top.Position + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
	ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(base) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	ring:SetAttribute("BasePosition", base)
	ring.Parent = effect
	return { part = ring, spin = spin }
end

local EMITTER_BUDGET = 1

-- Creates a coloured particle emitter on a part, rising or drifting.
-- Returns: the new ParticleEmitter.
local function makeEmitter(parent: BasePart, name: string, color: Color3, rate: number, rising: boolean): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = name
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.2
	emitter.LightInfluence = 1
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.2)
	emitter.Rate = rate
	if rising then
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(2.5, 4.5)
		emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(8, 8)
		emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
	else
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.4, 1.2)
		emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30)
		emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
	end
	emitter.Parent = parent
	return emitter
end

-- Destroys a pedestal's showcase and removes it from the ring and ticker lists.
-- Returns: nothing.
local function clearShowcase(visual: Visual)
	if not visual.showcase then
		return
	end
	rings[visual.showcase] = nil
	for i = #showcases, 1, -1 do
		if showcases[i] == visual.showcase then
			table.remove(showcases, i)
		end
	end
	visual.showcase:Destroy()
	visual.showcase = nil
end

-- === showcase effect ===
-- Rebuilds a pedestal's rarity showcase (rings, motes, gold shaft by tier); skips untiered rarities.
-- Returns: nothing.
local function buildShowcase(visual: Visual, entry: Cast.Entry)
	clearShowcase(visual)
	local tier = RARITY_TIER[entry.rarity]
	if not tier then
		return
	end
	local color = RARITY_COLOR[entry.rarity] or entry.aura
	local effect = Instance.new("Model")
	effect.Name = "Showcase"
	effect.Parent = visual.top.Parent
	visual.showcase = effect
	local list: { Ring } = {}
	table.insert(list, makeRing(effect, visual.top, 4.2, 0.4, color, 0.8))
	if tier >= 2 then
		table.insert(list, makeRing(effect, visual.top, 3.2, 0.9, color, -1.2))
	end
	rings[effect] = list

	local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Name = "ShowcaseAnchor"
	anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	anchor.Anchored = true
	anchor.CanCollide = false
	anchor.CanQuery = false
	anchor.CanTouch = false
	anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(visual.top.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
	anchor.Parent = effect

	local emitterCount = 0
	if tier >= 3 and emitterCount < EMITTER_BUDGET then
		makeEmitter(anchor, "RisingMotes", color, 12, true)
		emitterCount += 1
	end
	if tier >= 5 and emitterCount < EMITTER_BUDGET then
		makeEmitter(anchor, "GoldSparkle", GOLD, 14, true)
		emitterCount += 1
	end

	if tier >= 5 then
		local shaft = Instance.new("Part")
		shaft.Name = "LightShaft"
		shaft.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		shaft.Size = Vector3.new(9, 2.2, 2.2)
		shaft.Color = GOLD
		shaft.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		shaft.Transparency = 0.8
		shaft.Anchored = true
		shaft.CanCollide = false
		shaft.CanQuery = false
		shaft.CanTouch = false
		shaft.CastShadow = false
		shaft.CFrame = CFrame.new(visual.top.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5.5, 0))
		shaft.Parent = effect
	end

	table.insert(showcases, effect)
	startShowcaseTicker()
end

-- === prompt helpers ===
-- Creates a named proximity prompt on a pedestal top with the given text and hold time.
-- Returns: the new ProximityPrompt.
local function promptOn(host: BasePart, name: string, action: string, objectText: string, hold: number): ProximityPrompt
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = name
	prompt.ActionText = action
	prompt.ObjectText = objectText
	prompt.HoldDuration = hold
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = host
	return prompt
end

-- Syncs a pedestal's prompts (and clears its model when empty) from the base owner's slot state.
-- Returns: nothing.
local function refresh(visual: Visual)
	local record = Bases.getByIndex(visual.baseIndex)
	local owner = record and record.owner
	local state = owner and PlayerState.get(owner)
	local slot = state and state.slots[visual.slotIndex]
	if not slot then
		if visual.model then
			Factory.remove(visual.model)
			visual.model = nil
		end
		clearShowcase(visual)
		visual.sellPrompt.Enabled = false
		visual.placePrompt.Enabled = true
		visual.sellPrompt.ObjectText = "Empty"
		return
	end
	if visual.model and not visual.model.Parent then
		visual.model = nil
	end
	visual.sellPrompt.Enabled = true
	visual.placePrompt.Enabled = false
	visual.sellPrompt.ObjectText = slot.name
end

-- === slot visuals ===
-- Rebuilds a pedestal's model and showcase from the owner's current slot, or clears it.
-- Returns: nothing.
local function showSlot(visual: Visual, slot: Slot?)
	if visual.model then
		if visual.model.Parent then
			Factory.remove(visual.model)
		end
		visual.model = nil
	end
	if not slot then
		clearShowcase(visual)
		refresh(visual)
		return
	end
	local record = Bases.getByIndex(visual.baseIndex)
	local owner = record and record.owner
	local ownerState = owner and PlayerState.get(owner)
	local current = ownerState and ownerState.slots[visual.slotIndex]
	if not current then
		clearShowcase(visual)
		refresh(visual)
		return
	end
	local entry = Cast.getById(current.id)
	if not entry then
		clearShowcase(visual)
		refresh(visual)
		return
	end
	local model = Factory.create(entry, visual.top.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	model.Parent = visual.top.Parent
	Factory.standOn(model, visual.top)
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if root then
		root.Anchored = true
	end
	model:SetAttribute("Placed", true)
	model:SetAttribute("BaseIndex", visual.baseIndex)
	model:SetAttribute("SlotIndex", visual.slotIndex)
	visual.model = model
	buildShowcase(visual, entry)
	refresh(visual)
end

-- === public api ===
-- Builds a visual with place and sell prompts for every pedestal of every base.
-- Returns: nothing.
function Pedestal.init()
	table.clear(visuals)
	for _, record in Bases.records() do
		for slotIndex, top in record.pedestals do
			local visual: Visual = {
				baseIndex = record.index,
				slotIndex = slotIndex,
				top = top,
				model = nil,
				placePrompt = promptOn(top, "PlacePrompt", "Place", "Pedestal", 0),
				sellPrompt = promptOn(top, "SellPrompt", "Sell", "Empty", 0.4),
				showcase = nil,
			}
			visual.sellPrompt.Enabled = false
			table.insert(visuals, visual)
		end
	end
end

-- Looks up the visual for a base index and slot index.
-- Returns: that Visual, or nil if none matches.
function Pedestal.visual(baseIndex: number, slotIndex: number): Visual?
	for _, visual in visuals do
		if visual.baseIndex == baseIndex and visual.slotIndex == slotIndex then
			return visual
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Redraws every pedestal on the player's base from their saved slots.
-- Returns: nothing.
function Pedestal.sync(player: Player)
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state or not state.baseIndex then
		return
	end
	for slotIndex = 1, Config.slotCount do
		local visual = Pedestal.visual(state.baseIndex, slotIndex)
		if visual then
			showSlot(visual, state.slots[slotIndex])
		end
	end
end

-- Empties every pedestal on a base and resets its prompts to the empty state.
-- Returns: nothing.
function Pedestal.clearBase(baseIndex: number)
	for slotIndex = 1, Config.slotCount do
		local visual = Pedestal.visual(baseIndex, slotIndex)
		if visual then
			showSlot(visual, nil)
			visual.model = nil
			clearShowcase(visual)
			visual.sellPrompt.Enabled = false
			visual.placePrompt.Enabled = true
			visual.sellPrompt.ObjectText = "Empty"
		end
	end
end

-- Moves the owner's carried brainrot onto an empty pedestal slot and shows it.
-- Returns: true if placed, false if not the owner, not carrying, or the slot is filled.
local function place(player: Player, visual: Visual): boolean
	local record = Bases.getByIndex(visual.baseIndex)
	if not record or record.owner ~= player then
		return false
	end
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state or not state.carrying then
		return false
	end
	if state.slots[visual.slotIndex] ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	local slot = state.carrying
	local model = Carry.takeModel(player)
	PlayerState.setSlot(player, visual.slotIndex, slot)
	if model then
		Factory.remove(model)
	end
	showSlot(visual, slot)
	PlayerState.markTutorial(player)
	return true
end

-- Sells the owner's brainrot on a pedestal for price * Config.sellFraction and empties the slot.
-- Returns: the cash paid out, or 0 if not the owner or the slot is empty.
local function sell(player: Player, visual: Visual): number
	local record = Bases.getByIndex(visual.baseIndex)
	if not record or record.owner ~= player then
		return 0
	end
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	local slot = state.slots[visual.slotIndex]
	if not slot then
		return 0
	end
	local payout = math.floor(slot.price * Config.sellFraction)
	PlayerState.setSlot(player, visual.slotIndex, nil)
	PlayerState.addCash(player, payout)
	showSlot(visual, nil)
	return payout
end

-- Attempts a place on the pedestal at the given base and slot index.
-- Returns: true if placed, false if the pedestal is unknown or the place was refused.
function Pedestal.tryPlace(player: Player, baseIndex: number, slotIndex: number): boolean
	local visual = Pedestal.visual(baseIndex, slotIndex)
	if not visual then
		return false
	end
	return place(player, visual)
end

-- Attempts a sale on the pedestal at the given base and slot index.
-- Returns: the payout, or 0 if the pedestal is unknown or the sale was refused.
function Pedestal.trySell(player: Player, baseIndex: number, slotIndex: number): number
	local visual = Pedestal.visual(baseIndex, slotIndex)
	if not visual then
		return 0
	end
	return sell(player, visual)
end

-- Pays each player placed income * income multiplier * Config.incomeTickRate when positive.
-- Returns: nothing.
function Pedestal.tickIncome()
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local state = PlayerState.get(player)
		if state then
			local gain = PlayerState.placedIncome(player) * PlayerState.incomeMultiplier(player) * Config.incomeTickRate
			if gain > 0 then
				PlayerState.addCash(player, gain)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Connects place and sell prompts to the matching pedestal's place and sell actions.
-- Returns: nothing.
function Pedestal.bind()
	ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, player)
		local top = prompt.Parent
		if not (top and top:IsA("BasePart")) then
			return
		end
		local visual: Visual? = nil
		for _, candidate in visuals do
			if candidate.top == top then
				visual = candidate
				break
			end
		end
		if not visual then
			return
		end
		if prompt.Name == "PlacePrompt" then
			place(player, visual)
		elseif prompt.Name == "SellPrompt" then
			sell(player, visual)
		end
	end)
end

-- Starts the income loop, running Pedestal.tickIncome every Config.incomeTickRate seconds (once only).
-- Returns: nothing.
function Pedestal.start()
	if ticking then
		return
	end
	ticking = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while ticking do
			local ok, err = pcall(Pedestal.tickIncome)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Pedestal] income tick failed: " .. tostring(err))
			end
			task.wait(Config.incomeTickRate)
		end
	end)
end

-- Signals the income loop to stop after its current wait.
-- Returns: nothing.
function Pedestal.stop()
	ticking = false
end

return Pedestal

local FacetTypes = require("../../src")

type FacetModule = FacetTypes.Facet
type FacetControls = FacetTypes.Controls
type ReadOnlyValue<T> = FacetTypes.ReadOnlyValue<T>
type Use = <T>(ReadOnlyValue<T>) -> T
type Item = { id: string, name: string, category: string }
type Model = { items: ReadOnlyValue<{ Item }> }

return function(Facet: FacetModule, UI: FacetControls, model: Model): Instance
	local category = Facet.Compose.cell("all")
	local itemsSpec: FacetTypes.KeyedCollectionSpec<Item, string> = {
		UI.fill(),
		from = function(use: Use)
			local selected = use(category)
			local filtered: { Item } = {}
			for _, item in use(model.items) do
				if selected == "all" or item.category == selected then
					table.insert(filtered, item)
				end
			end
			return filtered
		end,
		key = "id",
		minColumnWidth = 180,
		minColumns = 2,
		itemSize = 80,
		scrollReset = category,
		render = function(current: ReadOnlyValue<Item>): GuiObject
			return UI.Text "ItemName" {
				text = function(use: Use)
					return use(current).name
				end,
				textRole = "heading",
			}
		end,
	}
	local options: { FacetTypes.PickerOption<string> } = {
		{ value = "all", label = "All" },
		{ value = "tools", label = "Tools" },
		{ value = "outfits", label = "Outfits" },
	}
	local pickerSpec: FacetTypes.SinglePickerSpec<string> = {
		label = "Category",
		style = "segmented",
		selected = category,
		options = options,
	}
	return UI.Screen "Categories" {
		padding = "m",
		gap = "m",
		UI.Text "Title" { text = "Collection", textRole = "title" },
		UI.Picker "CategoryTabs"(pickerSpec),
		UI.VirtualGrid "Items"(itemsSpec),
	}
end

--!strict
-- Pit.lua -- 8254 programmable interval timer.
--
-- Machine advances all three counters once per emulated instruction. Channel 0
-- raises IRQ0 every reload; channel 1 is the refresh timer and channel 2 drives
-- the PC speaker. The BIOS uses channel 0 both for the system tick and as a
-- calibrated delay source, so reads must return a changing count.

const band, bor, lshift, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const Pit = {}
Pit.__index = Pit

const CHANNELS = 3

type Channel = {
	reload: number,
	counter: number,
	access: number, -- 1 LSB, 2 MSB, 3 LSB-then-MSB
	mode: number,
	bcd: boolean,
	flipFlop: number,
	latched: number?,
	statusLatched: number?, -- read-back status byte, returned before the count
	output: boolean,
}

export type Pit = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		channels: { Channel },
		irqPending: boolean,
		channel0Divisor: number,
		channel0Phase: number,
		in8: (self: Pit, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Pit, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		advance: (self: Pit, cycles: number) -> boolean,
		reset: (self: Pit) -> (),
	},
	Pit
))

local function newChannel(): Channel
	return {
		reload = 0,
		counter = 0x10000,
		access = 3,
		mode = 3,
		bcd = false,
		flipFlop = 0,
		latched = nil,
		statusLatched = nil,
		output = false,
	}
end

function Pit.new(): Pit
	local self = setmetatable({}, Pit) :: any
	self.channels = { newChannel(), newChannel(), newChannel() }
	self.irqPending = false
	-- Channel 0 (IRQ0) advances once per `channel0Divisor` advance() calls so a
	-- host can keep channel 2 fast (speed benchmarks) without flooding guests
	-- with timer IRQs far above real-time rate.
	self.channel0Divisor = 1
	self.channel0Phase = 0
	return self
end

function Pit.reset(self: Pit)
	self.channels = { newChannel(), newChannel(), newChannel() }
	self.irqPending = false
end

local function reloadValue(channel: Channel): number
	return if channel.reload == 0 then 0x10000 else channel.reload
end

function Pit.advance(self: Pit, cycles: number): boolean
	local irq = false
	const channels = self.channels
	-- Channel 0 sees one count per `channel0Divisor` guest steps; batched calls
	-- (cycles > 1) carry the remainder in channel0Phase.
	local channel0Cycles = cycles
	if self.channel0Divisor > 1 then
		const total = self.channel0Phase + cycles
		channel0Cycles = total // self.channel0Divisor
		self.channel0Phase = total - channel0Cycles * self.channel0Divisor
	end
	for index = 0, CHANNELS - 1 do
		const ticks = if index == 0 then channel0Cycles else cycles
		if ticks == 0 then
			continue
		end
		const channel = channels[index + 1]
		-- Inline reloadValue: advance runs once per guest instruction.
		const period = if channel.reload == 0 then 0x10000 else channel.reload
		local remaining = channel.counter - ticks
		while remaining <= 0 do
			remaining += period
			if index == 0 then
				irq = true
			end
			-- Mode 0 (interrupt on terminal count) drives the output high at
			-- the terminal count and leaves it high until reprogrammed. SeaBIOS
			-- uses this on channel 2 for TSC calibration and polls PPI bit 5.
			if channel.mode == 0 then
				channel.output = true
			else
				channel.output = not channel.output
			end
		end
		channel.counter = remaining
	end
	if irq then
		self.irqPending = true
	end
	return irq
end

function Pit.out8(self: Pit, port: number, value: number)
	value = band(value, 0xFF)
	if port == 0x43 then
		const channelIndex = rshift(value, 6)
		if channelIndex == 3 then
			-- Read-back command (11 !COUNT !STATUS C2 C1 C0 0). Bits 1-3 select
			-- channels; a clear bit 5 latches the count, a clear bit 4 latches
			-- the status byte, which the next read returns before the count.
			-- WIN98 SETUP times IDIV with 0xC8 (channel 2, count + status).
			const latchCount = band(value, 0x20) == 0
			const latchStatus = band(value, 0x10) == 0
			for index = 0, 2 do
				if band(value, lshift(2, index)) ~= 0 then
					const target = self.channels[index + 1]
					if latchCount and target.latched == nil then
						target.latched = target.counter
					end
					if latchStatus and target.statusLatched == nil then
						target.statusLatched = bor(
							if target.output then 0x80 else 0,
							lshift(target.access, 4),
							lshift(target.mode, 1),
							if target.bcd then 1 else 0
						)
					end
				end
			end
			return
		end
		const channel = self.channels[channelIndex + 1]
		channel.access = band(rshift(value, 4), 3)
		channel.mode = band(rshift(value, 1), 7)
		channel.bcd = band(value, 1) ~= 0
		channel.flipFlop = 0
		if channel.access == 0 then
			channel.latched = channel.counter
		end
		return
	end
	if port >= 0x40 and port <= 0x42 then
		const channel = self.channels[port - 0x40 + 1]
		if channel.access == 1 then
			channel.reload = band(value, 0xFF)
		elseif channel.access == 2 then
			channel.reload = lshift(band(value, 0xFF), 8)
		else
			if channel.flipFlop == 0 then
				channel.reload = band(channel.reload, 0xFF00) + band(value, 0xFF)
				channel.flipFlop = 1
			else
				channel.reload = band(value, 0xFF) * 0x100 + band(channel.reload, 0xFF)
				channel.flipFlop = 0
			end
		end
		channel.counter = reloadValue(channel)
		channel.output = false
	end
end

function Pit.in8(self: Pit, port: number): number
	if port < 0x40 or port > 0x42 then
		return 0xFF
	end
	const channel = self.channels[port - 0x40 + 1]
	if channel.statusLatched ~= nil then
		const status = channel.statusLatched :: number
		channel.statusLatched = nil
		return status
	end
	local value
	if channel.latched ~= nil then
		value = channel.latched :: number
	else
		value = channel.counter
	end
	local result
	if channel.access == 1 then
		result = band(value, 0xFF)
	elseif channel.access == 2 then
		result = band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF)
	else
		if channel.flipFlop == 0 then
			result = band(value, 0xFF)
			channel.flipFlop = 1
		else
			result = band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF)
			channel.flipFlop = 0
			channel.latched = nil
		end
	end
	return result
end

return Pit

-- PlayerState: owns the authoritative per-player state record: cash, rebirths, slots, carrying, and (de)serialization.
-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: PlayerState.create, PlayerState.get, PlayerState.addCash, PlayerState.spendCash, PlayerState.setBase, PlayerState.setCarrying, PlayerState.setSlot, PlayerState.clearSlots, PlayerState.incomeMultiplier, PlayerState.placedIncome, PlayerState.serialize, PlayerState.clear, PlayerState.slotFromEntry
-- contract:
--   Owns: one State per player keyed by player, with fields cash, rebirths, baseIndex, slots (Config.slotCount entries), carrying, userId.
--   Validates: loaded cash/rebirths must be numbers (floored, clamped >= 0); loaded slot/carrying ids must resolve via Cast.getById;
--   spendCash refuses negative cost or insufficient cash; setSlot ignores indexes outside 1..Config.slotCount; addCash clamps cash at 0.
--   Returns: create -> State (existing one if present); spendCash -> boolean; addCash -> new cash (0 if no state);
--   incomeMultiplier -> 1 + rebirthIncomeBonus * rebirths; serialize -> plain table (empty slots/carrying as false, baseIndex 0 if nil) or nil.
--!strict

local Config = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Cast = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Cast"))

export type Slot = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	income: number,
	price: number,
}

export type State = {
	cash: number,
	rebirths: number,
	baseIndex: number?,
	slots: { Slot? },
	carrying: Slot?,
	tutorialDone: boolean,
	userId: number,
}

local byPlayer: { [any]: State } = {}

-- PlayerState module table.
-- Owns: the private byPlayer map holding one State per player (cash, rebirths, baseIndex, slots, carrying, userId).
-- Refuses: a second create for the same player (returns the existing State); loaded cash/rebirths that are not numbers;
--   loaded slot/carrying ids that Cast.getById cannot resolve; spendCash with a negative cost or more than the player holds;
--   setSlot indexes outside 1..Config.slotCount; cash going below 0 in addCash; every mutator is a no-op when no State exists.
-- Returns: State from create/get, new cash from addCash, boolean from spendCash, numbers from incomeMultiplier/placedIncome,
--   a plain save table (with incomeRate) or nil from serialize, and a fresh Slot from slotFromEntry.
local PlayerState = {}

-- === state lifecycle ===
-- Builds an empty slot list sized to Config.slotCount with every entry nil.
-- Returns: a fresh { Slot? } table with no occupied slots.
local function blankSlots(): { Slot? }
	local slots: { Slot? } = {}
	for i = 1, Config.slotCount do
		slots[i] = nil
	end
	return slots
end

-- Creates the player's State from defaults, overlaying validated cash, rebirths, carrying and slots from a loaded save.
-- Returns: the new State, or the already existing State if the player has one.
function PlayerState.create(player: any, loaded: { [string]: any }?): State
	local existing = byPlayer[player]
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	local state: State = {
		cash = Config.startingCash,
		rebirths = 0,
		baseIndex = nil,
		slots = blankSlots(),
		carrying = nil,
		tutorialDone = false,
		userId = if typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.UserId else (player.UserId or 0),
	}
	if loaded then
		if loaded.tutorialDone == true then
			state.tutorialDone = true
		end
		if typeof(loaded.cash) == "number" then
			state.cash = math.max(0, math.floor(loaded.cash))
		end
		if typeof(loaded.rebirths) == "number" then
			state.rebirths = math.max(0, math.floor(loaded.rebirths))
		end
		if typeof(loaded.carrying) == "table" then
			local entry = Cast.getById(loaded.carrying.id)
			if entry then
				state.carrying = {
					id = entry.id,
					name = entry.name,
					income = entry.income,
					price = entry.price,
				}
			end
		end
		if typeof(loaded.slots) == "table" then
			for i = 1, Config.slotCount do
				local raw = loaded.slots[i]
				if typeof(raw) == "table" and typeof(raw.id) == "string" then
					local entry = Cast.getById(raw.id)
					if entry then
						state.slots[i] = {
							id = entry.id,
							name = entry.name,
							income = entry.income,
							price = entry.price,
						}
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	byPlayer[player] = state
	return state
end

-- Looks up the player's current State.
-- Returns: the State, or nil if the player has none.
function PlayerState.get(player: any): State?
	return byPlayer[player]
end

-- === cash ===
-- Adds the floored amount to the player's cash, clamping the result at 0.
-- Returns: the player's new cash, or 0 if the player has no State.
function PlayerState.addCash(player: any, amount: number): number
	local state = byPlayer[player]
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	state.cash += math.floor(amount)
	if state.cash < 0 then
		state.cash = 0
	end
	return state.cash
end

-- Deducts the floored amount from cash if the player has a State, the cost is non-negative and affordable.
-- Returns: true if the cash was spent, false otherwise.
function PlayerState.spendCash(player: any, amount: number): boolean
	local state = byPlayer[player]
	local cost = math.floor(amount)
	if not state or cost < 0 or state.cash < cost then
		return false
	end
	state.cash -= cost
	return true
end

-- === base and slots ===
-- Sets (or clears with nil) the player's base index when the player has a State.
-- Returns: nothing.
function PlayerState.setBase(player: any, index: number?)
	local state = byPlayer[player]
	if state then
		state.baseIndex = index
	end
end

-- Sets (or clears with nil) the slot the player is carrying when the player has a State.
-- Returns: nothing.
function PlayerState.setCarrying(player: any, slot: Slot?)
	local state = byPlayer[player]
	if state then
		state.carrying = slot
	end
end

-- Puts a slot (or nil) at index when the player has a State and index is within 1..Config.slotCount.
-- Returns: nothing.
function PlayerState.setSlot(player: any, index: number, slot: Slot?)
	local state = byPlayer[player]
	if state and index >= 1 and index <= Config.slotCount then
		state.slots[index] = slot
	end
end

-- Empties every slot from 1 to Config.slotCount when the player has a State.
-- Returns: nothing.
function PlayerState.clearSlots(player: any)
	local state = byPlayer[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	for i = 1, Config.slotCount do
		state.slots[i] = nil
	end
end

-- === derived values ===
-- Computes the rebirth income multiplier from Config.rebirthIncomeBonus and the player's rebirths.
-- Returns: 1 + rebirthIncomeBonus * rebirths, or 1 if the player has no State.
function PlayerState.incomeMultiplier(player: any): number
	local state = byPlayer[player]
	if not state then
		return 1
	end
	return 1 + Config.rebirthIncomeBonus * state.rebirths
end

-- Sums the base income of every occupied slot.
-- Returns: the total placed income, or 0 if the player has no State.
function PlayerState.placedIncome(player: any): number
	local state = byPlayer[player]
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	local sum = 0
	for i = 1, Config.slotCount do
		local slot = state.slots[i]
		if slot then
			sum += slot.income
		end
	end
	return sum
end

-- === serialization ===
-- Copies the player's State into a plain save table with empty slots/carrying as false and baseIndex 0 when nil.
-- Returns: the table (cash, rebirths, baseIndex, slots, carrying, incomeRate), or nil if the player has no State.
function PlayerState.serialize(player: any): { [string]: any }?
	local state = byPlayer[player]
	if not state then
		return nil
	end
	local slots = {}
	for i = 1, Config.slotCount do
		local slot = state.slots[i]
		if slot then
			slots[i] = {
				id = slot.id,
				name = slot.name,
				income = slot.income,
				price = slot.price,
			}
		else
			slots[i] = false
		end
	end
	local carrying: any = false
	if state.carrying then
		carrying = {
			id = state.carrying.id,
			name = state.carrying.name,
			income = state.carrying.income,
			price = state.carrying.price,
		}
	end
	return {
		cash = state.cash,
		rebirths = state.rebirths,
		baseIndex = state.baseIndex or 0,
		slots = slots,
		carrying = carrying,
		tutorialDone = state.tutorialDone == true,
		incomeRate = PlayerState.placedIncome(player) * PlayerState.incomeMultiplier(player),
	}
end

-- Drops the player's State from the byPlayer map.
-- Returns: nothing.
function PlayerState.clear(player: any)
	byPlayer[player] = nil
end

-- Builds a Slot from a Cast entry's id, name, income and price.
-- Returns: a new Slot table.
function PlayerState.slotFromEntry(entry: Cast.Entry): Slot
	return {
		id = entry.id,
		name = entry.name,
		income = entry.income,
		price = entry.price,
	}
end

-- Marks the first-run tutorial as completed for this player so the hints stop appearing.
-- Returns: true when the flag changed from false to true.
function PlayerState.markTutorial(player: any): boolean
	local state = byPlayer[player]
	if not state or state.tutorialDone then
		return false
	end
	state.tutorialDone = true
	return true
end

return PlayerState

--!strict
local FacetTypes = require("../../src")

type Use = FacetTypes.Use
type FacetModule = FacetTypes.Facet
type FacetControls = FacetTypes.Controls
type Result = { ok: boolean, rewards: { string }?, reason: string? }
type Model = { redeem: (code: string) -> Result }

return function(Facet: FacetModule, UI: FacetControls, model: Model): Instance
	local Compose = Facet.Compose
	local code = Compose.cell("")
	local busy = Compose.cell(false)
	local message = Compose.cell("")
	return UI.Screen "CodeRedeem" {
		padding = "m",
		gap = "m",
		UI.Text "Title" { text = "Redeem a code", textRole = "title" },
		UI.TextInput "Code" {
			label = "Code",
			value = code,
			enabled = function(use: Use)
				return not use(busy)
			end,
		},
		UI.Button "Redeem" {
			label = "Redeem",
			appearance = "emphasis",
			busy = busy,
			enabled = function(use: Use)
				return use(code) ~= "" and not use(busy)
			end,
			onActivate = function()
				busy:set(true)
				local result = model.redeem(code:peek())
				message:set(
					if result.ok
						then "Received: " .. table.concat(result.rewards or {}, ", ")
						else result.reason or "Redeem failed"
				)
				busy:set(false)
			end,
		},
		UI.Text "Result" { text = message, textRole = "body", wrap = true },
	}
end

--!strict
-- Sb16.lua -- practical ISA Sound Blaster 16 subset.
--
-- DSP reset/commands, mixer registers, FM register latches and 8-bit DMA
-- playback are modelled. FM synthesis and audio mixing are host concerns; the
-- injected sink receives the raw unsigned 8-bit sample block. Playback is
-- pumped synchronously or by the machine's periodic tick.

const band, bor, lshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift

const DEFAULT_BASE = 0x220
const DEFAULT_IRQ = 5
const DEFAULT_DMA = 1

const PARAM_COUNTS: { [number]: number } = {
	[0x10] = 1, -- direct DAC
	[0x14] = 2, -- single-cycle 8-bit DMA
	[0x1C] = 2, -- auto-init 8-bit DMA
	[0x40] = 1, -- time constant
	[0x41] = 2, -- sample rate
	[0x48] = 2, -- block size
}

export type Config = {
	base: number?,
	irq: number?,
	dma: any?,
	dmaChannel: number?,
	sink: ((samples: buffer) -> ())?,
}

const Sb16 = {}
Sb16.__index = Sb16

export type Sb16 = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		base: number,
		irq: number,
		dma: any?,
		dmaChannel: number,
		sink: (samples: buffer) -> (),
		resetHeld: boolean,
		readQueue: { number },
		readHead: number,
		pendingCommand: number?,
		pendingParams: { number },
		pendingNeeded: number,
		versionMajor: number,
		versionMinor: number,
		mixerAddress: number,
		mixerRegs: { [number]: number },
		fmAddress: number,
		fmRegs: { [number]: number },
		speakerOn: boolean,
		timeConstant: number,
		sampleRate: number,
		blockSize: number,
		remaining: number,
		active: boolean,
		autoinit: boolean,
		paused: boolean,
		irqPending: boolean,
		lastCommand: number,
		lastDac: number,
		in8: (self: Sb16, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Sb16, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		resetDsp: (self: Sb16) -> (),
		executeCommand: (self: Sb16, command: number, params: { number }) -> (),
		takeIrq: (self: Sb16) -> boolean,
		pump: (self: Sb16) -> number,
		tick: (self: Sb16) -> number,
	},
	Sb16
))

local function clearQueue(self: Sb16)
	self.readQueue = {}
	self.readHead = 1
end

local function queueByte(self: Sb16, value: number)
	self.readQueue[#self.readQueue + 1] = band(value, 0xFF)
end

local function hasData(self: Sb16): boolean
	return self.readHead <= #self.readQueue
end

local function dspRead(self: Sb16): number
	if not hasData(self) then
		return 0xFF
	end
	const value = self.readQueue[self.readHead]
	self.readHead += 1
	if self.readHead > #self.readQueue then
		clearQueue(self)
	end
	return value
end

local function resetMixer(self: Sb16)
	self.mixerRegs = {}
	self.mixerAddress = 0
end

function Sb16.new(config: Config?): Sb16
	const cfg = (config or {}) :: Config
	local self = setmetatable({}, Sb16) :: any
	self.base = cfg.base or DEFAULT_BASE
	self.irq = cfg.irq or DEFAULT_IRQ
	self.dma = cfg.dma
	self.dmaChannel = cfg.dmaChannel or DEFAULT_DMA
	self.sink = cfg.sink or function() end
	self.versionMajor = 4
	self.versionMinor = 5
	self.mixerRegs = {}
	self.mixerAddress = 0
	self.fmRegs = {}
	self.fmAddress = 0
	self.lastCommand = 0
	self.lastDac = 0
	self:resetDsp()
	return self
end

function Sb16.resetDsp(self: Sb16)
	clearQueue(self)
	self.resetHeld = false
	self.pendingCommand = nil
	self.pendingParams = {}
	self.pendingNeeded = 0
	self.speakerOn = false
	self.timeConstant = 0
	self.sampleRate = 0
	self.blockSize = 0
	self.remaining = 0
	self.active = false
	self.autoinit = false
	self.paused = false
	self.irqPending = false
	self.lastDac = 0
	if self.dma then
		self.dma:request(self.dmaChannel, false)
	end
	queueByte(self, 0xAA)
end

function Sb16.takeIrq(self: Sb16): boolean
	if not self.irqPending then
		return false
	end
	self.irqPending = false
	return true
end

local function dspWrite(self: Sb16, value: number)
	value = band(value, 0xFF)
	if self.pendingNeeded > 0 then
		self.pendingParams[#self.pendingParams + 1] = value
		self.pendingNeeded -= 1
		if self.pendingNeeded == 0 then
			const command = self.pendingCommand
			const params = self.pendingParams
			self.pendingCommand = nil
			self.pendingParams = {}
			if command ~= nil then
				self:executeCommand(command, params)
			end
		end
		return
	end
	self.lastCommand = value
	const needed = PARAM_COUNTS[value] or 0
	if needed == 0 then
		self:executeCommand(value, {})
	else
		self.pendingCommand = value
		self.pendingParams = {}
		self.pendingNeeded = needed
	end
end

function Sb16.executeCommand(self: Sb16, command: number, params: { number })
	if command == 0xE1 then
		queueByte(self, self.versionMajor)
		queueByte(self, self.versionMinor)
	elseif command == 0x10 then
		self.lastDac = params[1] or 0
		if self.speakerOn then
			const sample = buffer.create(1)
			buffer.writeu8(sample, 0, self.lastDac)
			self.sink(sample)
		end
	elseif command == 0x14 or command == 0x1C then
		const length = bor(params[1] or 0, lshift(params[2] or 0, 8))
		self.blockSize = length + 1
		self.autoinit = command == 0x1C
		self.remaining = self.blockSize
		self.active = true
		self.paused = false
		self.irqPending = false
		if self.dma then
			self.dma:request(self.dmaChannel, true)
		end
		self:pump()
	elseif command == 0x40 then
		self.timeConstant = params[1] or 0
		if self.timeConstant < 256 then
			self.sampleRate = math.floor(1000000 / (256 - self.timeConstant) + 0.5)
		else
			self.sampleRate = 0
		end
	elseif command == 0x41 then
		self.sampleRate = bor(lshift(params[1] or 0, 8), params[2] or 0)
	elseif command == 0x48 then
		self.blockSize = bor(params[1] or 0, lshift(params[2] or 0, 8)) + 1
	elseif command == 0xD0 then
		self.paused = true
	elseif command == 0xD1 then
		self.speakerOn = true
	elseif command == 0xD3 then
		self.speakerOn = false
	elseif command == 0xD4 then
		self.paused = false
	elseif command == 0xDA then
		self.autoinit = false
		self.active = false
		if self.dma then
			self.dma:request(self.dmaChannel, false)
		end
	end
end

function Sb16.pump(self: Sb16): number
	if not self.active or self.paused or not self.dma then
		return 0
	end
	if self.remaining <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	const samples = self.dma:read(self.dmaChannel, self.remaining)
	if not samples or buffer.len(samples) == 0 then
		if not self.autoinit then
			self.active = false
			self.dma:request(self.dmaChannel, false)
		end
		return 0
	end
	const count = buffer.len(samples)
	if self.speakerOn then
		self.sink(samples)
	end
	self.remaining -= count
	if self.remaining <= 0 then
		self.irqPending = true
		if self.autoinit then
			self.remaining = self.blockSize
			self.dma:request(self.dmaChannel, true)
		else
			self.active = false
			self.dma:request(self.dmaChannel, false)
		end
	end
	return count
end

function Sb16.tick(self: Sb16): number
	return self:pump()
end

function Sb16.in8(self: Sb16, port: number): number
	if port == self.base + 4 then
		return self.mixerAddress
	elseif port == self.base + 5 then
		return self.mixerRegs[self.mixerAddress] or 0
	elseif port == self.base + 6 then
		return 0xFF
	elseif port == self.base + 8 or port == 0x388 then
		return 0 -- FM timer status: no expired timers
	elseif port == self.base + 9 or port == 0x389 then
		return self.fmRegs[self.fmAddress] or 0
	elseif port == self.base + 0x0A then
		return dspRead(self)
	elseif port == self.base + 0x0E then
		return if hasData(self) then 0x80 else 0x00
	end
	return 0xFF
end

function Sb16.out8(self: Sb16, port: number, value: number)
	value = band(value, 0xFF)
	if port == self.base + 4 then
		self.mixerAddress = value
	elseif port == self.base + 5 then
		if self.mixerAddress == 0 then
			resetMixer(self)
		else
			self.mixerRegs[self.mixerAddress] = value
		end
	elseif port == self.base + 6 then
		if band(value, 1) ~= 0 then
			self.resetHeld = true
			clearQueue(self)
			self.pendingCommand = nil
			self.pendingParams = {}
			self.pendingNeeded = 0
			self.active = false
			if self.dma then
				self.dma:request(self.dmaChannel, false)
			end
		elseif self.resetHeld then
			self:resetDsp()
		end
	elseif port == self.base + 8 or port == 0x388 then
		self.fmAddress = value
	elseif port == self.base + 9 or port == 0x389 then
		self.fmRegs[self.fmAddress] = value
	elseif port == self.base + 0x0C then
		dspWrite(self, value)
	end
end

return Sb16

-- Rebirth: owns rebirth costs, the rebirth prompt and sign, and the reset that spends cash for an income multiplier.
-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: Rebirth.cost, Rebirth.costFor, Rebirth.multiplier, Rebirth.try, Rebirth.init, Rebirth.bind
-- contract:
--   Cost: Config.rebirthBaseCost * (Config.rebirthGrowth ^ rebirths), i.e. 100000 * 2^rebirths. Multiplier: 1 + Config.rebirthIncomeBonus * rebirths, i.e. 1 + 0.5 * rebirths.
--   try validates the player has state, cash >= cost and PlayerState.spendCash succeeds; returns false otherwise.
--   On success it clears the carry, slots and base pedestals, adds one rebirth, sets cash to Config.cashAfterRebirth, notifies, and returns true.
--   bind only calls try for a "RebirthPrompt" trigger by a player who holds a base.
-- module block:
--   Owns: the rebirth cost curve, the income multiplier curve, the "RebirthPrompt" ProximityPrompt and "RebirthSign"
--     BillboardGui on the plaza spot, and the rebirth reset (carry, slots, base pedestals, rebirth count, cash).
--   Refuses: a rebirth for a player with no PlayerState, cash below the cost, or a failed PlayerState.spendCash;
--     prompt triggers whose prompt is not named "RebirthPrompt"; triggers from a player with no Bases record.
--   Returns: the Rebirth table; cost/costFor/multiplier return numbers, try returns a boolean, init and bind return nothing.
--!strict

local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")

local Config = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Config"))
local PlayerState = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("PlayerState"))
local Bases = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Bases"))
local Pedestal = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Pedestal"))
local Carry = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Carry"))
local Storm = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Storm"))

local Rebirth = {}

-- Computes the cash price of the next rebirth for a given rebirth count from Config base cost and growth.
-- Returns a number: Config.rebirthBaseCost * Config.rebirthGrowth ^ rebirths.
function Rebirth.cost(rebirths: number): number
	return Config.rebirthBaseCost * (Config.rebirthGrowth ^ rebirths)
end

-- Looks up the player's current rebirth count (0 when they have no state) and prices their next rebirth.
-- Returns a number: Rebirth.cost of that rebirth count.
function Rebirth.costFor(player: Player): number
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	local rebirths = if state then state.rebirths else 0
	return Rebirth.cost(rebirths)
end

-- Computes the income multiplier granted by a given rebirth count using Config.rebirthIncomeBonus.
-- Returns a number: 1 + Config.rebirthIncomeBonus * rebirths.
function Rebirth.multiplier(rebirths: number): number
	return 1 + Config.rebirthIncomeBonus * rebirths
end

-- Attempts a rebirth: spends the price, clears carry, slots and base pedestals, bumps rebirths, resets cash, notifies.
-- Returns a boolean: true on success, false if the player has no state, too little cash, or spendCash fails.
function Rebirth.try(player: Player): boolean
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state then
		return false
	end
	local price = Rebirth.cost(state.rebirths)
	if state.cash < price then
		return false
	end
	if not PlayerState.spendCash(player, price) then
		return false
	end
	local baseIndex = state.baseIndex
	Carry.clear(player)
	PlayerState.clearSlots(player)
	if baseIndex then
		Pedestal.clearBase(baseIndex)
	end
	state.rebirths += 1
	state.cash = Config.cashAfterRebirth
	Storm.notify(player, "rebirth", "Rebirth complete! Now x" .. string.format("%.1f", Rebirth.multiplier(state.rebirths)) .. " income", Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 120))
	return true
end

-- Builds the "RebirthPrompt" ProximityPrompt and the "RebirthSign" BillboardGui with its "Cost" label on the given spot.
-- Returns nothing; the created instances are parented to spot.
function Rebirth.init(spot: BasePart)
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "RebirthPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Rebirth"
	prompt.ObjectText = "Plaza"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 1
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = spot

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "RebirthSign"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 70)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = spot
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Cost"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 208, 102)
	label.Text = "REBIRTH"
	label.Parent = gui
end

-- Connects PromptTriggered so a "RebirthPrompt" trigger by a player holding a base calls Rebirth.try.
-- Returns nothing; other prompts and players without a Bases record are ignored.
function Rebirth.bind()
	ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, player)
		if prompt.Name ~= "RebirthPrompt" then
			return
		end
		local record = Bases.get(player)
		if not record then
			return
		end
		Rebirth.try(player)
	end)
end

return Rebirth
