-- Storm: owns the periodic storm cycle and the storm/notify remotes that broadcast to clients.
-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: Storm.secondsUntilNext, Storm.init, Storm.bind, Storm.start, Storm.fireAlert, Storm.notify, Storm.notifyAll, Storm.fireBroadcast
--
-- Module contract (derived from the code below):
-- Owns: the storm timer (first storm after FIRST_STORM seconds, then every INTERVAL seconds),
--   the warning/wave/clear phase broadcasts on the Net.Storm RemoteEvent, the Net.Alert
--   RemoteEvent used for player notifications, the workspace.Shells folder and every Shell
--   part and ProximityPrompt spawned into it, and the Lighting darken/restore tweens.
-- Refuses: to open a shell that is already opened, has left the Shells folder, or is used by a
--   player with no state or one already carrying; to sweep a player whose carried model is
--   held inside their own base or parented under a base (BaseIndex attribute); to fire any
--   remote before init has created it (alert/storm calls are silent no-ops until then).
-- Returns: the Storm table from the module, from Storm.init and from Storm.bind;
--   Storm.secondsUntilNext returns a whole number of seconds; every other public function
--   returns nothing.
--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)
local Cast = require(script.Parent.Cast)
local PlayerState = require(script.Parent.PlayerState)
local Carry = require(script.Parent.Carry)
local Bases = require(script.Parent.Bases)

local Storm = {}

local FIRST_STORM = 120
local INTERVAL = 180
local WARN_TIME = 10
local WAVE_TIME = 8
local SHELL_LIFETIME = 60
local WAVE_HEIGHT = 14
local SHELL_TIERS = {
	near = { "Common", "Uncommon" },
	mid = { "Rare", "Epic" },
	far = { "Legendary", "Mythic", "Ultra Rare" },
}
local NEAR_RADIUS = 120
local MID_RADIUS = 260

local net: Instance? = nil
local stormEvent: RemoteEvent? = nil
local alertEvent: RemoteEvent? = nil
local shellFolder: Folder? = nil
local islandCenter = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
local pierCenter = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

-- Finds the workspace "Pier" (part, folder or model) and caches its position in pierCenter.
-- Returns nothing; pierCenter is left unchanged when no usable pier is found.
local function resolvePier()
	local pier = workspace:FindFirstChild("Pier", true)
	if pier and pier:IsA("BasePart") then
		pierCenter = pier.Position
		return
	end
	if pier and pier:IsA("Folder") then
		local first = pier:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		if first then
			pierCenter = first.Position
			return
		end
	end
	if pier and pier:IsA("Model") then
		local ok, cf = pcall(function()
			return (pier :: Model):GetPivot()
		end)
		if ok and cf then
			pierCenter = cf.Position
		end
	end
end

-- Converts the cumulative Config.tiers thresholds into a per-rarity probability weight.
-- Returns a map of rarity name to weight (threshold span divided by 1000).
local function rarityWeights(): { [string]: number }
	local weights: { [string]: number } = {}
	local prev = 0
	for _, tier in Config.tiers do
		weights[tier.rarity] = (tier.threshold - prev) / 1000
		prev = tier.threshold
	end
	return weights
end

-- Picks one rarity from the given list using the Config-derived weights.
-- Returns the rolled rarity, the first entry if all weights are zero, or the last as fallback.
local function rollFrom(list: { string }): string
	local weights = rarityWeights()
	local total = 0
	for _, rarity in list do
		total += weights[rarity] or 0
	end
	if total <= 0 then
		return list[1]
	end
	local roll = math.random() * total
	for _, rarity in list do
		roll -= weights[rarity] or 0
		if roll <= 0 then
			return rarity
		end
	end
	return list[#list]
end

-- Collects every Cast entry whose rarity matches the requested rarity.
-- Returns an array of matching entries, empty when none match or Cast.entries is missing.
local function poolFor(rarity: string): { any }
	local pool: { any } = {}
	if typeof(Cast.entries) == "table" then
		for _, entry in Cast.entries do
			if entry.rarity == rarity then
				table.insert(pool, entry)
			end
		end
	end
	return pool
end

-- Measures flat (XZ) distance from the island centre to choose a shell rarity band.
-- Returns the near, mid or far rarity list from SHELL_TIERS.
local function tiersForDistance(position: Vector3): { string }
	local flat = Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z)
	local center = Vector3.new(islandCenter.X, 0, islandCenter.Z)
	local dist = (flat - center).Magnitude
	if dist <= NEAR_RADIUS then
		return SHELL_TIERS.near
	elseif dist <= MID_RADIUS then
		return SHELL_TIERS.mid
	end
	return SHELL_TIERS.far
end

-- Rolls a rarity for the position and picks a random Cast entry of that rarity.
-- Returns the chosen Cast entry, or nil when the rolled rarity has no entries.
local function chooseCharacter(position: Vector3): any?
	local rarity = rollFrom(tiersForDistance(position))
	local pool = poolFor(rarity)
	if #pool == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
end

-- Spawns a Shell part with an "Open" prompt that attaches a rolled character to the opener.
-- Returns nothing; the shell self-destructs after SHELL_LIFETIME seconds or once opened.
local function spawnShell(position: Vector3)
	local folder = shellFolder
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Shell"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 1.6, 2)
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 196)
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0))
	part.Parent = folder

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ObjectText = "Shell"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.ActionText = "Open"
	prompt.Parent = part

	local opened = false
	local connection = prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		if opened or part.Parent ~= folder then
			return
		end
		local state = PlayerState.get(player)
		if not state or state.carrying ~= nil then
			return
		end
		local choice = chooseCharacter(position)
		if not choice then
			return
		end
		local slot = PlayerState.slotFromEntry(choice)
		local model = Carry.attach(player, slot, nil)
		if model then
			opened = true
			if alertEvent then
				alertEvent:FireClient(player, {
					kind = "placed",
					text = "You opened a shell: " .. tostring(choice.name),
					tier = choice.rarity,
					color = choice.aura,
				})
				alertEvent:FireAllClients({
					kind = "shell-opened",
					position = position,
					tier = choice.rarity,
				})
			end
			part:Destroy()
		end
	end)

	task.delay(SHELL_LIFETIME, function()
		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		if prompt.Parent then
			prompt:Destroy()
		end
		if part.Parent then
			part:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local stormStartAt: number? = nil
local stormEndAt: number? = nil

-- Stamps the phase name onto the payload and fires it to all clients over the Storm remote.
-- Returns nothing; silently skips the fire when the Storm remote does not exist yet.
local function broadcastPhase(phase: string, payload: { [string]: any }?)
	local data = payload or {}
	data.phase = phase
	if stormEvent then
		stormEvent:FireAllClients(data)
	end
end

-- Reports time until the next storm start, or until the current clear phase ends.
-- Returns whole seconds (never negative), or INTERVAL when no timer is scheduled.
function Storm.secondsUntilNext(): number
	local now = os.clock()
	local target: number? = nil
	if stormStartAt and now < stormStartAt then
		target = stormStartAt
	elseif stormEndAt then
		target = stormEndAt
	end
	if not target then
		return math.floor(INTERVAL)
	end
	return math.max(0, math.ceil(target - now))
end

-- Checks whether the player is protected by their base: locked, or within 40 studs of its centre.
-- Returns true when protected, false when the player has no base or is outside it.
local function inOwnBase(player: Player, position: Vector3): boolean
	local record = Bases.get(player)
	if not record then
		return false
	end
	if record.lockedUntil and record.lockedUntil > os.clock() then
		return true
	end
	local centre = record.centre
	if centre then
		local flat = Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z)
		local origin = Vector3.new(centre.Position.X, 0, centre.Position.Z)
		if (flat - origin).Magnitude <= 40 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Checks whether a position lies within 48 studs (XZ only) of the cached pier centre.
-- Returns true when on or near the pier, false otherwise.
local function onPier(position: Vector3): boolean
	local distance = Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z) - Vector3.new(pierCenter.X, 0, pierCenter.Z)
	local probe = Vector3.new(distance.X, 0, distance.Z).Magnitude
	return probe <= 48
end

-- Walks up the instance's ancestors looking for one tagged with a BaseIndex attribute.
-- Returns true when the instance sits under a base, false otherwise.
local function underABase(instance: Instance): boolean
	local current: Instance? = instance.Parent
	while current do
		if current:GetAttribute("BaseIndex") ~= nil then
			return true
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return false
end

-- Sweeps exposed players (on the pier, or carrying outside their base) into shells and respawns them.
-- Returns the number of players swept; seeds three pier shells when nobody was swept.
local function sweep()
	resolvePier()
	local swept = 0
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if character and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			local position = root.Position
			local state = PlayerState.get(player)
			local inside = inOwnBase(player, position)
			local carrying = state ~= nil and state.carrying ~= nil
			local carried = if carrying then Carry.modelOf(player) else nil
			local carriedInBase = inside and carried ~= nil and carried.Parent ~= nil and carried:IsDescendantOf(character)
			local underBase = carried ~= nil and carried.Parent ~= nil and underABase(carried)
			local outside = not inside
			local onDock = onPier(position)
			if not carriedInBase and not underBase and (onDock or (carrying and outside)) then
				local spot = position
				pcall(function()
					Carry.clear(player)
				end)
				if character.Parent ~= nil then
					character:Destroy()
				end
				spawnShell(spot)
				swept += 1
				if alertEvent then
					alertEvent:FireClient(player, {
						kind = "storm",
						text = "The storm swept you away!",
						color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 190, 255),
					})
				end
				pcall(function()
					player:LoadCharacter()
				end)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0)
	end
	if swept == 0 then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local offset = Vector3.new((i - 2) * 16, 0, 0)
			spawnShell(pierCenter + offset + Vector3.new(0, 0, -24))
		end
	end
	return swept
end

-- Broadcasts the "wave" phase, waits WAVE_TIME seconds, then runs the player sweep.
-- Returns nothing; the sweep count is discarded.
local function waveSweep()
	broadcastPhase("wave", { toward = "island" })
	task.wait(WAVE_TIME)
	sweep()
end

-- Tweens Lighting to the dim storm palette over the given duration in seconds.
-- Returns nothing; the tween plays asynchronously.
local function darken(duration: number)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(Lighting, TweenInfo.new(duration), {
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(64, 70, 86),
		OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(70, 78, 96),
		Brightness = 1.4,
	})
	tween:Play()
end

-- Tweens Lighting back to the bright daytime palette over four seconds.
-- Returns nothing; the tween plays asynchronously.
local function restore()
	local tween = TweenService:Create(Lighting, TweenInfo.new(4), {
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(158, 184, 204),
		OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(168, 194, 214),
		Brightness = 3.2,
	})
	tween:Play()
end

-- Runs one full storm: darken and warn, wait, wave sweep, then broadcast clear and restore light.
-- Returns nothing; yields for roughly WARN_TIME + WAVE_TIME seconds.
local function runStorm()
	darken(WARN_TIME)
	broadcastPhase("warning", { seconds = WARN_TIME })
	Storm.notifyAll("storm-warning", "STORM INBOUND - 10s", Color3.fromRGB(120, 190, 255))
	task.wait(WARN_TIME)
	waveSweep()
	broadcastPhase("clear", { seconds = INTERVAL - WARN_TIME - WAVE_TIME })
	restore()
end

-- Finds or creates the Net folder, Storm/Alert remotes and Shells folder; caches island centre and pier.
-- Returns the Storm module table for chaining.
function Storm.init(anchors: any)
	net = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Net", 10)
	if not net then
		net = Instance.new("Folder")
		net.Name = "Net"
		net.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	stormEvent = (net :: Instance):FindFirstChild("Storm") :: RemoteEvent?
	if not stormEvent then
		local event = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		event.Name = "Storm"
		event.Parent = net
		stormEvent = event
	end
	alertEvent = (net :: Instance):FindFirstChild("Alert") :: RemoteEvent?
	if not alertEvent then
		local event = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		event.Name = "Alert"
		event.Parent = net
		alertEvent = event
	end
	shellFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Shells") :: Folder?
	if not shellFolder then
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "Shells"
		folder.Parent = workspace
		shellFolder = folder
	end
	if anchors and anchors.centre and anchors.centre.Position then
		islandCenter = anchors.centre.Position
	end
	resolvePier()
	return Storm
end

-- No-op bind hook kept for a uniform module lifecycle (init, bind, start).
-- Returns the Storm module table for chaining.
function Storm.bind()
	return Storm
end

-- Starts the endless storm loop in a new thread, tracking start/end times for the countdown.
-- Returns nothing; a failed storm is warned about and the loop continues.
function Storm.start()
	stormStartAt = os.clock() + FIRST_STORM
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(FIRST_STORM)
		while true do
			stormStartAt = nil
			local ok, err = pcall(runStorm)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Storm] storm failed: " .. tostring(err))
			end
			stormEndAt = os.clock() + INTERVAL - WARN_TIME - WAVE_TIME
			task.wait(INTERVAL - WARN_TIME - WAVE_TIME)
			stormEndAt = nil
			stormStartAt = os.clock() + INTERVAL
		end
	end)
end

-- Sends a raw alert payload to one player over the Alert remote.
-- Returns nothing; skips silently before init has created the remote.
function Storm.fireAlert(player: Player, data: { [string]: any })
	if alertEvent then
		alertEvent:FireClient(player, data)
	end
end

-- Sends a kind/text/colour notification to one player over the Alert remote.
-- Returns nothing; skips silently before init has created the remote.
function Storm.notify(player: Player, kind: string, text: string, color: Color3?)
	if alertEvent then
		alertEvent:FireClient(player, { kind = kind, text = text, color = color })
	end
end

-- Sends a kind/text/colour notification to every player over the Alert remote.
-- Returns nothing; skips silently before init has created the remote.
function Storm.notifyAll(kind: string, text: string, color: Color3?)
	if alertEvent then
		alertEvent:FireAllClients({ kind = kind, text = text, color = color })
	end
end

-- Sends a raw alert payload to every player over the Alert remote.
-- Returns nothing; skips silently before init has created the remote.
function Storm.fireBroadcast(data: { [string]: any })
	if alertEvent then
		alertEvent:FireAllClients(data)
	end
end

return Storm

--!strict
--[[
	Cleanup
	Collects things that need tearing down (connections, instances, threads,
	functions, objects with :Destroy()) and cleans them all up in one call.
	Stops memory leaks from forgotten connections.

	local cleanup = Cleanup.new()
	cleanup:Add(part.Touched:Connect(onTouched))
	cleanup:Add(Instance.new("Part"))
	cleanup:Add(function() print("bye") end)
	cleanup:Clean() -- disconnects, destroys, calls, in reverse order
]]

local Cleanup = {}
Cleanup.__index = Cleanup

export type Cleanup = {
	Add: <T>(self: Cleanup, item: T, methodName: string?) -> T,
	Remove: (self: Cleanup, item: any) -> boolean,
	Clean: (self: Cleanup) -> (),
	Destroy: (self: Cleanup) -> (),
}

local function cleanItem(item: any, methodName: string?)
	local kind = typeof(item)

	if kind == "function" then
		item()
	elseif kind == "thread" then
		if coroutine.status(item) ~= "dead" then
			pcall(task.cancel, item)
		end
	elseif kind == "RBXScriptConnection" then
		item:Disconnect()
	elseif kind == "Instance" then
		item:Destroy()
	elseif kind == "table" then
		if methodName then
			item[methodName](item)
		elseif type(item.Destroy) == "function" then
			item:Destroy()
		elseif type(item.Disconnect) == "function" then
			item:Disconnect()
		else
			error("Cleanup: table has no Destroy or Disconnect method")
		end
	else
		error("Cleanup: can't clean up a value of type " .. kind)
	end
end

function Cleanup.new(): Cleanup
	local self = setmetatable({
		_items = {},
		_methods = {},
		_cleaning = false,
	}, Cleanup)
	return (self :: any) :: Cleanup
end

function Cleanup:Add<T>(item: T, methodName: string?): T
	assert(item ~= nil, "Cleanup:Add got nil")
	if self._cleaning then
		-- Something was added while cleaning; clean it straight away.
		cleanItem(item, methodName)
		return item
	end
	table.insert(self._items, item)
	if methodName then
		self._methods[item] = methodName
	end
	return item
end

-- Stop tracking an item without cleaning it up.
function Cleanup:Remove(item: any): boolean
	local index = table.find(self._items, item)
	if index then
		table.remove(self._items, index)
		self._methods[item] = nil
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Cleans everything in reverse order (last added, first cleaned), which is
-- usually what you want when later items depend on earlier ones.
-- Errors in one item don't stop the rest; the first error is re-thrown at the end.
function Cleanup:Clean()
	if self._cleaning then
		return
	end
	self._cleaning = true

	local items = self._items
	local methods = self._methods
	self._items = {}
	self._methods = {}

	local firstError = nil
	for i = #items, 1, -1 do
		local item = items[i]
		local ok, err = pcall(cleanItem, item, methods[item])
		if not ok and firstError == nil then
			firstError = err
		end
	end

	self._cleaning = false
	if firstError ~= nil then
		error(firstError, 0)
	end
end

function Cleanup:Destroy()
	self:Clean()
end

return Cleanup

--!strict
-- VgaSink.lua -- dirty-rectangle presenter for a Vga device.
--
-- The core owns no Roblox types. A host supplies present(pixels, width, height,
-- rect); the Roblox adapter turns that into an EditableImage write, while the
-- Lune harness can save a PPM or inspect the buffer.

const VgaSink = {}
VgaSink.__index = VgaSink

export type Rect = {
	x: number,
	y: number,
	width: number,
	height: number,
}

export type Present = (pixels: buffer, width: number, height: number, rect: Rect) -> ()

export type VgaSink = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		vga: any,
		present: Present,
		frames: number,
		lastRect: Rect?,
		lastPixels: buffer?,
		poll: (self: VgaSink, force: boolean?) -> boolean,
		invalidate: (self: VgaSink) -> (),
	},
	VgaSink
))

function VgaSink.new(vga: any, present: Present?): VgaSink
	local self = setmetatable({
		vga = vga,
		present = present
			or function(_pixels: buffer, _width: number, _height: number, _rect: Rect) end,
		frames = 0,
		lastRect = nil,
		lastPixels = nil,
	}, VgaSink) :: any
	return self
end

function VgaSink.invalidate(self: VgaSink)
	self.vga:markAllDirty()
end

-- Present only when the VGA has a dirty rectangle, or when force is set. The
-- region snapshot preserves pixels outside the rectangle from prior frames.
function VgaSink.poll(self: VgaSink, force: boolean?): boolean
	local rect: Rect? = self.vga:consumeDirty()
	if not rect and not force then
		return false
	end
	const activeRect: Rect = rect
		or {
			x = 0,
			y = 0,
			width = self.vga:width() :: number,
			height = self.vga:height() :: number,
		}
	const pixels =
		self.vga:snapshotRegionRGBA(activeRect.x, activeRect.y, activeRect.width, activeRect.height)
	self.present(pixels, self.vga:width() :: number, self.vga:height() :: number, activeRect)
	self.frames += 1
	self.lastRect = activeRect
	self.lastPixels = pixels
	return true
end

return VgaSink

-- BaseManager owns the eight bases ringing the plaza: who owns which one, which
-- slot each brainrot stands on, and moving a brainrot onto or off a base.

local GameState = require(script.Parent.GameState)
local WorldBuilder = require(script.Parent.WorldBuilder)

local BaseManager = {}

-- Hands the player the first free base and writes their name on its sign.
function BaseManager.claimBase(state)
	for index, base in ipairs(WorldBuilder.layout.bases) do
		if GameState.bases[index] == nil or GameState.bases[index].owner == nil then
			GameState.bases[index] = { owner = state.player.UserId, center = base.center, slots = {} }
			state.baseIndex = index
			base.sign.Text = state.player.DisplayName .. "'s Base"
			return index
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Moves a bought (or stolen, or granted) brainrot onto a free slot pad.
-- Returns the slot index, or nil when the base is full.
function BaseManager.placeOnBase(state, record)
	local slot = GameState.findFreeSlot(state)
	if not slot then
		return nil
	end
	local base = WorldBuilder.layout.bases[state.baseIndex]
	if not base then
		return nil
	end
	local padPosition = base.slots[slot]
	record.location = "base"
	record.owner = state.player.UserId
	record.slot = slot
	record.baseIndex = state.baseIndex
	record.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(padPosition))
	state.owned[slot] = record
	GameState.bases[state.baseIndex].slots[slot] = record.uid
	state.purchaseLocks[record.uid] = os.time() + 30
	return slot
end

-- Lifts a brainrot off its base without destroying it (a steal hands it over).
function BaseManager.liftFromBase(record)
	local ownerState = GameState.getPlayer(record.owner)
	if ownerState and record.slot then
		ownerState.owned[record.slot] = nil
		ownerState.purchaseLocks[record.uid] = nil
	end
	if record.baseIndex and GameState.bases[record.baseIndex] then
		GameState.bases[record.baseIndex].slots[record.slot] = nil
	end
	record.slot = nil
	record.baseIndex = nil
end

-- Destroys a brainrot that leaves the game (sold by a rebirth, or its owner left).
function BaseManager.removeFromBase(uid)
	local record = GameState.brainrots[uid]
	if not record then
		return
	end
	BaseManager.liftFromBase(record)
	if record.model then
		record.model:Destroy()
	end
	GameState.brainrots[uid] = nil
end

-- Frees a base when its owner leaves: every brainrot on it is destroyed.
function BaseManager.releaseBase(state)
	if not state.baseIndex then
		return
	end
	local ownedUids = {}
	for _, record in pairs(state.owned) do
		table.insert(ownedUids, record.uid)
	end
	for _, uid in ipairs(ownedUids) do
		BaseManager.removeFromBase(uid)
	end
	local base = WorldBuilder.layout.bases[state.baseIndex]
	if base then
		base.sign.Text = "Base " .. state.baseIndex
	end
	GameState.bases[state.baseIndex] = nil
	state.baseIndex = nil
end

return BaseManager

-- World: owns generating the island map once at startup and returning the anchors other modules wire to.
-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- Public API: World (build() returns the anchors table: pierSpawns, plotCentres, pedestals, rebirth, centre)
-- island layout
--   eight plot centres (y = PLOT_Y = 2.2, PLOT = 34 studs square), from build():
--     west, x = -118: Base1 z = -8, Base2 z = 34, Base3 z = 76, Base4 z = 118
--     east, x =  118: Base5 z = -8, Base6 z = 34, Base7 z = 76, Base8 z = 118
--   pedestal grid: 3 columns x 2 rows per base, spacing GAP = 7 studs both ways,
--     in hut space at x = col * 7 (col -1..1), z = -12.2 - row * 7 (row 0..1)
--   pier spawn x: -16 (PierSpawn1) and 16 (PierSpawn2), pad at z = PIER_Z - 16 = -19
--   island radius: no radius constant exists; the land is irregular overlapping slabs.
--     Outermost sand slab centres: SpitWestTip (-198, 92), SpitSouthTip (48, 204),
--     ShelfE (150, 14), ShelfNE (140, -48). Sea plane is 980 x 980 centred on (0, 40).
--   plot size: PLOT = 34 x 34 studs (0.8 thick); pedestals built: 8 bases x 6 = 48 in total
--   sea and land are anchored parts (create sets Anchored = true); applyLighting moves Baseplate to y = -30
--!strict

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

type Anchors = {
	pierSpawns: { BasePart },
	plotCentres: { BasePart },
	pedestals: { { BasePart } },
	rebirth: BasePart,
	centre: BasePart,
}

local WALK_Y = 3

local SAND = Color3.fromRGB(232, 206, 150)

-- === geometry helpers ===
-- Builds one anchored, smooth-surfaced Part from the given name, size, CFrame, colour, material and options, optionally tagged Decor.
-- Returns the new Part (and bumps decorCount when decorated).
local function create(
	name: string,
	size: Vector3,
	cf: CFrame,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material,
	parent: Instance,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
	transparency: number?,
	canCollide: boolean?,
	decorated: boolean?
): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material
	p.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
	p.Transparency = transparency or 0
	p.CanCollide = if canCollide == nil then true else canCollide
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Parent = parent
	if decorated then
		p:SetAttribute("Decor", true)
		decorCount += 1
	end
	return p
end

-- Builds a structural (non-decor) Part by forwarding to create with decorated = false.
-- Returns the new Part.
local function part(
	name: string,
	size: Vector3,
	cf: CFrame,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material,
	parent: Instance,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
	transparency: number?,
	canCollide: boolean?
): Part
	return create(name, size, cf, color, material, parent, shape, transparency, canCollide, false)
end

-- Builds a decorative Part by forwarding to create with decorated = true, so it gets the Decor attribute.
-- Returns the new Part.
local function decor(
	name: string,
	size: Vector3,
	cf: CFrame,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material,
	parent: Instance,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
	transparency: number?,
	canCollide: boolean?
): Part
	return create(name, size, cf, color, material, parent, shape, transparency, canCollide, true)
end

-- Builds a CFrame at center rolled 90 degrees on Z so a cylinder's length axis points straight up.
-- Returns that CFrame.
local function upright(center: Vector3): CFrame
	return CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
end

-- Builds a CFrame at the midpoint of a and b that lays a cylinder's length axis along a to b (upright when degenerate or vertical).
-- Returns that CFrame.
local function span(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): CFrame
	local delta = b - a
	local mid = (a + b) / 2
	local length = delta.Magnitude
	if length < 1e-4 then
		return upright(mid)
	end
	if math.abs(delta.Unit:Dot(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))) > 0.999 then
		return upright(mid)
	end
	return CFrame.lookAt(mid, b) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
end

-- Builds a cylinder Part stretched between points a and b with the given diameter, as decor or structure.
-- Returns the new Part.
local function cyl(
	name: string,
	a: Vector3,
	b: Vector3,
	diameter: number,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material,
	parent: Instance,
	decorated: boolean,
	canCollide: boolean?
): Part
	local builder = if decorated then decor else part
	return builder(name, Vector3.new((b - a).Magnitude, diameter, diameter), span(a, b), color, material, parent, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, nil, canCollide)
end

-- Builds a vertical cylinder Part of the given height and diameter centred on center, as decor or structure.
-- Returns the new Part.
local function vcyl(
	name: string,
	center: Vector3,
	height: number,
	diameter: number,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material,
	parent: Instance,
	decorated: boolean,
	canCollide: boolean?
): Part
	local builder = if decorated then decor else part
	return builder(name, Vector3.new(height, diameter, diameter), upright(center), color, material, parent, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, nil, canCollide)
end

-- Builds a PointLight of the given colour and range parented to host.
-- Returns nothing.

-- === lighting ===
-- Builds the island lighting: sets Lighting properties, replaces sky and post effects, flags LightingOk, drops the Baseplate.
-- Returns nothing.
local function applyLighting()
	Lighting.ClockTime = 15.4
	Lighting.Brightness = 2.4
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(96, 112, 138)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(186, 190, 178)
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.45
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.5
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.3
	Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0.25
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
	Lighting.FogStart = 300
	Lighting.FogEnd = 950
	Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(191, 227, 232)

	local effectClasses = { "Atmosphere", "BloomEffect", "ColorCorrectionEffect", "SunRaysEffect", "DepthOfFieldEffect" }
	for _, child in Lighting:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Sky") then
			child:Destroy()
		else
			for _, className in effectClasses do
				if child:IsA(className) then
					child:Destroy()
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	pcall(function()
		local atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
		atmosphere.Density = 0.32
		atmosphere.Offset = 0.1
		atmosphere.Haze = 2.0
		atmosphere.Glare = 0.1
		atmosphere.Color = Color3.fromRGB(191, 227, 232)
		atmosphere.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(126, 154, 134)
		atmosphere.Parent = Lighting
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
		bloom.Intensity = 0.55
		bloom.Size = 16
		bloom.Parent = Lighting
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local colorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
		colorCorrection.Saturation = -0.08
		colorCorrection.Contrast = 0.07
		colorCorrection.Brightness = 0.01
		colorCorrection.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 246, 236)
		colorCorrection.Parent = Lighting
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local sunRays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
		sunRays.Intensity = 0.06
		sunRays.Spread = 0.8
		sunRays.Parent = Lighting
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local depthOfField = Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect")
		depthOfField.FarIntensity = 0.1
		depthOfField.FocusDistance = 60
		depthOfField.InFocusRadius = 200
		depthOfField.Parent = Lighting
	end)

	local counts = {
		Atmosphere = 0,
		BloomEffect = 0,
		ColorCorrectionEffect = 0,
		SunRaysEffect = 0,
		DepthOfFieldEffect = 0,
	}
	for _, child in Lighting:GetChildren() do
		local className = child.ClassName
		if counts[className] ~= nil then
			counts[className] += 1
		end
	end
	local lightingOk = counts.Atmosphere >= 1
		and counts.BloomEffect >= 1
		and counts.ColorCorrectionEffect >= 1
		and counts.SunRaysEffect >= 1
		and counts.DepthOfFieldEffect >= 1
	workspace:SetAttribute("LightingOk", lightingOk)

	local baseplate = workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
	if baseplate and baseplate:IsA("BasePart") then
		baseplate.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -30, 0)
	end
end

-- === land ===
-- Builds three stepped grass mounds (west, east, south), four shrinking tiers each.
-- Returns nothing.
local function buildMounds(parent: Instance)
	local mounds = {
		{ "MoundWest", -64, 44, 5.2, 12 },
		{ "MoundEast", 76, 60, 4.2, -8 },
		{ "MoundSouth", 46, 98, 6.4, 20 },
	}
	local feet = {
		Vector3.new(16, 12),
		Vector3.new(11, 8.5),
		Vector3.new(7, 5.2),
		Vector3.new(3.8, 2.8),
	}
	for _, spec in mounds do
		local name, x, z, tall, yaw = spec[1], spec[2], spec[3], spec[4], spec[5]
		local risen = 0
		for i, foot in feet do
			local h = tall / 4
			risen += h
			local top = GRASS_Y + risen
			local thick = h + 0.2
			part(
				name,
				Vector3.new(foot.X, thick, foot.Y),
				CFrame.new(x, top - thick / 2, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw + i * 11), 0),
				if i % 2 == 0 then GRASS_DARK else GRASS,
				Enum.Material.Grass,
				parent
			)
		end
	end
end

-- Builds the north east rock outcrop and the five stone climbing steps that lead up it.
-- Returns nothing.
local function buildHeadland(parent: Instance)
	local rocks = {
		{ "OutcropBase", Vector3.new(16, 4.0, 13), 138, -48, 2.6, 8 },
		{ "OutcropMid", Vector3.new(11, 3.0, 9), 138, -47, 5.4, -6 },
		{ "OutcropHigh", Vector3.new(7.5, 2.4, 6), 137, -46, 7.6, 12 },
		{ "OutcropCap", Vector3.new(4.6, 2.0, 3.8), 136, -46, 9.6, -4 },
	}
	for _, spec in rocks do
		local name, size, x, z, y, yaw = spec[1], spec[2], spec[3], spec[4], spec[5], spec[6]
		part(name, size, CFrame.new(x, y, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw), 0), ROCK, Enum.Material.Rock, parent)
	end
	local steps = {
		{ 90, -24, 2.8 },
		{ 102, -36, 4.4 },
		{ 114, -46, 6.0 },
		{ 126, -50, 7.6 },
		{ 136, -46, 9.2 },
	}
	for i, spec in steps do
		local x, z, top = spec[1], spec[2], spec[3]
		local bottom = 1.4
		local h = top - bottom
		part(
			"Climb",
			Vector3.new(4.4, h, 3.6),
			CFrame.new(x, (top + bottom) / 2, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad((i - 1) * 16), 0),
			STONE,
			Enum.Material.Slate,
			parent
		)
	end
end

-- Builds one pier model at originX: planks, posts, crossbeams, ropes, lamps and an invisible spawn pad.
-- Returns the spawn pad part named spawnName.
local function buildPier(originX: number, spawnName: string, parent: Instance): BasePart
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = spawnName
	model.Parent = parent

	local planks = 18
	local plankLen = PIER_LENGTH / planks
	for i = 0, planks - 1 do
		local z = PIER_Z - plankLen / 2 - i * plankLen
		local shade = if i % 2 == 0 then PLANKS else WOOD_LIGHT
		part("Plank", Vector3.new(PIER_WIDTH, 0.4, plankLen + 0.02), CFrame.new(originX, WALK_Y - 0.2, z), shade, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, model)
	end

	local posts = 7
	for i = 0, posts - 1 do
		local z = PIER_Z - 5 - i * (PIER_LENGTH - 10) / (posts - 1)
		for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
			local x = originX + side * (PIER_WIDTH / 2 + 0.85)
			vcyl("Post", Vector3.new(x, 1.1, z), 6.6, 0.7, WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model, false)
			part("Cap", Vector3.new(1.1, 0.25, 1.1), CFrame.new(x, 4.5, z), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
		end
		cyl(
			"Crossbeam",
			Vector3.new(originX - PIER_WIDTH / 2 - 0.85, 0.9, z),
			Vector3.new(originX + PIER_WIDTH / 2 + 0.85, 0.9, z),
			0.5,
			WOOD_DARK,
			Enum.Material.Wood,
			model,
			false
		)
	end

	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		local x = originX + side * (PIER_WIDTH / 2 + 0.85)
		for i = 0, 5 do
			local z0 = PIER_Z - 5 - i * 14
			cyl("Rope", Vector3.new(x, 4.05, z0), Vector3.new(x, 4.05, z0 - 14), 0.2, ROPE, Enum.Material.Fabric, model, false, false)
			cyl("RopeLow", Vector3.new(x, 3.45, z0), Vector3.new(x, 3.45, z0 - 14), 0.16, ROPE, Enum.Material.Fabric, model, false, false)
		end
	end

	for i = 0, 3 do
		local z = PIER_Z - 14 - i * 20
		for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
			local x = originX + side * (PIER_WIDTH / 2 + 1.7)
			vcyl("LampPost", Vector3.new(x, 2.2, z), 4.4, 0.3, WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model, false)
			local lamp = part("Lamp", Vector3.new(0.9, 0.9, 0.9), CFrame.new(x, 4.6, z), LAMP, Enum.Material.Neon, model, Enum.PartType.Ball, nil, false)
			glow(lamp, LAMP, 14)
		end
	end

	return part(spawnName, Vector3.new(4, 0.15, 4), CFrame.new(originX, WALK_Y + 0.05, PIER_Z - 16), PLANKS, Enum.Material.Wood, model, nil, 1, false)
end

-- Builds the bamboo fence around a plot, with a gated gap on the side facing points to.
-- Returns nothing.
local function buildFence(centre: Vector3, facing: Vector3, parent: Instance)
	local right = Vector3.new(-facing.Z, 0, facing.X)
	local half = PLOT / 2
	local function edge(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, gate: boolean)
		local steps = 4
		for i = 0, steps do
			local t = i / steps
			local skipped = gate and t > 0.28 and t < 0.72
			if not skipped then
				local at = from:Lerp(to, t)
				vcyl("FencePost", Vector3.new(at.X, PLOT_Y + 1.4, at.Z), 2.8, 0.36, BAMBOO_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, parent, false)
			end
		end
		local function rail(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, height: number)
			cyl("Rail", Vector3.new(a.X, PLOT_Y + height, a.Z), Vector3.new(b.X, PLOT_Y + height, b.Z), 0.18, BAMBOO, Enum.Material.Wood, parent, false, false)
		end
		if gate then
			local left = from:Lerp(to, 0.28)
			local rightEnd = from:Lerp(to, 0.72)
			rail(from, left, 1)
			rail(from, left, 2.1)
			rail(rightEnd, to, 1)
			rail(rightEnd, to, 2.1)
			local mid = from:Lerp(to, 0.5)
			local along = (to - from).Unit
			for _, hand in { -1, 1 } do
				local at = mid + along * (hand * 1.7)
				part(
					"Gate",
					Vector3.new(2.6, 2.4, 0.16),
					CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(at.X, PLOT_Y + 1.2, at.Z), Vector3.new(at.X, PLOT_Y + 1.2, at.Z) + facing),
					BAMBOO,
					Enum.Material.Wood,
					parent,
					nil,
					nil,
					false
				)
			end
		else
			rail(from, to, 1)
			rail(from, to, 2.1)
		end
	end
	local c1 = centre + (-facing - right) * half
	local c2 = centre + (-facing + right) * half
	local c3 = centre + (facing + right) * half
	local c4 = centre + (facing - right) * half
	edge(c1, c2, false)
	edge(c2, c3, false)
	edge(c3, c4, true)
	edge(c4, c1, false)
end

-- Builds one base: plot, centre marker, stilt hut, name board, six pedestals and fence.
-- Returns the PlotCentre marker, the six pedestal tops, and the hut roof peak point.
local function buildBase(index: number, centre: Vector3, facing: Vector3, parent: Instance): (BasePart, { BasePart }, Vector3)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Base" .. tostring(index)
	model.Parent = parent
	local plot = part("Plot", Vector3.new(PLOT, 0.8, PLOT), CFrame.new(centre.X, PLOT_Y - 0.4, centre.Z), SAND, Enum.Material.Sand, model)
	local marker = part("PlotCentre", Vector3.new(2, 0.15, 2), CFrame.new(centre.X, PLOT_Y + 0.05, centre.Z), SAND_DARK, Enum.Material.Sand, model, nil, 1, false)

	local hut = centre - facing * 8
	local hutCF = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(hut.X, PLOT_Y, hut.Z), Vector3.new(hut.X, PLOT_Y, hut.Z) + facing)
	for _, corner in { Vector3.new(-4, 0, -3), Vector3.new(4, 0, -3), Vector3.new(-4, 0, 3), Vector3.new(4, 0, 3) } do
		local foot = hutCF:PointToWorldSpace(corner)
		vcyl("Stilt", Vector3.new(foot.X, PLOT_Y + 1.3, foot.Z), 2.6, 0.5, WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model, false)
	end
	part("HutFloor", Vector3.new(9, 0.3, 7), hutCF * CFrame.new(0, 2.75, 0), PLANKS, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, model)
	part("WallBack", Vector3.new(9, 3.2, 0.3), hutCF * CFrame.new(0, 4.5, 3.3), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	part("WallL", Vector3.new(0.3, 3.2, 7), hutCF * CFrame.new(-4.35, 4.5, 0), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	part("WallR", Vector3.new(0.3, 3.2, 7), hutCF * CFrame.new(4.35, 4.5, 0), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	part("WallFrontL", Vector3.new(2.8, 3.2, 0.3), hutCF * CFrame.new(-3.05, 4.5, -3.3), WOOD_LIGHT, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	part("WallFrontR", Vector3.new(2.8, 3.2, 0.3), hutCF * CFrame.new(3.05, 4.5, -3.3), WOOD_LIGHT, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	part("Lintel", Vector3.new(3.2, 0.9, 0.3), hutCF * CFrame.new(0, 5.65, -3.3), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	part("RoofL", Vector3.new(5.4, 0.28, 8), hutCF * CFrame.new(-2.05, 6.9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(28)), STRAW, Enum.Material.Grass, model)
	part("RoofR", Vector3.new(5.4, 0.28, 8), hutCF * CFrame.new(2.05, 6.9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-28)), STRAW_DARK, Enum.Material.Grass, model)
	part("Ridge", Vector3.new(0.5, 0.35, 8.2), hutCF * CFrame.new(0, 7.9, 0), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model)

	local boardPos = hutCF:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 6.5, -4.05))
	local board = part("NameBoard", Vector3.new(6, 1.15, 0.22), CFrame.lookAt(boardPos, boardPos + facing), WOOD_LIGHT, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	write(board, "Pemilik")

	local accent = ACCENT[((index - 1) % #ACCENT) + 1]
	part("AccentBand", Vector3.new(9.6, 0.5, 0.5), hutCF * CFrame.new(0, 3.1, -3.45), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	part("AccentRidge", Vector3.new(0.9, 0.55, 8.3), hutCF * CFrame.new(0, 8.1, 0), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	part("AccentPost", Vector3.new(0.45, 3.0, 0.45), hutCF * CFrame.new(-4.4, 4.4, -3.4), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	part("AccentPost", Vector3.new(0.45, 3.0, 0.45), hutCF * CFrame.new(4.4, 4.4, -3.4), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	local flagAt = hutCF * CFrame.new(0, 9.6, 0)
	part("AccentPole", Vector3.new(0.2, 4.2, 0.2), flagAt * CFrame.new(0, 1.4, 0), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	part("AccentFlag", Vector3.new(2.4, 1.5, 0.12), flagAt * CFrame.new(1.2, 3.0, 0), accent, Enum.Material.Fabric, model)
	local numPlate = part("BaseNumberPlate", Vector3.new(11, 0.3, 11), flagAt * CFrame.new(0, 5.6, 0), WHITE, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	writeTop(numPlate, "#" .. tostring(index), accent)
	local platePos = hutCF:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 3.1, -4.25))
	local plate = part("BaseNumber", Vector3.new(2.8, 1.3, 0.16), CFrame.lookAt(platePos, platePos + facing), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	write(plate, "#" .. tostring(index))

	local gateAt = Vector3.new(centre.X + facing.X * 14, PLOT_Y, centre.Z + facing.Z * 14)
	vcyl("GatePost", gateAt + Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0), 5.2, 0.34, WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model, true)
	local gateSign = part("GateNumber", Vector3.new(4.4, 2.2, 0.2), CFrame.lookAt(gateAt + Vector3.new(0, 5.6, 0), gateAt + Vector3.new(0, 5.6, 0) + facing), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	write(gateSign, "#" .. tostring(index))

	local tops: { BasePart } = {}
	local n = 0
	for row = 0, 1 do
		for col = -1, 1 do
			n += 1
			local at = hutCF:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(col * GAP, 0, -12.2 - row * GAP))
			table.insert(tops, buildPedestal(at, model, n))
		end
	end

	buildFence(centre, facing, model)
	local peak = hutCF:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 8.3, 0))
	return marker, tops, peak
end

-- Builds a decorative palm model: leaning three-segment trunk, six leaves, two coconuts.
-- Returns nothing.
local function buildPalm(ground: Vector3, lean: Vector3, parent: Instance, scale: number)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Palm"
	model.Parent = parent
	local base = ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)
	local crown = base + Vector3.new(lean.X, 13 * scale, lean.Z)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local a = base:Lerp(crown, (i - 1) / 3)
		local b = base:Lerp(crown, i / 3)
		cyl("Trunk", a, b, (1.6 - i * 0.25) * scale, if i % 2 == 0 then TRUNK_DARK else TRUNK, Enum.Material.Wood, model, true)
	end
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local angle = math.rad((i - 1) * 60 + 12)
		local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 1.15, -0.42, math.sin(angle) * 1.15)
		local length = 7.4 * scale
		local mid = crown + dir.Unit * (length * 0.46)
		decor("Leaf", Vector3.new(1.7 * scale, 0.28 * scale, length), CFrame.lookAt(mid, mid + dir), if i % 2 == 0 then LEAF else LEAF_LIT, Enum.Material.Grass, model, nil, nil, false)
	end
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local angle = math.rad(20 + i * 140)
		decor("Coconut", Vector3.new(0.85, 0.85, 0.85) * scale, CFrame.new(crown + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 0.55, -0.7 * scale, math.sin(angle) * 0.55)), Color3.fromRGB(90, 56, 30), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model, Enum.PartType.Ball, nil, false)
	end
end

-- Returns nothing.

	model.Parent = parent
	local origin = Vector3.new(118, 3.2, -34)
	decor("Deck", Vector3.new(8, 0.4, 6), CFrame.new(origin + Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)), PLANKS, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, model)
	for _, corner in { Vector3.new(-3.4, 0, -2.4), Vector3.new(3.4, 0, -2.4), Vector3.new(-3.4, 0, 2.4), Vector3.new(3.4, 0, 2.4) } do
		vcyl("Stilt", origin + corner + Vector3.new(0, 1.0, 0), 2.6, 0.45, WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model, true)
	end
	local railY = origin.Y + 3.5
	local function rail(a: Vector3, b: Vector3)
		cyl("Rail", a, b, 0.22, BAMBOO, Enum.Material.Wood, model, true, false)
	end
	local corners = {
		origin + Vector3.new(-3.6, 3.5, -2.6),
		origin + Vector3.new(3.6, 3.5, -2.6),
		origin + Vector3.new(3.6, 3.5, 2.6),
		origin + Vector3.new(-3.6, 3.5, 1.0),

	vcyl("Planter", at + Vector3.new(0, 0.7, 0), 1.4, 2.6, STONE, Enum.Material.Slate, parent, true)
	vcyl("Soil", at + Vector3.new(0, 1.35, 0), 0.3, 2.2, SAND_DARK, Enum.Material.Ground, parent, true, false)
	buildPalm(at, Vector3.new(0.2, 0, 0.2), parent, 0.55)
end

-- === plaza ===
-- Builds the Totem model: the island's landmark, a carved tiki totem on the plaza with a glowing gem crown.
-- Returns nothing.
local function buildTotem(parent: Instance)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Totem"
	model.Parent = parent
	local base = Vector3.new(0, WALK_Y, 22)
	decor("TotemBase", Vector3.new(14, 1.2, 14), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)), STONE_DARK, Enum.Material.Slate, model, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	decor("TotemTier1", Vector3.new(7, 6, 7), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0)), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	decor("TotemTier2", Vector3.new(6, 5, 6), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 9.8, 0)), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	decor("TotemTier3", Vector3.new(5, 4.5, 5), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 14.6, 0)), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	decor("TotemBand1", Vector3.new(7.8, 0.8, 7.8), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 7.4, 0)), STONE, Enum.Material.Slate, model)
	decor("TotemBand2", Vector3.new(6.8, 0.8, 6.8), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 12.5, 0)), STONE, Enum.Material.Slate, model)
	decor("TotemBrow", Vector3.new(7.4, 0.8, 0.9), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 6.4, -3.4)), STONE_DARK, Enum.Material.Slate, model)
	decor("TotemMouth", Vector3.new(3.4, 0.9, 0.6), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 2.6, -3.5)), Color3.fromRGB(24, 20, 18), Enum.Material.Slate, model)
	for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local eye = decor("TotemEye", Vector3.new(1.1, 1.1, 0.7), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(sx * 1.9, 5.4, -3.5)), LAMP, Enum.Material.Neon, model)
		glow(eye, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120), 8)
	end
	for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		decor("TotemFin", Vector3.new(0.7, 3.4, 3.4), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(sx * 4.2, 9.8, 0)), RED, Enum.Material.Fabric, model)
	end
	local gem = decor("TotemGem", Vector3.new(2.6, 2.6, 2.6), CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 18.4, 0)), GOLD, Enum.Material.Neon, model)
	glow(gem, GOLD, 22)
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = GOLD
	light.Range = 34
	light.Brightness = 2.4
	light.Parent = gem
	for _, corner in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-7.5, 0, -7.5), Vector3.new(7.5, 0, -7.5), Vector3.new(-7.5, 0, 7.5), Vector3.new(7.5, 0, 7.5) }) do
		local at = base + corner
		vcyl("TotemTorch", at + Vector3.new(0, 3.0, 0), 6.0, 0.34, WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model, true)
		local flame = decor("TotemFlame", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.6, 1.2), CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(0, 6.4, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 60), Enum.Material.Neon, model)
		glow(flame, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 60), 14)
	end
end

-- Builds the PlazaDress model: paving, rebirth step, planters, light posts, string lights, sign border and flag.
-- Returns nothing.
local function buildPlazaDress(parent: Instance)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "PlazaDress"
	model.Parent = parent
	for col = -2, 2 do
		for row = -1, 1 do
			local tone = if (col + row) % 2 == 0 then STONE else Color3.fromRGB(196, 188, 174)
			decor("PlazaStone", Vector3.new(7.4, 0.16, 6.4), CFrame.new(col * 8, WALK_Y + 0.12, 22 + row * 8), tone, Enum.Material.Cobblestone, model, nil, nil, false)
		end
	end
	decor("RebirthStep", Vector3.new(12, 0.4, 12), CFrame.new(0, WALK_Y + 0.25, 32), STONE_DARK, Enum.Material.Slate, model, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	planter(Vector3.new(-20, WALK_Y, 8), model)
	planter(Vector3.new(20, WALK_Y, 8), model)
	planter(Vector3.new(-20, WALK_Y, 36), model)
	local posts = { Vector3.new(-24, WALK_Y, 4), Vector3.new(24, WALK_Y, 4), Vector3.new(-24, WALK_Y, 40), Vector3.new(24, WALK_Y, 40) }
	for _, at in posts do
		vcyl("LightPost", at + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0), 6.4, 0.4, WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model, true)
	end
	buildWire(posts[1] + Vector3.new(0, 6.4, 0), posts[2] + Vector3.new(0, 6.4, 0), model)
	buildWire(posts[3] + Vector3.new(0, 6.4, 0), posts[4] + Vector3.new(0, 6.4, 0), model)
	local z = 12
	decor("SignBorder", Vector3.new(18.4, 4.2, 0.3), CFrame.new(0, 8.2, z + 0.45), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, model)
	local lampL = decor("SignLamp", Vector3.new(0.8, 1.0, 0.8), CFrame.new(-9.2, 8.4, z), LAMP, Enum.Material.Neon, model, nil, nil, false)
	local lampR = decor("SignLamp", Vector3.new(0.8, 1.0, 0.8), CFrame.new(9.2, 8.4, z), LAMP, Enum.Material.Neon, model, nil, nil, false)
	glow(lampL, LAMP, 12)
	glow(lampR, LAMP, 12)
	vcyl("FlagPole", Vector3.new(0, 12.4, z), 4.0, 0.28, WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, model, true)
	decor("Flag", Vector3.new(2.4, 1.4, 0.12), CFrame.new(1.4, 13.6, z), RED, Enum.Material.Fabric, model, nil, nil, false)
	buildTotem(parent)
end

-- === composition ===
-- Builds the Composition model: planned palm groves in the open lawns, a planted ring around the plaza totem,
-- lamp pairs along the spawn corridor and flower beds at the plaza corners.
-- Returns nothing.
local function buildComposition(parent: Instance)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Composition"
	model.Parent = parent
	local groves = {
		{ Vector3.new(-68, GRASS_Y, 22), 1.00 },
		{ Vector3.new(68, GRASS_Y, 22), 1.05 },
		{ Vector3.new(-70, GRASS_Y, 66), 0.95 },
		{ Vector3.new(70, GRASS_Y, 66), 1.10 },
		{ Vector3.new(-66, GRASS_Y, 108), 1.00 },
		{ Vector3.new(66, GRASS_Y, 108), 0.92 },
	}
	for i, grove in ipairs(groves) do
		local at: Vector3 = grove[1]
		local scale: number = grove[2]
		local leanDir = if i % 2 == 0 then 1 else -1
		buildPalm(at, Vector3.new(leanDir * 1.1, 0, 0.5), model, scale)
		buildPalm(at + Vector3.new(4.5, 0, 5.0), Vector3.new(-leanDir * 0.7, 0, -0.9), model, scale * 0.85)
		buildBush(at + Vector3.new(2.6, 0, -3.4), if i % 2 == 0 then FLOWER_PINK else FLOWER_YELLOW, model, 3.0)
		buildBush(at + Vector3.new(-3.2, 0, -2.6), if i % 2 == 0 then FLOWER_RED else FLOWER_PINK, model, 2.6)
		buildRock(at + Vector3.new(-1.6, 0, 6.4), 1.3, model, STONE)
	end
	for step = 0, 7 do
		local angle = (step / 8) * math.pi * 2
		planter(Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 13.5, WALK_Y, 22 + math.sin(angle) * 13.5), model)
	end
	local horizon = {
		{ Vector3.new(-720, 0, 300), 1.35 },
		{ Vector3.new(620, 0, -540), 1.05 },
		{ Vector3.new(180, 0, 790), 1.20 },
		{ Vector3.new(-520, 0, -640), 0.9 },
	}
	for _, spec in ipairs(horizon) do
		local at: Vector3 = spec[1]
		local scale: number = spec[2]
		local haze = Color3.fromRGB(150, 196, 190)
		decor("FarIsland", Vector3.new(210 * scale, 1.5, 150 * scale), CFrame.new(at), Color3.fromRGB(196, 214, 176), Enum.Material.Sand, model)
		decor("FarHill", Vector3.new(120 * scale, 46 * scale, 96 * scale), CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(-40 * scale, 20 * scale, 0)), haze, Enum.Material.Grass, model)
		decor("FarHill", Vector3.new(86 * scale, 30 * scale, 70 * scale), CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(46 * scale, 13 * scale, 18 * scale)), Color3.fromRGB(138, 184, 178), Enum.Material.Grass, model)
	end
	for _, z in ipairs({ 76, 124 }) do
		buildLanternPost(Vector3.new(-7.5, GRASS_Y, z), model)
		buildLanternPost(Vector3.new(7.5, GRASS_Y, z), model)
	end
	for _, corner in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-24, GRASS_Y, 2), Vector3.new(24, GRASS_Y, 2), Vector3.new(-24, GRASS_Y, 42), Vector3.new(24, GRASS_Y, 42) }) do
		decor("BedSoil", Vector3.new(7.0, 0.15, 4.0), CFrame.new(corner), Color3.fromRGB(88, 62, 40), Enum.Material.Ground, model)
		for step = -1, 1 do
			decor("BedFlower", Vector3.new(0.6, 0.55, 0.6), CFrame.new(corner + Vector3.new(step * 1.3, 0.35, 0.6)), if step % 2 == 0 then FLOWER_PINK else FLOWER_YELLOW, Enum.Material.Grass, model)
			decor("BedFlower", Vector3.new(0.6, 0.55, 0.6), CFrame.new(corner + Vector3.new(step * 1.3, 0.35, -0.7)), if step % 2 == 0 then FLOWER_RED else WHITE, Enum.Material.Grass, model)
		end
	end
end

-- Builds all scenery under parent and strings hut lights between the base roof peaks in peaks.
-- Returns nothing.
local function buildScenery(parent: Instance, peaks: { Vector3 })
	buildFishingCorner(Vector3.new(-34, BEACH_Y, -6), 0.4, parent)
	buildFishingCorner(Vector3.new(34, BEACH_Y, -4), -0.35, parent)
	buildFruitStall(parent)

	local lights = Instance.new("Model")

	local posts = {

		Vector3.new(40, GRASS_Y, 22),
		Vector3.new(0, GRASS_Y, 56),
		Vector3.new(-30, GRASS_Y, 78),
		Vector3.new(30, GRASS_Y, 78),

		Vector3.new(-60, GRASS_Y, 118),

		Vector3.new(-122, BEACH_Y, 74),
		Vector3.new(122, BEACH_Y, 70),

	}
	for _, at in posts do
		buildLanternPost(at, lights)
	end
	local buoys = {
		Vector3.new(-40, 0.6, -55),
		Vector3.new(48, 0.55, -60),
		Vector3.new(-190, 0.6, 70),
		Vector3.new(175, 0.55, 20),
		Vector3.new(60, 0.5, 210),
	}
	local buoyModel = Instance.new("Model")
	buoyModel.Name = "Buoys"
	buoyModel.Parent = parent
	for _, at in buoys do
		buildBuoy(at, buoyModel)
	end
	local wires = Instance.new("Model")
	wires.Name = "HutLights"
	wires.Parent = parent
	for base = 1, 3 do
		buildWire(peaks[base] + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 3), peaks[base + 1] + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, -3), wires)
	end
	for base = 5, 7 do
		buildWire(peaks[base] + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 3), peaks[base + 1] + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, -3), wires)
	end
	buildWire(Vector3.new(-168, BEACH_Y + 6, 80), Vector3.new(-156, BEACH_Y + 5.6, 75), wires)
	buildWire(Vector3.new(18, GRASS_Y + 6.2, 8), Vector3.new(26, GRASS_Y + 6.2, 8), wires)
	buildMarketLane(parent)
	buildPalmGrove(parent)
	buildPond(parent)
	buildFlowerBeds(parent)
	buildCoast(parent)
	buildPlazaDress(parent)
	buildComposition(parent)
end

-- === composition ===
-- Builds the whole island under workspace.Pulau: lighting, sea, land, paths, piers, eight bases, scenery.
-- Returns the Anchors table (pierSpawns, plotCentres, pedestals, rebirth, centre).
local function build(): Anchors
	applyLighting()

	local root = Instance.new("Folder")
	root.Name = "Pulau"
	root.Parent = workspace

	local sea = Instance.new("Model")
	sea.Name = "Sea"
	sea.Parent = root
	buildSea(sea)

	local land = Instance.new("Model")
	land.Name = "Land"
	land.Parent = root
	local rebirth, centre = buildLand(land)
	buildPaths(land)

	local piers = Instance.new("Model")
	piers.Name = "Piers"
	piers.Parent = root
	local pierSpawns = {
		buildPier(-16, "PierSpawn1", piers),
		buildPier(16, "PierSpawn2", piers),
	}
	buildSign(piers)

	local bases = Instance.new("Model")
	bases.Name = "Bases"
	bases.Parent = root
	local plotCentres: { BasePart } = {}
	local pedestals: { { BasePart } } = {}
	local peaks: { Vector3 } = {}
	local zs = { -8, 34, 76, 118 }
	for side = -1, 1, 2 do
		for slot, z in zs do
			local at = Vector3.new(side * 118, PLOT_Y, z)
			local facing = Vector3.new(side, 0, 0)
			local index = (if side < 0 then 0 else 4) + slot
			local plot, tops, peak = buildBase(index, at, facing, bases)
			table.insert(plotCentres, plot)
			table.insert(pedestals, tops)
			table.insert(peaks, peak)
		end
	end

	local scenery = Instance.new("Model")
	scenery.Name = "Scenery"
	scenery.Parent = root
	buildScenery(scenery, peaks)

	root:SetAttribute("DecorParts", decorCount)
	return {
		pierSpawns = pierSpawns,
		plotCentres = plotCentres,
		pedestals = pedestals,
		rebirth = rebirth,
		centre = centre,
	}
end

return build()

--!strict
-- Xms.lua -- minimal XMS 3.0 driver (HIMEM entry point, A20, HMA, EMB moves).
-- WIN.CNF probes INT 2Fh AX=4300/4310 and then calls the far entry; DOSX uses
-- the same interface after the CPU/version gate. No HIMEM.SYS binary needed.

const band, bor, lshift, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const Xms = {}
Xms.__index = Xms

-- Reserved hypervisor segment: F100 hosts the IVT/timer/mouse stubs up to
-- 0x6D, so the XMS far entry goes at 0xC0 and cannot overlap a loaded program
-- (the DOS loader places images below the 0xA000 arena top, but a segment as
-- low as F200 looked "free" only until WSWAP happened to land there).
const ENTRY_SEG = 0xF100
const ENTRY_OFF = 0x00C0
const HMA_START = 0x100000
const HMA_SIZE = 0x10000
const EXT_START = HMA_START + HMA_SIZE

export type Block = {
	start: number,
	size: number,
}

export type Xms = {
	machine: any,
	a20: boolean,
	hmaInUse: boolean,
	blocks: { [number]: Block },
	nextHandle: number,
	entrySeg: number,
	entryOff: number,
	FN: { [number]: (self: Xms, cpu: any) -> () },
	enabled: (self: Xms) -> boolean,
	int2f: (self: Xms) -> boolean,
	dispatch: (self: Xms) -> (),
	releaseAll: (self: Xms) -> (),
}

function Xms.new(machine: any): Xms
	const self = setmetatable({}, Xms) :: any
	self.machine = machine
	-- HIMEM.SYS enables A20 while it initialises and leaves it on; real DOS
	-- extended-memory users (WSWAP) rely on that. 8086 keeps the 20-bit wrap.
	self.a20 = machine.cpu.level >= 1
	machine.mem.a20 = self.a20
	self.hmaInUse = false
	self.blocks = {}
	self.nextHandle = 1
	self.entrySeg = ENTRY_SEG
	self.entryOff = ENTRY_OFF
	-- Far entry: INT 9Fh (inline-dispatched by the machine's stub) ; RETF.
	machine.mem:write8(lshift(ENTRY_SEG, 4) + ENTRY_OFF, 0xCD)
	machine.mem:write8(lshift(ENTRY_SEG, 4) + ENTRY_OFF + 1, 0x9F)
	machine.mem:write8(lshift(ENTRY_SEG, 4) + ENTRY_OFF + 2, 0xCB)
	-- The no-ROM test/hypervisor machine installs every IVT vector as a far
	-- return at F000:0100. Hook the two DPMI-era services here so INT 2Fh and
	-- the far XMS entry reach the driver without a DOS layer.
	machine.cpu.defaultInts[0x2F] = function()
		self:int2f()
	end
	machine.cpu.defaultInts[0x9F] = function()
		self:dispatch()
	end
	machine.cpu:registerStub(0x2F, 0xF000, 0x0100)
	machine.cpu:registerStub(0x9F, 0xF000, 0x0100)
	return self
end

function Xms.enabled(self: Xms): boolean
	return self.machine.cpu.level >= 1 -- 286+
end

-- INT 2Fh installation check / driver entry. Returns true when handled.
function Xms.int2f(self: Xms): boolean
	const cpu = self.machine.cpu
	if not self:enabled() then
		return false
	end
	const ax = cpu.r[1]
	if ax == 0x4300 then
		cpu:wb(0, 0x80)
		cpu:wr(3, 0x0100)
		return true
	elseif ax == 0x4310 then
		cpu.es = self.entrySeg
		cpu:wr(3, self.entryOff)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function setMemA20(self: Xms, on: boolean)
	self.a20 = on
	self.machine.mem.a20 = on
end

local function freeList(self: Xms): { Block }
	local list: { Block } = {}
	for _, block in pairs(self.blocks) do
		list[#list + 1] = block
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a: Block, b: Block): boolean
		return a.start < b.start
	end)
	return list
end

local function memoryTotals(self: Xms): (number, number)
	const memSize = self.machine.mem.size
	local cursor = EXT_START
	local largest, total = 0, 0
	for _, block in ipairs(freeList(self)) do
		const gap = block.start - cursor
		if gap > largest then
			largest = gap
		end
		total += gap
		cursor = block.start + block.size
	end
	const tail = memSize - cursor
	if tail > largest then
		largest = tail
	end
	total += tail
	return math.floor(largest / 1024), math.floor(total / 1024)
end

local function allocate(self: Xms, bytes: number): (number?, number?)
	local cursor = EXT_START
	const memSize = self.machine.mem.size
	for _, block in ipairs(freeList(self)) do
		if block.start - cursor >= bytes then
			const handle = self.nextHandle
			self.nextHandle += 1
			self.blocks[handle] = { start = cursor, size = bytes }
			return handle, cursor
		end
		cursor = block.start + block.size
	end
	if memSize - cursor >= bytes then
		const handle = self.nextHandle
		self.nextHandle += 1
		self.blocks[handle] = { start = cursor, size = bytes }
		return handle, cursor
	end
	return nil, nil
end

local function readDword(mem: any, addr: number): number
	return bor(mem:read16(addr), lshift(mem:read16(addr + 2), 16))
end

local function copyLinear(mem: any, dst: number, src: number, length: number)
	for index = 0, length - 1 do
		mem:write8(dst + index, mem:read8(src + index))
	end
end

Xms.FN = {}

Xms.FN[0x00] = function(_self: Xms, cpu: any) -- get version
	cpu:wr(0, 0x0300)
	cpu:wr(3, 0x0100)
end

Xms.FN[0x01] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- request HMA (DX = KB)
	if self.hmaInUse then
		cpu:wr(0, 0)
		return
	end
	self.hmaInUse = true
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
end

Xms.FN[0x02] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- release HMA
	self.hmaInUse = false
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
end

Xms.FN[0x03] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- enable A20
	setMemA20(self, true)
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
end

Xms.FN[0x04] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- disable A20
	setMemA20(self, false)
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
end

Xms.FN[0x05] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- local enable A20
	setMemA20(self, true)
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
end

Xms.FN[0x06] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- local disable A20
	setMemA20(self, false)
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
end

Xms.FN[0x07] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- query A20
	cpu:wr(0, self.a20 and 1 or 0)
end

Xms.FN[0x08] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- query free memory
	const largest, total = memoryTotals(self)
	cpu:wr(0, largest)
	cpu:wr(2, total)
end

Xms.FN[0x09] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- allocate EMB (DX = KB)
	const handle = allocate(self, cpu.r[3] * 1024)
	if not handle then
		cpu:wr(0, 0)
		return
	end
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
	cpu:wr(2, handle) -- XMS 09: DX = handle, AX = 1
end

Xms.FN[0x0A] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- free EMB
	if self.blocks[cpu.r[3]] then
		self.blocks[cpu.r[3]] = nil
		cpu:wr(0, 1)
	else
		cpu:wr(0, 0)
	end
end

Xms.FN[0x0B] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- move extended memory block
	const mem = self.machine.mem
	const base = lshift(cpu.ds, 4) + cpu.r[7] -- DS:SI -> move structure
	const length = readDword(mem, base)
	const srcHandle = mem:read16(base + 4)
	const srcOffset = readDword(mem, base + 6)
	const dstHandle = mem:read16(base + 10)
	const dstOffset = readDword(mem, base + 12)
	-- XMS 0Bh: handle 0 means a real-mode segment:offset packed as a DWORD
	-- (segment in the high word), not a linear address. WSWAP depends on it.
	local function realAddress(offset: number): number
		return lshift(rshift(offset, 16), 4) + band(offset, 0xFFFF)
	end
	local src
	local dst
	if srcHandle == 0 then
		src = realAddress(srcOffset)
	else
		const block = self.blocks[srcHandle]
		if not block or srcOffset + length > block.size then
			cpu:wr(0, 0)
			return
		end
		src = block.start + srcOffset
	end
	if dstHandle == 0 then
		dst = realAddress(dstOffset)
	else
		const block = self.blocks[dstHandle]
		if not block or dstOffset + length > block.size then
			cpu:wr(0, 0)
			return
		end
		dst = block.start + dstOffset
	end
	-- XMS owns A20 during a move: the guest's current gate state must not fold
	-- destinations that live in extended memory (DOSX disables A20 while it
	-- prepares its GDT, then copies the table into an EMB with 0Bh).
	const savedA20 = mem.a20
	mem.a20 = true
	copyLinear(mem, dst, src, length)
	mem.a20 = savedA20
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
end

Xms.FN[0x0C] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- lock EMB
	const block = self.blocks[cpu.r[3]]
	if not block then
		cpu:wr(0, 0)
		return
	end
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
	cpu:wr(3, band(block.start, 0xFFFF))
	cpu:wr(2, band(rshift(block.start, 16), 0xFFFF))
end

Xms.FN[0x0D] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- unlock EMB
	cpu:wr(0, self.blocks[cpu.r[3]] and 1 or 0)
end

Xms.FN[0x0E] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- get EMB info
	const block = self.blocks[cpu.r[3]]
	if not block then
		cpu:wr(0, 0)
		return
	end
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
	cpu:wr(3, 0) -- BL=0 locked blocks, BH=0 total blocks
	cpu:wr(2, band(block.size / 1024, 0xFFFF)) -- DX = size KB
end

Xms.FN[0x88] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- query any extended memory
	const kb = math.floor((self.machine.mem.size - HMA_START) / 1024)
	cpu:wr(0, band(kb, 0xFFFF))
end

Xms.FN[0x89] = function(self: Xms, cpu: any) -- allocate any extended memory
	const handle = allocate(self, cpu.r[3] * 1024)
	if not handle then
		cpu:wr(0, 0)
		return
	end
	cpu:wr(0, 1)
	cpu:wr(2, handle)
end

-- A new image cannot inherit another process's extended-memory handles. Real
-- DOS leaves them allocated, but Windows 3.1's WSWAP keeps its swap block and
-- returns to WIN.CNF without freeing it, which would leave DOSX with no XMS.
-- Releasing on EXEC matches what a well-behaved DOS session needs.
function Xms.releaseAll(self: Xms)
	self.blocks = {}
	self.hmaInUse = false
end

function Xms.dispatch(self: Xms)
	const cpu = self.machine.cpu
	const fn = band(rshift(cpu.r[1], 8), 0xFF)
	const handler = self.FN[fn]
	if not handler then
		cpu:wr(0, 0)
		return
	end
	handler(self, cpu)
end

return Xms

-- BrainrotSpawner runs the conveyor: absurd characters stroll down the plaza
-- on their own, and a player who clicks one buys it if they can afford it and
-- have a free base slot. The same click on a base brainrot goes to stealing,
-- and on the wave's fish to claiming it.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local GameConfig = require(Shared.GameConfig)
local BrainrotData = require(Shared.BrainrotData)
local BrainrotBuilder = require(Shared.BrainrotBuilder)

local GameState = require(script.Parent.GameState)
local WorldBuilder = require(script.Parent.WorldBuilder)
local Economy = require(script.Parent.Economy)
local StealSystem = require(script.Parent.StealSystem)
local WaveEvent = require(script.Parent.WaveEvent)

local BrainrotSpawner = {}

local function countConveyor()
	local count = 0
	for _ in pairs(GameState.conveyor) do
		count += 1
	end
	return count
end

-- One click on any brainrot in the world lands here, then fans out by where it is.
function BrainrotSpawner.onBrainrotClicked(player, uid)
	local record = GameState.brainrots[uid]
	if not record then
		return
	end
	if record.location == "conveyor" then
		Economy.buyBrainrot(player, uid)
	elseif record.location == "base" then
		StealSystem.trySteal(player, uid)
	elseif record.location == "wave" then
		WaveEvent.claimWaveBrainrot(player, uid)
	end
end

local function attachClick(model, uid)
	local detector = model:FindFirstChild("Clicker", true)
	if detector then
		detector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
			BrainrotSpawner.onBrainrotClicked(player, uid)
		end)
	end
end

function BrainrotSpawner.removeBrainrot(uid)
	local record = GameState.brainrots[uid]
	if record and record.model then
		record.model:Destroy()
	end
	GameState.brainrots[uid] = nil
	GameState.conveyor[uid] = nil
end

-- Walks the model down the waypoints, then despawns it at the gate.
local function walkBrainrot(record)
	task.spawn(function()
		local waypoints = WorldBuilder.layout.waypoints
		local index = 1
		while record.model.Parent ~= nil and record.location == "conveyor" do
			local target = waypoints[index]
			if not target then
				break
			end
			local position = record.model:GetPivot().Position
			local toTarget = target - position
			local distance = toTarget.Magnitude
			if distance < 0.5 then
				index += 1
				if index > #waypoints then
					break
				end
			else
				local direction = toTarget.Unit
				local step = math.min(distance, GameConfig.WALK_SPEED * 0.05)
				local newPosition = position + direction * step
				record.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(newPosition, newPosition + direction))
				task.wait(0.05)
			end
		end
		if record.location == "conveyor" then
			BrainrotSpawner.removeBrainrot(record.uid)
		end
	end)
end

function BrainrotSpawner.spawnBrainrot()
	if countConveyor() >= GameConfig.MAX_ON_CONVEYOR then
		return
	end
	local character = BrainrotData.rollCharacter()
	local mutation = BrainrotData.rollMutation()
	local uid = GameState.nextBrainrotUid()
	local model = BrainrotBuilder.build(character, mutation, character.income * mutation.multiplier, "  •  $" .. character.cost)
	local start = WorldBuilder.layout.waypoints[1]
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(start))
	model.Parent = Workspace
	local record = {
		uid = uid,
		character = character,
		mutation = mutation,
		income = character.income * mutation.multiplier,
		cost = character.cost,
		model = model,
		location = "conveyor",
		owner = nil,
		slot = nil,
		baseIndex = nil,
	}
	GameState.brainrots[uid] = record
	GameState.conveyor[uid] = record
	attachClick(model, uid)
	walkBrainrot(record)
end

-- The conveyor never stops: a fresh brainrot every few seconds.
function BrainrotSpawner.startLoop()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(GameConfig.SPAWN_INTERVAL)
			BrainrotSpawner.spawnBrainrot()
		end
	end)
end

return BrainrotSpawner

--!strict
--[[
	Retry
	Calls a function that might fail (DataStores, HttpService, MarketplaceService)
	and retries with exponential backoff.

	local ok, data = Retry.call(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end, { attempts = 5, baseDelay = 1 })

	if not ok then warn("Load failed:", data) end
]]

local Retry = {}

export type Options = {
	attempts: number?, -- total tries, default 3
	baseDelay: number?, -- seconds before the 2nd try, default 1
	maxDelay: number?, -- cap on any single wait, default 30
	onRetry: ((attempt: number, err: any) -> ())?,
}

-- Returns (true, ...results) on success, or (false, lastError) after all attempts fail.
function Retry.call(fn: () -> ...any, options: Options?): (boolean, ...any)
	local opts = options or {}
	local attempts = opts.attempts or 3
	local baseDelay = opts.baseDelay or 1
	local maxDelay = opts.maxDelay or 30
	assert(attempts >= 1, "Retry.call: attempts must be at least 1")

	local lastError: any = nil
	for attempt = 1, attempts do
		local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
		if results[1] then
			return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
		end
		lastError = results[2]

		if attempt < attempts then
			if opts.onRetry then
				opts.onRetry(attempt, lastError)
			end
			local delaySeconds = math.min(baseDelay * 2 ^ (attempt - 1), maxDelay)
			if delaySeconds > 0 then
				task.wait(delaySeconds)
			end
		end
	end
	return false, lastError
end

return Retry

-- SOFTWARE.

-- init.server: owns server bootstrap: remotes, wiring of every gameplay module, and the player join/leave/state-push loops.
-- Server gameplay is authoritative; the client only renders and sends intents.
-- boot order: require Config, PlayerState, World, Bases, Carry, Dock, Pedestal, Lock, Steal, Rebirth, Save, Storm;
-- boot order: create Net remotes State, Notify, Alert;
-- boot order: init World anchors, Bases, Pedestal, Lock, Steal, Rebirth, Dock, Storm;
-- boot order: bind Pedestal, Lock, Steal, Rebirth;
-- boot order: connect PlayerAdded/PlayerRemoving, spawn onPlayer for present players, then start Pedestal, Lock, Dock, Storm, bind Save.
--!strict

-- boot order (as this file runs it, top to bottom):
--   1. world: require World, which builds the island once and returns the anchors (pierSpawns, plotCentres, pedestals, rebirth, centre);
--      the same pass requires Config, PlayerState, Bases, Carry, Dock, Pedestal, Lock, Steal, Rebirth, Save and Storm.
--   2. remotes: create ReplicatedStorage.Net with the State, Notify and Alert RemoteEvents.
--   3. bases: Bases.init(anchors) builds the base records on the plot centres.
--   4. pedestal, lock, steal: Pedestal.init, Lock.init, Steal.init set up slots, fences/boards and steal prompts.
--   5. rebirth: Rebirth.init(anchors.rebirth) builds the rebirth sign and prompt.
--   6. dock: Dock.init(anchors, workspace) sets up the pier spawn spots.
--   7. storm: Storm.init(anchors) sets up the storm cycle and notify remotes.
--   8. bind: Pedestal.bind, Lock.bind, Steal.bind, Rebirth.bind hook up the place/sell, lock, steal and rebirth prompts.
--   9. joins and leaves: PlayerAdded queues a serialised join (save: Save.load, PlayerState.create, Bases.assign,
--      Bases.bindCharacter, LoadCharacter, carry: Carry.restore, Pedestal.sync, first push); PlayerRemoving runs Save.save,
--      Carry.clear, Pedestal.clearBase, Steal.clear, Bases.release; players already present are queued too.
--  10. income tick: Pedestal.start starts the income loop (every Config.incomeTickRate seconds).
--  11. Lock.start (lock countdown ticker), Dock.start (restocking), Storm.start (storm cycle), Save.bind (save all on BindToClose).
--  12. state push loop: every Config.statePushRate seconds push each player's state and lock alert.
--
-- module contract (derived from the code below):
--   owns:    the ReplicatedStorage.Net folder and its State, Notify and Alert RemoteEvents; Players.CharacterAutoLoads = true;
--            the lastPushedCash table (per-player cash at the last state push, used for the payload "gain" field);
--            the joinQueue / joinRunning pair that serialises joins one player at a time; the onLeave teardown order;
--            the state push loop that fires State (serialized PlayerState + stormIn, basePosition, gain) and Alert (lock kind).
--   refuses: to finish a join for a player who left during Save.load (player.Parent ~= Players returns early);
--            to run a second join pump while one is running (joinRunning guard); to queue-process players no longer in Players;
--            to give a character, pedestal sync or first push to a player with no free base (warns, restores carry, returns);
--            to let a failed Save.load abort the join (warns and starts fresh with nil data);
--            to let one failing leave step, join or push stop the others (each wrapped in pcall and warned).
--   returns: nothing; this is the server entry Script, not a ModuleScript, so no module table is exported.

-- services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- module requires
local Config = require(script:WaitForChild("Config"))
local PlayerState = require(script:WaitForChild("PlayerState"))
local World = require(script:WaitForChild("World"))
local Bases = require(script:WaitForChild("Bases"))
local Carry = require(script:WaitForChild("Carry"))
local Dock = require(script:WaitForChild("Dock"))
local Pedestal = require(script:WaitForChild("Pedestal"))
local Lock = require(script:WaitForChild("Lock"))
local Steal = require(script:WaitForChild("Steal"))
local Rebirth = require(script:WaitForChild("Rebirth"))
local Save = require(script:WaitForChild("Save"))
local Storm = require(script:WaitForChild("Storm"))

-- character autoload
Players.CharacterAutoLoads = true

-- Net remotes folder
local net = Instance.new("Folder")
net.Name = "Net"
net.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

-- === remotes ===
-- remote factory
-- remote(name): creates a RemoteEvent with the given name and parents it under ReplicatedStorage.Net.
-- returns: the new RemoteEvent.
local function remote(name: string): RemoteEvent
	local event = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	event.Name = name
	event.Parent = net
	return event
end

-- remote events
local stateEvent = remote("State")
remote("Notify")
local alertEvent = remote("Alert")

-- === module setup ===
-- module init
local anchors = World
Bases.init(anchors)
Pedestal.init()
Lock.init()
Steal.init()
Rebirth.init(anchors.rebirth)
Dock.init(anchors, workspace)
Storm.init(anchors)

-- module prompt binding
Pedestal.bind()
Lock.bind()
Steal.bind()
Rebirth.bind()

-- last pushed cash per player
local lastPushedCash: { [Player]: number } = {}

-- === player lifecycle ===
-- state push to one player
-- push(player, previousCash?): serializes the player's state, adds stormIn, basePosition and gain, and fires State to them.
-- returns: nothing; does nothing when PlayerState.serialize yields no payload.
local function push(player: Player, previousCash: number?)
	local payload = PlayerState.serialize(player)
	if payload then
		payload.stormIn = Storm.secondsUntilNext()
		local record = Bases.get(player)
		if record and record.centre then
			payload.basePosition = record.centre.Position
		end
		payload.gain = math.max(0, math.floor((payload.cash or 0) - (previousCash or 0)))
		stateEvent:FireClient(player, payload)
	end
end

-- join handler
-- onPlayer(player): loads save data, creates state, assigns a base, spawns the character, restores carry, syncs pedestals, pushes and welcomes.
-- returns: nothing; returns early if the player left during load or no free base exists.
local function onPlayer(player: Player)
	local loaded: { [string]: any }? = nil
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return Save.load(player)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Save] join load failed, starting fresh: " .. tostring(result))
	end
	if player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	if ok and typeof(result) == "table" then
		loaded = result
	end
	PlayerState.create(player, loaded)
	local record = Bases.assign(player)
	if not record then
		warn("[Bases] no free base for " .. player.Name)
		Carry.restore(player)
		return
	end
	Bases.bindCharacter(player)
	player:LoadCharacter()
	Carry.restore(player)
	Pedestal.sync(player)
	local startState = PlayerState.get(player)
	lastPushedCash[player] = if startState then startState.cash else nil
	push(player)
	Storm.notify(player, "join", "Welcome to Pulau Brainrot")
end

-- join queue state
local joinQueue: { Player } = {}
local joinRunning = false

-- join queue pump
-- pumpJoins(): drains joinQueue one player at a time, running onPlayer under pcall for players still in the game.
-- returns: nothing; exits immediately if a pump is already running.
local function pumpJoins()
	if joinRunning then
		return
	end
	joinRunning = true
	while #joinQueue > 0 do
		local player = table.remove(joinQueue, 1)
		if player.Parent == Players then
			local ok, err = pcall(onPlayer, player)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Server] join failed: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end
	joinRunning = false
end

-- join enqueue
-- queueJoin(player): appends the player to joinQueue and spawns a pumpJoins task.
-- returns: nothing.
local function queueJoin(player: Player)
	table.insert(joinQueue, player)
	task.spawn(pumpJoins)
end

-- leave handler
-- onLeave(player): saves, then clears carry, the base's pedestals, steal state, the base and player state, each step isolated by pcall.
-- returns: nothing.
local function onLeave(player: Player)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		Save.save(player)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Save] leave save failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end
	pcall(function()
		Carry.clear(player)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local state = PlayerState.get(player)
		if state and state.baseIndex then
			Pedestal.clearBase(state.baseIndex)
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		Steal.clear(player)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		Bases.release(player)
	end)
	PlayerState.clear(player)
	lastPushedCash[player] = nil
end

-- === player lifecycle ===
-- PlayerAdded hook
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	queueJoin(player)
end)

-- PlayerRemoving hook
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, err = pcall(onLeave, player)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Server] leave failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end)

-- queue players already present
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	queueJoin(player)
end

-- income tick, module loops and save binding
Pedestal.start()
Lock.start()
Dock.start()
Storm.start()
Save.bind()

-- === state push loop ===
-- state push loop
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.statePushRate)
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local previous = lastPushedCash[player]
			local ok, err = pcall(push, player, previous)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Server] state push failed: " .. tostring(err))
			end
			local record = Bases.get(player)
			local state = PlayerState.get(player)
			if state then
				lastPushedCash[player] = state.cash
			end
			if record then
				local left = math.max(0, record.lockedUntil - os.clock())
				alertEvent:FireClient(player, {
					kind = "lock",
					locked = left > 0,
					seconds = math.ceil(left),
				})
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- (recorded build witness b)

-- (recorded build witness c)
