-- DataStore saves each player's progress: cash, rebirths, slots and the
-- brainrots on their base. Every call is wrapped in pcall, so when Studio's
-- API access is off the game just plays without saving, never errors.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local GameState = require(script.Parent.GameState)
local BaseManager = require(script.Parent.BaseManager)

local DataStore = {}

local store = nil
local function getStore()
	if store then
		return store
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore("BrainrotBay_v1")
	end)
	if ok then
		store = result
	end
	return store
end

local function keyFor(userId)
	return "player_" .. userId
end

-- Loads a save and rebuilds the player's base from it; returns true on success.
function DataStore.loadPlayer(player, state)
	local dataStore = getStore()
	if not dataStore then
		return false
	end
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return dataStore:GetAsync(keyFor(player.UserId))
	end)
	if not ok or type(saved) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	state.cash = saved.cash or state.cash
	state.rebirths = saved.rebirths or 0
	state.multiplier = GameState.multiplierOf(state.rebirths)
	state.slotsOwned = saved.slotsOwned or state.slotsOwned
	if state.cashValue then
		state.cashValue.Value = state.cash
	end
	local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").BrainrotData)
	local BrainrotBuilder = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").BrainrotBuilder)
	for _, entry in ipairs(saved.owned or {}) do
		local character = BrainrotData.getCharacter(entry.characterId)
		if character then
			local mutation = BrainrotData.MUTATIONS[1]
			for _, candidate in ipairs(BrainrotData.MUTATIONS) do
				if candidate.name == entry.mutationName then
					mutation = candidate
				end
			end
			local uid = GameState.nextBrainrotUid()
			local income = GameState.incomeOf(state, character, mutation)
			local model = BrainrotBuilder.build(character, mutation, income, "")
			model.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace")
			local record = {
				uid = uid,
				character = character,
				mutation = mutation,
				income = income,
				cost = character.cost,
				model = model,
				location = "base",
				owner = player.UserId,
				slot = nil,
				baseIndex = nil,
			}
			GameState.brainrots[uid] = record
			BaseManager.placeOnBase(state, record)
			local label = record.model:FindFirstChild("Label", true)
			if label then
				local money = label:FindFirstChild("Money")
				if money then
					money.Text = "$" .. record.income .. "/s"
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Writes the player's progress. Never errors: a failed save is just skipped.
function DataStore.savePlayer(player, state)
	local dataStore = getStore()
	if not dataStore then
		return false
	end
	local owned = {}
	for _, record in pairs(state.owned) do
		table.insert(owned, { characterId = record.character.id, mutationName = record.mutation.name })
	end
	local data = {
		cash = state.cash,
		rebirths = state.rebirths,
		slotsOwned = state.slotsOwned,
		owned = owned,
	}
	local ok = pcall(function()
		dataStore:SetAsync(keyFor(player.UserId), data)
	end)
	return ok
end

-- Saves every online player on a timer, so a crash loses at most a minute.
function DataStore.startAutosave()
	local GameConfig = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").GameConfig)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(GameConfig.AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
			for _, state in pairs(GameState.players) do
				DataStore.savePlayer(state.player, state)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return DataStore

--!strict
--[[
	Signal
	A lightweight, pure-Luau event object (like BindableEvent, but faster and
	without serialization, so tables/functions are passed by reference).

	local Signal = require(path.to.Signal)
	local died = Signal.new()
	local conn = died:Connect(function(player) print(player, "died") end)
	died:Fire(somePlayer)
	conn:Disconnect()
]]

local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal

local Connection = {}
Connection.__index = Connection

export type Connection = {
	Connected: boolean,
	Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
}

export type Signal = {
	Connect: (self: Signal, handler: (...any) -> ()) -> Connection,
	Once: (self: Signal, handler: (...any) -> ()) -> Connection,
	Fire: (self: Signal, ...any) -> (),
	Wait: (self: Signal) -> ...any,
	DisconnectAll: (self: Signal) -> (),
	Destroy: (self: Signal) -> (),
}

function Connection:Disconnect()
	if not self.Connected then
		return
	end
	self.Connected = false
	local handlers = self._signal._handlers
	local index = table.find(handlers, self)
	if index then
		table.remove(handlers, index)
	end
end

function Signal.new(): Signal
	local self = setmetatable({
		_handlers = {},
	}, Signal)
	return (self :: any) :: Signal
end

function Signal:Connect(handler: (...any) -> ()): Connection
	assert(type(handler) == "function", "Signal:Connect expects a function")
	local connection = setmetatable({
		Connected = true,
		_signal = self,
		_handler = handler,
	}, Connection)
	table.insert(self._handlers, connection)
	return (connection :: any) :: Connection
end

function Signal:Once(handler: (...any) -> ()): Connection
	local connection
	connection = self:Connect(function(...)
		connection:Disconnect()
		handler(...)
	end)
	return connection
end

-- Each handler runs in its own thread, so one erroring or yielding handler
-- never stops the others. We iterate over a snapshot so handlers can safely
-- connect/disconnect while the signal is firing.
function Signal:Fire(...: any)
	local snapshot = table.clone(self._handlers)
	for _, connection in snapshot do
		if connection.Connected then
			task.spawn(connection._handler, ...)
		end
	end
end

function Signal:Wait(): ...any
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	self:Once(function(...)
		task.spawn(thread, ...)
	end)
	return coroutine.yield()
end

function Signal:DisconnectAll()
	for _, connection in table.clone(self._handlers) do
		connection.Connected = false
	end
	table.clear(self._handlers)
end

function Signal:Destroy()
	self:DisconnectAll()
end

return Signal

--!nonstrict
-- Boot.lua -- find a guest machine supplied by the surrounding game.
--
-- RVPC core ships no ROM or OS media. A game provides one of the ModuleScripts
-- below in ReplicatedStorage:
--
--   RvpcBoot, Boot, boot, Machine
--
-- Each may return:
--   * function(Rvpc, RvpcUi) -> Machine
--   * a table with :boot(Rvpc, RvpcUi), :create(...) or :new(...)
--   * a ready Machine table (run, pressKey, releaseKey, mouseMove, vga)
--
-- A "Machine" here is the configured instance, not core/Machine.lua's class.

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

const Boot = {}

const MODULE_NAMES = { "RvpcBoot", "Boot", "boot", "Machine" }

local function isMachine(value: any): boolean
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	const vga = value.vga
	return type(value.run) == "function"
		and type(value.pressKey) == "function"
		and type(value.releaseKey) == "function"
		and type(value.mouseMove) == "function"
		and type(vga) == "table"
		and type(vga.width) == "function"
		and type(vga.height) == "function"
end

local function callFactory(factory: any, Rvpc: any, RvpcUi: any): (any?, string?)
	if type(factory) == "function" then
		const ok, machine = pcall(factory, Rvpc, RvpcUi)
		if not ok then
			return nil, tostring(machine)
		end
		return machine, nil
	end
	if type(factory) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "module did not return a function or table"
	end
	if isMachine(factory) then
		return factory, nil
	end
	if factory == Rvpc.Machine then
		return nil, "core Machine class needs a configured factory"
	end
	for _, methodName in { "boot", "create", "new" } do
		const method = factory[methodName]
		if type(method) == "function" then
			const ok, machine = pcall(method, factory, Rvpc, RvpcUi)
			if not ok then
				return nil, tostring(machine)
			end
			return machine, nil
		end
	end
	return nil, "module has no boot/create/new method"
end

-- Returns machine, sourceName, details. details is filled when nothing loaded.
function Boot.resolve(Rvpc: any, RvpcUi: any, container: Instance?): (any?, string?, string?)
	const root = container or ReplicatedStorage
	const problems: { string } = {}
	local found = false
	for _, name in MODULE_NAMES do
		const module = root:FindFirstChild(name)
		if module and module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			found = true
			const okRequire, factory = pcall(require, module)
			if not okRequire then
				problems[#problems + 1] = name .. ": require failed: " .. tostring(factory)
			else
				const machine, err = callFactory(factory, Rvpc, RvpcUi)
				if isMachine(machine) then
					return machine, name, nil
				end
				problems[#problems + 1] = name .. ": " .. (err or "factory returned no machine")
			end
		end
	end
	if not found then
		problems[#problems + 1] = "no RvpcBoot/Boot/boot/Machine ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage"
	end
	return nil, nil, table.concat(problems, "\n")
end

-- A text-mode VGA showing the shell's instructions. This exercises the real
-- Vga -> VgaView path even when no guest machine exists.
function Boot.diagnosticVga(Rvpc: any, details: string?): any
	const mem = Rvpc.Memory.new(1024 * 1024)
	const vga = Rvpc.Vga.new(mem)
	vga:setMode(0x03)
	for row = 0, 24 do
		vga:writeText(row, 0, string.rep(" ", 80), 0x07)
	end

	local function put(row: number, text: string, attr: number)
		if row >= 25 then
			return
		end
		vga:writeText(row, 0, string.sub(text, 1, 80), attr)
	end

	put(0, " RVPC / 98  -  CLIENT DIAGNOSTIC", 0x1F)
	put(2, "No boot machine is available.", 0x0F)
	put(3, "The VGA presenter and input bridge are running.", 0x07)
	put(5, "Supply a ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage named:", 0x0F)
	put(6, "  RvpcBoot, Boot, boot or Machine", 0x0E)
	put(8, "Return one of:", 0x0F)
	put(9, "  function(Rvpc, RvpcUi) -> Machine", 0x07)
	put(10, "  table:boot(...) / :create(...) / :new(...)", 0x07)
	put(11, "  a ready Machine table", 0x07)
	put(13, "Machine fields: run, pressKey, releaseKey, mouseMove, vga.", 0x0F)
	put(15, "No SeaBIOS/SeaVGABIOS ROM or guest OS media is bundled.", 0x07)
	put(17, "Details:", 0x0F)

	if details and #details > 0 then
		local row = 18
		for line in string.gmatch(details, "[^\r\n]+") do
			local position = 1
			while position <= #line and row < 25 do
				vga:writeText(row, 0, string.sub(line, position, position + 79), 0x0C)
				row += 1
				position += 80
			end
			if row >= 25 then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return vga
end

return Boot

--!strict
--[[
	TableUtil
	Small table helpers you end up rewriting in every game.

	-- Fill in missing keys when you add new fields to saved player data:
	local data = TableUtil.reconcile(loadedData, DEFAULT_DATA)
]]

local TableUtil = {}

-- Full copy of a table, including nested tables. Handles cycles.
function TableUtil.deepCopy<T>(value: T): T
	local seen = {}
	local function copy(v: any): any
		if type(v) ~= "table" then
			return v
		end
		if seen[v] then
			return seen[v]
		end
		local result = {}
		seen[v] = result
		for key, child in v do
			result[copy(key)] = copy(child)
		end
		local mt = getmetatable(v)
		if type(mt) == "table" then
			setmetatable(result, mt)
		end
		return result
	end
	return copy(value)
end

-- Returns a copy of `target` where any key missing from it is filled in from
-- `template` (recursively). Existing values are kept. Neither input is changed.
function TableUtil.reconcile(target: { [any]: any }, template: { [any]: any }): { [any]: any }
	local result = TableUtil.deepCopy(target)
	for key, templateValue in template do
		local current = result[key]
		if current == nil then
			result[key] = TableUtil.deepCopy(templateValue)
		elseif type(current) == "table" and type(templateValue) == "table" then
			result[key] = TableUtil.reconcile(current, templateValue)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- Shuffles an array in place (Fisher-Yates). Pass a Random for repeatable results.
function TableUtil.shuffle<T>(array: { T }, rng: any?): { T }
	for i = #array, 2, -1 do
		local j = if rng then rng:NextInteger(1, i) else math.random(1, i)
		array[i], array[j] = array[j], array[i]
	end
	return array
end

function TableUtil.keys<K>(dict: { [K]: any }): { K }
	local result = {}
	for key in dict do
		table.insert(result, key)
	end
	return result
end

-- Counts entries in any table (# only works for arrays).
function TableUtil.count(dict: { [any]: any }): number
	local n = 0
	for _ in dict do
		n += 1
	end
	return n
end

-- Picks a random key from { [key] = weight }, e.g. loot tables.
function TableUtil.weightedPick<K>(weights: { [K]: number }, rng: any?): K?
	local total = 0
	for _, weight in weights do
		assert(weight >= 0, "TableUtil.weightedPick: weights can't be negative")
		total += weight
	end
	if total <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local roll = (if rng then rng:NextNumber() else math.random()) * total
	local last: K? = nil
	for key, weight in weights do
		if weight > 0 then
			last = key
			roll -= weight
			if roll < 0 then
				return key
			end
		end
	end
	return last -- float rounding fallback
end

return TableUtil

-- Economy is the money: the one-second income tick, buying brainrots off the
-- conveyor, buying more base slots, and the snapshot the client draws its HUD
-- from. The server is the only writer of cash; the client only asks.

local GameConfig = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").GameConfig)
local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").BrainrotData)

local GameState = require(script.Parent.GameState)
local BaseManager = require(script.Parent.BaseManager)
local Remotes = require(script.Parent.Remotes)

local Economy = {}

function Economy.notify(player, message)
	local event = Remotes.Notify
	if event then
		event:FireClient(player, message)
	end
end

function Economy.setupLeaderstats(player, state)
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	stats.Parent = player
	local cash = Instance.new("IntValue")
	cash.Name = "Cash"
	cash.Value = state.cash
	cash.Parent = stats
	state.cashValue = cash
end

-- Every second, each brainrot on a base pays its owner.
function Economy.startIncomeLoop()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			for _, state in pairs(GameState.players) do
				local income = GameState.computeIncome(state)
				if income > 0 then
					state.cash += income
					if state.cashValue then
						state.cashValue.Value = state.cash
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Refreshes the floating label once a brainrot lands on a base.
local function refreshLabel(record)
	local label = record.model:FindFirstChild("Label", true)
	if not label then
		return
	end
	local money = label:FindFirstChild("Money")
	if money then
		money.Text = "$" .. record.income .. "/s"
	end
end

-- Clicks a brainrot on the conveyor: pay its price, walk it to a free slot.
function Economy.buyBrainrot(player, uid)
	local record = GameState.brainrots[uid]
	local state = GameState.getPlayer(player.UserId)
	if not record or record.location ~= "conveyor" or not state then
		return
	end
	if state.cash < record.cost then
		Economy.notify(player, "Not enough cash for " .. record.character.name .. " ($" .. record.cost .. ")")
		return
	end
	if GameState.findFreeSlot(state) == nil then
		Economy.notify(player, "Your base is full! Buy another slot first.")
		return
	end
	state.cash -= record.cost
	if state.cashValue then
		state.cashValue.Value = state.cash
	end
	GameState.conveyor[uid] = nil
	record.income = GameState.incomeOf(state, record.character, record.mutation)
	local slot = BaseManager.placeOnBase(state, record)
	if not slot then
		state.cash += record.cost
		return
	end
	refreshLabel(record)
	Economy.notify(player, "Bought " .. record.character.name .. " for $" .. record.cost .. "!")
end

-- Buys one more base slot, up to the cap, at the escalating price.
function Economy.buySlot(player)
	local state = GameState.getPlayer(player.UserId)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if state.slotsOwned >= GameConfig.MAX_SLOTS then
		Economy.notify(player, "Your base already has the maximum slots.")
		return
	end
	local cost = GameState.nextSlotCost(state)
	if not cost then
		return
	end
	if state.cash < cost then
		Economy.notify(player, "A new slot costs $" .. cost .. ".")
		return
	end
	state.cash -= cost
	if state.cashValue then
		state.cashValue.Value = state.cash
	end
	state.slotsOwned += 1
	Economy.notify(player, "Base slot bought! You now have " .. state.slotsOwned .. " slots.")
end

-- Everything the HUD needs, in one table, once per broadcast.
function Economy.buildSnapshot(state)
	local waveSeconds = 0
	if GameState.wave.active then
		waveSeconds = -1
	elseif GameState.wave.nextAt then
		waveSeconds = math.max(0, GameState.wave.nextAt - os.time())
	end
	return {
		cash = state.cash,
		incomePerSecond = GameState.computeIncome(state),
		brainrotsOwned = GameState.usedSlots(state),
		rebirths = state.rebirths,
		multiplier = state.multiplier,
		slotsOwned = state.slotsOwned,
		slotsUsed = GameState.usedSlots(state),
		lockRemaining = GameState.lockRemaining(state),
		lockCooldownRemaining = GameState.lockCooldownRemaining(state),
		stealCooldownRemaining = GameState.stealCooldownRemaining(state),
		rebirthCost = BrainrotData.rebirthCost(state.rebirths),
		nextSlotCost = GameState.nextSlotCost(state),
		waveSecondsLeft = waveSeconds,
		waveActive = GameState.wave.active,
		topPlayers = GameState.topPlayers,
	}
end

return Economy

--!strict
--[[
	Timing
	debounce: run only after calls stop for `seconds` (e.g. search box, autosave).
	throttle: run at most once every `seconds` (e.g. ability cooldowns, remote spam).
	cooldown: per-key throttle, e.g. one cooldown per player.

	local save = Timing.debounce(saveData, 2)
	local shoot = Timing.throttle(fireGun, 0.25)
	local canUse = Timing.cooldown(5)
	if canUse(player) then ... end
]]

local Timing = {}

-- Swappable clock so tests can control time.
Timing.clock = os.clock

function Timing.debounce(fn: (...any) -> (), seconds: number): (...any) -> ()
	local pending: thread? = nil
	return function(...)
		if pending then
			pcall(task.cancel, pending)
		end
		local args = table.pack(...)
		pending = task.delay(seconds, function()
			pending = nil
			fn(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
		end)
	end
end

function Timing.throttle(fn: (...any) -> (), seconds: number): (...any) -> boolean
	local lastRun = -math.huge
	return function(...)
		local now = Timing.clock()
		if now - lastRun < seconds then
			return false
		end
		lastRun = now
		fn(...)
		return true
	end
end

-- Returns a checker: canUse(key) -> true (and starts the cooldown) or false.
-- Keys are held weakly, so players leaving don't leak memory.
function Timing.cooldown(seconds: number): (key: any) -> boolean
	local lastUsed = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: { [any]: number }
	return function(key: any): boolean
		local now = Timing.clock()
		local last = lastUsed[key]
		if last and now - last < seconds then
			return false
		end
		lastUsed[key] = now
		return true
	end
end

return Timing

-- GameState keeps every number the game runs on in one place: each player's
-- cash, brainrots, slots, locks and cooldowns, the conveyor, the bases and the
-- wave. Server systems read and write it; nothing else holds game state.

local GameConfig = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").GameConfig)
local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").BrainrotData)

local GameState = {}

-- [userId] -> player state
GameState.players = {}
-- [uid] -> every brainrot alive: { uid, character, mutation, income, cost, model,
--   location ("conveyor" | "base" | "wave"), owner (userId or nil), slot, baseIndex }
GameState.brainrots = {}
-- [uid] -> conveyor brainrot (same records as GameState.brainrots, for the cap)
GameState.conveyor = {}
-- [baseIndex] -> { owner (userId or nil), center (CFrame), slots = { [slot] = uid or nil } }
GameState.bases = {}
-- The tide wave: nextAt (os.time), active (bool), warned (bool).
GameState.wave = { nextAt = os.time() + GameConfig.WAVE_INTERVAL, active = false, warned = false }
-- Top players by cash, refreshed by the leaderboard: { { name, cash } }
GameState.topPlayers = {}
GameState.nextUid = 1

function GameState.nextBrainrotUid()
	local uid = GameState.nextUid
	GameState.nextUid += 1
	return uid
end

function GameState.multiplierOf(rebirths)
	return 1 + rebirths * GameConfig.REBIRTH_MULTIPLIER_STEP
end

function GameState.newPlayerState(player)
	return {
		player = player,
		cash = GameConfig.START_CASH,
		rebirths = 0,
		multiplier = 1,
		slotsOwned = GameConfig.START_SLOTS,
		-- [slotIndex] -> owned brainrot { uid, characterId, mutationName, income, model }
		owned = {},
		baseIndex = nil,
		lockUntil = 0,
		lockCooldownUntil = 0,
		stealCooldownUntil = 0,
		purchaseLocks = {}, -- [uid] -> os.time until which it cannot be stolen
	}
end

function GameState.getPlayer(userId)
	return GameState.players[userId]
end

function GameState.usedSlots(state)
	local count = 0
	for _ in pairs(state.owned) do
		count += 1
	end
	return count
end

function GameState.findFreeSlot(state)
	for slot = 1, state.slotsOwned do
		if state.owned[slot] == nil then
			return slot
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- A brainrot's income at the player's current rebirth multiplier.
function GameState.incomeOf(state, character, mutation)
	return BrainrotData.incomeOf(character, mutation, state.multiplier)
end

function GameState.computeIncome(state)
	local total = 0
	for _, owned in pairs(state.owned) do
		total += owned.income
	end
	return total
end

function GameState.nextSlotCost(state)
	local index = state.slotsOwned - GameConfig.START_SLOTS + 1
	return GameConfig.SLOT_COSTS[index]
end

function GameState.isBaseLocked(state)
	return os.time() < state.lockUntil
end

function GameState.lockRemaining(state)
	return math.max(0, state.lockUntil - os.time())
end

function GameState.stealCooldownRemaining(state)
	return math.max(0, state.stealCooldownUntil - os.time())
end

function GameState.lockCooldownRemaining(state)
	return math.max(0, state.lockCooldownUntil - os.time())
end

return GameState

-- Leaderboard ranks every player by cash for the HUD's top five, and pushes
-- each player their own snapshot (cash, income, locks, wave timer) twice a
-- second, so the HUD is always the server's truth, never a client guess.

local GameState = require(script.Parent.GameState)
local Economy = require(script.Parent.Economy)
local Remotes = require(script.Parent.Remotes)

local Leaderboard = {}

-- Sorts every online player by cash and keeps the richest five.
function Leaderboard.refreshTop()
	local ranked = {}
	for _, state in pairs(GameState.players) do
		table.insert(ranked, { name = state.player.DisplayName, cash = state.cash })
	end
	table.sort(ranked, function(a, b)
		return a.cash > b.cash
	end)
	local top = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(5, #ranked) do
		top[i] = ranked[i]
	end
	GameState.topPlayers = top
end

-- Sends every player their snapshot, and the top five with it.
function Leaderboard.broadcastStates()
	Leaderboard.refreshTop()
	local event = Remotes.StateUpdate
	if not event then
		return
	end
	for _, state in pairs(GameState.players) do
		event:FireClient(state.player, Economy.buildSnapshot(state))
	end
end

function Leaderboard.startLoop()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(2)
			Leaderboard.broadcastStates()
		end
	end)
end

return Leaderboard

-- RebirthSystem trades everything for power: pay the rebirth price, lose your
-- cash and every brainrot on your base, and gain a permanent +50% income
-- multiplier plus a Garuda Emas that only reborn players own.

local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").BrainrotData)
local BrainrotBuilder = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").BrainrotBuilder)

local GameState = require(script.Parent.GameState)
local BaseManager = require(script.Parent.BaseManager)
local Economy = require(script.Parent.Economy)

local RebirthSystem = {}

-- Rebirths the player: reset, multiply, and grant the exclusive Garuda Emas.
function RebirthSystem.tryRebirth(player)
	local state = GameState.getPlayer(player.UserId)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local cost = BrainrotData.rebirthCost(state.rebirths)
	if state.cash < cost then
		Economy.notify(player, "Rebirth costs $" .. cost .. ". You have $" .. state.cash .. ".")
		return
	end
	local ownedUids = {}
	for _, record in pairs(state.owned) do
		table.insert(ownedUids, record.uid)
	end
	for _, uid in ipairs(ownedUids) do
		BaseManager.removeFromBase(uid)
	end
	state.cash = 0
	if state.cashValue then
		state.cashValue.Value = 0
	end
	state.rebirths += 1
	state.multiplier = GameState.multiplierOf(state.rebirths)
	local character = BrainrotData.REBIRTH_BRAINROT
	local mutation = BrainrotData.MUTATIONS[1]
	local uid = GameState.nextBrainrotUid()
	local income = character.income * state.rebirths
	local model = BrainrotBuilder.build(character, mutation, income, "")
	model.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local record = {
		uid = uid,
		character = character,
		mutation = mutation,
		income = income,
		cost = 0,
		model = model,
		location = "base",
		owner = player.UserId,
		slot = nil,
		baseIndex = nil,
	}
	GameState.brainrots[uid] = record
	local slot = BaseManager.placeOnBase(state, record)
	if slot then
		local label = record.model:FindFirstChild("Label", true)
		if label then
			local money = label:FindFirstChild("Money")
			if money then
				money.Text = "$" .. record.income .. "/s"
			end
		end
	end
	Economy.notify(player, "REBIRTH " .. state.rebirths .. "! Income x" .. state.multiplier .. " and a Garuda Emas is yours!")
end

return RebirthSystem

--!strict
--!native
--!optimize 2

const async = require("./types")
const graph = require("../core_graph/types")
const logging = require("../core_logging/types")
const memory = require("../core_memory/types")
const state = require("../core_state/types")

const ExternalScheduler = require("../core_external/ExternalScheduler")
const cancel_task = ExternalScheduler.cancel_task
const schedule_task_immediate = ExternalScheduler.schedule_task_immediate

const ExternalLogger = require("../core_external/ExternalLogger")
const log_error_nonfatal = ExternalLogger.log_error_nonfatal

const cast_to_state = require("../core_state/cast_to_state")
const change = require("../core_graph/change")
const cleanup = require("../core_memory/cleanup")
const depend = require("../core_graph/depend")
const derive_scope = require("../core_memory/derive_scope")
const evaluate = require("../core_graph/evaluate")
const is_similar = require("../core_state/is_similar")
const node_destructor = require("../core_graph/node_destructor")
const parse_error = require("../core_logging/parse_error")
const peek = require("../core_state/peek")

type Self<T, S> = async.Eventual<T> & {
	processor: async.EventualProcessor<S, T>,
	become: (T) -> T,
	use: state.Use,

	prev_value: T?,
	is_becoming: boolean,

	session_thread: thread?,
	session_scope: memory.Scope<S>?,
	session_used: { [graph.GraphNode]: true },
}

const function run_eventual_computation(eventual: Self<any, any>)
	if eventual.scope == nil then
		return
	end

	eventual.session_thread = coroutine.running()

	const session_scope = derive_scope(eventual.scope)

	const ok, err: logging.Error =
		xpcall(eventual.processor :: any, parse_error, eventual.use, session_scope, eventual.become)

	if ok then -- adopt computation scope, clean up old one
		cleanup(eventual.session_scope)
		eventual.session_scope = session_scope
	else -- throw away computation scope, invalidated because computation errored
		cleanup(session_scope)
		log_error_nonfatal(state.callback_error, err)
	end

	eventual.session_thread = nil
end

const function generate_eventual_callbacks<T, S>(eventual: Self<T, S>): (state.Use, (T) -> T)
	const session_used = eventual.session_used

	const function use(target: state.UsedAs<any>) -- using any to silence the nonsensical type error
		if cast_to_state(target) ~= nil then
			depend(eventual, target)

			session_used[target] = true
		end

		return peek(target)
	end

	const function become(new_value: T): T
		const prev_value = eventual.cached_value

		eventual.prev_value = prev_value
		eventual.cached_value = new_value

		if eventual.validity == "busy" then
			return new_value
		end

		eventual.is_becoming = true -- gross flag but it works

		change(eventual)

		for target in session_used do
			depend(eventual, target)
		end

		return new_value
	end

	return use, become
end

const function destroy_eventual<T, S>(eventual: Self<T, S>)
	if eventual.session_thread ~= nil then
		cancel_task(eventual.session_thread)
	end

	cleanup(eventual.session_scope)
	eventual.session_scope = nil

	table.clear(eventual.session_used)
end

const CLASS_MT = table.freeze({
	__index = table.freeze({
		type = "state",
		kind = "Eventual",
		timeliness = "eager",

		is_pending = function<T, S>(self: Self<T, S>): boolean
			return self.session_thread ~= nil
		end,
		evaluate = function<T, S>(self: Self<T, S>): boolean
			if self.scope == nil then
				return false
			end

			-- calling `become` causes the Eventual to be reevaluated, but we don't want to completely reevaluate everything
			if self.is_becoming then
				self.is_becoming = false

				return not is_similar(self.prev_value, self.cached_value)
			end

			if self.session_thread ~= nil then
				cancel_task(self.session_thread)
				self.session_thread = nil
			end

			table.clear(self.session_used)

			-- self.cached_value = nil
			self.prev_value = nil

			schedule_task_immediate(run_eventual_computation, self)

			return not is_similar(self.prev_value, self.cached_value)
		end,
	}),
})

const function Eventual<T, S>(scope: memory.Scope<S>, processor: async.EventualProcessor<S, T>): async.Eventual<T>
	const new_eventual: Self<T, S> = setmetatable({
		scope = scope,
		created_at = os.clock(),
		validity = "valid",
		using = {},
		users = {},
		cached_value = nil,

		processor = processor,
		prev_value = nil,
		is_becoming = false,
		session_scope = nil,
		session_thread = nil,
		session_used = {},
	}, CLASS_MT) :: any

	new_eventual.use, new_eventual.become = generate_eventual_callbacks(new_eventual)

	const oldest_task = node_destructor(new_eventual, destroy_eventual)
	new_eventual.oldest_task = oldest_task
	table.insert(scope, oldest_task)

	evaluate(new_eventual, true)

	return new_eventual
end

return Eventual

	folder = Instance.new("Folder")

end

local Remotes = {}
for _, event in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
	if event:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		Remotes[event.Name] = event
	end
end

return Remotes

--!strict
--!native
--!optimize 2

const async = require("./types")
const graph = require("../core_graph/types")
const memory = require("../core_memory/types")

const ExternalLogger = require("../core_external/ExternalLogger")
const log_error = ExternalLogger.log_error

const cast_to_graph = require("../core_graph/cast_to_graph")
const observe = require("../core_graph/observe")

--- Pauses the current thread until the subject receives an eager update
const function await(scope: memory.Scope, subject: graph.GraphNode)
	if cast_to_graph(subject) == nil then
		-- i believe this should error, because if we didn't it would infitely yield a thread
		-- or cause loops that depend on it to spiral out of control
		log_error(async.invalid_await_type, nil, { type = typeof(subject) })
	end

	const current = coroutine.running()

	local disconnect
	disconnect = observe(scope, subject, function()
		coroutine.resume(current)

		if disconnect then
			disconnect()
		end
	end)

	coroutine.yield()
end

return await

-- BRAINROT RUSH client: HUD, overlays, WASD + Space input, camera, feedback.
-- Reads state broadcast by the server via the UpdateState RemoteEvent.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared").Config)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Grab the server's remote folder.
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local updateEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("UpdateState")
local waveEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("WaveEvent")
local buyEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("BuyResult")
local sellEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("SellResult")
local lockEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("LockResult")
local stealEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("StealResult")

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Input: WASD + Space (read key state so Roblox's camera scripts don't eat it).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local MOVE_SPEED = 22
local JUMP_SPEED = 22
local GRAVITY = 40
local velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
local grounded = true

-- Move the local player's character block.
local function applyMovement(dt)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end

	local move = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move += Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move += Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move += Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move += Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end

	local pos = root.Position
	if move.Magnitude > 0 then
		move = move.Unit * MOVE_SPEED * dt
		pos += move
	end

	-- Jump: launch up when on the ground and Space pressed.
	if grounded and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
		velocity = Vector3.new(0, JUMP_SPEED, 0)
		grounded = false
	end
	-- Apply gravity.
	velocity = Vector3.new(0, velocity.Y - GRAVITY * dt, 0)
	pos += Vector3.new(0, velocity.Y * dt, 0)

	-- Keep above the floor (floor top at Y = 1; keep the character just above).
	if pos.Y < 3 then
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, 3, pos.Z)
		velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		grounded = true
	end

	root.Position = pos
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	applyMovement(dt)
	-- Follow the character with the camera.
	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 16), root.Position)
		end
	end
end)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HUD: coins, $/s, rebirth, wave timer, lock, next-tier hint. Top-left corner.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Hud"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 10
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function makeLabel(parent, name, pos, size, text, color, fontSize)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name = name
	l.Position = pos
	l.Size = size
	l.Text = text
	l.TextColor3 = color
	l.TextSize = fontSize
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	l.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

local coinsLabel = makeLabel(gui, "Coins", UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.02), UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.05),
	"$0", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60), 26)
local rateLabel = makeLabel(gui, "Rate", UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.075), UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.04),
	"$0/s", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120), 18)
local rebirthLabel = makeLabel(gui, "Rebirths", UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.12), UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.04),
	"Rebirths: 0 (x1)", Color3.fromRGB(150, 180, 255), 16)
local waveLabel = makeLabel(gui, "Wave", UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.165), UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.04),
	"Wave in 90s", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 160), 16)
local lockLabel = makeLabel(gui, "Lock", UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.21), UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.04),
	"Base lock: READY (click B)", Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220), 14)
local hintLabel = makeLabel(gui, "Hint", UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.255), UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.05),
	"Next: save $30", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 14)

-- State: keep the HUD in sync with the server broadcasts.
local state = {
	coins = Config.START_COINS,
	rate = 0,
	waveTimer = Config.WAVE_INTERVAL,
	waveCount = 0,
	elapsed = 0,
	lockedUntil = 0,
}

updateEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	state.elapsed = data.elapsed
	state.waveTimer = data.waveTimer
	state.waveCount = data.waveCount
	local att = player:GetAttribute("coins")
	if att then
		state.coins = att
	end
	local attRate = player:GetAttribute("rate")
	if attRate then
		state.rate = attRate
	end
	-- Update the labels.
	coinsLabel.Text = "$" .. math.floor(state.coins)
	rateLabel.Text = "$" .. math.floor(state.rate) .. "/s"
	local reb = player:GetAttribute("rebirths") or 0
	local m = Config.REBIRTH_MULT ^ reb
	rebirthLabel.Text = "Rebirths: " .. tostring(reb) .. " (x" .. m .. ")"
	waveLabel.Text = "Wave " .. (state.waveCount + 1) .. " in " .. math.ceil(state.waveTimer) .. "s"
	-- Next tier hint.
	updateHint()
end)

-- Figure out the next affordable roster tier for the HUD hint.
local function updateHint()
	local nextDef = nil
	for _, def in ipairs(Config.ROSTER) do
		if def.cost > state.coins then
			nextDef = def
			break
		end
	end
	if nextDef then
		hintLabel.Text = "Next: " .. nextDef.name .. " — save $" .. nextDef.cost
	else
		hintLabel.Text = "All brainrots bought! Next: rebirth"
	end
end

-- Click a belt brainrot to buy it, or a placed one to sell it.
local Mouse = nil
local function raycastToThing()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local dir = (Camera.CFrame.LookVector * 60)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace:FindFirstChild("Base"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Belt"), workspace:FindFirstChild("RivalBase") }
	local result = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), dir, params)
	return result
end

-- The brainrot model parts are clickable. They carry a BrIndex attribute
-- into the server's brainrot list. Left-click = buy/sell; right-click = steal.
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	local isLeft = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
	local isRight = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
	if not (isLeft or isRight) then return end
	local result = raycastToThing()
	if not result then return end
	local hit = result.Instance
	local model = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if not model then return end
	local idx = model:GetAttribute("BrIndex")
	if idx then
		if isRight then
			stealEvent:FireServer(idx)
		else
			buyEvent:FireServer(idx)
		end
	end
end)

-- Feedback: transient status message at the bottom.
local statusLabel = makeLabel(gui, "Status", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.85), UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.06),
	"", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 18)
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
statusLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

local function say(msg)
	statusLabel.Text = msg
	task.delay(3, function()
		if statusLabel.Text == msg then
			statusLabel.Text = ""
		end
	end)
end

buyEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(ok, reason)
	if ok then
		say("Bought a brainrot!")
	elseif reason == "NoFreePad" then
		say("No free pad on your base!")
	elseif reason == "TooPoor" then
		say("Not enough coins!")
	end
end)

lockEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(ok)
	if ok then
		say("Base locked — stealers blocked for 30s!")
		lockLabel.Text = "Base lock: ACTIVE"
	else
		say("Lock on cooldown.")
	end
end)

stealEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(ok, reason)
	if ok then
		say("You stole a brainrot — carry it home!")
	elseif reason == "Locked" then
		say("That base is locked!")
	elseif reason == "AlreadyCarrying" then
		say("You are already carrying one!")
	elseif reason == "NotPlaced" then
		say("Only steal placed brainrots!")
	end
end)

-- Wave events: warning banner and penalty notice.
local warning = makeLabel(gui, "Warning", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.3), UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.1),
	"", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 60), 34)
warning.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
warning.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
warning.Visible = false

waveEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, arg)
	if kind == "warning" then
		warning.Visible = true
		warning.Text = "BRAINROT WAVE IN " .. math.ceil(arg) .. "s — GET TO YOUR BASE!"
	elseif kind == "wave" then
		say("THE BRAINROT WAVE SWEEPS THE MAP!")
		warning.Visible = false
	elseif kind == "penalty" then
		say("Caught outside your base! Lost $" .. arg)
	end
end)

-- Keyboard shortcuts: B lock, R restart, S sell the looked-at brainrot.
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then
		lockEvent:FireServer()
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
		-- Restart: respawn the character back at spawn.
		local char = player.Character
		if char then
			local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				root.Position = Config.PLAZA.spawn
			end
		end
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then
		-- Sell the brainrot currently being looked at (raycast a placed one).
		local result = raycastToThing()
		if result then
			local model = result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			if model then
				local idx = model:GetAttribute("BrIndex")
				if idx then
					sellEvent:FireServer(idx)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Start overlay: the goal + controls. Click anywhere to dismiss.

local startGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
startGui.Name = "StartOverlay"
startGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

startGui.DisplayOrder = 20

controls.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

rebirthGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

local rTitle = makeLabel(rBackdrop, "RTitle", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.35), UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.14),
	"REBIRTH READY!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 220), 40)

-- StealSystem is the threat that keeps bases honest: click a brainrot on
-- someone else's base to take it, unless their base is locked, the brainrot
-- was only just bought, you are on cooldown, or your own base is full.
-- A base lock buys twenty seconds of peace, then a long cooldown.

local GameConfig = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").GameConfig)

local GameState = require(script.Parent.GameState)
local BaseManager = require(script.Parent.BaseManager)
local Economy = require(script.Parent.Economy)

local StealSystem = {}

-- Steals a brainrot off another player's base and walks it onto the thief's.
function StealSystem.trySteal(player, uid)
	local record = GameState.brainrots[uid]
	local thief = GameState.getPlayer(player.UserId)
	if not record or record.location ~= "base" or not thief then
		return
	end
	if record.owner == player.UserId then
		Economy.notify(player, "That brainrot is already yours.")
		return
	end
	local victim = GameState.getPlayer(record.owner)
	if not victim then
		return
	end
	if GameState.isBaseLocked(victim) then
		Economy.notify(player, victim.player.DisplayName .. "'s base is locked!")
		return
	end
	local lockedUntil = victim.purchaseLocks[uid] or 0
	if os.time() < lockedUntil then
		Economy.notify(player, "That brainrot was just bought - it cannot be stolen yet.")
		return
	end
	if GameState.stealCooldownRemaining(thief) > 0 then
		Economy.notify(player, "Steal is on cooldown for " .. GameState.stealCooldownRemaining(thief) .. "s.")
		return
	end
	if GameState.findFreeSlot(thief) == nil then
		Economy.notify(player, "Your base is full! Buy another slot first.")
		return
	end
	BaseManager.liftFromBase(record)
	record.income = GameState.incomeOf(thief, record.character, record.mutation)
	local slot = BaseManager.placeOnBase(thief, record)
	if not slot then
		return
	end
	local label = record.model:FindFirstChild("Label", true)
	if label then
		local money = label:FindFirstChild("Money")
		if money then
			money.Text = "$" .. record.income .. "/s"
		end
	end
	thief.stealCooldownUntil = os.time() + GameConfig.STEAL_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
	Economy.notify(player, "You stole " .. record.character.name .. " from " .. victim.player.DisplayName .. "!")
	Economy.notify(victim.player, player.DisplayName .. " stole your " .. record.character.name .. "!")
end

-- Locks your own base against every steal for a short while.
function StealSystem.lockBase(player)
	local state = GameState.getPlayer(player.UserId)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if GameState.isBaseLocked(state) then
		Economy.notify(player, "Your base is already locked.")
		return
	end
	if GameState.lockCooldownRemaining(state) > 0 then
		Economy.notify(player, "Base lock is on cooldown for " .. GameState.lockCooldownRemaining(state) .. "s.")
		return
	end
	state.lockUntil = os.time() + GameConfig.LOCK_DURATION_SECONDS
	state.lockCooldownUntil = os.time() + GameConfig.LOCK_DURATION_SECONDS + GameConfig.LOCK_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
	Economy.notify(player, "Base locked for " .. GameConfig.LOCK_DURATION_SECONDS .. " seconds!")
end

return StealSystem

-- BrainrotService: spawn brainrots, roll mutations, move them along the belt,
-- handle buy + place on pads, and sell. One job.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local BrainrotService = {}
BrainrotService.brainrots = {} -- list of { model, def, mutation, pad, owner }
BrainrotService.beltPath = {} -- waypoints as Vector3 list

local mutationAccum = 0 -- cumulative weight table for rolling mutations

-- Precompute the cumulative weights of mutations once.
local weights = {}
for _, m in ipairs(Config.MUTATIONS) do
	weights[#weights + 1] = m.weight
end
mutationAccum = {}
local acc = 0
for i, w in ipairs(weights) do
	acc += w
	mutationAccum[i] = acc
end
BrainrotService.mutationAccum = mutationAccum

-- Pick a mutation at random using the weighted table.
function BrainrotService.rollMutation()
	local total = mutationAccum[#mutationAccum]
	local r = math.random() * total
	for i, cutoff in ipairs(mutationAccum) do
		if r <= cutoff then
			return Config.MUTATIONS[i]
		end
	end
	return Config.MUTATIONS[1]
end

-- Pick a random roster definition, weighted toward rarer as time passes.
function BrainrotService.rollRoster(elapsed)
	local rarityBias = math.clamp(elapsed / 300, 0, 1)
	-- bias toward higher rarities over time; pick from the pool.
	local pool = Config.ROSTER
	-- Simple escalating: sometimes upgrade to a rarer slot.
	local idx = math.random(#pool)
	local boost = math.floor(rarityBias * 5)
	idx = math.min(idx + boost, #pool)
	return pool[idx]
end

-- Build a simple model for one brainrot from its roster def and mutation.
-- Returns the Model root. Its colour shifts with the mutation.
function BrainrotService.buildModel(def, mutation)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = def.name

	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Anchored = false
	body.Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 3, 2.5)
	body.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	body.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	local baseColor = def.color
	if mutation.name == "GOLDEN" then
		baseColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40)
	elseif mutation.name == "RAINBOW" then
		baseColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 200)
	elseif mutation.name == "VOID" then
		baseColor = Color3.fromRGB(40, 20, 80)
	end
	body.Color = baseColor
	body.Parent = model

	-- A little "face" accent on the front.
	local eye = Instance.new("Part")
	eye.Anchored = false
	eye.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.6, 0.1)
	eye.Color = def.accent
	eye.Parent = model
	eye.CFrame = body.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.4, 0.3, 1.3)

	local eye2 = eye:Clone()
	eye2.Parent = model
	eye2.CFrame = body.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.4, 0.3, 1.3)

	-- Weld eyes to body so they follow it.
	local weld1 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld1.Part0 = body
	weld1.Part1 = eye
	weld1.Parent = model
	local weld2 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld2.Part0 = body
	weld2.Part1 = eye2
	weld2.Parent = model

	model.PrimaryPart = body
	return model
end

-- Spawn a brainrot onto the belt at the given waypoint index.
function BrainrotService.spawnBelt(def, mutation, waypoints)
	local model = BrainrotService.buildModel(def, mutation)
	model.Parent = workspace
	model.PivotTo(CFrame.new(waypoints[1]))
	local entry = {
		model = model,
		def = def,
		mutation = mutation,
		pad = nil,
		owner = nil,
		wayIndex = 1,
		t = 0,
		bought = false,
	}
	BrainrotService.brainrots[#BrainrotService.brainrots + 1] = entry
	entry.model:SetAttribute("BrIndex", #BrainrotService.brainrots)
	return entry
end

-- Advance one brainrot along the belt loop each step.
function BrainrotService.advance(entry, speed, dt)
	local wp = BrainrotService.beltPath
	if #wp < 2 then
		return
	end
	local a = wp[entry.wayIndex]
	local b = wp[entry.wayIndex % #wp + 1]
	entry.t += speed * dt
	local dist = (b - a).Magnitude
	while entry.t >= dist do
		entry.t -= dist
		entry.wayIndex = entry.wayIndex % #wp + 1
		a = wp[entry.wayIndex]
		b = wp[entry.wayIndex % #wp + 1]
		dist = (b - a).Magnitude
	end
	local frac = dist > 0 and entry.t / dist or 0
	local pos = a:Lerp(b, frac)
	entry.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
end

-- Find the first free pad position for a player's base.
function BrainrotService.findFreePad(padPositions, ownedBrainrots)
	for _, padPos in ipairs(padPositions) do
		local taken = false
		for _, br in ipairs(ownedBrainrots) do
			if br.pad == padPos then
				taken = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not taken then
			return padPos
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Place a bought brainrot onto a pad of the player's base.
function BrainrotService.placeOnPad(entry, padPos)
	entry.pad = padPos
	entry.bought = true
	entry.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(padPos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)))
end

-- Buy a brainrot off the belt: move it from belt to a pad. Returns true/false.
function BrainrotService.buy(entry, player, padPositions, ownedBrainrots, spendFn)
	if entry.bought then
		return false
	end
	local padPos = BrainrotService.findFreePad(padPositions, ownedBrainrots)
	if not padPos then
		return false, "NoFreePad"
	end
	if not spendFn(entry.def.cost) then
		return false, "TooPoor"
	end
	entry.owner = player
	BrainrotService.placeOnPad(entry, padPos)
	return true
end

-- Sell a brainrot off a pad; returns the coin value (50% of cost).
function BrainrotService.sell(entry)
	entry.model:Destroy()
	local value = math.floor(entry.def.cost * Config.SELL_RATE)
	-- remove from list
	for i, br in ipairs(BrainrotService.brainrots) do
		if br == entry then
			table.remove(BrainrotService.brainrots, i)
			break
		end
	end
	return value
end

return BrainrotService

-- WaveEvent is the hazard that sweeps the island: every couple of minutes the
-- tide rolls in from the north sea, knocks players back toward their bases,
-- and washes a rare Ikan Ombak onto the beach for whoever clicks it first.

local GameConfig = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").GameConfig)
local BrainrotData = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").BrainrotData)
local BrainrotBuilder = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared").BrainrotBuilder)

local GameState = require(script.Parent.GameState)
local BaseManager = require(script.Parent.BaseManager)
local Economy = require(script.Parent.Economy)

local WaveEvent = {}

local waveWall = nil
local waveFishUid = nil

-- A player who clicks the washed-up fish claims it, free, if they have a slot.
function WaveEvent.claimWaveBrainrot(player, uid)
	if uid ~= waveFishUid then
		return
	end
	local record = GameState.brainrots[uid]
	local state = GameState.getPlayer(player.UserId)
	if not record or record.location ~= "wave" or not state then
		return
	end
	if GameState.findFreeSlot(state) == nil then
		Economy.notify(player, "Your base is full! Buy another slot first.")
		return
	end
	GameState.brainrots[uid] = record
	waveFishUid = nil
	record.income = GameState.incomeOf(state, record.character, record.mutation)
	local slot = BaseManager.placeOnBase(state, record)
	if not slot then
		return
	end
	local label = record.model:FindFirstChild("Label", true)
	if label then
		local money = label:FindFirstChild("Money")
		if money then
			money.Text = "$" .. record.income .. "/s"
		end
	end
	Economy.notify(player, "You caught the Ikan Ombak from the wave!")
end

local function spawnWaveFish()
	local character = BrainrotData.WAVE_BRAINROT
	local mutation = BrainrotData.MUTATIONS[1]
	local uid = GameState.nextBrainrotUid()
	local model = BrainrotBuilder.build(character, mutation, character.income, "  •  FREE")
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, 1.4, 60))
	model.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local record = {
		uid = uid,
		character = character,
		mutation = mutation,
		income = character.income,
		cost = 0,
		model = model,
		location = "wave",
		owner = nil,
		slot = nil,
		baseIndex = nil,
	}
	GameState.brainrots[uid] = record
	waveFishUid = uid
	local detector = model:FindFirstChild("Clicker", true)
	if detector then
		detector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
			WaveEvent.claimWaveBrainrot(player, uid)
		end)
	end
	task.delay(45, function()
		if waveFishUid == uid and GameState.brainrots[uid] and GameState.brainrots[uid].location == "wave" then
			GameState.brainrots[uid].model:Destroy()
			GameState.brainrots[uid] = nil
			waveFishUid = nil
		end
	end)
end

-- Shoves every player near the wall back toward the south, once per pass.
local function knockPlayersBack(wallZ)
	for _, state in pairs(GameState.players) do
		local character = state.player.Character
		if character then
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local position = root.Position
				if math.abs(position.Z - wallZ) < 8 and math.abs(position.X) < 90 then
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 25, 55)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function runWave()
	GameState.wave.active = true
	for _, state in pairs(GameState.players) do
		Economy.notify(state.player, "THE TIDE WAVE IS COMING! Dash back to your base!")
	end
	waveWall = Instance.new("Part")
	waveWall.Name = "TideWave"
	waveWall.Size = Vector3.new(220, 14, 4)
	waveWall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 140, 220)
	waveWall.Material = Enum.Material.Water
	waveWall.Transparency = 0.3
	waveWall.Anchored = true
	waveWall.CanCollide = false
	waveWall.CanQuery = false
	waveWall.Position = Vector3.new(0, 7, -110)
	waveWall.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace")
	spawnWaveFish()
	local z = -110
	while z < 115 do
		z += GameConfig.WAVE_SPEED * 0.1
		waveWall.Position = Vector3.new(0, 7, z)
		knockPlayersBack(z)
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	waveWall:Destroy()
	waveWall = nil
	GameState.wave.active = false
	GameState.wave.warned = false
	GameState.wave.nextAt = os.time() + GameConfig.WAVE_INTERVAL
end

-- The wave clock: warn ten seconds out, then roll the tide across the island.
function WaveEvent.startLoop()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			local now = os.time()
			if not GameState.wave.active and not GameState.wave.warned
				and GameState.wave.nextAt - now <= GameConfig.WAVE_WARNING_SECONDS then
				GameState.wave.warned = true
				for _, state in pairs(GameState.players) do
					Economy.notify(state.player, "A tide wave is coming in 10 seconds!")
				end
			end
			if not GameState.wave.active and GameState.wave.nextAt <= now then
				runWave()
			end
		end
	end)
end

return WaveEvent

-- EconomyService: coins, $/s ticking, sell, rebirth multiplier.
-- One job: own every player's money state and the earnings tick.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local EconomyService = {}
EconomyService.data = {} -- [player] = { coins, lifetime, rebirths }

local function get(player)
	local d = EconomyService.data[player]
	if not d then
		d = { coins = Config.START_COINS, lifetime = 0, rebirths = 0 }
		EconomyService.data[player] = d
	end
	return d
end

-- Add coins; lifetime only counts coins actually earned (not spent), and
-- is used toward the rebirth threshold.
function EconomyService.add(player, amount, countsLifetime)
	local d = get(player)
	d.coins += amount
	if countsLifetime then
		d.lifetime += amount
	end
	player:SetAttribute("lifetime", d.lifetime)
	player:SetAttribute("rebirths", d.rebirths)
	return d.coins
end

function EconomyService.spend(player, amount)
	local d = get(player)
	if d.coins < amount then
		return false
	end
	d.coins -= amount
	return true
end

function EconomyService.coins(player)
	return get(player).coins
end

-- The $/s for one brainrot = roster.rate * mutation.mult * rebirth multiplier.
function EconomyService.effectiveRate(player, rosterRate, mutationMult)
	local d = get(player)
	local mult = (Config.REBIRTH_MULT ^ d.rebirths)
	return rosterRate * mutationMult * mult
end

-- Sell a brainrot back for 50% of its cost.
function EconomyService.sellValue(cost)
	return math.floor(cost * Config.SELL_RATE)
end

function EconomyService.rebirth(player)
	local d = get(player)
	if d.lifetime < Config.REBIRTH_NEED then
		return false
	end
	d.rebirths += 1
	d.lifetime = 0
	d.coins = Config.START_COINS
	return true
end

return EconomyService

--!strict

const iter_for = require("../iter_for/types")
const memory = require("../core_memory/types")
const state = require("../core_state/types")
const tweens = require("../motion_tweens/types")

export type Chain<S, T> = {
	type: "Chain",

	latent: T,

	map: <O>(Chain<S, T>, processor: (value: T, use: state.Use, scope: memory.Scope<S>) -> O) -> Chain<S, T>,
	modify: <O>(Chain<S, T>, processor: (scope: memory.Scope<S>, latent: T) -> O) -> Chain<S, T>,

	spring: (Chain<S, T>, speed: state.UsedAs<number>?, damping: state.UsedAs<number>?) -> Chain<S, T>,
	tween: (Chain<S, T>, info: state.UsedAs<tweens.TweenInfo>) -> Chain<S, T>,

	for_pairs: <IK, IV, OK, OV>(
		Chain<S, T>,
		processor: iter_for.ForPairsProcessor<S, IK, IV, OK, OV>
	) -> Chain<S, T>,
	for_values: <IK, IV, OV>(Chain<S, T>, processor: iter_for.ForValuesProcessor<S, IV, OV>) -> Chain<S, T>,
	for_keys: <IK, IV, OK>(Chain<S, T>, processor: iter_for.ForKeysProcessor<S, IK, OK>) -> Chain<S, T>,
}

export type ChainConstructor = <S, T>(scope: memory.Scope<S>, initial_value: state.UsedAs<T>) -> Chain<S, T>

return nil

-- AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER

-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

-- WorldBuilder raises the whole island at server start, from data alone: sand,
-- sea, plaza, the conveyor the brainrots walk, eight player bases, palm trees,
-- the pier and the spawn. Nothing here is hand-placed in Studio, so the place
-- file stays small and the scripts stay the source of the world.

local WorldBuilder = {}

-- The layout other systems read: conveyor waypoints, base centers and slots.
WorldBuilder.layout = nil

local function makePart(name, size, color, material, transparency)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Transparency = transparency or 0
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = true
	part.CanQuery = true
	part.CanTouch = false
	return part
end

local function place(part, position, parent)
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function buildPalm(parent, position)
	local trunk = makePart("Trunk", Vector3.new(1.2, 7, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(140, 95, 50), Enum.Material.Wood)
	trunk.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
	trunk.Parent = parent
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local angle = (i - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / 5)
		local leaf = makePart("Leaf", Vector3.new(1, 0.5, 4.5), Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 70), Enum.Material.Grass)
		leaf.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 7.2, 0))
			* CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)
			* CFrame.new(0, 0.4, 2)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-25), 0, 0)
		leaf.Parent = parent
	end
end

local function buildBase(parent, index, center)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Base" .. index
	folder.Parent = parent

	local platform = makePart("Platform", Vector3.new(26, 1, 20), Color3.fromRGB(210, 180, 140), Enum.Material.Sand)
	platform.CFrame = center
	platform.Parent = folder

	local trim = makePart("Trim", Vector3.new(26.6, 0.4, 20.6), Color3.fromRGB(90, 160, 220), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	trim.CFrame = center * CFrame.new(0, -0.4, 0)
	trim.Parent = folder

	-- A floating sign that BaseManager fills with the owner's name.
	local sign = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	sign.Name = "BaseSign"
	sign.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 32)
	sign.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)
	sign.AlwaysOnTop = true
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Owner"
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 60, 100)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	label.Text = "Base " .. index
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.Parent = sign
	local anchor = makePart("SignPost", Vector3.new(1, 5, 1), Color3.fromRGB(120, 90, 60), Enum.Material.Wood)
	anchor.CFrame = center * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, -9)
	anchor.Parent = folder
	sign.Parent = anchor

	-- Twelve slot pads in a 3 by 4 grid, facing the plaza.
	local slots = {}
	for row = 1, 4 do
		for col = 1, 3 do
			local slotIndex = (row - 1) * 3 + col
			local pad = makePart("Pad" .. slotIndex, Vector3.new(5, 0.3, 4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.6)
			local offset = CFrame.new((col - 2) * 7, 0.7, (row - 2.5) * 4.5)
			pad.CFrame = center * offset
			pad.Parent = folder
			slots[slotIndex] = pad.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)
		end
	end

	return { center = center, slots = slots, folder = folder, sign = label }
end

function WorldBuilder.build()
	local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local island = Instance.new("Folder")
	island.Name = "BrainrotBay"
	island.Parent = workspace

	-- Sand island on top of the sea.
	local sand = makePart("Sand", Vector3.new(220, 2, 220), Color3.fromRGB(240, 220, 160), Enum.Material.Sand)
	place(sand, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), island)
	local sea = makePart("Sea", Vector3.new(500, 1, 500), Color3.fromRGB(40, 140, 220), Enum.Material.Water, 0.25)
	sea.CanCollide = false -- falling off the island drops you into the bay, not onto the water
	place(sea, Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0), island)

	-- Central plaza: a round stage where the conveyor crosses.
	local plaza = makePart("Plaza", Vector3.new(0.6, 34, 34), Color3.fromRGB(200, 190, 170), Enum.Material.Concrete, 0)
	plaza.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	plaza.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0.95, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	place(plaza, Vector3.new(0, 0.95, 0), island)

	-- The conveyor walkway the brainrots stroll down, south to north.
	local path = makePart("ConveyorPath", Vector3.new(8, 0.3, 140), Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80), Enum.Material.Concrete)
	place(path, Vector3.new(0, 1.15, 0), island)
	local gateLeft = makePart("Gate", Vector3.new(1, 8, 1), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 30), Enum.Material.Neon)
	place(gateLeft, Vector3.new(-4.5, 5, 72), island)
	local gateRight = makePart("Gate", Vector3.new(1, 8, 1), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 30), Enum.Material.Neon)
	place(gateRight, Vector3.new(4.5, 5, 72), island)
	local gateTop = makePart("Gate", Vector3.new(10, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 30), Enum.Material.Neon)
	place(gateTop, Vector3.new(0, 9, 72), island)

	-- The pier runs south into the sea, past the spawn.
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local plank = makePart("PierPlank", Vector3.new(6, 0.5, 3), Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 70), Enum.Material.Wood)
		place(plank, Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 96 + i * 3.2), island)
	end

	-- Palm trees around the rim, plus rocks and bushes for depth.
	local palmSpots = {
		Vector3.new(-80, 1, -60), Vector3.new(80, 1, -60), Vector3.new(-90, 1, 10),
		Vector3.new(90, 1, 10), Vector3.new(-70, 1, 70), Vector3.new(70, 1, 70),
		Vector3.new(-40, 1, -85), Vector3.new(40, 1, -85), Vector3.new(-95, 1, -40),
		Vector3.new(95, 1, -40),
	}
	for _, spot in ipairs(palmSpots) do
		buildPalm(island, spot)
	end
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local rock = makePart("Rock", Vector3.new(3, 2, 3), Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140), Enum.Material.Slate)
		rock.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		local angle = math.rad(i * 45 + 15)
		place(rock, Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 100, 2, math.sin(angle) * 100), island)
	end

	-- Eight bases in a ring around the plaza, each facing the center.
	local bases = {}
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local angle = (i - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / 8) + math.pi / 8
		local x = math.cos(angle) * 58
		local z = math.sin(angle) * 58
		local facing = CFrame.new(x, 1.5, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, -angle + math.pi / 2 + math.pi, 0)
		bases[i] = buildBase(island, i, facing)
	end

	-- Spawn point on the plaza's south edge.
	local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	spawn.Name = "BaySpawn"
	spawn.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
	spawn.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 82)
	spawn.Anchored = true
	spawn.Neutral = true
	spawn.Duration = 0
	spawn.Parent = island

	local waypoints = {}
	for z = -68, 68, 20 do
		table.insert(waypoints, Vector3.new(0, 1.4, z))
	end

	WorldBuilder.layout = {
		waypoints = waypoints,
		bases = bases,
		spawnCFrame = CFrame.new(0, 3, 82),
	}
	return WorldBuilder.layout
end

return WorldBuilder

-- StealService: STEALING. Players can carry a rival brainrot home, but a base
-- LOCK blocks stealing for 30s (cooldown 60s), and a stolen brainrot can be
-- re-stolen. One job: honest steal + lock state.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local StealService = {}

-- Per-player lock state.
StealService.locks = {} -- [player] = { lockedUntil, cooldownUntil }
StealService.carried = {} -- [player] = brainrot entry being carried

local function lockState(player)
	local l = StealService.locks[player]
	if not l then
		l = { lockedUntil = 0, cooldownUntil = 0 }
		StealService.locks[player] = l
	end
	return l
end

function StealService.isLocked(player)
	local l = lockState(player)
	return os.clock() < l.lockedUntil
end

function StealService.lockCooldownLeft(player)
	local l = lockState(player)
	return math.max(0, l.cooldownUntil - os.clock())
end

-- Set the base lock. Only possible off cooldown. Returns true if set.
function StealService.setLock(player)
	local l = lockState(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < l.cooldownUntil then
		return false
	end
	l.lockedUntil = now + Config.LOCK_DURATION
	l.cooldownUntil = now + Config.LOCK_DURATION + Config.LOCK_COOLDOWN
	return true
end

-- Can a player steal from a locked base? The player here is the *owner* whose
-- base lock matters (the defender). Locking blocks *others* from stealing.
function StealService.canStealFrom(owner)
	return not StealService.isLocked(owner)
end

-- Start carrying a brainrot. Returns false if the player already carries one.
function StealService.pickup(player, entry)
	if StealService.carried[player] then
		return false
	end
	StealService.carried[player] = entry
	entry.owner = player -- they now own (carry) it
	return true
end

function StealService.carriedEntry(player)
	return StealService.carried[player]
end

-- Drop the carried brainrot (e.g. it is placed on home pad).
function StealService.drop(player)
	StealService.carried[player] = nil
end

return StealService

const chrono = require("./types")
const memory = require("../core_memory/types")

const ExternalScheduler = require("../core_external/ExternalScheduler")
const change = require("../core_graph/change")
const node_destructor = require("../core_graph/node_destructor")

type Self = chrono.ExternalTime

const ALL_TIMERS: { [Self]: true } = {}

const CLASS = {
	type = "state",
	kind = "ExternalTime",
	timeliness = "lazy",
	using = table.freeze({}),
	cached_value = ExternalScheduler.get_last_update(),

	enable = function(self: Self)
		ALL_TIMERS[self] = true
	end,
	disable = function(self: Self)
		ALL_TIMERS[self] = nil
	end,
	is_enabled = function(self: Self)
		return ALL_TIMERS[self] ~= nil
	end,
	evaluate = function(self: Self)
		return true
	end,
}
const CLASS_MT = table.freeze({ __index = CLASS })

ExternalScheduler.bind_to_update_step(function(now: number)
	CLASS.cached_value = now

	for timer in ALL_TIMERS do
		change(timer)
	end
end)

const function destroy_externaltime(externaltime: Self)
	ALL_TIMERS[externaltime] = nil
end

const function ExternalTime(scope: memory.Scope): chrono.ExternalTime
	const new_externaltime: Self = setmetatable({
		scope = scope,
		created_at = os.clock(),
		validity = "valid",
		users = {},
	}, CLASS_MT) :: any

	ALL_TIMERS[new_externaltime] = true

	const oldest_task = node_destructor(new_externaltime, destroy_externaltime)
	new_externaltime.oldest_task = oldest_task
	table.insert(scope, oldest_task)

	return new_externaltime
end

return ExternalTime

-- Brainrot Bay bootstrap: builds the island, wires the systems, and greets
-- every player with a base, a save and a running economy. Nothing here runs
-- before the world exists: the layout is built first, then the loops start.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local GameState = require(script.GameState)
local WorldBuilder = require(script.WorldBuilder)
local BaseManager = require(script.BaseManager)
local Economy = require(script.Economy)
local StealSystem = require(script.StealSystem)
local RebirthSystem = require(script.RebirthSystem)
local BrainrotSpawner = require(script.BrainrotSpawner)
local WaveEvent = require(script.WaveEvent)
local DataStore = require(script.DataStore)
local Leaderboard = require(script.Leaderboard)
local Remotes = require(script.Remotes)

-- The island first: every system below reads WorldBuilder.layout.
WorldBuilder.build()
print("[Brainrot Bay] Island built: 8 bases, conveyor, pier and palms ready.")

-- Player joins: fresh state, a base, leaderstats, then their save if one exists.
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local state = GameState.newPlayerState(player)
	GameState.players[player.UserId] = state
	Economy.setupLeaderstats(player, state)
	BaseManager.claimBase(state)
	DataStore.loadPlayer(player, state)
	Economy.notify(player, "Welcome to Brainrot Bay! Click a brainrot on the conveyor to buy it.")
	print("[Brainrot Bay] " .. player.Name .. " joined on base " .. tostring(state.baseIndex))
end

-- Player leaves: save, then free the base and clear its brainrots.
local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	local state = GameState.getPlayer(player.UserId)
	if state then
		DataStore.savePlayer(player, state)
		BaseManager.releaseBase(state)
		GameState.players[player.UserId] = nil
	end
	print("[Brainrot Bay] " .. player.Name .. " left.")
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

-- Client buttons talk back through these three remotes; the server validates all.
Remotes.LockBase.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	StealSystem.lockBase(player)
end)
Remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	RebirthSystem.tryRebirth(player)
end)
Remotes.BuySlot.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	Economy.buySlot(player)
end)

-- The game's heartbeat: income, conveyor, waves, saves and the HUD feed.
Economy.startIncomeLoop()
BrainrotSpawner.startLoop()
WaveEvent.startLoop()
DataStore.startAutosave()
Leaderboard.startLoop()
print("[Brainrot Bay] All systems running. Good luck out there!")

-- WaveService: THE BRAINROT WAVE. Tracks the timer, warns 10s ahead,
-- sweeps the map, and takes 25% of coins from anyone outside the safe zone.

local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local WaveService = {}
WaveService.events = {} -- { onWarning, onWaveStart, onWaveEnd }

local state = {
	timeToWave = Config.WAVE_INTERVAL,
	waveCount = 0,
	active = false,
}

function WaveService.timer()
	return state.timeToWave
end

function WaveService.count()
	return state.waveCount
end

-- Player is safe if their torso is inside the base safe box.
local function inSafeZone(pos)
	local pl = Config.PLAZA
	local safe = pl.base.safe
	local center = pl.base.position + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
	local half = safe.size / 2
	local d = (pos - center)
	return math.abs(d.X) <= half.X and math.abs(d.Z) <= half.Z and pos.Y > -5
end

-- Each tick. dt seconds pass; returns events fired for the client.
function WaveService.step(dt, players, applyPenalty)
	if state.active then
		return "none"
	end
	local before = state.timeToWave
	state.timeToWave -= dt
	-- Fire warning when we cross into the warning window.
	if before > Config.WAVE_WARNING and state.timeToWave <= Config.WAVE_WARNING then
		return "warning"
	end
	if state.timeToWave <= 0 then
		WaveService.triggerWave(players, applyPenalty)
		return "wave"
	end
	return "none"
end

function WaveService.triggerWave(players, applyPenalty)
	state.waveCount += 1
	-- Determine the next interval (waves speed up each cycle).
	local interval = math.max(
		Config.WAVE_MIN_INTERVAL,
		Config.WAVE_INTERVAL - (state.waveCount - 1) * Config.WAVE_SHRINK
	)
	-- Apply the coin penalty to any player caught outside the safe zone.
	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local char = player.Character
		if char then
			local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root and not inSafeZone(root.Position) then
				applyPenalty(player)
			end
		end
	end
	state.timeToWave = interval
	state.active = true
end

-- The wave is a transient "sweep" that ends after a short moment.
function WaveService.endSweep()
	state.active = false
end

return WaveService

--!strict
--!native
--!optimize 2

const chrono = require("./types")
const memory = require("../core_memory/types")

const ExternalTime = require("./ExternalTime")
const change = require("../core_graph/change")
const depend = require("../core_graph/depend")
const node_destructor = require("../core_graph/node_destructor")
const peek = require("../core_state/peek")

type Self = {
	external_time: chrono.ExternalTime,
} & chrono.Timer

const CLASS_MT = table.freeze({
	__index = table.freeze({
		type = "state",
		kind = "Timer",
		timeliness = "lazy",

		unpause = function(self: Self)
			if not self.is_paused then
				return
			end

			const external_time = self.external_time
			external_time:enable()

			self.reference_point = peek<<number>>(external_time) - self.cached_value
			self.is_paused = false

			change(self)
		end,
		pause = function(self: Self)
			if self.is_paused then
				return
			end

			self.external_time:disable()
			self.is_paused = true

			change(self)
		end,
		zero = function(self: Self)
			self.reference_point = peek<<number>>(self.external_time)
			self.cached_value = 0

			change(self)
		end,

		evaluate = function(self: Self)
			if self.is_paused then
				return false
			end

			const external_time = self.external_time

			depend(self, external_time)

			const now = peek<<number>>(external_time) :: number

			const old_value = self.cached_value
			const new_value = now - self.reference_point

			self.cached_value = new_value

			return old_value ~= new_value
		end,
	}),
})

const function Timer(scope: memory.Scope): chrono.Timer
	const externaltime = ExternalTime(scope)
	const new_timer: chrono.Timer = setmetatable({
		scope = scope,
		created_at = os.clock(),
		validity = "valid",
		using = {},
		users = {},
		cached_value = 0,

		is_paused = false,
		reference_point = peek<<number>>(externaltime),
		external_time = externaltime,
	}, CLASS_MT) :: any

	const oldest_task = node_destructor(new_timer)
	new_timer.oldest_task = oldest_task
	table.insert(scope, oldest_task)

	depend(new_timer, externaltime)

	return new_timer
end

return Timer

-- CarryPose: the arms-up pose while a player carries a brainrot.
-- When the server says a carry starts, both shoulders swing forward so
-- the character looks like it is holding something in front of it. When
-- the carry ends, the shoulders go back to how they were. Works for the
-- classic R6 rig; on any other rig it simply does nothing.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local CarryPose = {}

local carrying = false
local saved = {}

-- The raised pose for one shoulder: forward, slightly out.
local function raisedPose(side)
	local across = if side == "Left" then -1 else 1
	return CFrame.new(across, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-80), 0, math.rad(across * -12))
end

local function apply(character)
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local torso = character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	if not torso then
		return
	end
	for _, side in ipairs({ "Left", "Right" }) do
		local joint = torso:FindFirstChild(side .. " Shoulder")
		if joint and joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
			if carrying then
				if not saved[side] then
					saved[side] = joint.C0
				end
				joint.C0 = raisedPose(side)
			elseif saved[side] then
				joint.C0 = saved[side]
				saved[side] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function CarryPose.setCarrying(value)
	carrying = value
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	apply(player.Character)
end

-- A respawned character starts with normal arms; if the player is
-- still carrying, raise them again.
Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	task.wait(0.5)
	apply(character)
end)

return CarryPose
