-- WorldBuilder: builds the bright plaza from Config.PLAZA.
-- One job: turn the shared layout table into real anchored parts in Workspace.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local WorldBuilder = {}

local function part(parent, size, pos, color, name)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Locked = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Size = size
	p.Position = pos
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Name = name or "Part"
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

function WorldBuilder.build(workspace)
	local pl = Config.PLAZA

	-- Bright floor.
	part(workspace, pl.floor.size, pl.floor.position, pl.floor.color, "Floor")

	-- Conveyor belt: a raised rectangular track plus a pair of rails.
	local bw = pl.belt.width
	local bt = pl.belt.height
	local beltHolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	beltHolder.Name = "Belt"
	beltHolder.Parent = workspace
	part(beltHolder, Vector3.new(132, bt, 44), Vector3.new(0, bt / 2, -30), pl.belt.color, "BeltTrack")
	-- Two rails along the belt edges.
	part(beltHolder, Vector3.new(132, 2, 1), Vector3.new(0, bt + 1, -52 + 1), pl.belt.railColor, "RailN")
	part(beltHolder, Vector3.new(132, 2, 1), Vector3.new(0, bt + 1, -8), pl.belt.railColor, "RailS")

	-- Player base: raised plot.
	local base = Instance.new("Folder")
	base.Name = "Base"
	base.Parent = workspace
	part(base, pl.base.size, pl.base.position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), pl.base.color, "BasePlot")
	-- 8 pads on top of the base.
	for i, padPos in ipairs(pl.base.pads) do
		part(base, Vector3.new(8, 1, 8), padPos + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), pl.base.padColor, "Pad" .. i)
	end

	-- Rival base (steal target).
	local rival = Instance.new("Folder")
	rival.Name = "RivalBase"
	rival.Parent = workspace
	part(rival, pl.rival.size, pl.rival.position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), pl.rival.color, "RivalPlot")
	for i, padPos in ipairs(pl.rival.pads) do
		part(rival, Vector3.new(8, 1, 8), padPos + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), pl.base.padColor, "Pad" .. i)
	end

	-- Decorative props: trees and rocks.
	for i, prop in ipairs(pl.props) do
		if prop.kind == "tree" then
			part(workspace, Vector3.new(6, 6, 2), prop.pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), prop.color, "Tree" .. i)
			part(workspace, Vector3.new(1.5, 1, 1.5), prop.pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), "Trunk" .. i)
		else
			part(workspace, Vector3.new(6, 3, 6), prop.pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), prop.color, "Rock" .. i)
		end
	end

	-- Safe-zone visual for the wave (a translucent box over the base).
	local safe = part(workspace, pl.base.safe.size, pl.base.position + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0), Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120), "SafeZone")
	safe.Transparency = 0.75
	safe.CanCollide = false
	safe.Parent = workspace

	return beltHolder
end

	remotes.RebirthRequest:FireServer()
end)

	cashLabel.Text = "Cash: $" .. tostring(cash)
	incomeLabel.Text = "+$" .. tostring(income) .. "/s"
	rebirthLabel.Text = "Rebirths: " .. tostring(rebirths)
end)

remotes.Announce.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text, kind)
	if kind == "error" then
		announceLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
	elseif kind == "warn" then
		announceLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60)
	elseif kind == "good" then
		announceLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
	else
		announceLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

	announceLabel.Text = text

	end)
end)

remotes.CarryState.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(carrying)

-- BrainrotBuilder turns a character table into a 3D model that walks the island:
-- a body, a head with eyes, one accessory, and a floating label that reads its
-- name, rarity and money-per-second. All parts are anchored; the server moves
-- the model with PivotTo, never with physics.

local BrainrotData = require(script.Parent.BrainrotData)

local BrainrotBuilder = {}

local function makePart(name, size, color, shape)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = true
	part.CanTouch = false
	return part
end

-- One small extra part that sells the character: crown, headphones, hat...
local function addAccessory(model, kind, size, trimColor)
	local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then
		return
	end
	local s = size
	if kind == "crown" then
		local crown = makePart("Crown", Vector3.new(2.2 * s, 0.7 * s, 2.2 * s), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0))
		crown.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.1 * s, 0)
		crown.Parent = model
	elseif kind == "headphones" then
		for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local ear = makePart("Ear", Vector3.new(0.5 * s, 1.2 * s, 1.2 * s), trimColor)
			ear.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(side * 1.3 * s, 0, 0)
			ear.Parent = model
		end
	elseif kind == "hat" then
		local hat = makePart("Hat", Vector3.new(2.6 * s, 0.5 * s, 2.6 * s), trimColor)
		hat.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2 * s, 0)
		hat.Parent = model
	elseif kind == "helmet" then
		local dome = makePart("Helmet", Vector3.new(2.4 * s, 1.6 * s, 2.4 * s), Color3.fromRGB(180, 220, 255), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		dome.Transparency = 0.4
		dome.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * s, 0)
		dome.Parent = model
	elseif kind == "band" then
		local band = makePart("Band", Vector3.new(2.3 * s, 0.5 * s, 2.3 * s), trimColor)
		band.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6 * s, 0)
		band.Parent = model
	elseif kind == "cup" then
		local cup = makePart("Cup", Vector3.new(0.9 * s, 1.2 * s, 0.9 * s), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
		cup.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4 * s, 0)
		cup.Parent = model
	elseif kind == "antenna" then
		local rod = makePart("Antenna", Vector3.new(0.3 * s, 1.6 * s, 0.3 * s), trimColor)
		rod.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.6 * s, 0)
		rod.Parent = model
		local tip = makePart("Tip", Vector3.new(0.7 * s, 0.7 * s, 0.7 * s), Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		tip.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5 * s, 0)
		tip.Parent = model
	elseif kind == "cone" then
		local cone = makePart("Cone", Vector3.new(1.2 * s, 1.8 * s, 1.2 * s), Color3.fromRGB(230, 180, 120))
		cone.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.6 * s, 0)
		cone.Parent = model
	elseif kind == "wings" then
		for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local wing = makePart("Wing", Vector3.new(0.3 * s, 1.6 * s, 2.4 * s), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
			wing.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(side * 1.5 * s, -0.4 * s, -0.6 * s)
			wing.Parent = model
		end
	elseif kind == "spoiler" then
		local spoiler = makePart("Spoiler", Vector3.new(2.4 * s, 0.3 * s, 1.0 * s), trimColor)
		spoiler.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4 * s, -1.6 * s)
		spoiler.Parent = model
	elseif kind == "sword" then
		local blade = makePart("Sword", Vector3.new(0.4 * s, 3.0 * s, 0.4 * s), Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230))
		blade.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(1.8 * s, 0.4 * s, 0.6 * s)
		blade.Parent = model
	end
end

-- The floating label above the character: name, rarity, $/s, and price on the conveyor.
local function addLabel(model, character, mutation, income, priceText)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "Label"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 56)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.2 + 1.2 * character.size, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.LightInfluence = 0

	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Name = "Name"
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.42)
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = character.name
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	nameLabel.TextScaled = true
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	nameLabel.Parent = gui

	local rarityLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	rarityLabel.Name = "Rarity"
	rarityLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.42)
	rarityLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.28)
	rarityLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	local rarity = BrainrotData.getRarity(character.rarity)
	rarityLabel.Text = mutation.name .. " " .. character.rarity
	rarityLabel.TextColor3 = rarity.color
	rarityLabel.TextScaled = true
	rarityLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	rarityLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	rarityLabel.Parent = gui

	local moneyLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	moneyLabel.Name = "Money"
	moneyLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.7)
	moneyLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.3)
	moneyLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	moneyLabel.Text = "$" .. income .. "/s" .. priceText
	moneyLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 140)
	moneyLabel.TextScaled = true
	moneyLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	moneyLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	moneyLabel.Parent = gui

	gui.Parent = model
end

-- Builds the model. priceText is "" on a base, "  •  $500" on the conveyor.
function BrainrotBuilder.build(character, mutation, income, priceText)
	local size = character.size
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = character.id

	local bodyColor = character.bodyColor
	if mutation.tint then
		bodyColor = mutation.tint
	end

	local body = makePart("Body", Vector3.new(2.4 * size, 2.4 * size, 2.0 * size), bodyColor)
	body.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.2 * size, 0)
	body.Parent = model

	local head = makePart("Head", Vector3.new(2.0 * size, 1.8 * size, 1.8 * size), character.trimColor, Enum.PartType.Ball)
	head.Position = Vector3.new(0, 3.2 * size, 0)
	head.Parent = model

	for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local eye = makePart("Eye", Vector3.new(0.35 * size, 0.5 * size, 0.2 * size), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20))
		eye.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(side * 0.45 * size, 0.2 * size, 0.9 * size)
		eye.Parent = model
	end

	addAccessory(model, character.accessory, size, character.trimColor)

	local clicker = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
	clicker.Name = "Clicker"
	clicker.MaxActivationDistance = 32
	clicker.Parent = body

	-- The pivot must sit at the model's feet: PrimaryPart hijacks the pivot,
	-- so a body PrimaryPart would put the model's middle at every PivotTo
	-- target and sink the character into the floor. A tiny invisible root
	-- part at the origin keeps feet on the ground instead.
	local root = makePart("Root", Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0))
	root.Transparency = 1
	root.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	root.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	addLabel(model, character, mutation, income, priceText or "")
	return model
end

return BrainrotBuilder

--- Converts a Roblox `Color3` into a `vector`.
const function Color3_to_vector(color: Color3): vector
	return vector.create(color.R, color.G, color.B)
end

--- Converts a `vector` into a Roblox `Color3`.
const function vector_to_Color3(color_vector: vector): Color3
	color_vector = vector.clamp(color_vector, vector.zero, vector.one)
	return Color3.new(color_vector.x, color_vector.y, color_vector.z)
end

return {

	vector_to_Color3 = vector_to_Color3,
}

-- BRAINROT RUSH server: game state machine. Owns the loop, fires RemoteEvents
-- to clients, and delegates each job to its module.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local WorldBuilder = require(script.WorldBuilder)
local Economy = require(script.EconomyService)
local Brainrot = require(script.BrainrotService)
local Wave = require(script.WaveService)
local Steal = require(script.StealService)

-- RemoteEvents published to clients.
local remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
remotes.Name = "Remotes"
remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function makeRemote(name)
	local r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	r.Name = name
	r.Parent = remotes
	return r
end

local updateEvent = makeRemote("UpdateState")
local waveEvent = makeRemote("WaveEvent")
local buyEvent = makeRemote("BuyResult")
local stealEvent = makeRemote("StealResult")

-- Build the world.
WorldBuilder.build(workspace)
Brainrot.beltPath = Config.PLAZA.belt.waypoints

-- Track per-player owned brainrots.
local owned = {} -- [player] = list of brainrot entries on their pads

local function owns(player)
	local list = owned[player] or {}
	owned[player] = list
	return list
end

-- Spawn some brainrots onto the belt at start.
local elapsed = 0
for i = 1, 6 do
	local def = Brainrot.rollRoster(0)
	local mut = Brainrot.rollMutation()
	Brainrot.spawnBelt(def, mut, Config.PLAZA.belt.waypoints)
end

-- Purchase handler: buy a brainrot off the belt.
buyEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, index)
	local entry = Brainrot.brainrots[index]
	if not entry or entry.bought then
		return
	end
	local padPositions = Config.PLAZA.base.pads
	local ok, reason = Brainrot.buy(entry, player, padPositions, owns(player), function(cost)
		return Economy.spend(player, cost)
	end)
	if ok then
		local list = owns(player)
		list[#list + 1] = entry
		player:SetAttribute("coins", Economy.coins(player))
	end
	buyEvent:FireClient(player, ok, reason)
end)

-- Spawn a player with a colourful block body at the spawn point.
local function spawnCharacter(player)
	local char = Instance.new("Model")
	char.Name = "Character"
	local root = Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name = "HumanoidRootPart"
	root.Anchored = true
	root.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	root.Position = Config.PLAZA.spawn
	root.Transparency = 1
	root.Parent = char
	local head = Instance.new("Part")
	head.Name = "Head"
	head.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1.2, 2)
	head.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120)
	head.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 0)
	head.Parent = char
	player.Character = char
	return char
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	spawnCharacter(player)
	player:SetAttribute("coins", Config.START_COINS)
end)

-- STEAL + SELL handlers.
local sellEvent = makeRemote("SellResult")
local lockEvent = makeRemote("LockResult")

-- Sell: client tells us the brainrot index; we credit half its cost.
sellEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, index)
	local entry = Brainrot.brainrots[index]
	if not entry or not entry.bought or entry.owner ~= player then
		return
	end
	local list = owns(player)
	for i, br in ipairs(list) do
		if br == entry then
			table.remove(list, i)
			break
		end
	end
	local value = Brainrot.sell(entry)
	Economy.add(player, value, false)
	player:SetAttribute("coins", Economy.coins(player))
	sellEvent:FireClient(player, value)
end)

-- Lock: set the base lock to block stealing.
lockEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local ok = Steal.setLock(player)
	lockEvent:FireClient(player, ok)
end)

-- Steal: try to pick up a rival (or any) brainrot by index.
stealEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, index)
	local entry = Brainrot.brainrots[index]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	-- Can't steal a belt brainrot (unbought) — only placed ones.
	if not entry.bought then
		stealEvent:FireClient(player, false, "NotPlaced")
		return
	end
	-- Can't steal from a locked base (owner has lock active).
	if not Steal.canStealFrom(entry.owner) then
		stealEvent:FireClient(player, false, "Locked")
		return
	end
	-- Pick up: remove from owner's list, set owner to carrier.
	local ownerList = owns(entry.owner)
	for i, br in ipairs(ownerList) do
		if br == entry then
			table.remove(ownerList, i)
			break
		end
	end
	local ok = Steal.pickup(player, entry)
	stealEvent:FireClient(player, ok, ok and "Carried" or "AlreadyCarrying")
end)

-- Carry step: keep a carried brainrot glued to the carrier's character.
local function carryStep(dt)
	for player, entry in pairs(Steal.carried) do
		local char = player.Character
		if char then
			local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				entry.model:PivotTo(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 4, 0))
				-- If the carrier reaches their own base, drop it onto a pad.
				local padPositions = Config.PLAZA.base.pads
				local pad = Brainrot.findFreePad(padPositions, owns(player))
				local rootPos = root.Position
				local base = Config.PLAZA.base.position
				if pad and (rootPos - base).Magnitude < 30 then
					Brainrot.placeOnPad(entry, pad)
					Steal.drop(player)
					owns(player)[#owns(player) + 1] = entry
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- The main loop: belt moves, brainrots spawn, money ticks, waves fire.
local moneyAccum = 0

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	elapsed += dt
	carryStep(dt)

	-- Advance every unbought belt brainrot.
	local speed = Config.BELT_SPEED + Config.BELT_SPEED_GROWTH * elapsed
	for _, entry in ipairs(Brainrot.brainrots) do
		if not entry.bought and not Steal.carriedEntry(entry.owner) then
			Brainrot.advance(entry, speed, dt)
		end
	end

	-- Periodically spawn a fresh brainrot onto the belt.
	if math.random() < dt * 0.5 then
		local def = Brainrot.rollRoster(elapsed)
		local mut = Brainrot.rollMutation()
		Brainrot.spawnBelt(def, mut, Config.PLAZA.belt.waypoints)
	end

	-- Money tick: every TICK_INTERVAL, add each pad brainrot's $/s.
	moneyAccum += dt
	if moneyAccum >= Config.TICK_INTERVAL then
		moneyAccum -= Config.TICK_INTERVAL
		for player, list in pairs(owned) do
			local gain = 0
			for _, br in ipairs(list) do
				gain += Economy.effectiveRate(player, br.def.rate, br.mutation.mult)
			end
			if gain > 0 then
				Economy.add(player, gain, true)
			end
			player:SetAttribute("coins", Economy.coins(player))
			player:SetAttribute("rate", gain)
		end
	end

	-- Wave step.
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	local waveOutcome = Wave.step(dt, players, function(player)
		-- penalty: lose 25% of current coins
		local coins = Economy.coins(player)
		local lost = math.floor(coins * Config.WAVE_PENALTY)
		Economy.add(player, -lost, false)
		player:SetAttribute("coins", Economy.coins(player))
		waveEvent:FireClient(player, "penalty", lost)
	end)
	if waveOutcome == "warning" then
		for _, p in ipairs(players) do
			waveEvent:FireClient(p, "warning", Wave.timer())
		end
	elseif waveOutcome == "wave" then
		for _, p in ipairs(players) do
			waveEvent:FireClient(p, "wave", Wave.count())
		end
	end

	-- Broadcast state to all clients.
	updateEvent:FireAllClients({
		coins = 0, -- per-player, set below
		elapsed = elapsed,
		waveTimer = Wave.timer(),
		waveCount = Wave.count(),
		beltSpeed = speed,
	})
end)

-- Clean up carried state on player leave.
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	Steal.drop(player)
	owned[player] = nil
end)

-- Brainrot Bay cast: every character is invented for this game, with its own

-- Steal a Brainrot or any other commercial game.

	id = "ikan-ombak", name = "Ikan Ombak", rarity = "Epic", cost = 0, income = 800,
	bodyColor = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 255), trimColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	accessory = "wings", size = 1.3, blurb = "Rode in on the big wave.",
}

-- Every rebirth grants this exclusive brainrot, stronger each rebirth.
BrainrotData.REBIRTH_BRAINROT = {
	id = "garuda-emas", name = "Garuda Emas", rarity = "Mythic", cost = 0, income = 1500,
	bodyColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40), trimColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40),
	accessory = "wings", size = 1.6, blurb = "Born again, shinier than before.",
}

function BrainrotData.getRarity(name)
	for _, rarity in ipairs(BrainrotData.RARITIES) do
		if rarity.name == name then
			return rarity
		end
	end
	return BrainrotData.RARITIES[1]
end

function BrainrotData.getCharacter(id)
	for _, character in ipairs(BrainrotData.CHARACTERS) do
		if character.id == id then
			return character
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function BrainrotData.charactersOfRarity(name)
	local list = {}
	for _, character in ipairs(BrainrotData.CHARACTERS) do
		if character.rarity == name then
			table.insert(list, character)
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- Weighted rarity roll for the conveyor, then a random character of that rarity.
function BrainrotData.rollCharacter()
	local total = 0
	for _, rarity in ipairs(BrainrotData.RARITIES) do
		total += rarity.weight
	end
	local roll = math.random() * total
	for _, rarity in ipairs(BrainrotData.RARITIES) do
		roll -= rarity.weight
		if roll <= 0 then
			local pool = BrainrotData.charactersOfRarity(rarity.name)
			return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
		end
	end
	return BrainrotData.CHARACTERS[1]
end

-- Mutation roll: most brainrots are Normal, a few come gilded.
function BrainrotData.rollMutation()
	local roll = math.random()
	local running = 0
	for _, mutation in ipairs(BrainrotData.MUTATIONS) do
		running += mutation.chance
		if roll <= running then
			return mutation
		end
	end
	return BrainrotData.MUTATIONS[1]
end

function BrainrotData.incomeOf(character, mutation, rebirthMultiplier)
	return math.floor(character.income * mutation.multiplier * rebirthMultiplier + 0.5)
end

function BrainrotData.rebirthCost(rebirths)
	return math.floor(50000 * (rebirths + 1) * (rebirths + 1))
end

return BrainrotData

-- LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

--!strict
--!native
--!optimize 2

const OKLAB_L_COLUMN = vector.create(0.4122214708, 0.5363325363, 0.0514459929)
const OKLAB_M_COLUMN = vector.create(0.2119034982, 0.6806995451, 0.1073969566)
const OKLAB_S_COLUMN = vector.create(0.0883024619, 0.2817188376, 0.6299787005)

const function channel_srgb_to_linear(channel: number): number
	if channel < 0.04045 then
		return channel / 12.92
	end

	return ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
end

const function channel_linear_to_srgb(channel: number): number
	if channel <= 0.0031308 then
		return channel * 12.92
	end

	return (1.055 * channel ^ (1 / 2.4)) - 0.055
end

--- Maps a colour from the `sRGB` space into the `Linear RGB` space.
const function srgb_to_linear(srgb: vector): vector
	return vector.create(channel_srgb_to_linear(srgb.x), channel_srgb_to_linear(srgb.y), channel_srgb_to_linear(srgb.z))
end

--- Maps a colour from the `Linear RGB` space into the `sRGB` space.
const function linear_to_srgb(lrgb: vector): vector
	return vector.create(channel_linear_to_srgb(lrgb.x), channel_linear_to_srgb(lrgb.y), channel_linear_to_srgb(lrgb.z))
end

--- Maps a colour defined in the `Linear RGB` space into the `Oklab` space.
const function linear_to_oklab(lrgb: vector): vector
	const l_root = vector.dot(lrgb, OKLAB_L_COLUMN) ^ (1 / 3)
	const m_root = vector.dot(lrgb, OKLAB_M_COLUMN) ^ (1 / 3)
	const s_root = vector.dot(lrgb, OKLAB_S_COLUMN) ^ (1 / 3)

	return vector.create(
		l_root * 0.2104542553 + m_root * 0.7936177850 - s_root * 0.0040720468,
		l_root * 1.9779984951 - m_root * 2.4285922050 + s_root * 0.4505937099,
		l_root * 0.0259040371 + m_root * 0.7827717662 - s_root * 0.8086757660
	)
end

--- Maps a colour defined in the `Oklab` space into the `Linear RGB` space.
const function oklab_to_linear(lab: vector): vector
	const L, a, b = lab.x, lab.y, lab.z

	const root = vector.create(
		L + a * 0.3963377774 + b * 0.2158037573,
		L - a * 0.1055613458 - b * 0.0638541728,
		L - a * 0.0894841775 - b * 1.2914855480
	)

	const cubed = root * root * root

	const l = cubed.x
	const m = cubed.y
	const s = cubed.z

	return vector.create(
		l * 4.0767416621 - m * 3.3077115913 + s * 0.2309699292,
		l * -1.2684380046 + m * 2.6097574011 - s * 0.3413193965,
		l * -0.0041960863 - m * 0.7034186147 + s * 1.7076147010
	)
end

--- Maps a colour defined in the `sRGB` space into the `Oklab` space.
const function srgb_to_oklab(srgb: vector): vector
	return linear_to_oklab(srgb_to_linear(srgb))
end

--- Maps a colour defined in the `Oklab` space into the `sRGB` space.
const function oklab_to_srgb(lab: vector): vector
	return linear_to_srgb(oklab_to_linear(lab))
end

--- Interpolates between two `sRGB` colours using the `Oklab` space.
const function lerp_srgb_as_oklab(srgb_from: vector, srgb_to: vector, alpha: number, clamped: boolean): vector
	const oklab_from = srgb_to_oklab(srgb_from)
	const oklab_to = srgb_to_oklab(srgb_to)
	const oklab_result = vector.lerp(oklab_from, oklab_to, alpha)

	if not clamped then
		return oklab_to_srgb(oklab_result)
	end

	return oklab_to_srgb(vector.clamp(oklab_result, vector.zero, vector.one))
end

return {
	srgb_to_linear = srgb_to_linear,
	linear_to_srgb = linear_to_srgb,

	linear_to_oklab = linear_to_oklab,
	oklab_to_linear = oklab_to_linear,

	srgb_to_oklab = srgb_to_oklab,
	oklab_to_srgb = oklab_to_srgb,
	lerp_srgb_as_oklab = lerp_srgb_as_oklab,
}

--!strict
--!native

const context = require("./types")

const ExternalLogger = require("../core_external/ExternalLogger")
const log_error = ExternalLogger.log_error

const parse_error = require("../core_logging/parse_error")

type Self<T> = {
	default: T,
	values: { [thread]: { T } },
} & context.Contextual<T>

const CLASS_MT = table.freeze({
	__index = table.freeze({
		type = "Contextual",

		now = function<T>(self: Self<T>): T
			const current_thread = coroutine.running()
			const value = self.values[current_thread]

			if value == nil then
				return self.default
			end

			return value[1]
		end,
		execute_with = function<T, R, A...>(self: Self<T>, new: T, callback: (A...) -> R, ...: A...): R
			const thread = coroutine.running()
			const original = self.values[thread]

			self.values[thread] = { new }

			const ok, value_or_err = xpcall(callback, parse_error, ...)

			self.values[thread] = original

			if not ok then
				log_error(context.callback_error, value_or_err, { value = new })
			end

			return value_or_err
		end,
	}),
})
const WEAK_KEYS_MT = table.freeze({ __mode = "k" })

const function Contextual<T>(default: T): context.Contextual<T>
	const new_contextual: Self<T> = setmetatable({
		default = default,
		values = setmetatable({}, WEAK_KEYS_MT),
	}, CLASS_MT) :: any

	return new_contextual
end

return Contextual

-- Starting money for a brand-new player.

GameConfig.MAX_SLOTS = 12
-- Cost of the next slot, by how many the player already owns (slot 5..12).

GameConfig.MAX_ON_CONVEYOR = 8
GameConfig.WALK_SPEED = 6 -- studs per second along the conveyor

-- A brainrot bought less than this long ago cannot be stolen yet.
GameConfig.PURCHASE_LOCK_SECONDS = 30
-- After a successful steal, the thief waits this long before stealing again.
GameConfig.STEAL_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 60
-- Base lock: blocks every steal for this long, then this long a cooldown.
GameConfig.LOCK_DURATION_SECONDS = 20
GameConfig.LOCK_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 90

-- The tide wave: every 150 s, warned 10 s ahead, then it sweeps the island.
GameConfig.WAVE_INTERVAL = 150
GameConfig.WAVE_WARNING_SECONDS = 10
GameConfig.WAVE_SPEED = 18 -- studs per second across the island

-- Rebirth: cash needed grows with the rebirth count; each rebirth adds +50% income.
GameConfig.REBIRTH_BASE_COST = 50000
GameConfig.REBIRTH_MULTIPLIER_STEP = 0.5

-- Saving: autosave cadence and the DataStore name.
GameConfig.AUTOSAVE_SECONDS = 90
GameConfig.DATASTORE_NAME = "BrainrotBay_v1"

return GameConfig

--!strict

const external = require("./types")
const memory = require("../core_memory/types")

local current_debugger: external.ExternalDebugger? = nil

const function set_debugger(new_debugger: external.ExternalDebugger?)
	const old_debugger = current_debugger

	if old_debugger ~= nil then
		old_debugger.stop_debugging()
	end

	if new_debugger ~= nil then
		new_debugger.start_debugging()
	end

	current_debugger = new_debugger

	return old_debugger
end

const function track_scope(scope: memory.Scope)
	if current_debugger == nil then
		return
	end

	current_debugger.track_scope(scope)
end

const function untrack_scope(scope: memory.Scope)
	if current_debugger == nil then
		return
	end

	current_debugger.untrack_scope(scope)
end

const function begin_profile(label: string)
	if current_debugger == nil then
		return
	end

	current_debugger.begin_profile(label)
end

const function end_profile()
	if current_debugger == nil then
		return
	end

	current_debugger.end_profile()
end

return {
	set_debugger = set_debugger,

	track_scope = track_scope,
	untrack_scope = untrack_scope,

	begin_profile = begin_profile,
	end_profile = end_profile,
}

-- Menu: the character index and the rebirth panel.
-- One toggleable panel that lists every brainrot in the catalogue with
-- its rarity, price, income and caption, plus a short section on what a
-- rebirth costs and what it pays. Built once, shown and hidden on demand.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Data = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))

local Menu = {}

local frame = nil
local visible = false

local function tierColor(tier)
	if tier == "Common" then
		return Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	elseif tier == "Rare" then
		return Color3.fromRGB(90, 160, 255)
	elseif tier == "Epic" then
		return Color3.fromRGB(180, 100, 255)
	elseif tier == "Legendary" then
		return Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 40)
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 200)
end

local function build()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "BlitzMenu"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "IndexFrame"
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 460, 0, 520)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -230, 0.5, -260)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 40)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 2
	frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 220)
	frame.Visible = false
	frame.Parent = gui

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "BRAINROT INDEX"
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextScaled = true
	title.Parent = frame

	local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -110)
	list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 52)
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 6
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #Data.CHARACTERS * 62 + 90)
	list.Parent = frame

	local y = 0
	for _, entry in ipairs(Data.CHARACTERS) do
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 56)
		row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, y)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 60)
		row.BorderSizePixel = 0
		row.Parent = list

		local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 26)
		nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 2)
		nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		nameLabel.Text = entry.name .. "  (" .. entry.tier .. ")"
		nameLabel.TextColor3 = tierColor(entry.tier)
		nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		nameLabel.TextSize = 16
		nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		nameLabel.Parent = row

		local infoLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		infoLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 22)
		infoLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 30)
		infoLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		infoLabel.Text = "$" .. tostring(entry.price) .. "   $" .. tostring(entry.income) .. "/s   —  " .. entry.caption
		infoLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
		infoLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		infoLabel.TextSize = 14
		infoLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		infoLabel.Parent = row

		y += 62
	end

	local rebirthLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	rebirthLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 70)
	rebirthLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, y + 8)
	rebirthLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rebirthLabel.Text = "REBIRTH: pay $12,000 x (rebirths + 1) to multiply ALL income by 1.5x forever. Mutations: Gold (2x) and Diamond (3x) spawn rarely."
	rebirthLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)
	rebirthLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	rebirthLabel.TextSize = 14
	rebirthLabel.TextWrapped = true
	rebirthLabel.Parent = list

	local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
	close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 40)
	close.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -60, 1, -50)
	close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 60, 60)
	close.Text = "CLOSE"
	close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	close.TextScaled = true
	close.Parent = frame
	close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Menu.toggle()
	end)
end

function Menu.toggle()
	if not frame then
		build()
	end
	visible = not visible
	frame.Visible = visible
end

return Menu

const function default_log_warn(message: string, context: logging.LogContext?)

		current_log_warn = new_logger.log_warn
		current_log_error = new_logger.log_error
		current_log_error_nonfatal = new_logger.log_error_nonfatal
	else
		current_log_warn = default_log_warn
		current_log_error = default_log_error
		current_log_error_nonfatal = default_log_error_nonfatal
	end

	current_logger = new_logger

	return old_logger
end

const function log_warn(message: string, context: logging.LogContext?)
	current_log_warn(message, context)
end

const function log_error(message: string, err: logging.Error | string?, context: logging.LogContext?): never
	current_log_error(message, err, context)
	error(external.fallback_error) -- fallback error incase the external log_error did not throw like it should've
end

const function log_error_nonfatal(message: string, err: logging.Error | string?, context: logging.LogContext?)
	current_log_error_nonfatal(message, err, context)
end

return {
	set_logger = set_logger,
	log_warn = log_warn,
	log_error = log_error,
	log_error_nonfatal = log_error_nonfatal,
}

-- probe: box-scan
-- datamodel: any
-- params: cx=0 cy=10 cz=0 sx=20 sy=20 sz=20 root=workspace max=40
-- purpose: Every part whose world bounding box touches a region, INCLUDING CanQuery = false parts that
--   GetPartBoundsInBox/GetPartsInPart silently skip. Use it to prove a corridor, doorway or spawn is really clear.
local root = {{root}}
local c, half = Vector3.new({{cx}}, {{cy}}, {{cz}}), Vector3.new({{sx}}, {{sy}}, {{sz}}) / 2
local qmin, qmax = c - half, c + half
local found = {}
for _, p in root:GetDescendants() do
	if p:IsA("BasePart") and not p:IsA("Terrain") then
		local cf, h = p.CFrame, p.Size / 2
		local r, u, b = cf.RightVector, cf.UpVector, cf.LookVector
		-- world AABB of the oriented part (conservative for rotated parts)
		local e = Vector3.new(
			math.abs(r.X) * h.X + math.abs(u.X) * h.Y + math.abs(b.X) * h.Z,
			math.abs(r.Y) * h.X + math.abs(u.Y) * h.Y + math.abs(b.Y) * h.Z,
			math.abs(r.Z) * h.X + math.abs(u.Z) * h.Y + math.abs(b.Z) * h.Z)
		local pmin, pmax = cf.Position - e, cf.Position + e
		if pmin.X <= qmax.X and pmax.X >= qmin.X and pmin.Y <= qmax.Y and pmax.Y >= qmin.Y and pmin.Z <= qmax.Z and pmax.Z >= qmin.Z then
			table.insert(found, p)
		end
	end
end
local engine = #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(c), half * 2)
local out = { string.format("%d parts touch the box (engine query found %d - the difference is CanQuery=false):", #found, engine) }
for i = 1, math.min(#found, {{max}}) do
	local p = found[i]
	table.insert(out, string.format("%s  collide=%s query=%s transp=%.2f", p:GetFullName(), tostring(p.CanCollide), tostring(p.CanQuery), p.Transparency))
end
return table.concat(out, "\n")

-- Brainrot Blitz -- the carry pose.
-- While the player carries a character, both arms rise as if holding
-- something up. The pose is done by turning the shoulder joints, so it
-- works on either body type, and it restores the arms the moment the
-- player lets go.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CarryPose = {}

function CarryPose.start(player)
	local originals = {}
	local carrying = false

	-- Find the two shoulder joints of this character, whatever body type
	-- it is, and remember how they rest.
	local function shoulders()
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then
			return {}
		end
		local found = {}
		for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("Motor6D") then
				local n = desc.Name
				if n == "Left Shoulder" or n == "Right Shoulder" or n == "LeftShoulder" or n == "RightShoulder" then
					found[n] = desc
					if originals[n] == nil then
						originals[n] = desc.C0
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return found
	end

	-- Raise both arms forward and up; drop them back to rest.
	local function pose(on)
		for name, joint in pairs(shoulders()) do
			local base = originals[name]
			if not base then
				continue
			end
			if on then
				local side = (name:find("Left") and 1 or -1)
				joint.C0 = base * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-105), 0, math.rad(side * 18))
			else
				joint.C0 = base
			end
		end
	end

	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Carrying"):Connect(function()
		carrying = player:GetAttribute("Carrying") == true
		pose(carrying)
	end)

	-- Keep the pose applied: the animation system resets joints, so the
	-- pose is re-applied every frame while carrying.
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if carrying then
			pose(true)
		end
	end)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(0.5)
		originals = {}
		pose(carrying)
	end)
end

return CarryPose

-- BaseService: the six safehouses and their stands.
-- The first player to join claims the first free base. Each base holds
-- up to eight stand slots, of which the player starts with four and can
-- buy more. A stand holds one brainrot: the model sits on the slot, a
-- Sell prompt lets the owner cash it out, and a Take prompt lets anyone
-- else try to steal it (or lets the owner place a carried brainrot).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local World = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("World"))

local BaseService = {}

local ctx = nil
local owners = {}
local playerBase = {}
local standCount = {}

-- The model's Body sits this far above its base.
local PIVOT_LIFT = 1.5

-- How many stands of this base the player may use right now.
local function usableStands(player)
	return standCount[player] or ctx.data.START_STANDS
end

-- Hide the stand slots a player has not bought yet.
local function refreshStands(player)
	local baseIndex = playerBase[player]
	if not baseIndex then
		return
	end
	local allowed = usableStands(player)
	for i, slot in ipairs(ctx.world.bases[baseIndex].stands) do
		slot.pad.Transparency = if i <= allowed then 0 else 0.7
	end
end

-- Give the joining player the first base nobody owns yet.
local function assign(player)
	for i, base in ipairs(ctx.world.bases) do
		if not owners[i] then
			owners[i] = player
			playerBase[player] = i
			standCount[player] = ctx.data.START_STANDS
			local gui = base.sign:FindFirstChild("SignGui")
			if gui then
				gui.SignText.Text = player.Name .. "'s Base"
			end
			refreshStands(player)
			return i
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- The first free, usable stand slot of the player's base, or nil.
function BaseService.freeStand(player)
	local baseIndex = playerBase[player]
	if not baseIndex then
		return nil
	end
	local allowed = usableStands(player)
	for i, slot in ipairs(ctx.world.bases[baseIndex].stands) do
		if i <= allowed and not slot.occupant then
			return { baseIndex = baseIndex, slotIndex = i, slot = slot }
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Set a brainrot model onto a stand slot and record who owns it.
function BaseService.placeOnStand(player, slotRef, entry, mutation, model)
	local slot = slotRef.slot
	local surfaceY = slot.position.Y
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(slot.position.X, surfaceY + PIVOT_LIFT, slot.position.Z))
	model.Parent = workspace
	slot.occupant = { entry = entry, mutation = mutation, model = model, owner = player, baseIndex = slotRef.baseIndex, slotIndex = slotRef.slotIndex }
end

-- Sell the brainrot on one of the player's own stands for half its price.
local function sellFromStand(player, baseIndex, slotIndex)
	local base = ctx.world.bases[baseIndex]
	if not base then
		return
	end
	local slot = base.stands[slotIndex]
	if not slot or not slot.occupant then
		return
	end
	if slot.occupant.owner ~= player then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "That brainrot is not yours to sell.", "error")
		return
	end
	local entry = slot.occupant.entry
	local refund = math.floor(entry.price * ctx.data.SELL_RATE)
	slot.occupant.model:Destroy()
	slot.occupant = nil
	ctx.money.earn(player, refund)
	ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "Sold " .. entry.name .. " for $" .. tostring(refund) .. ".", "good")
end

-- Buy one more stand, if the player can afford it and has room.
local function upgrade(player)
	local baseIndex = playerBase[player]
	if not baseIndex then
		return
	end
	local current = usableStands(player)
	if current >= ctx.data.MAX_STANDS then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "Your base already has the maximum stands.", "error")
		return
	end
	local cost = ctx.data.upgradeCost(current)
	if ctx.money.getCash(player) < cost then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "Upgrade costs $" .. tostring(cost) .. ".", "error")
		return
	end
	ctx.money.spend(player, cost)
	standCount[player] = current + 1
	refreshStands(player)
	ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "Base upgraded! You now have " .. tostring(current + 1) .. " stands.", "good")
end

-- The base this player owns, or nil.
function BaseService.getBase(player)
	return playerBase[player]
end

-- The player who owns this base, or nil.
function BaseService.getOwner(baseIndex)
	return owners[baseIndex]
end

function BaseService.start(context)
	ctx = context

	-- One Sell prompt and one Take prompt on every stand disc.
	for baseIndex, base in ipairs(ctx.world.bases) do
		for slotIndex, slot in ipairs(base.stands) do
			local sellPrompt = World.makePrompt(slot.pad, "Brainrot", "Sell", 0)
			sellPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				sellFromStand(player, baseIndex, slotIndex)
			end)
			local takePrompt = World.makePrompt(slot.pad, "Brainrot", "Steal / Place", 0)
			takePrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				ctx.steal.tryTake(player, baseIndex, slotIndex)
			end)
		end
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(assign)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		assign(player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		local baseIndex = playerBase[player]
		if baseIndex then
			owners[baseIndex] = nil
		end
		playerBase[player] = nil
		standCount[player] = nil
	end)

	ctx.remotes.UpgradeRequest.OnServerEvent:Connect(upgrade)
end

return BaseService

--!strict
--!native
--!optimize 2

const external = require("./types")

const ExternalLogger = require("./ExternalLogger")
const log_error = ExternalLogger.log_error
const log_warn = ExternalLogger.log_warn

const BOUND_CALLBACKS = {}

const function default_do_task_immediate<A...>(resume: (A...) -> () | thread, ...: A...): thread
	const thread: thread = if type(resume) == "thread" then resume else coroutine.create(resume)

	coroutine.resume(thread, ...)

	if coroutine.status(thread) == "suspended" then
		log_warn(external.scheduler_missing_spawn)
	end

	return thread
end

const function default_cancel_task(task: thread): boolean
	const success = coroutine.close(task)

	return success
end

local current_scheduler: external.ExternalScheduler? = nil
local current_do_task_immediate: <A...>(resume: (A...) -> () | thread, A...) -> thread? = default_do_task_immediate
local current_do_task_deferred: (<A...>(resume: (A...) -> () | thread, A...) -> thread?)? = nil
local current_do_task_delayed: (<A...>(sec: number, resume: (A...) -> () | thread, A...) -> thread?)? = nil
local current_cancel_task: (task: thread) -> boolean = default_cancel_task

local last_update_time = os.clock()
local delta_time = 0

const function perform_update_step()
	-- should confusion keep track of its own time, or be reliant on the external scheduler's time?
	-- if the need ever arises we can change this, but for now i think its good to keep things consistent
	const now = os.clock()

	delta_time = now - last_update_time
	last_update_time = now

	for _, callback in BOUND_CALLBACKS do
		callback(now, delta_time)
	end
end

const function bind_to_update_step(callback: (now: number, dt: number) -> ()): () -> ()
	const unique_identifier = {}
	BOUND_CALLBACKS[unique_identifier] = callback

	return function()
		BOUND_CALLBACKS[unique_identifier] = nil
	end
end

const function set_scheduler(new_scheduler: external.ExternalScheduler?)
	const old_scheduler = current_scheduler

	if old_scheduler ~= nil then
		old_scheduler.stop_scheduler()
	end

	if new_scheduler ~= nil then
		new_scheduler.start_scheduler(perform_update_step)

		current_do_task_immediate = new_scheduler.schedule_task_immediate or default_do_task_immediate
		current_do_task_deferred = new_scheduler.schedule_task_deferred
		current_do_task_delayed = new_scheduler.schedule_task_delayed
		current_cancel_task = new_scheduler.cancel_task or default_cancel_task
	else
		current_do_task_immediate = default_do_task_immediate
		current_do_task_deferred = nil
		current_do_task_delayed = nil
		current_cancel_task = default_cancel_task
	end

	current_scheduler = new_scheduler

	return old_scheduler
end

const function schedule_task_immediate<A...>(resume: (A...) -> () | thread, ...: A...): thread?
	return current_do_task_immediate(resume, ...)
end

const function schedule_task_deferred<A...>(resume: (A...) -> () | thread, ...: A...): thread?
	if current_scheduler == nil then
		return log_error(external.missing_scheduler)
	end

	if current_do_task_deferred == nil then
		return log_error(external.scheduler_missing_defer)
	end

	return current_do_task_deferred(resume, ...)
end

const function schedule_task_delayed<A...>(delay_sec: number, resume: (A...) -> () | thread, ...: A...): thread?
	if current_scheduler == nil then
		return log_error(external.missing_scheduler)
	end

	if current_do_task_delayed == nil then
		return log_error(external.scheduler_missing_delay)
	end

	return current_do_task_delayed(delay_sec, resume, ...)
end

const function cancel_task(task: thread): boolean
	return current_cancel_task(task)
end

const function get_delta_time(): number
	return delta_time
end

const function get_last_update(): number
	return last_update_time
end

return {
	set_scheduler = set_scheduler,

	schedule_task_immediate = schedule_task_immediate,
	schedule_task_deferred = schedule_task_deferred,
	schedule_task_delayed = schedule_task_delayed,
	cancel_task = cancel_task,

	bind_to_update_step = bind_to_update_step,
	get_delta_time = get_delta_time,
	get_last_update = get_last_update,
}

-- carry pose so a carried character reads as held up high.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local BrainrotData = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))
local Menu = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Menu"))
local CarryPose = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CarryPose"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainrotRemotes")

local PushState = remotes:WaitForChild("PushState")
local PushWave = remotes:WaitForChild("PushWave")
local PushShield = remotes:WaitForChild("PushShield")
local OpenShop = remotes:WaitForChild("OpenShop")

-- A small helper to make a text button.
local function button(parent, name, text, pos, size)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Name = name
	b.Text = text
	b.Position = pos
	b.Size = size
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 45, 60)
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	b.TextScaled = true
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.Parent = parent
	return b
end

-- A small helper to make a text label.
local function label(parent, name, text, pos, size, color)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name = name
	l.Text = text
	l.Position = pos
	l.Size = size
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
	l.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
	l.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	l.TextScaled = true
	l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

-- The HUD.
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "BrainrotHud"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local cashLabel = label(gui, "Cash", "Cash: $150", UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), UDim2.fromOffset(220, 36))
local incomeLabel = label(gui, "Income", "Income: $0/s", UDim2.fromOffset(12, 54), UDim2.fromOffset(220, 36))
local rebirthLabel = label(gui, "Rebirths", "Rebirths: 0", UDim2.fromOffset(12, 96), UDim2.fromOffset(220, 36))
local waveLabel = label(gui, "Wave", "", UDim2.fromOffset(12, 138), UDim2.fromOffset(220, 36), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120))
waveLabel.Visible = false
local shieldLabel = label(gui, "Shield", "Shield: ready", UDim2.fromOffset(12, 180), UDim2.fromOffset(220, 36), Color3.fromRGB(140, 190, 255))

local menuButton = button(gui, "MenuButton", "Menu (M)", UDim2.new(1, -132, 0, 12), UDim2.fromOffset(120, 40))
local shieldButton = button(gui, "ShieldButton", "Shield", UDim2.new(1, -132, 0, 58), UDim2.fromOffset(120, 40))
local upgradeButton = button(gui, "UpgradeButton", "Buy Stand", UDim2.new(1, -132, 0, 104), UDim2.fromOffset(120, 40))
local placeButton = button(gui, "PlaceButton", "Place", UDim2.new(1, -132, 0, 150), UDim2.fromOffset(120, 40))
local sellButton = button(gui, "SellButton", "Sell", UDim2.new(1, -132, 0, 196), UDim2.fromOffset(120, 40))
placeButton.Visible = false
sellButton.Visible = false

-- The menu (index, rebirth, shop) lives in its own module.
local menu = Menu.build({
	Data = BrainrotData,
	Remotes = remotes,
	Player = player,
})

menuButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	menu.toggle()
end)
shieldButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	remotes:WaitForChild("ToggleShield"):FireServer()
end)
upgradeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	remotes:WaitForChild("UpgradeStand"):FireServer()
end)
placeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	remotes:WaitForChild("PlaceCarried"):FireServer()
end)
sellButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	remotes:WaitForChild("SellCarried"):FireServer()
end)

-- M opens and closes the menu.
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.M then
		menu.toggle()
	end
end)

-- Show the Place and Sell buttons only while carrying something.
local function refreshCarry()
	local carrying = player:GetAttribute("Carrying") == true
	placeButton.Visible = carrying
	sellButton.Visible = carrying
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Carrying"):Connect(refreshCarry)
refreshCarry()

-- The server's numbers, straight onto the HUD.
PushState.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(state)
	cashLabel.Text = "Cash: $" .. tostring(state.cash)
	incomeLabel.Text = "Income: $" .. tostring(state.income) .. "/s"
	rebirthLabel.Text = "Rebirths: " .. tostring(state.rebirths)
end)

-- The wave: a warning, then the sweep, then calm.
PushWave.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(info)
	if info.phase == "warn" then
		waveLabel.Text = "TSUNAMI INCOMING! EVACUATE!"
		waveLabel.Visible = true
	elseif info.phase == "sweep" then
		waveLabel.Text = "TSUNAMI! GET TO HIGH GROUND!"
		waveLabel.Visible = true
	else
		waveLabel.Visible = false
	end
end)

-- Shield news: which plot raised one, and when it is ready again.
PushShield.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(info)
	if info.active then
		shieldLabel.Text = "Shield: Plot " .. tostring(info.plot) .. " ACTIVE"
	else
		shieldLabel.Text = "Shield: Plot " .. tostring(info.plot) .. " down"
	end
end)

-- The merchant's prompt opens the shop tab of the menu.
OpenShop.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
	menu.openShop()
end)

-- The carry pose runs for the whole session.
CarryPose.start(player)

-- Bootstrap: the server entry script for Brainrot Blitz.
-- Builds the island, creates the remote events every service shares,
-- hands every service the same context table, and starts them in an
-- order that lets each one find the others already in place.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local BrainrotData = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))
local World = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("World"))
local BrainrotModels = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("BrainrotModels"))
local MoneyService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("MoneyService"))
local BaseService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("BaseService"))
local ConveyorService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("ConveyorService"))
local StealService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("StealService"))
local ShieldService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("ShieldService"))
local WaveService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("WaveService"))
local MerchantService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("MerchantService"))

-- The remote events every service and the client share.
local remotesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
remotesFolder.Name = "BlitzRemotes"
remotesFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function makeRemote(name)
	local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = name
	remote.Parent = remotesFolder
	return remote
end

local remotes = {
	UpgradeRequest = makeRemote("UpgradeRequest"),
	ShieldRequest = makeRemote("ShieldRequest"),
	RebirthRequest = makeRemote("RebirthRequest"),
	Announce = makeRemote("Announce"),
	CashChanged = makeRemote("CashChanged"),
	CarryState = makeRemote("CarryState"),
}

-- The island comes first: every service works on what it builds.
local world = World.build()

local ctx = {
	data = BrainrotData,
	world = world,
	remotes = remotes,
	models = BrainrotModels,
	money = MoneyService,
	bases = BaseService,
	conveyor = ConveyorService,
	steal = StealService,
	shield = ShieldService,
	wave = WaveService,
	merchant = MerchantService,
}

-- Money and bases first (players join into a wallet and a base),
-- then the systems that fill and threaten those bases.
MoneyService.start(ctx)
BaseService.start(ctx)
ConveyorService.start(ctx)
StealService.start(ctx)
ShieldService.start(ctx)
WaveService.start(ctx)
MerchantService.start(ctx)

-- A slow heartbeat that keeps the server's loops honest: if a service
-- ever stops, its own loop is the one to blame, not this one.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(30)
	end
end)

-- probe: camera-pin
-- datamodel: Client
-- params: px=0 py=20 pz=30 lx=0 ly=5 lz=0
-- purpose: Hold the Play camera at a fixed pose so captures are comparable (before/after a fix, hide/restore
--   bisects). Game camera scripts and execute_luau both move the camera otherwise. Run camera-free afterwards.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local pose = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new({{px}}, {{py}}, {{pz}}), Vector3.new({{lx}}, {{ly}}, {{lz}}))
pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ForgeProbeCamera") end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep("ForgeProbeCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 1, function()
	cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	cam.CFrame = pose
end)
return "camera pinned; capture with screen_capture (no camera args), then run camera-free"

const logging = require("../core_logging/types")
const memory = require("../core_memory/types")

export type ExternalScheduler = {
	start_scheduler: (step: () -> ()) -> (),
	stop_scheduler: () -> (),

	schedule_task_immediate: nil | <A...>(resume: (A...) -> () | thread, A...) -> thread,
	schedule_task_deferred: nil | <A...>(resume: (A...) -> () | thread, A...) -> thread,
	schedule_task_delayed: nil | <A...>(sec: number, resume: (A...) -> () | thread, A...) -> thread,

	start_debugging: () -> (),

-- Brainrot Blitz -- the menu: index, rebirth and shop.
-- One window with three tabs. The index ticks off every character the
-- player owns. The rebirth tab shows the price of the next rebirth and a
-- button to take it. The shop lists every character with its price and a
-- buy button. The menu starts hidden; the HUD button, the M key and the
-- merchant's prompt all open it.

local Menu = {}

function Menu.build(ctx)
	local M = {}
	local player = ctx.Player
	local remotes = ctx.Remotes
	local data = ctx.Data

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "BrainrotMenu"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.Enabled = false
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Window"
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(560, 420)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -280, 0.5, -210)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 45)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = gui

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.Text = "Brainrot Blitz"
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
	title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 70)
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)
	title.TextScaled = true
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.Parent = frame

	local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
	close.Name = "Close"
	close.Text = "X"
	close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40)
	close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 2)
	close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
	close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	close.TextScaled = true
	close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	close.Parent = frame

	-- Three tab buttons across the top.
	local tabs = {}
	local tabNames = { "Index", "Rebirth", "Shop" }
	for i, name in ipairs(tabNames) do
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
		b.Name = name .. "Tab"
		b.Text = name
		b.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -4, 0, 36)
		b.Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / 3, 2, 0, 48)
		b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 60, 80)
		b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		b.TextScaled = true
		b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		b.Parent = frame
		tabs[name] = b
	end

	-- One scrolling list per tab; only the active one shows.
	local pages = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(tabNames) do
		local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		page.Name = name .. "Page"
		page.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -100)
		page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 92)
		page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		page.ScrollBarThickness = 6
		page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		page.Visible = false
		page.Parent = frame
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
		layout.Parent = page
		pages[name] = page
	end

	local function row(parent, text, color)
		local r = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		r.Text = text
		r.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 30)
		r.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 65)
		r.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		r.TextScaled = true
		r.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		r.Parent = parent
		return r
	end

	-- The index: every character, with a tick when the player owns one.
	local function refreshIndex()
		local page = pages.Index
		for _, child in ipairs(page:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local owned = {}
		local ok, list = pcall(function()
			return remotes:WaitForChild("RequestIndex"):InvokeServer()
		end)
		if ok and list then
			for _, key in ipairs(list) do
				owned[key] = true
			end
		end
		for _, char in ipairs(data.Characters) do
			local mark = owned[char.key] and "[x] " or "[ ] "
			local color = owned[char.key] and Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 140) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			row(page, mark .. char.name .. "  (" .. char.rarity .. ", $" .. tostring(char.income) .. "/s)  " .. char.caption, color)
		end
	end

	-- The rebirth tab: the price of the next rebirth and the button.
	local rebirthCost = row(pages.Rebirth, "Rebirth: +50% income forever", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90))
	local rebirthButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	rebirthButton.Name = "RebirthButton"
	rebirthButton.Text = "Rebirth"
	rebirthButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 44)
	rebirthButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 90)
	rebirthButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	rebirthButton.TextScaled = true
	rebirthButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	rebirthButton.Parent = pages.Rebirth
	rebirthButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		remotes:WaitForChild("DoRebirth"):FireServer()
		refreshIndex()
	end)

	-- The shop: every character with its price and a buy button.
	local function refreshShop()
		local page = pages.Shop
		for _, child in ipairs(page:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("TextButton") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		for _, char in ipairs(data.Characters) do
			local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
			holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 36)
			holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			holder.Parent = page
			local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			nameLabel.Text = char.name .. "  ($" .. tostring(char.price) .. ", $" .. tostring(char.income) .. "/s)"
			nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
			nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			nameLabel.TextScaled = true
			nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			nameLabel.Parent = holder
			local buy = Instance.new("TextButton")
			buy.Text = "Buy"
			buy.Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 1, 0)
			buy.Position = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0, 0)
			buy.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 70)
			buy.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			buy.TextScaled = true
			buy.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			buy.Parent = holder
			buy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				remotes:WaitForChild("BuyMerchant"):FireServer(char.key)
			end)
		end
	end

	local current = "Index"
	local function showTab(name)
		current = name
		for tabName, page in pairs(pages) do
			page.Visible = tabName == name
		end
		if name == "Index" then
			refreshIndex()
		elseif name == "Shop" then
			refreshShop()
		elseif name == "Rebirth" then
			rebirthCost.Text = "Rebirth: +50% income forever"
		end
	end
	for name, b in pairs(tabs) do
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			showTab(name)
		end)
	end
	close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		gui.Enabled = false
	end)

	function M.toggle()
		gui.Enabled = not gui.Enabled
		if gui.Enabled then
			showTab(current)
		end
	end

	function M.openShop()
		gui.Enabled = true

end

-- BrainrotModels: builds the 3D model of one brainrot character.
-- Every model is assembled from parts at runtime: a body, a head, a
-- signature feature drawn from the character's name, and a floating
-- label with the name, the rarity and the money per second. Models face
-- minus Z and stand with their base at Y zero, so they sit cleanly on
-- the conveyor belt and on stands.

local BrainrotModels = {}

local function makePart(name, shape, size, color, position, parent)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Shape = shape
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function makeLabel(model, title, detail, color)
	local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Name = "LabelAnchor"
	anchor.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	anchor.Anchored = true
	anchor.CanCollide = false
	anchor.Position = Vector3.new(0, 5.4, 0)
	anchor.Parent = model

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "NameLabel"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 54)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = anchor

	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Name = "Title"
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.55, 0)
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = title
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	nameLabel.TextScaled = true
	nameLabel.Parent = gui

	local detailLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	detailLabel.Name = "Detail"
	detailLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.45, 0)
	detailLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.55, 0)
	detailLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	detailLabel.Text = detail
	detailLabel.TextColor3 = color
	detailLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	detailLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	detailLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	detailLabel.TextScaled = true
	detailLabel.Parent = gui
end

-- One signature feature per character, picked from what the name
-- suggests: fins for the shark, a snout for the crocodile, a peel for
-- the banana monkey, and so on. Each feature is a few extra parts.
local function addFeature(model, entry)
	local body = entry.body
	local accent = entry.accent
	local name = entry.name

	if name == "Tralalero Tralala" then
		-- Shark: a tall fin on top and a tail at the back.
		makePart("Fin", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.3, 2.2, 1.6), accent, Vector3.new(0, 4.4, 0.2), model)
		makePart("Tail", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.3, 1.6, 1.2), body, Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 1.6), model)
		makePart("Snout", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1.6, 1.0, 1.2), accent, Vector3.new(0, 2.6, -1.8), model)
	elseif name == "Bombardiro Crocodilo" then
		-- Crocodile: a long snout, a ridged back and a heavy tail.
		makePart("Snout", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1.8, 0.9, 2.4), accent, Vector3.new(0, 2.2, -1.9), model)
		makePart("Ridge", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.6, 1.0, 2.6), accent, Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0.4), model)
		makePart("Tail", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1.0, 0.8, 3.0), body, Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 2.4), model)
	elseif name == "Chimpanzini Bananini" then
		-- Banana monkey: a curved peel over the shoulders and a tail.
		makePart("Peel", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.6, 0.5, 1.4), accent, Vector3.new(0, 4.6, 0), model)
		makePart("Tail", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.4, 2.2, 0.4), accent, Vector3.new(1.2, 2.6, 1.2), model)
		makePart("EarLeft", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), body, Vector3.new(-1.5, 4.4, 0), model)
		makePart("EarRight", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), body, Vector3.new(1.5, 4.4, 0), model)
	elseif name == "Lirili Larila" then
		-- Cactus elephant: a trunk, two tusks and spines.
		makePart("Trunk", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.8, 2.4, 0.8), accent, Vector3.new(0, 2.8, -1.7), model)
		makePart("TuskLeft", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 1.4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 230), Vector3.new(-0.9, 3.2, -1.5), model)
		makePart("TuskRight", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 1.4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 230), Vector3.new(0.9, 3.2, -1.5), model)
		makePart("Spine", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.4, 1.4, 0.4), accent, Vector3.new(0, 4.8, 0.6), model)
	elseif name == "Frigo Camelo" then
		-- Fridge camel: a cold box on the back and two humps.
		makePart("Fridge", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.4, 2.0, 1.6), accent, Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0.9), model)
		makePart("HumpLeft", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.2, 1.0, 1.2), body, Vector3.new(-0.7, 4.6, 0), model)
		makePart("HumpRight", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.2, 1.0, 1.2), body, Vector3.new(0.7, 4.6, 0), model)
	elseif name == "Brr Brr Patapim" then
		-- Ice creature: crystals on the head and shoulders.
		makePart("CrystalTop", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.7, 1.6, 0.7), accent, Vector3.new(0, 5.2, 0), model)
		makePart("CrystalLeft", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.0, 0.5), accent, Vector3.new(-1.4, 4.4, 0), model)
		makePart("CrystalRight", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.0, 0.5), accent, Vector3.new(1.4, 4.4, 0), model)
	elseif name == "Ballerina Cappuccina" then
		-- Ballerina: a tutu skirt and a bun.
		makePart("Tutu", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(1.2, 3.6, 1.2), accent, Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0), model)
		makePart("Bun", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), body, Vector3.new(0, 5.4, 0.4), model)
		makePart("Sash", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.4, 0.4, 0.2), accent, Vector3.new(0, 3.4, -1.15), model)
	elseif name == "Cappuccino Assassino" then
		-- Assassin cup: a lid, a handle and a dark hood.
		makePart("Lid", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.5, 2.6, 0.5), accent, Vector3.new(0, 5.0, 0), model)
		makePart("Handle", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.2, 0.5), accent, Vector3.new(1.5, 3.2, 0), model)
		makePart("Hood", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.8, 0.8, 2.8), accent, Vector3.new(0, 5.0, 0), model)
	elseif name == "Orangutini Ananasini" then
		-- Pineapple orangutan: a leafy crown and long arms.
		makePart("LeafOne", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.4, 1.8, 0.4), accent, Vector3.new(-0.5, 5.6, 0), model)
		makePart("LeafTwo", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.4, 1.8, 0.4), accent, Vector3.new(0.5, 5.6, 0), model)
		makePart("ArmLeft", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.6, 2.6, 0.6), body, Vector3.new(-1.7, 2.6, 0), model)
		makePart("ArmRight", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.6, 2.6, 0.6), body, Vector3.new(1.7, 2.6, 0), model)
	elseif name == "La Vaca Saturno Saturnita" then
		-- Saturn cow: a ring around the body and two horns.
		makePart("Ring", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.3, 5.4, 0.3), accent, Vector3.new(0, 3.0, 0), model)
		makePart("HornLeft", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.4, 1.2, 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 230), Vector3.new(-1.2, 5.0, 0), model)
		makePart("HornRight", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.4, 1.2, 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 230), Vector3.new(1.2, 5.0, 0), model)
	elseif name == "Tung Tung Tung Sahur" then
		-- Wooden log drummer: a drum on the belly and two sticks.
		makePart("Drum", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(1.2, 1.6, 1.2), accent, Vector3.new(0, 2.6, -1.4), model)
		makePart("StickLeft", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.3, 1.6, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(220, 190, 140), Vector3.new(-1.4, 3.6, -1.2), model)
		makePart("StickRight", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.3, 1.6, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(220, 190, 140), Vector3.new(1.4, 3.6, -1.2), model)
	elseif name == "Boneca Ambalabu" then
		-- Doll: a bow on the head and a dress.
		makePart("BowLeft", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.9, 0.7, 0.3), accent, Vector3.new(-0.8, 5.2, 0), model)
		makePart("BowRight", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.9, 0.7, 0.3), accent, Vector3.new(0.8, 5.2, 0), model)
		makePart("Dress", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(1.0, 3.0, 1.0), accent, Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), model)
	elseif name == "Trippi Troppi" then
		-- Tropical fish: a tail fin and side fins.
		makePart("TailFin", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.3, 1.8, 1.4), accent, Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 1.7), model)
		makePart("FinLeft", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1.0, 0.6, 0.3), accent, Vector3.new(-1.6, 3.0, 0), model)
		makePart("FinRight", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1.0, 0.6, 0.3), accent, Vector3.new(1.6, 3.0, 0), model)
	end
end

-- Build one character model from its catalogue entry and mutation.
-- The model is anchored and ready to be placed on the belt or a stand.
function BrainrotModels.build(entry, mutation)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = entry.name

	-- Body and head, sized so every character reads at a glance.
	makePart("Body", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.6, 3.0, 1.8), entry.body, Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), model)
	makePart("Head", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.2, 2.0, 2.0), entry.body, Vector3.new(0, 4.0, 0), model)

	-- Two eyes on the front face (minus Z is the front).
	makePart("EyeLeft", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.6, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Vector3.new(-0.55, 4.2, -1.05), model)
	makePart("EyeRight", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.6, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Vector3.new(0.55, 4.2, -1.05), model)
	makePart("PupilLeft", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.25, 0.3, 0.15), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-0.55, 4.2, -1.2), model)
	makePart("PupilRight", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.25, 0.3, 0.15), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0.55, 4.2, -1.2), model)

	-- The character's own signature feature.
	addFeature(model, entry)

	-- A mutation changes the look: gold shines, diamond sparkles.
	if mutation == "Gold" then
		local glow = makePart("GoldTrim", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.8, 0.3, 2.0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60), Vector3.new(0, 3.1, 0), model)
		glow.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	elseif mutation == "Diamond" then
		local glow = makePart("DiamondTrim", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.8, 0.3, 2.0), Color3.fromRGB(150, 230, 255), Vector3.new(0, 3.1, 0), model)
		glow.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	end

	-- A small base plate so the model sits flat anywhere.
	local plate = makePart("Plate", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.4, 3.4, 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70), Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0), model)
	plate.Material = Enum.Material.Metal

	-- The readable label: name on top, rarity and income below.
	local labelColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	if mutation == "Gold" then
		labelColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60)
	elseif mutation == "Diamond" then
		labelColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 230, 255)
	end
	local detail = entry.tier
	if mutation ~= "Normal" then
		detail = mutation .. " " .. entry.tier
	end
	detail = detail .. "  $" .. tostring(entry.income) .. "/s"
	makeLabel(model, entry.name, detail, labelColor)

	model.PrimaryPart = model:FindFirstChild("Body")
	return model
end

return BrainrotModels

-- probe: capture-quality
-- datamodel: Client
-- params: level=21
-- purpose: Force the render quality for a capture, then put it back. Studio left in the background runs at about
--   15 fps; with quality on Automatic that collapses the draw distance, so distant geometry (a skyline, the far
--   wall) is missing from Play captures even though it exists. Run with level=21 before capturing and with
--   level=0 afterwards to restore the owner's setting. The reply also reports the frame rate, so a flat ~15 fps
--   tells you timings measured in this session are inflated about four times.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local level = {{level}}
local ok, message = pcall(function()
	local rendering = settings().Rendering
	if level == 0 then
		-- The saved level lives in a workspace attribute: _G is not shared between separate command sessions.
		local saved = workspace:GetAttribute("ForgeSavedQuality")
		if saved then
			rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel[saved]
			workspace:SetAttribute("ForgeSavedQuality", nil)
		end
		return (saved and "restored to " or "nothing saved, still ") .. tostring(rendering.QualityLevel)
	end
	if workspace:GetAttribute("ForgeSavedQuality") == nil then
		workspace:SetAttribute("ForgeSavedQuality", rendering.QualityLevel.Name)
	end
	rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel["Level" .. string.format("%02d", level)]
	return "quality " .. tostring(rendering.QualityLevel) .. " (was " .. tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("ForgeSavedQuality")) .. ")"
end)
local frames, t0 = 0, os.clock()
while os.clock() - t0 < 2 do
	RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
	frames += 1
end
local fps = frames / 2
local note = fps < 20 and " - Studio looks throttled (background window): boot and frame timings are not real" or ""
return (ok and message or ("could not change quality: " .. tostring(message))) .. string.format(" | %.0f fps%s", fps, note)

-- Brainrot Blitz -- the six safehouse plots and their stands.
-- This service owns the ground each player builds on: it hands a free plot
-- to each newcomer, grows their stands when they pay for an upgrade, and
-- places or removes the character models that live on those stands. It
-- never decides prices or income; it asks BrainrotData and MoneyService.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local BaseService = {}

function BaseService.start(ctx)
	local B = {}
	B.plots = {}

	-- Where the stands sit on one pad: two rows of four, so a full plot
	-- holds eight characters without crowding the walkway.
	local standOffsets = {
		{ dx = -9, dz = -8 }, { dx = -3, dz = -8 }, { dx = 3, dz = -8 }, { dx = 9, dz = -8 },
		{ dx = -9, dz = 8 }, { dx = -3, dz = 8 }, { dx = 3, dz = 8 }, { dx = 9, dz = 8 },
	}

	-- Build one plot record from its pad: the owner, the stands it starts
	-- with, and a little platform plus plaque per stand.
	local function makePlot(pad)
		local plot = {
			index = pad.index,
			x = pad.x,
			z = pad.z,
			owner = nil,
			stands = {},
			pad = pad.part,
		}
		for i = 1, ctx.Data.Economy.StartStands do
			B.addStandSlot(plot, i)
		end
		return plot
	end

	-- Add one stand slot to a plot: a platform, a plaque with its number,
	-- and an empty slot record the other services fill.
	function B.addStandSlot(plot, index)
		local off = standOffsets[index]
		if not off then
			return nil
		end
		local platform = ctx.World.makePart(
			plot.pad.Parent,
			"Stand" .. index,
			Vector3.new(5, 0.5, 5),
			Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220),
			Vector3.new(plot.x + off.dx, 0.75, plot.z + off.dz)
		)
		platform.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		local slot = {
			index = index,
			x = plot.x + off.dx,
			z = plot.z + off.dz,
			groundY = 1,
			platform = platform,
			model = nil,
		}
		plot.stands[index] = slot
		return slot
	end

	-- The plot a player owns, or nil when they have none.
	function B.getPlot(player)
		for _, plot in ipairs(B.plots) do
			if plot.owner == player then
				return plot
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- The plot by its number (one to six).
	function B.getPlotByIndex(index)
		return B.plots[index]
	end

	-- The first empty stand slot on a plot, or nil when it is full.
	function B.freeStand(plot)
		for _, slot in ipairs(plot.stands) do
			if not slot.model then
				return slot
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- Put a character model on a stand slot: parent it, stand it on the
	-- platform, and stamp who owns it and which slot it fills.
	function B.placeBrainrot(plot, slot, model)
		model.Parent = plot.pad.Parent
		local size = model:GetExtentsSize()
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(slot.x, slot.groundY + size.Y / 2, slot.z))
		model:SetAttribute("OwnerId", plot.owner and plot.owner.UserId or 0)
		model:SetAttribute("StandIndex", slot.index)
		slot.model = model
		if ctx.Steal then
			ctx.Steal.wirePrompt(model, plot, slot)
		end
		return true
	end

	-- Lift a character model off its stand and hand it back.
	function B.takeBrainrot(plot, slot)
		local model = slot.model
		slot.model = nil
		if model then
			model:SetAttribute("StandIndex", 0)
		end
		return model
	end

	-- Buy one more stand for a plot, when the player can afford it and the
	-- plot is not already at the maximum.
	function B.buyStand(player)
		local plot = B.getPlot(player)
		if not plot then
			return false, "No plot"
		end
		if #plot.stands >= ctx.Data.Economy.MaxStands then
			return false, "Max stands"
		end
		local cost = ctx.Data.upgradeCost(#plot.stands)
		if not ctx.Money.spend(player, cost) then
			return false, "Not enough cash"
		end
		B.addStandSlot(plot, #plot.stands + 1)
		return true, "Stand added"
	end

	-- A newcomer takes the first free plot; a full house means spectating.
	local function onJoin(player)
		for _, plot in ipairs(B.plots) do
			if not plot.owner then
				plot.owner = player
				ctx.World.makeSign(
					plot.pad.Parent,
					"OwnerSign" .. plot.index,
					Vector3.new(12, 3, 1),
					Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50),
					Vector3.new(plot.x, 5, plot.z - 15),
					player.DisplayName,
					Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
					180
				)
				if ctx.Money then
					ctx.Money.push(player)
				end
				return
			end
		end
	end

	-- A leaving player's characters go back to the conveyor pool: their
	-- models are removed so the next owner starts clean.
	local function onLeave(player)
		local plot = B.getPlot(player)
		if plot then
			for _, slot in ipairs(plot.stands) do
				if slot.model then
					slot.model:Destroy()
					slot.model = nil
				end
			end
			plot.owner = nil
		end
	end

	for _, pad in ipairs(ctx.World.pads) do
		table.insert(B.plots, makePlot(pad))
	end
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(onJoin, player)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onLeave)

	ctx.Remotes.UpgradeStand.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		B.buyStand(player)
	end)

	ctx.Bases = B
	return B
end

return BaseService
