--!strict
--!native
--!optimize 2

const graph = require("./types")

const ExternalScheduler = require("../core_external/ExternalScheduler")
const schedule_task_immediate = ExternalScheduler.schedule_task_immediate

const ExternalLogger = require("../core_external/ExternalLogger")
const log_error = ExternalLogger.log_error

const evaluate = require("./evaluate")

const function fire_node_observers(node: graph.GraphNode)
	if node.observers == nil then
		return
	end

	for _, callback in node.observers do
		schedule_task_immediate(callback)
	end
end

-- locally redefining this as i'd like to reap the benefits of -O2 compilation inlining
-- which isn't currently possible because of a lack of cross script compilation
const function is_eager(node: graph.GraphNode): boolean
	return node.timeliness == "eager" or (node.observers ~= nil and next(node.observers) ~= nil)
end

--[[
	Prompts a graph node to be reevaluated. If it meaningfully
	changes, then dependents will be marked invalid and will have to be
	reevaluated at a later point (or immediately if it is eager).

	https://fluff.blog/2024/04/16/monotonic-painting.html
]]
const function change(node: graph.GraphNode)
	if not evaluate(node, true) then
		return false
	end

	const eager_users: { graph.GraphNode } = {}

	local search_now: { graph.GraphNode } = { node }
	local search_next: { graph.GraphNode } = {}

	repeat
		local is_finished = true

		for _, searching: graph.GraphNode in search_now do
			for user in searching.users do
				const user_validity = user.validity

				if user_validity == "busy" then
					log_error(graph.infinite_loop)
				elseif user_validity == "valid" then
					is_finished = false

					user.validity = "invalid"

					table.insert(search_next, user)

					if is_eager(user) then
						table.insert(eager_users, user)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		search_now, search_next = search_next, search_now
		table.clear(search_next)
	until is_finished

	table.sort(eager_users, function(x: graph.GraphNode, y: graph.GraphNode)
		return x.created_at < y.created_at
	end)

	fire_node_observers(node)

	for _, user: graph.GraphNode in eager_users do
		if evaluate(user) then
			fire_node_observers(user)
		end
	end

	return true
end

return change

-- probe: console
-- datamodel: any
-- params: limit=30 include="error" since=0
-- purpose: The output log, deduplicated and counted, newest last. include = "error" (errors only), "warn" (errors
--   and warnings) or "all". since = only the last N seconds (0 = whole session) - use it right after a change so old
--   errors do not read as new. Zero NEW errors is the gate.
local LIMIT, include, since = {{limit}}, {{include}}, {{since}}
local cutoff = if since > 0 then os.time() - since else 0
local want = {
	[Enum.MessageType.MessageError] = true,
	[Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning] = include ~= "error",
	[Enum.MessageType.MessageOutput] = include == "all",
	[Enum.MessageType.MessageInfo] = include == "all",
}
local seen, order = {}, {}
for _, e in game:GetService("LogService"):GetLogHistory() do
	if want[e.messageType] and (e.timestamp or 0) >= cutoff then
		local key = e.message:gsub("%d+%.%d+", "#"):sub(1, 220)
		if not seen[key] then
			seen[key] = { n = 0, kind = e.messageType.Name:gsub("Message", ""), text = e.message:sub(1, 300) }
			table.insert(order, key)
		end
		seen[key].n += 1
	end
end
local out = { string.format("%d distinct %s message(s)%s", #order, include, if since > 0 then " in the last " .. since .. " s" else "") }
for i = math.max(1, #order - LIMIT + 1), #order do
	local s = seen[order[i]]
	table.insert(out, string.format("%-7s x%-3d %s", s.kind, s.n, s.text))
end
return table.concat(out, "\n")

-- Brainrot Blitz -- builds the 3D model of one brainrot character.
-- Every character is assembled from plain parts, so each one reads clearly
-- at a distance: a distinct silhouette, its own body color, and a floating
-- label with its name and income. The caller decides where the model goes
-- and what prompt it carries; this module only builds the look.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local BrainrotData = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))

local BrainrotModels = {}

-- One part, placed and colored, anchored so the world never knocks it over.
local function mk(parent, name, shape, size, color, pos)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Shape = shape
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Position = pos
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- A floating name plate above the model: the character's name, its income
-- per second, and the mutation when it has one.
local function label(model, text, color)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "NameLabel"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 34)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = model
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Name = "Text"
	t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	t.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
	t.TextColor3 = color
	t.TextScaled = true
	t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	t.Text = text
	t.Parent = gui
end

-- Each builder gets the model, the character row and the body color, and
-- adds the parts that make this character recognizable. All of them face
-- minus Z, sit on Y 0, and keep their bulk near the middle so the model
-- stands stably on a belt or a stand.

-- Build one character model. The mutation tints the body: gold leans warm
-- yellow, diamond leans icy cyan, and the label names the mutation so a
-- player can spot a valuable spawn from across the island.
function BrainrotModels.build(key, mutation)
	local char = BrainrotData.find(key)
	if not char then
		return nil
	end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = char.name
	local bodyColor = char.body
	if mutation == "Gold" then
		bodyColor = bodyColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60), 0.55)
	elseif mutation == "Diamond" then
		bodyColor = bodyColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255), 0.55)
	end
	local build = builders[key]
	if build then
		build(model, char, bodyColor)
	end
	local anchor = model:FindFirstChild("Body") or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	if anchor then
		model.PrimaryPart = anchor
	end
	model:SetAttribute("CharacterKey", key)
	model:SetAttribute("Mutation", mutation or "Normal")
	model:SetAttribute("Price", char.price)
	model:SetAttribute("Income", char.income)
	local rarity = BrainrotData.Rarities[char.rarity]
	local title = char.name
	if mutation and mutation ~= "Normal" then
		title = mutation .. " " .. title
	end
	label(model, title .. "\n$" .. tostring(char.income) .. "/s", rarity and rarity.color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	return model
end

return BrainrotModels

--!strict
--!native
--!optimize 2

const graph = require("./types")

const ExternalLogger = require("../core_external/ExternalLogger")
const log_error = ExternalLogger.log_error

const cast_to_graph = require("./cast_to_graph")
const check_lifetime = require("../core_memory/check_lifetime")
const evaluate = require("./evaluate")
const name_of = require("../core_logging/name_of")

const function depend_lifetime_formatter(
	a: unknown,
	b: unknown
): { subject_description: string, case_description: string }
	return {
		subject_description = `The dependency '{name_of(b, "object")}'`,
		case_description = `being used by the user '{name_of(a, "object")}'`,
	}
end

--[[
	Forms a dependency on a graph object.
]]
const function depend(user: graph.GraphNode, dependency: any?)
	if cast_to_graph(dependency) == nil then
		return
	end

	check_lifetime(user, dependency, dependency.scope, depend_lifetime_formatter)

	evaluate(dependency :: graph.GraphNode)

	if table.isfrozen(user.using) then
		log_error(graph.cannot_depend_user_frozen, nil, {
			dependant = name_of(user, "unknown"),
			dependency = name_of(dependency, "unknown"),
		})
	elseif table.isfrozen(dependency.users) then
		log_error(graph.cannot_depend_dependency_frozen, nil, {
			dependant = name_of(user, "unknown"),
			dependency = name_of(dependency, "unknown"),
		})
	end

	user.using[dependency :: graph.GraphNode] = true
	dependency.users[user] = true
end

return depend

-- probe: goto
-- datamodel: Server
-- params: x=0 y=10 z=0 anchor=true name=""
-- purpose: Move a player's character to a spot so that area streams in and can be inspected or captured. With
--   StreamingEnabled a camera pinned far from the character shows an empty world: content streams around the
--   character, not the camera, and RequestStreamAroundAsync from the client is not enough. `anchor=true` holds the
--   character in place and makes it unkillable while you look; run again with anchor=false to release it.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local want = {{name}}
local plr
for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
	if want == "" or p.Name == want or p.DisplayName == want then
		plr = p
		break
	end
end
if not plr or not plr.Character then
	return "no player character to move"
end
local char = plr.Character
local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not root or not hum then
	return "character has no HumanoidRootPart/Humanoid yet"
end
local target = Vector3.new({{x}}, {{y}}, {{z}})
pcall(function()
	plr:RequestStreamAroundAsync(target, 5)
end)
local hold = {{anchor}}
if hold then
	if char:GetAttribute("ForgeGotoHealth") == nil then
		char:SetAttribute("ForgeGotoHealth", hum.MaxHealth)
	end
	hum.MaxHealth, hum.Health = 1e6, 1e6
else
	local old = char:GetAttribute("ForgeGotoHealth")
	if old then
		hum.MaxHealth, hum.Health = old, old
		char:SetAttribute("ForgeGotoHealth", nil)
	end
end
char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target))
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
root.Anchored = hold
task.wait(2)
local at = char:GetPivot().Position
return string.format("%s at (%.0f, %.0f, %.0f) anchored=%s - now camera-pin on the Client and capture", plr.Name, at.X, at.Y, at.Z, tostring(hold))

-- Brainrot Blitz -- the conveyor belt.
-- This service is the game's supply line: every few seconds a new
-- character rides in from one end of the belt, and any player can buy it
-- off the belt before it rolls off the other end. It never decides who can
-- afford what; it asks MoneyService and BaseService, then moves the model.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ConveyorService = {}

function ConveyorService.start(ctx)
	local C = {}
	C.active = {}
	C.maxActive = 12

	local Models = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("BrainrotModels"))

	-- How high the belt's top is, so a model stands on it instead of in it.
	local function groundY(model)
		return ctx.World.BeltTopY + model:GetExtentsSize().Y / 2
	end

	-- Put a fresh character on the belt at the start end, with a buy prompt
	-- showing its price and name.
	function C.spawnOne()
		if #C.active >= C.maxActive then
			return
		end
		local char = ctx.Data.rollCharacter()
		local mutation = ctx.Data.rollMutation()
		local model = Models.build(char.key, mutation)
		if not model then
			return
		end
		model.Parent = ctx.World.folder
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ctx.Data.Timing.BeltMinX, groundY(model), 0))
		local prompt = ctx.World.makePrompt(model.PrimaryPart, "Buy", "$" .. tostring(char.price) .. " " .. char.name, 0.3)
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			C.buy(player, model)
		end)
		table.insert(C.active, { model = model, x = ctx.Data.Timing.BeltMinX })
	end

	-- Buy the character off the belt: the player needs a plot, a free
	-- stand and enough cash. On success the model leaves the belt and
	-- moves to the player's stand.
	function C.buy(player, model)
		local plot = ctx.Bases.getPlot(player)
		if not plot then
			return false
		end
		local slot = ctx.Bases.freeStand(plot)
		if not slot then
			return false
		end
		local key = model:GetAttribute("CharacterKey")
		local char = ctx.Data.find(key)
		if not char then
			return false
		end
		if not ctx.Money.spend(player, char.price) then
			return false
		end
		for i, entry in ipairs(C.active) do
			if entry.model == model then
				table.remove(C.active, i)
				break
			end
		end
		local prompt = model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
		if prompt then
			prompt:Destroy()
		end
		ctx.Bases.placeBrainrot(plot, slot, model)
		ctx.Money.push(player)
		return true
	end

	-- Roll the belt: every active character slides forward, and any that
	-- reach the far end are removed.
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local speed = ctx.Data.Timing.BeltSpeed
		local far = ctx.Data.Timing.BeltMaxX
		for i = #C.active, 1, -1 do
			local entry = C.active[i]
			if not entry.model.Parent then
				table.remove(C.active, i)
			else
				entry.x += speed * dt
				entry.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(entry.x, groundY(entry.model), 0))
				if entry.x >= far then
					entry.model:Destroy()
					table.remove(C.active, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- The spawn clock: a new character every interval, forever.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(ctx.Data.Timing.SpawnInterval)
			C.spawnOne()
		end
	end)

	ctx.Conveyor = C
	return C
end

return ConveyorService

-- ConveyorService: the belt that supplies the game.
-- A new brainrot rolls out every few seconds, rides the belt from the
-- west dock to the east gate, and leaves if nobody buys it. Clicking
-- one buys it onto a free stand in the buyer's own base.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Server = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Models = require(Server:WaitForChild("BrainrotModels"))

local ConveyorService = {}

local ctx = nil
local active = {}
local nextId = 0
-- The model's Body sits this far above its base, so a model placed on
-- a surface needs its pivot lifted by this much.
local PIVOT_LIFT = 1.5

-- Put one fresh brainrot on the belt at the west dock.
local function spawnOne()
	local entry = ctx.data.randomCharacter()
	local mutation = ctx.data.rollMutation()
	local model = Models.build(entry, mutation)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ctx.world.beltStart + Vector3.new(0, PIVOT_LIFT, 0)))
	model.Parent = workspace

	local detector = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
	detector.MaxActivationDistance = 24
	detector.Parent = model

	nextId += 1
	local id = nextId
	active[id] = { id = id, entry = entry, mutation = mutation, model = model, x = ctx.data.CONVEYOR_MIN_X }
	detector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
		ConveyorService.buy(player, id)
	end)
end

-- Slide every brainrot along the belt; drop the ones that reach the
-- east gate unsold.
local function step(dt)
	for id, item in pairs(active) do
		item.x += ctx.data.CONVEYOR_SPEED * dt
		if item.x >= ctx.data.CONVEYOR_MAX_X then
			item.model:Destroy()
			active[id] = nil
		else
			item.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(item.x, 2 + PIVOT_LIFT, 0))
		end
	end
end

-- Buy the brainrot with this id onto one of the buyer's free stands.
function ConveyorService.buy(player, id)
	local item = active[id]
	if not item then
		return
	end
	if ctx.money.getCash(player) < item.entry.price then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "Not enough cash for " .. item.entry.name .. " ($" .. tostring(item.entry.price) .. ").", "error")
		return
	end
	local slot = ctx.bases.freeStand(player)
	if not slot then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "No free stand! Upgrade your base to hold more brainrots.", "error")
		return
	end
	ctx.money.spend(player, item.entry.price)
	active[id] = nil
	ctx.bases.placeOnStand(player, slot, item.entry, item.mutation, item.model)

-- probe: gui-overflow
-- datamodel: any
-- params: root=workspace
-- purpose: Find SurfaceGui/BillboardGui content drawn outside its canvas (ClipsDescendants is false by default, so
--   oversized children paint in mid-air, one-sided) and AlwaysOnTop SurfaceGuis (did not render in testing).
--   Run this FIRST for any "flat wall / screen effect seen from one side only" report.
local root = {{root}}
local out, guis = {}, {}
local function consider(g)
	if g:IsA("SurfaceGui") or g:IsA("BillboardGui") then guis[g] = true end
end
for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do consider(d) end
local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
if lp and lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") then
	for _, d in lp.PlayerGui:GetDescendants() do consider(d) end
end
local nOver, nTop = 0, 0
for g in guis do
	if g:IsA("SurfaceGui") and g.AlwaysOnTop then
		nTop += 1
		if nTop <= 10 then table.insert(out, "ALWAYSONTOP " .. g:GetFullName()) end
	end
	if not g.ClipsDescendants then
		for _, c in g:GetDescendants() do
			if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c.Visible and c.Parent == g then
				local p, s = c.Position, c.Size
				local x0, y0 = p.X.Scale - c.AnchorPoint.X * s.X.Scale, p.Y.Scale - c.AnchorPoint.Y * s.Y.Scale
				if x0 < -0.01 or y0 < -0.01 or x0 + s.X.Scale > 1.01 or y0 + s.Y.Scale > 1.01 then
					nOver += 1
					if nOver <= 20 then
						table.insert(out, string.format("OVERFLOW %s  (x %.2f..%.2f, y %.2f..%.2f of canvas 0..1)", c:GetFullName(), x0, x0 + s.X.Scale, y0, y0 + s.Y.Scale))
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
table.insert(out, 1, string.format("guis scanned %d | overflowing children %d | AlwaysOnTop SurfaceGuis %d", (function() local n = 0 for _ in guis do n += 1 end return n end)(), nOver, nTop))
if nOver > 0 then table.insert(out, "FIX: set ClipsDescendants = true on those SurfaceGuis (or keep children inside 0..1).") end
return table.concat(out, "\n")

const graph = require("./types")

const ExternalLogger = require("../core_external/ExternalLogger")
const log_error = ExternalLogger.log_error

local global_version = 0

const function next_version(): number
	global_version += 1

	return global_version
end

--[[
	Evaluates the graph object if necessary, so that it is up to date.
	Returns `true` if it meaningfully changed.

	https://fluff.blog/2024/04/16/monotonic-painting.html
]]
const function evaluate(node: graph.GraphNode, force_computation: boolean?): boolean
	if node.validity == "busy" then
		log_error(graph.infinite_loop)
	end

	const first_evaluation = node.cached_version == nil and node.absolute_version == nil
	const is_dirty = node.validity == "dirty"
	const is_invalid = node.validity == "invalid"

	if not (first_evaluation or is_dirty or is_invalid or force_computation) then
		return false
	end

	local needs_computation = force_computation or first_evaluation or is_dirty

	-- check dependencies to see if any of them have updated before use, if so then we need to be reevaluated
	if not needs_computation then
		for dependency in node.using do
			evaluate(dependency, false)

			if (dependency.cached_version :: number) > (node.absolute_version :: number) then
				needs_computation = true

				break
			end
		end
	end

	local meaningfully_changed = false

	if needs_computation then
		-- clear dependencies
		for dependency in node.using do
			dependency.users[node] = nil
			node.using[dependency] = nil
		end

		node.validity = "busy"

		meaningfully_changed = node:evaluate() or first_evaluation

		const new_version = next_version()

		node.absolute_version = new_version

		if meaningfully_changed then
			node.cached_version = new_version
		end
	end

	node.validity = "valid"

	return meaningfully_changed
end

return evaluate

-- Brainrot Blitz -- the merchant and his shop.
-- This service is the second way to get characters: a shopkeeper stands
-- behind the stall at the end of the island, and any player can buy any
-- character straight from him instead of waiting for the conveyor. The
-- shop sells at the same list price; the only difference is that the
-- player chooses instead of hoping the belt brings what they want.

local MerchantService = {}

function MerchantService.start(ctx)
	local M = {}

	local Models = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("BrainrotModels"))

	-- The shopkeeper himself: a stout body, an apron, a wide hat and a
	-- friendly face, standing behind the counter and facing the island.
	local function buildKeeper()
		local model = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Name = "Merchant"
		local spot = ctx.World.merchantSpot
		local function part(name, size, color, offset, shape)
			local p = ctx.World.makePart(model, name, size, color, spot + offset, shape)
			return p
		end
		part("Body", Vector3.new(2.2, 2.4, 1.4), Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 200), Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0))
		part("Apron", Vector3.new(1.6, 1.8, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 235), Vector3.new(0, 1.1, -0.8))
		part("Head", Vector3.new(1.3, 1.3, 1.3), Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 160), Vector3.new(0, 3.0, 0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
		part("Brim", Vector3.new(0.3, 2.2, 2.2), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		part("HatTop", Vector3.new(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), Vector3.new(0, 4.1, 0), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		part("ArmL", Vector3.new(0.5, 1.6, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 200), Vector3.new(-1.3, 1.4, 0))
		part("ArmR", Vector3.new(0.5, 1.6, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 200), Vector3.new(1.3, 1.4, 0))
		model.Parent = ctx.World.folder
		return model
	end

	buildKeeper()

	-- The shop prompt on the counter: it opens the shop on the player's
	-- screen.
	local counter = ctx.World.folder:FindFirstChild("StallCounter")
	if counter then
		local prompt = ctx.World.makePrompt(counter, "Shop", "Brainrot Shop", 0.3)
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			ctx.Remotes.OpenShop:FireClient(player, { characters = ctx.Data.Characters })
		end)
	end

	-- Buy one character from the shop, straight onto the player's first
	-- free stand. The mutation is rolled, so a shop buy can still be Gold
	-- or Diamond.
	function M.buy(player, key)
		local char = ctx.Data.find(key)
		if not char then
			return false
		end
		local plot = ctx.Bases.getPlot(player)
		if not plot then
			return false
		end
		local slot = ctx.Bases.freeStand(plot)
		if not slot then
			return false
		end
		if not ctx.Money.spend(player, char.price) then
			return false
		end
		local mutation = ctx.Data.rollMutation()
		local model = Models.build(key, mutation)
		if not model then
			ctx.Money.addCash(player, char.price)
			return false
		end
		ctx.Bases.placeBrainrot(plot, slot, model)
		ctx.Money.push(player)
		return true
	end

	ctx.Remotes.BuyMerchant.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, key)
		M.buy(player, key)
	end)

	ctx.Merchant = M
	return M
end

return MerchantService

-- MerchantService: the travelling merchant by the conveyor.
-- A friendly seller stands at the stall near the belt and offers a
-- random brainrot for a premium over its usual price. Buying from the
-- merchant works like buying from the belt: it needs cash and a free
-- stand, and the brainrot goes straight onto the stand.

local Server = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Models = require(Server:WaitForChild("BrainrotModels"))

local MerchantService = {}

local ctx = nil
-- The merchant charges half again over the belt price.
local MARKUP = 1.5

-- Build the merchant: a stout figure in an apron and a wide hat.
local function buildMerchant(spot)
	local npc = Instance.new("Model")
	npc.Name = "Merchant"

	local function part(name, shape, size, color, position)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Shape = shape
		p.Size = size
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.Position = position
		p.Parent = npc
		return p
	end

	part("Body", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.4, 2.6, 1.6), Color3.fromRGB(240, 230, 210), spot + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0))
	part("Apron", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.0, 2.0, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 60), spot + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, -0.9))
	part("Head", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.8, 1.8, 1.8), Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 150), spot + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0))
	part("HatTop", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.5, 2.6, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), spot + Vector3.new(0, 4.6, 0))
	part("HatBrim", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.3, 3.6, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), spot + Vector3.new(0, 4.3, 0))
	part("EyeLeft", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.2), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), spot + Vector3.new(-0.4, 3.6, -0.9))
	part("EyeRight", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.2), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), spot + Vector3.new(0.4, 3.6, -0.9))
	part("Moustache", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1.0, 0.25, 0.2), Color3.fromRGB(60, 40, 20), spot + Vector3.new(0, 3.1, -0.95))

	-- A floating label so players can find the seller.
	local anchor = part("LabelAnchor", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), spot + Vector3.new(0, 5.6, 0))
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "MerchantLabel"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 40)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = anchor
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "MERCHANT"
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Parent = gui

	npc.PrimaryPart = npc:FindFirstChild("Body")
	npc.Parent = workspace
	return npc
end

-- Sell one random brainrot to the player at the merchant's price.
local function buyFromMerchant(player)
	local entry = ctx.data.randomCharacter()
	local price = math.floor(entry.price * MARKUP)
	if ctx.money.getCash(player) < price then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "The merchant wants $" .. tostring(price) .. " for a " .. entry.name .. ".", "error")
		return
	end
	local slot = ctx.bases.freeStand(player)
	if not slot then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "No free stand! Upgrade your base first.", "error")
		return
	end
	ctx.money.spend(player, price)
	local mutation = ctx.data.rollMutation()
	local model = Models.build(entry, mutation)
	ctx.bases.placeOnStand(player, slot, entry, mutation, model)
	ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "The merchant sold you " .. entry.name .. " for $" .. tostring(price) .. "!", "good")
end

function MerchantService.start(context)
	ctx = context
	local npc = buildMerchant(ctx.world.merchantSpot)
	local body = npc:FindFirstChild("Body")
	if body then
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ObjectText = "Merchant"
		prompt.ActionText = "Buy random brainrot"
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
		prompt.Parent = body
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(buyFromMerchant)
	end
end

return MerchantService

const graph = require("../core_graph/types")

const function node_destructor(node: graph.GraphNode, auxiliary: (any) -> ()?): () -> ()
	const function destroy()
		node.scope = nil

		const using = node.using

		for dependency in using do
			dependency.users[node] = nil
			using[dependency] = nil
		end

		const users = node.users

		for user in users do
			user.using[node] = nil
			users[user] = nil
		end

		if auxiliary ~= nil then
			auxiliary(node)
		end
	end

	return destroy
end

return node_destructor

-- Brainrot Blitz -- money, income and rebirths.
-- This service owns every dollar: starting cash, the one-second income
-- tick from the characters on a player's stands, selling, and the rebirth
-- count that DataStore remembers between visits. It never touches the
-- world itself; it asks BaseService which characters a player owns.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local MoneyService = {}

function MoneyService.start(ctx)
	local M = {}
	M.cash = {}
	M.rebirths = {}
	M.store = nil
	local ok, store = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(ctx.Data.Economy.StoreName)
	end)
	if ok then
		M.store = store
	end

	-- How much cash a player has right now (zero when unknown).
	function M.getCash(player)
		return M.cash[player] or 0
	end

	-- Add cash (negative amounts take it away, never below zero) and tell
	-- the player's screen about the new total.
	function M.addCash(player, amount)
		local now = math.max(0, (M.cash[player] or 0) + amount)
		M.cash[player] = now
		M.push(player)
		return now
	end

	-- Take cash when the player can afford it; false when they cannot.
	function M.spend(player, amount)
		if (M.cash[player] or 0) < amount then
			return false
		end
		M.addCash(player, -amount)
		return true
	end

	-- How many times this player has rebirthed (zero when unknown).
	function M.getRebirths(player)
		return M.rebirths[player] or 0
	end

	-- Send the player's cash, income per second and rebirth count to their
	-- screen, and keep the leaderboard values in step.
	function M.push(player)
		local plot = ctx.Bases and ctx.Bases.getPlot(player)
		local income = 0
		if plot then
			for _, slot in ipairs(plot.stands) do
				if slot.model then
					local key = slot.model:GetAttribute("CharacterKey")
					local mutation = slot.model:GetAttribute("Mutation") or "Normal"
					local char = ctx.Data.find(key)
					if char then
						income += ctx.Data.incomeOf(char, mutation, M.getRebirths(player))
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if stats then
			local cashValue = stats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
			if cashValue then
				cashValue.Value = math.floor(M.getCash(player))
			end
			local rebirthValue = stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
			if rebirthValue then
				rebirthValue.Value = M.getRebirths(player)
			end
		end
		ctx.Remotes.PushState:FireClient(player, {
			cash = math.floor(M.getCash(player)),
			income = math.floor(income),
			rebirths = M.getRebirths(player),
		})
	end

	-- Read the rebirth count back from DataStore; a failure just means the
	-- player starts fresh this visit.
	function M.loadRebirths(player)
		local count = 0
		if M.store then
			local ok2, value = pcall(function()
				return M.store:GetAsync("rebirths_" .. player.UserId)
			end)
			if ok2 and typeof(value) == "number" then
				count = value
			end
		end
		M.rebirths[player] = count
		return count
	end

	-- Write the rebirth count back; a failure is swallowed so a save error
	-- never breaks the game.
	function M.saveRebirths(player)
		if M.store then
			pcall(function()
				M.store:SetAsync("rebirths_" .. player.UserId, M.getRebirths(player))
			end)
		end
	end

	-- Rebirth: pay the cost, gain a permanent income boost, remember it.
	function M.doRebirth(player)
		local cost = ctx.Data.rebirthCost(M.getRebirths(player))
		if not M.spend(player, cost) then
			return false, "Not enough cash"
		end
		M.rebirths[player] = M.getRebirths(player) + 1
		M.saveRebirths(player)
		M.push(player)
		return true, "Reborn"
	end

	-- One income tick: every owned character pays its per-second income.
	function M.tick()
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local plot = ctx.Bases and ctx.Bases.getPlot(player)
			if not plot then
				continue
			end
			local income = 0
			for _, slot in ipairs(plot.stands) do
				if slot.model then
					local key = slot.model:GetAttribute("CharacterKey")
					local mutation = slot.model:GetAttribute("Mutation") or "Normal"
					local char = ctx.Data.find(key)
					if char then
						income += ctx.Data.incomeOf(char, mutation, M.getRebirths(player))
					end
				end
			end
			if income > 0 then
				M.addCash(player, income)
			else
				M.push(player)
			end
		end
	end

	-- A new player starts with the starting cash and a leaderboard entry.
	local function onJoin(player)
		M.cash[player] = ctx.Data.Economy.StartCash
		M.loadRebirths(player)
		local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
		stats.Name = "leaderstats"
		local cashValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
		cashValue.Name = "Cash"
		cashValue.Value = ctx.Data.Economy.StartCash
		cashValue.Parent = stats
		local rebirthValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
		rebirthValue.Name = "Rebirths"
		rebirthValue.Value = M.getRebirths(player)
		rebirthValue.Parent = stats
		stats.Parent = player
		M.push(player)
	end

	-- A leaving player keeps their rebirth count; their cash is not saved.
	local function onLeave(player)
		M.saveRebirths(player)
		M.cash[player] = nil
		M.rebirths[player] = nil
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(onJoin, player)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onLeave)

	-- The rebirth button on the client.
	ctx.Remotes.DoRebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		M.doRebirth(player)
	end)

	-- The income clock: one tick every second, forever.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			M.tick()
		end
	end)

	ctx.Money = M
	return M
end

return MoneyService

-- probe: perf
-- datamodel: any
-- params: seconds=3
-- purpose: A quick performance snapshot: frame time over a short window, memory, and the instance counts that
--   usually explain a slow place. Compare before and after a change; one snapshot alone means little.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local frames, worst, t0 = 0, 0, os.clock()
local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	frames += 1
	worst = math.max(worst, dt)
end)
task.wait({{seconds}})
conn:Disconnect()
local elapsed = os.clock() - t0
local parts, scripts, guis, emitters, lights = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
for _, d in workspace:GetDescendants() do
	if d:IsA("BasePart") then parts += 1
	elseif d:IsA("BaseScript") then scripts += 1
	elseif d:IsA("LayerCollector") then guis += 1
	elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then emitters += 1
	elseif d:IsA("Light") then lights += 1 end
end
return string.format(
	"heartbeat avg %.1f ms (%.0f fps), worst %.1f ms | memory %.0f MB | instances %d | workspace: parts %d, scripts %d, world guis %d, emitters %d, lights %d",
	elapsed / math.max(frames, 1) * 1000, frames / elapsed, worst * 1000, Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb(),
	Stats.InstanceCount, parts, scripts, guis, emitters, lights)

-- MoneyService: cash, income and rebirths.
-- Every player starts with a little cash. Each brainrot on their stands
-- pays its rate every second, multiplied by its mutation and by the
-- player's rebirths. Rebirths are saved in a DataStore so they survive
-- between sessions; cash itself is per session.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local MoneyService = {}

local ctx = nil
local cash = {}
local rebirths = {}
local store = nil

-- Push the player's money state to their HUD.
local function push(player)
	local income = MoneyService.incomePerSecond(player)
	ctx.remotes.CashChanged:FireClient(player, cash[player] or 0, income, rebirths[player] or 0)
end

-- Load a joining player's saved rebirths and set up their wallet.
local function onJoin(player)
	local saved = 0
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("rebirths_" .. tostring(player.UserId))
	end)
	if ok and typeof(value) == "number" then
		saved = value
	end
	rebirths[player] = saved
	cash[player] = ctx.data.START_CASH

	local board = Instance.new("Folder")
	board.Name = "leaderstats"
	board.Parent = player
	local cashValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	cashValue.Name = "Cash"
	cashValue.Value = cash[player]
	cashValue.Parent = board
	local rebirthValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	rebirthValue.Name = "Rebirths"
	rebirthValue.Value = saved
	rebirthValue.Parent = board

	push(player)
end

-- Save a leaving player's rebirths.
local function onLeave(player)
	local count = rebirths[player]
	if count ~= nil and count > 0 then
		pcall(function()
			store:SetAsync("rebirths_" .. tostring(player.UserId), count)
		end)
	end
	cash[player] = nil
	rebirths[player] = nil
end

-- Income per second from every brainrot on the player's stands.
function MoneyService.incomePerSecond(player)
	local baseIndex = ctx.bases.getBase(player)
	if not baseIndex then
		return 0
	end
	local total = 0
	local count = rebirths[player] or 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(ctx.world.bases[baseIndex].stands) do
		if slot.occupant then
			total += ctx.data.incomePerSecond(slot.occupant.entry, slot.occupant.mutation, count)
		end
	end
	return total
end

function MoneyService.getCash(player)
	return cash[player] or 0
end

function MoneyService.getRebirths(player)
	return rebirths[player] or 0
end

function MoneyService.spend(player, amount)
	cash[player] = (cash[player] or 0) - amount
	push(player)
end

function MoneyService.earn(player, amount)
	cash[player] = (cash[player] or 0) + amount
	push(player)
end

-- Pay for a rebirth: permanent extra income, priced by how many
-- rebirths the player already has.
local function rebirth(player)
	local count = rebirths[player] or 0
	local cost = ctx.data.rebirthCost(count)
	if (cash[player] or 0) < cost then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "Rebirth costs $" .. tostring(cost) .. ". Keep earning!", "error")
		return
	end
	cash[player] -= cost
	rebirths[player] = count + 1
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("rebirths_" .. tostring(player.UserId), count + 1)
	end)
	local board = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if board then
		local value = board:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
		if value then
			value.Value = count + 1
		end
	end
	ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "Rebirth complete! All income is now x" .. tostring(ctx.data.rebirthMultiplier(count + 1)) .. ".", "good")
	push(player)
end

function MoneyService.start(context)
	ctx = context
	store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(ctx.data.REBIRTH_STORE)

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		onJoin(player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onLeave)

	ctx.remotes.RebirthRequest.OnServerEvent:Connect(rebirth)

	-- Every second, pay every player what their stands earned.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local income = MoneyService.incomePerSecond(player)
				if income > 0 then
					cash[player] = (cash[player] or 0) + income
					local board = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
					if board then
						local value = board:FindFirstChild("Cash")
						if value then
							value.Value = cash[player]
						end
					end
				end
				push(player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return MoneyService

--!strict
--!native
--!optimize 2
const memory = require("../core_memory/types")

const name_of = require("../core_logging/name_of")
const nicknames = require("../core_logging/nicknames")

const check_lifetime = require("../core_memory/check_lifetime")

const cast_to_graph = require("./cast_to_graph")
const evaluate = require("./evaluate")

const function observe_lifetime_formatter(_, b: unknown): { case_description: string, subject_description: string }
	return {
		subject_description = `The subject '{name_of(b, "unknown")}'`,
		case_description = "it could be observed",
	}
end

--[[
	Adds an observer callback to a graph node. This has the side 
	effect of also making the node eager.
	
	Returns a disconnect function that removes the observer callback from the node.
]]
const function observe(scope: memory.Scope, subject: any, callback: () -> ()): (() -> ())?
	if cast_to_graph(subject) == nil then
		return nil
	end

	check_lifetime(nil, subject, subject.scope, observe_lifetime_formatter)

	local observers = subject.observers :: { () -> () }

	if observers == nil then
		observers = {}
		subject.observers = observers
	end

	table.insert(observers, callback)

	evaluate(subject)

	local is_disconnected = false

	const function disconnect()
		if is_disconnected then
			return
		end

		is_disconnected = true

		const index = table.find(observers, callback)

		if index ~= nil then
			const n = #observers
			observers[index] = observers[n]
			observers[n] = nil
		end

		-- const disconnect_index = table.find(scope, disconnect)

		-- if disconnect_index ~= nil then
		-- 	table.remove(scope, disconnect_index)
		-- end
	end

	nicknames[disconnect] = `Observer ({name_of(subject, "unknown")})`

	table.insert(scope, disconnect)

	return disconnect
end

return observe

-- probe: player-state
-- datamodel: any
-- params: name=""
-- purpose: Where a player is and what state they are in: position, velocity, humanoid state and health, floor
--   material, the player's and character's attributes. On the Client it reads the local player; on the Server pass
--   a name (empty = first player). Use it instead of guessing from a screenshot.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
if not plr then
	local want = {{name}}
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if want == "" or p.Name == want or p.DisplayName == want then plr = p break end
	end
end
if not plr then return "no player" end
local char = plr.Character
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local out = { "player " .. plr.Name }
if hrp then
	table.insert(out, string.format("pos %s  vel %.1f studs/s", tostring(hrp.Position), hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude))
end
if hum then
	table.insert(out, string.format("state %s  health %.0f/%.0f  floor %s  walkspeed %.0f", hum:GetState().Name, hum.Health, hum.MaxHealth, hum.FloorMaterial.Name, hum.WalkSpeed))
end
local function attrs(inst, label)
	local parts = {}
	for k, v in inst:GetAttributes() do table.insert(parts, k .. "=" .. tostring(v)) end
	table.sort(parts)
	if #parts > 0 then table.insert(out, label .. ": " .. table.concat(parts, "  ")) end
end
attrs(plr, "player attrs")
if char then attrs(char, "character attrs") end
return table.concat(out, "\n")

-- Brainrot Blitz -- shields and collision groups.
-- This service owns the game's thirteen collision groups and the shield
-- that guards each plot. A shield, once raised, holds for a while and then
-- needs a long cooldown before it can be raised again; the cooldown is
-- counted from the moment the shield falls, not from when it was raised.
-- While a shield is up, its glowing barrier blocks raiders at the edge of
-- the plot, and StealService refuses any raid on that plot.

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ShieldService = {}

function ShieldService.start(ctx)
	local S = {}
	S.shields = {}

	-- Thirteen groups: the built-in Default plus twelve of my own. The
	-- barrier of each plot gets its own group so it can be toggled alone.
	local groups = {
		"Players", "Brainrots", "World", "Water", "Conveyor", "Merchant",
		"Shield1", "Shield2", "Shield3", "Shield4", "Shield5", "Shield6",
	}
	for _, name in ipairs(groups) do
		PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(name)
	end

	-- What may pass through what. Players walk on the world and bump into
	-- barriers, but the characters on display never block a walkway.
	local function setNoCollide(a, b)
		PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(a, b, false)
	end
	setNoCollide("Players", "Brainrots")
	setNoCollide("Brainrots", "World")
	setNoCollide("Brainrots", "Water")
	setNoCollide("Brainrots", "Conveyor")
	setNoCollide("Brainrots", "Merchant")
	setNoCollide("Brainrots", "Shield1")
	setNoCollide("Brainrots", "Shield2")
	setNoCollide("Brainrots", "Shield3")
	setNoCollide("Brainrots", "Shield4")
	setNoCollide("Brainrots", "Shield5")
	setNoCollide("Brainrots", "Shield6")
	setNoCollide("Water", "Conveyor")
	setNoCollide("Water", "Merchant")

	-- Put the world's parts in their groups, by name.
	local function groupWorld()
		for _, part in ipairs(ctx.World.folder:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local name = part.Name
				if name == "Sea" then
					part.CollisionGroup = "Water"
				elseif name == "ConveyorBelt" or name == "RailNorth" or name == "RailSouth" or name == "Roller" then
					part.CollisionGroup = "Conveyor"
				elseif name == "StallCounter" or name == "StallRoof" or name == "StallPostL" or name == "StallPostR" then
					part.CollisionGroup = "Merchant"
				else
					part.CollisionGroup = "World"
				end
			end
		end
	end
	groupWorld()

	-- Every player's body parts live in the Players group.
	local function groupCharacter(player)
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then
			return
		end
		for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CollisionGroup = "Players"
			end
		end
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.wait(0.2)
			groupCharacter(player)
		end)
	end)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character then
			task.spawn(groupCharacter, player)
		end
	end

	-- One glowing barrier per plot: four walls around the pad, hidden and
	-- harmless until the shield goes up.
	local function buildBarrier(plot)
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "ShieldBarrier" .. plot.index
		folder.Parent = ctx.World.folder
		local group = "Shield" .. plot.index
		local walls = {}
		local halfW, halfD, height = 13, 15, 6
		local defs = {
			{ size = Vector3.new(halfW * 2, height, 0.8), pos = Vector3.new(plot.x, 3, plot.z - halfD) },
			{ size = Vector3.new(halfW * 2, height, 0.8), pos = Vector3.new(plot.x, 3, plot.z + halfD) },
			{ size = Vector3.new(0.8, height, halfD * 2), pos = Vector3.new(plot.x - halfW, 3, plot.z) },
			{ size = Vector3.new(0.8, height, halfD * 2), pos = Vector3.new(plot.x + halfW, 3, plot.z) },
		}
		for i, def in ipairs(defs) do
			local wall = ctx.World.makePart(folder, "BarrierWall" .. i, def.size, Color3.fromRGB(90, 160, 255), def.pos)
			wall.Transparency = 1
			wall.CanCollide = false
			wall.CollisionGroup = group
			table.insert(walls, wall)
		end
		return { walls = walls, folder = folder }
	end

	for _, plot in ipairs(ctx.Bases.plots) do
		S.shields[plot.index] = {
			plot = plot,
			activeUntil = 0,
			cooldownUntil = 0,
			barrier = buildBarrier(plot),
		}
	end

	-- Show or hide one plot's barrier.
	local function setBarrier(state, show)
		for _, wall in ipairs(state.barrier.walls) do
			wall.Transparency = show and 0.45 or 1
			wall.CanCollide = show
		end
	end

	-- Is this plot's shield up right now?
	function S.isShielded(plot)
		local state = S.shields[plot.index]
		return state and os.clock() < state.activeUntil
	end

	-- Raise a plot's shield. It holds for the shield time, and the
	-- cooldown that follows is counted from when it falls: the next
	-- activation is only possible after the full up-time plus the full
	-- cooldown have both passed.
	function S.activate(plot, player)
		if plot.owner ~= player then
			return false
		end
		local state = S.shields[plot.index]
		if not state then
			return false
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now < state.cooldownUntil then
			return false
		end
		local up = ctx.Data.Timing.ShieldUp
		local cool = ctx.Data.Timing.ShieldCooldown
		state.activeUntil = now + up
		state.cooldownUntil = state.activeUntil + cool
		setBarrier(state, true)
		ctx.Remotes.PushShield:FireAllClients({
			plot = plot.index,
			active = true,
			readyAt = state.cooldownUntil,
		})
		return true
	end

	-- A quiet clock that lowers each barrier the moment its time is up.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.5)
			local now = os.clock()
			for _, state in pairs(S.shields) do
				if now >= state.activeUntil and state.barrier.walls[1].CanCollide then
					setBarrier(state, false)
					ctx.Remotes.PushShield:FireAllClients({
						plot = state.plot.index,
						active = false,
						readyAt = state.cooldownUntil,
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	ctx.Remotes.ToggleShield.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		local plot = ctx.Bases.getPlot(player)
		if plot then
			S.activate(plot, player)
		end
	end)

	ctx.Shield = S
	return S
end

return ShieldService

-- ShieldService: the laser shield that guards a base from raids.
-- A player raises a glowing barrier around their own base. It holds for
-- a while, then needs a long cooldown before it can be raised again.
-- The cooldown is counted after the shield ends, never from the moment
-- it was raised: one full cycle is the duration plus the cooldown.
-- This file also owns the thirteen collision groups the game uses, so
-- carried brainrots, shields and the wave never snag on the wrong thing.

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")

local ShieldService = {}

local ctx = nil
local shields = {}

-- The thirteen collision groups: the default plus one for every kind
-- of thing that needs its own collision behaviour.
local GROUP_NAMES = {
	"Default",
	"Players",
	"Brainrots",
	"Stands",
	"Walls",
	"Water",
	"Shield",
	"Belt",
	"Decor",
	"Carried",
	"SafeZone",
	"Merchant",
	"Wave",
}

-- Build one glowing wall of the barrier around a base pad.
local function barrierWall(folder, name, size, position)
	local wall = Instance.new("Part")
	wall.Name = name
	wall.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	wall.Size = size
	wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255)
	wall.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	wall.Transparency = 0.4
	wall.Anchored = true
	wall.CanCollide = false
	wall.Position = position
	-- The barrier belongs to the Shield group, which nothing collides with.
	pcall(function()
		PhysicsService:SetPartCollisionGroup(wall, "Shield")
	end)
	wall.Parent = folder
	return wall
end

-- Raise the shield of the player's base, if its cooldown has run out.
local function activate(player)
	local baseIndex = ctx.bases.getBase(player)
	if not baseIndex then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local shield = shields[baseIndex]
	if shield and now < shield.cooldownUntil then
		local left = math.ceil(shield.cooldownUntil - now)
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "Shield is recharging: " .. tostring(left) .. "s left.", "error")
		return
	end

	local base = ctx.world.bases[baseIndex]
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "ShieldBarrier"
	folder.Parent = base.folder
	local center = base.position
	-- Four walls around the 34 by 26 pad, eight studs tall.
	barrierWall(folder, "ShieldNorth", Vector3.new(34, 8, 1), center + Vector3.new(0, 5, -13))
	barrierWall(folder, "ShieldSouth", Vector3.new(34, 8, 1), center + Vector3.new(0, 5, 13))
	barrierWall(folder, "ShieldWest", Vector3.new(1, 8, 26), center + Vector3.new(-17, 5, 0))
	barrierWall(folder, "ShieldEast", Vector3.new(1, 8, 26), center + Vector3.new(17, 5, 0))

	-- The shield ends after the duration; the cooldown runs after that.
	local raisedAt = now
	local endsAt = raisedAt + ctx.data.SHIELD_DURATION
	local readyAgainAt = endsAt + ctx.data.SHIELD_COOLDOWN
	shields[baseIndex] = { activeUntil = endsAt, cooldownUntil = readyAgainAt, barrier = folder }
	ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "Shield up! Your base is safe for " .. tostring(ctx.data.SHIELD_DURATION) .. " seconds.", "good")
end

-- Is this base's shield up right now?
function ShieldService.isProtected(baseIndex)
	local shield = shields[baseIndex]
	if not shield then
		return false
	end
	return os.clock() < shield.activeUntil
end

function ShieldService.start(context)
	ctx = context

	-- Create every collision group, then set the pairs that must pass
	-- through each other.
	for _, name in ipairs(GROUP_NAMES) do
		pcall(function()
			PhysicsService:CreateCollisionGroup(name)
		end)
	end
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Carried", "Players", false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Carried", "Brainrots", false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Carried", "Stands", false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Shield", "Players", false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Shield", "Brainrots", false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Wave", "Players", false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Wave", "Brainrots", false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Water", "Players", false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Water", "Brainrots", false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Water", "Stands", false)

	ctx.remotes.ShieldRequest.OnServerEvent:Connect(activate)

	-- A slow sweep takes down barriers whose shield has run out.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			local now = os.clock()
			for _, shield in pairs(shields) do
				if shield.barrier and now >= shield.activeUntil then
					shield.barrier:Destroy()
					shield.barrier = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return ShieldService

const memory = require("../core_memory/types")

const ExternalScheduler = require("../core_external/ExternalScheduler")
const schedule_task_immediate = ExternalScheduler.schedule_task_immediate

const observe = require("./observe")

--[[
	Adds an observer callback to a graph node after immediately calling the callback.
	This has the side effect of also making the node eager.
	
	Returns a disconnect function that removes the observer callback from the node.
]]
const function observe_immediate(scope: memory.Scope, subject: any, callback: () -> ()): (() -> ())?
	schedule_task_immediate(callback)

	return observe(scope, subject, callback)
end

return observe_immediate

-- Brainrot Blitz -- stealing, carrying and selling.
-- This service is the raid loop: a player takes a character off a stand,
-- carries it in front of them, and either places it on one of their own
-- stands or sells it at the merchant. A shielded plot refuses raids. The
-- model is welded to the carrier, so it follows them until they let go.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local StealService = {}

function StealService.start(ctx)
	local S = {}
	S.carried = {}

	-- Where a carried character rides: just above the head and a little
	-- in front, so it is visible without blocking the view.
	local function carryCFrame(player)
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then
			return nil
		end
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then
			return nil
		end
		return root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.4, -0.8)
	end

	-- Weld the model to the carrier and mark both sides as carrying.
	local function attach(player, model)
		local target = carryCFrame(player)
		if not target then
			return false
		end
		model:PivotTo(target)
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local primary = model.PrimaryPart
		if not root or not primary then
			return false
		end
		for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.Massless = true
			end
		end
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = primary
		weld.Part1 = root
		weld.Parent = primary
		player:SetAttribute("Carrying", true)
		return true
	end

	-- Unweld and clear the carrying mark.
	local function detach(player, model)
		local primary = model and model.PrimaryPart
		if primary then
			for _, child in ipairs(primary:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
		player:SetAttribute("Carrying", false)
	end

	-- Take a character off a stand. The owner takes it freely; a raider
	-- only when the plot's shield is down.
	function S.pickup(player, model, plot, slot)
		if S.carried[player] then
			return false
		end
		if not slot or slot.model ~= model then
			return false
		end
		if plot.owner ~= player and ctx.Shield and ctx.Shield.isShielded(plot) then
			return false
		end
		ctx.Bases.takeBrainrot(plot, slot)
		if not attach(player, model) then
			ctx.Bases.placeBrainrot(plot, slot, model)
			return false
		end
		S.carried[player] = { model = model, fromPlot = plot, fromSlot = slot }
		return true
	end

	-- Put the carried character on the carrier's first free stand.
	function S.place(player)
		local entry = S.carried[player]
		if not entry then
			return false
		end
		local plot = ctx.Bases.getPlot(player)
		if not plot then
			return false
		end
		local slot = ctx.Bases.freeStand(plot)
		if not slot then
			return false
		end
		detach(player, entry.model)
		ctx.Bases.placeBrainrot(plot, slot, entry.model)
		S.carried[player] = nil
		ctx.Money.push(player)
		return true
	end

	-- Sell the carried character for half its buy price.
	function S.sell(player)
		local entry = S.carried[player]
		if not entry then
			return false
		end
		local key = entry.model:GetAttribute("CharacterKey")
		local char = ctx.Data.find(key)
		if not char then
			return false
		end
		detach(player, entry.model)
		entry.model:Destroy()
		S.carried[player] = nil
		ctx.Money.addCash(player, ctx.Data.sellPriceOf(char))
		ctx.Money.push(player)
		return true
	end

	-- A carried character goes home: back to its original plot when there
	-- is room, otherwise it is gone.
	function S.returnCarried(player)
		local entry = S.carried[player]
		if not entry then
			return
		end
		detach(player, entry.model)
		S.carried[player] = nil
		local slot = entry.fromPlot and ctx.Bases.freeStand(entry.fromPlot)
		if slot and entry.model.Parent then
			ctx.Bases.placeBrainrot(entry.fromPlot, slot, entry.model)
		elseif entry.model.Parent then
			entry.model:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- The prompt on a stand character. One prompt covers taking and
	-- stealing; the server decides which one it is. Any prompt left over
	-- from an earlier placement is removed first, so a much-traded
	-- character never collects stale prompts.
	function S.wirePrompt(model, plot, slot)
		local primary = model.PrimaryPart
		if not primary then
			return
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(primary:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local prompt = ctx.World.makePrompt(primary, "Take", model.Name, 0.3)
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			S.pickup(player, model, plot, slot)
		end)
	end

	-- A player who dies or leaves drops what they were carrying.
	local function watchCharacter(player)
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then
			return
		end
		local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			S.returnCarried(player)
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			watchCharacter(player)
		end)
	end)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character then
			task.spawn(watchCharacter, player)
		end
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			watchCharacter(player)
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		S.returnCarried(player)
	end)

	ctx.Remotes.PlaceCarried.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		S.place(player)
	end)
	ctx.Remotes.SellCarried.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		S.sell(player)
	end)

	ctx.Steal = S
	return S
end

return StealService

-- StealService: carrying brainrots between bases.
-- A player can grab a brainrot off someone else's stand and carry it
-- home: the model welds in front of them while they walk, and a prompt
-- on one of their own free stands puts it down as theirs. A shielded
-- base cannot be raided. If the carrier dies or takes too long, the
-- brainrot walks itself back to the stand it came from.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local StealService = {}

local ctx = nil
local carrying = {}
local CARRY_TIMEOUT = 30
-- The model's Body sits this far above its base.
local PIVOT_LIFT = 1.5

-- Set every part of a model anchored or not.
local function setAnchored(model, anchored)
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Anchored = anchored
		end
	end
end

-- Send a carried brainrot back to the stand it was taken from.
local function returnHome(record)
	local base = ctx.world.bases[record.fromBase]
	if not base then
		record.model:Destroy()
		return
	end
	local slot = base.stands[record.fromSlot]
	if slot and not slot.occupant then
		slot.occupant = { entry = record.entry, mutation = record.mutation, model = record.model, owner = record.fromOwner, baseIndex = record.fromBase, slotIndex = record.fromSlot }
		setAnchored(record.model, true)
		record.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(slot.position.X, slot.position.Y + PIVOT_LIFT, slot.position.Z))
		record.model.Parent = workspace
	else
		record.model:Destroy()
	end
end

-- Drop what a player is carrying, returning it home.
local function dropCarried(player, reason)
	local record = carrying[player]
	if not record then
		return
	end
	carrying[player] = nil
	if record.weld then
		record.weld:Destroy()
	end
	ctx.remotes.CarryState:FireClient(player, false)
	if reason == "placed" then
		return
	end
	returnHome(record)
end

-- Put a carried brainrot onto one of the carrier's own free stands.
local function placeCarried(player, baseIndex, slotIndex)
	local record = carrying[player]
	if not record then
		return
	end
	local base = ctx.world.bases[baseIndex]
	if not base then
		return
	end
	if ctx.bases.getOwner(baseIndex) ~= player then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "That is not your base.", "error")
		return
	end
	local slot = base.stands[slotIndex]
	if not slot or slot.occupant then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "That stand is already taken.", "error")
		return
	end
	carrying[player] = nil
	if record.weld then
		record.weld:Destroy()
	end
	setAnchored(record.model, true)
	slot.occupant = { entry = record.entry, mutation = record.mutation, model = record.model, owner = player, baseIndex = baseIndex, slotIndex = slotIndex }
	record.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(slot.position.X, slot.position.Y + PIVOT_LIFT, slot.position.Z))
	record.model.Parent = workspace
	ctx.remotes.CarryState:FireClient(player, false)
	ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "Stolen! " .. record.entry.name .. " is yours now.", "good")
end

-- The Take prompt on a stand: steal from someone else, or place what
-- you are carrying on one of your own free stands.
function StealService.tryTake(player, baseIndex, slotIndex)
	local base = ctx.world.bases[baseIndex]
	if not base then
		return
	end
	local slot = base.stands[slotIndex]
	if not slot then
		return
	end

	-- Placing: the player carries one and this is their own free stand.
	if carrying[player] then
		placeCarried(player, baseIndex, slotIndex)
		return
	end

	-- Stealing: the stand must hold a brainrot that belongs to someone else.
	if not slot.occupant then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "That stand is empty.", "error")
		return
	end
	if slot.occupant.owner == player then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "That brainrot is already yours. Use Sell to cash it out.", "error")
		return
	end
	if ctx.shield.isProtected(baseIndex) then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "This base is shielded! The raid is blocked.", "error")
		return
	end

	local occupant = slot.occupant
	slot.occupant = nil
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		-- The carrier is not in a state to carry; put it back.
		slot.occupant = occupant
		return
	end

	-- Weld the model in front of the player and let them walk it home.
	setAnchored(occupant.model, false)
	for _, part in ipairs(occupant.model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = occupant.model.PrimaryPart
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, -3)
	weld.Parent = root
	occupant.model:PivotTo(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, -3))

	carrying[player] = {
		entry = occupant.entry,
		mutation = occupant.mutation,
		model = occupant.model,
		weld = weld,
		fromBase = baseIndex,
		fromSlot = slotIndex,
		fromOwner = occupant.owner,
		startedAt = os.clock(),
	}

	-- If the carrier dies, the brainrot goes home.
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		dropCarried(player, "died")
	end)

	ctx.remotes.CarryState:FireClient(player, true)
	ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "You grabbed " .. occupant.entry.name .. "! Carry it to your base before time runs out.", "good")
	local victim = occupant.owner
	if victim and victim ~= player then
		ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(victim, player.Name .. " is stealing your " .. occupant.entry.name .. "!", "warn")
	end
end

function StealService.start(context)
	ctx = context
	-- A slow sweep returns brainrots whose carrier took too long or left.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			for player, record in pairs(carrying) do
				if not player.Parent then
					dropCarried(player, "left")
				elseif os.clock() - record.startedAt > CARRY_TIMEOUT then
					ctx.remotes.Announce:FireClient(player, "You took too long! The brainrot ran back home.", "error")
					dropCarried(player, "timeout")
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		dropCarried(player, "left")
	end)
end

return StealService

-- probe: ray-all
-- datamodel: any
-- params: ox=0 oy=10 oz=0 tx=0 ty=10 tz=-100 root=workspace max=12
-- purpose: Everything a sight line passes through, INCLUDING parts workspace:Raycast skips (CanQuery = false,
--   transparent parts carrying SurfaceGuis/Decals). Sorted by distance. Use the capture camera position as the
--   origin and the pixel you are asking about as the target.
local root = {{root}}
local o, target = Vector3.new({{ox}}, {{oy}}, {{oz}}), Vector3.new({{tx}}, {{ty}}, {{tz}})
local dir = (target - o).Unit
local LIMIT = (target - o).Magnitude * 4
local function slab(p)
	local lo, ld = p.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(o), p.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(dir)
	local h = p.Size / 2
	local tmin, tmax = -math.huge, math.huge
	for _, ax in { "X", "Y", "Z" } do
		local a, b, e = lo[ax], ld[ax], h[ax]
		if math.abs(b) < 1e-9 then
			if math.abs(a) > e then return nil end
		else
			local t1, t2 = (-e - a) / b, (e - a) / b
			if t1 > t2 then t1, t2 = t2, t1 end
			tmin, tmax = math.max(tmin, t1), math.min(tmax, t2)
			if tmin > tmax then return nil end
		end
	end
	if tmax < 0 then return nil end
	return math.max(tmin, 0)
end
local hits = {}
for _, p in root:GetDescendants() do
	if p:IsA("BasePart") and not p:IsA("Terrain") then
		local t = slab(p)
		if t and t < LIMIT then table.insert(hits, { p = p, t = t }) end
	end
end
table.sort(hits, function(a, b) return a.t < b.t end)
local out = { string.format("%d parts on the line (first %d):", #hits, math.min(#hits, {{max}})) }
for i = 1, math.min(#hits, {{max}}) do
	local p = hits[i].p
	local extras = {}
	if not p.CanQuery then table.insert(extras, "CanQuery=false") end
	if p.Transparency >= 0.95 then table.insert(extras, "invisible") end
	if p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui") then table.insert(extras, "SurfaceGui") end
	if p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal") or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Texture") then table.insert(extras, "Decal") end
	table.insert(out, string.format("%5.1f  %s  %s", hits[i].t, p:GetFullName(), table.concat(extras, " ")))
end
local r = workspace:Raycast(o, dir * LIMIT)
table.insert(out, "workspace:Raycast says: " .. (r and (r.Instance:GetFullName() .. string.format(" at %.1f", (r.Position - o).Magnitude)) or "nothing"))
table.insert(out, "Nothing here but the artefact is on screen? It is not geometry: run gui-overflow, then bisect with hide.")
return table.concat(out, "\n")

-- Brainrot Blitz -- the periodic tsunami.
-- This service is the game's clock of dread: after a quiet opening, a
-- warning goes out, and then a wall of water sweeps the whole island from
-- one end to the other. Anyone it catches is carried back to their own
-- plot. Then the island is calm again until the next wave.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local WaveService = {}

function WaveService.start(ctx)
	local W = {}
	W.sweeping = false

	-- A big warning board over the belt, hidden until a wave is coming.
	local warnBoard = ctx.World.makeSign(
		ctx.World.folder,
		"WaveWarning",
		Vector3.new(40, 7, 1),
		Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40),
		Vector3.new(0, 12, -14),
		"TSUNAMI! EVACUATE!",
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	)
	warnBoard.Transparency = 1
	local warnGui = warnBoard:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceGui")
	if warnGui then
		warnGui.Enabled = false
	end

	-- Send a caught player back to their own plot (or the spawn when they
	-- have none), at most once a second per player.
	local lastTeleport = {}
	local function sendHome(player)
		local now = os.clock()
		if lastTeleport[player] and now - lastTeleport[player] < 1 then
			return
		end
		lastTeleport[player] = now
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then
			return
		end
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then
			return
		end
		local plot = ctx.Bases.getPlot(player)
		if plot then
			root.CFrame = CFrame.new(plot.x, 5, plot.z)
		else
			root.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 5, 85)
		end
	end

	-- One sweep: a wall of water crosses the island, and anything it
	-- touches is sent home.
	function W.sweep()
		W.sweeping = true
		ctx.Remotes.PushWave:FireAllClients({ phase = "sweep" })
		local wall = ctx.World.makePart(ctx.World.folder, "TsunamiWall", Vector3.new(12, 14, 200), Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 220), Vector3.new(-140, 7, 0))
		wall.Transparency = 0.4
		wall.CanCollide = false
		local connection
		connection = wall.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
			if player then
				sendHome(player)
			end
		end)
		local sweepTime = ctx.Data.Timing.WaveSweep
		local steps = 40
		for i = 0, steps do
			local x = -140 + (280 * i / steps)
			wall.Position = Vector3.new(x, 7, 0)
			task.wait(sweepTime / steps)
		end
		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		wall:Destroy()
		W.sweeping = false
	end

	-- The wave clock: a quiet opening, then warn, sweep, calm, repeat.
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(ctx.Data.Timing.WaveFirst)
		while true do
			ctx.Remotes.PushWave:FireAllClients({ phase = "warn", seconds = ctx.Data.Timing.WaveWarn })
			warnBoard.Transparency = 0
			if warnGui then
				warnGui.Enabled = true
			end
			task.wait(ctx.Data.Timing.WaveWarn)
			warnBoard.Transparency = 1
			if warnGui then
				warnGui.Enabled = false
			end
			W.sweep()
			ctx.Remotes.PushWave:FireAllClients({ phase = "calm" })
			task.wait(ctx.Data.Timing.WaveGap)
		end
	end)

	ctx.Wave = W
	return W
end

return WaveService

-- WaveService: the tsunami that sweeps the island on a schedule.
-- The first wave comes about a minute after the game starts. Every
-- wave is announced, gives players time to climb to high ground, then
-- a wall of water crosses the island from north to south. Anyone still
-- standing low when the wall passes over them takes damage. After the
-- sweep the sea calms down until the next wave.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local WaveService = {}

local ctx = nil

-- Run one wave: warn, wait, sweep the wall across, then clean up.
local function runWave()
	ctx.remotes.Announce:FireAllClients("TSUNAMI INCOMING! Climb to a roof or the lookout deck!", "warn")
	task.wait(ctx.data.WAVE_WARN_FOR)

	local wall = Instance.new("Part")
	wall.Name = "TsunamiWall"
	wall.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	wall.Size = Vector3.new(280, 12, 6)
	wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 100, 200)
	wall.Material = Enum.Material.Water
	wall.Transparency = 0.2
	wall.Anchored = true
	wall.CanCollide = false
	wall.Position = Vector3.new(0, 6, -110)
	wall.Parent = workspace

	local startedAt = os.clock()
	local duration = ctx.data.WAVE_SWEEP_FOR
	while os.clock() - startedAt < duration do
		local progress = (os.clock() - startedAt) / duration
		local z = -110 + progress * 220
		wall.Position = Vector3.new(0, 6, z)
		-- Anyone low and close to the wall gets hit by the water.
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local low = root.Position.Y < ctx.data.WAVE_SAFE_HEIGHT
				local nearWall = math.abs(root.Position.Z - z) < 8
				if low and nearWall then
					humanoid:TakeDamage(15)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	wall:Destroy()
	ctx.remotes.Announce:FireAllClients("The wave has passed. Keep earning!", "good")
end

function WaveService.start(context)
	ctx = context
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(ctx.data.WAVE_FIRST_AT)
		while true do
			runWave()
			task.wait(ctx.data.WAVE_GAP)
		end
	end)
end

return WaveService

-- probe: remotes
-- datamodel: any
-- params:
-- purpose: Every RemoteEvent / UnreliableRemoteEvent / RemoteFunction / BindableEvent with its path. Remotes the
--   client creates never reach the server, and a typo in a name fails silently: compare this list to the names
--   your scripts use. Each server handler still needs type, range, ownership and rate checks.
local out = {}
for _, svc in { game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), workspace, game:GetService("ServerStorage") } do
	for _, d in svc:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") or d:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent") or d:IsA("RemoteFunction") or d:IsA("BindableEvent") then
			table.insert(out, string.format("%-22s %s", d.ClassName, d:GetFullName()))
		end
	end
end
table.sort(out)
table.insert(out, 1, #out .. " remote/bindable object(s)")
return table.concat(out, "\n")
