-- Brainrot Blitz -- builds the island the game plays on.
-- One call lays out the whole place: the sand island, the sea around it,
-- the long conveyor down the middle, six plot pads, the boundary walls, a
-- few decorations, the merchant stall and the spawn. It also sets the
-- bright mid-morning light, and hands back helpers the services use to add
-- their own parts, signs and prompts.

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local World = {}

World.BeltTopY = 1

-- One part, anchored, with a name and a color. Everything the world builds
-- goes through here so the look stays consistent.
function World.makePart(parent, name, size, color, pos, shape)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Position = pos
	p.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- A standing board with readable text on its front face. The board turns
-- by `facing` degrees around Y, so the text faces the players who walk up
-- to it (0 faces north, 180 faces south).
function World.makeSign(parent, name, size, color, pos, text, textColor, facing)
	local board = World.makePart(parent, name, size, color, pos)
	board.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(facing or 0), 0)
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Name = "SignGui"
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	gui.Parent = board
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Text"
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextColor3 = textColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.Text = text
	label.Parent = gui
	return board
end

-- A proximity prompt on a part, with a short hold so a stray touch does not
-- fire it by accident.
function World.makePrompt(parent, action, object, hold)
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = action
	prompt.ObjectText = object
	prompt.HoldDuration = hold or 0.4
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = parent
	return prompt
end

-- A palm tree: a leaning trunk and a crown of leaves.
local function palm(parent, pos, lean)
	local trunk = World.makePart(parent, "PalmTrunk", Vector3.new(1.2, 7, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 60), pos + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	trunk.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(lean or 8))
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local a = (i - 1) * (360 / 5)
		local leaf = World.makePart(parent, "PalmLeaf", Vector3.new(0.5, 0.4, 3.4), Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 80), pos + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0))
		leaf.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(a), math.rad(-35)) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.4)
	end
end

-- A wooden crate, for decoration near the merchant stall.
local function crate(parent, pos, size)
	local c = World.makePart(parent, "Crate", Vector3.new(size, size, size), Color3.fromRGB(170, 125, 70), pos)
	c.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(20), 0)
end

-- Build the whole place. Returns the belt, the pads, the merchant spot and
-- the helpers, so the services can build on top of it.
function World.build(ctx)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "BlitzWorld"
	folder.Parent = Workspace

	-- Bright mid-morning light over the harbor.
	Lighting.ClockTime = 10.5
	Lighting.Brightness = 2
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
	Lighting.GeographicLatitude = 20

	-- The sea, then the sand island on top of it.
	World.makePart(folder, "Sea", Vector3.new(600, 1, 500), Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 200), Vector3.new(0, -2, 0))
	local island = World.makePart(folder, "Island", Vector3.new(268, 1, 200), Color3.fromRGB(225, 200, 150), Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0))
	island.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth

	-- The conveyor: a long dark belt down the middle of the island, with
	-- rails on both sides so the characters read as riding a track.
	local belt = World.makePart(folder, "ConveyorBelt", Vector3.new(262, 1, 8), Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60), Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
	belt.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	World.makePart(folder, "RailNorth", Vector3.new(262, 1.2, 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 100), Vector3.new(0, 0.9, -4.4))
	World.makePart(folder, "RailSouth", Vector3.new(262, 1.2, 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 100), Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 4.4))
	-- Rollers at both ends of the belt.
	for _, x in ipairs({ -131, 131 }) do
		local roller = World.makePart(folder, "Roller", Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 8.5), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), Vector3.new(x, 0.5, 0), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		roller.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
	end

	-- Six plot pads, one per player, in two rows of three.
	local pads = {}
	local padColors = {
		Color3.fromRGB(200, 170, 120), Color3.fromRGB(170, 200, 170),
		Color3.fromRGB(170, 180, 220), Color3.fromRGB(220, 180, 170),
		Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 140), Color3.fromRGB(190, 160, 200),
	}
	for i, plot in ipairs(ctx.Data.Plots) do
		local pad = World.makePart(folder, "Pad" .. i, Vector3.new(26, 0.5, 30), padColors[i], Vector3.new(plot.x, 0.25, plot.z))
		pad.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		-- A low curb around each pad so its edge is visible.
		World.makePart(folder, "Curb" .. i, Vector3.new(26, 0.6, 1), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Vector3.new(plot.x, 0.3, plot.z - 15))
		World.makePart(folder, "CurbBack" .. i, Vector3.new(26, 0.6, 1), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Vector3.new(plot.x, 0.3, plot.z + 15))
		table.insert(pads, { index = i, x = plot.x, z = plot.z, part = pad })
	end

	-- Boundary walls around the island so nobody walks off into the sea.
	local wallColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)
	World.makePart(folder, "WallNorth", Vector3.new(268, 4, 1.5), wallColor, Vector3.new(0, 2, -100))
	World.makePart(folder, "WallSouth", Vector3.new(268, 4, 1.5), wallColor, Vector3.new(0, 2, 100))
	World.makePart(folder, "WallWest", Vector3.new(1.5, 4, 200), wallColor, Vector3.new(-134, 2, 0))
	World.makePart(folder, "WallEast", Vector3.new(1.5, 4, 200), wallColor, Vector3.new(134, 2, 0))

	-- The welcome sign over the belt, and a sign at the merchant stall.
	-- The welcome sign faces south, toward the spawn; the merchant sign
	-- faces north, toward the players walking up from the island.
	World.makeSign(folder, "WelcomeSign", Vector3.new(30, 6, 1), Color3.fromRGB(40, 60, 120), Vector3.new(0, 8, -14), "BRAINROT BLITZ", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90), 180)
	World.makeSign(folder, "MerchantSign", Vector3.new(14, 4, 1), Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 30), Vector3.new(100, 6, 72), "BRAINROT SHOP", Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 180), 0)

	-- The merchant stall: a counter, a striped roof and a spot for the NPC.
	local stall = World.makePart(folder, "StallCounter", Vector3.new(10, 2.5, 4), Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 60), Vector3.new(100, 1.25, 78))
	World.makePart(folder, "StallRoof", Vector3.new(12, 0.6, 6), Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60), Vector3.new(100, 6.5, 78))
	World.makePart(folder, "StallPostL", Vector3.new(0.6, 6, 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 50), Vector3.new(95, 3, 78))
	World.makePart(folder, "StallPostR", Vector3.new(0.6, 6, 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 50), Vector3.new(105, 3, 78))
	local merchantSpot = Vector3.new(100, 0, 82)

	-- Palms in the corners and crates near the stall, for a harbor feel.
	palm(folder, Vector3.new(-120, 0, -85), 8)
	palm(folder, Vector3.new(120, 0, -85), -8)
	palm(folder, Vector3.new(-120, 0, 85), -6)
	palm(folder, Vector3.new(60, 0, -85), 6)
	crate(folder, Vector3.new(112, 1, 84), 2)
	crate(folder, Vector3.new(112, 1, 88), 1.5)
	crate(folder, Vector3.new(88, 1, 86), 1.5)

	-- Where players arrive.
	local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	spawn.Name = "BlitzSpawn"
	spawn.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
	spawn.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 85)
	spawn.Anchored = true
	spawn.Neutral = true
	spawn.Duration = 0
	spawn.Parent = folder

	return {
		folder = folder,
		belt = belt,
		pads = pads,
		merchantSpot = merchantSpot,
		makePart = World.makePart,
		makeSign = World.makeSign,
		makePrompt = World.makePrompt,
	}
end

return World

-- World: builds the whole island at server start.
-- A harbour rectangle with a conveyor down the middle, six safehouse
-- pads on the sides, walls around the edge, harbour decoration, and a
-- high lookout deck players can climb when the tsunami comes. Everything
-- is plain parts so the place builds the same way on every run.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Data = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))

local World = {}

-- One part, the way every builder in this file makes one.
function World.part(name, shape, size, color, position, parent, material)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Shape = shape
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = true
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

-- A sign board on a pole, with a floating label that services can
-- rename (the base owner's name goes here).
function World.makeSign(parent, position, title)
	local pole = World.part("SignPole", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.6, 6, 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(90, 70, 50), position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), parent)
	pole.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 90)
	local board = World.part("SignBoard", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(8, 3, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(40, 70, 120), position + Vector3.new(0, 6.5, 0), parent)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "SignGui"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 50)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = board
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "SignText"
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = title
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Parent = gui
	return board
end

-- A proximity prompt with one action line, ready for a service to
-- listen to.
function World.makePrompt(parent, objectText, actionText, holdSeconds)
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ObjectText = objectText
	prompt.ActionText = actionText
	prompt.HoldDuration = holdSeconds or 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = parent
	return prompt
end

-- The harbour ground, the sea around it and the boundary walls.
local function buildGround(folder)
	World.part("Island", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(Data.ISLAND_WIDTH, 2, Data.ISLAND_DEPTH), Color3.fromRGB(235, 215, 160), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Sand)
	World.part("Sea", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(700, 1, 600), Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 200), Vector3.new(0, -2.5, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Water)
	-- A sandy rim so the island reads as a beach from above.
	World.part("BeachNorth", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(Data.ISLAND_WIDTH, 0.5, 8), Color3.fromRGB(245, 230, 180), Vector3.new(0, 0.2, -96), folder, Enum.Material.Sand)
	World.part("BeachSouth", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(Data.ISLAND_WIDTH, 0.5, 8), Color3.fromRGB(245, 230, 180), Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 96), folder, Enum.Material.Sand)
	-- Low walls around the edge so players stay on the island.
	World.part("WallNorth", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(Data.ISLAND_WIDTH, 4, 2), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), Vector3.new(0, 2, -99), folder, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	World.part("WallSouth", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(Data.ISLAND_WIDTH, 4, 2), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), Vector3.new(0, 2, 99), folder, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	World.part("WallWest", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2, 4, Data.ISLAND_DEPTH), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), Vector3.new(-133, 2, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	World.part("WallEast", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2, 4, Data.ISLAND_DEPTH), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), Vector3.new(133, 2, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Concrete)
end

-- The long belt down the middle of the island, with rails on both
-- sides and a glowing strip so it reads from far away.
local function buildConveyor(folder)
	local belt = World.part("Belt", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(262, 2, 10), Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80), Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Metal)
	World.part("BeltStripe", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(262, 0.3, 1), Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40), Vector3.new(0, 2.1, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Neon)
	World.part("RailNorth", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(262, 1.5, 1), Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50), Vector3.new(0, 2.5, -5.5), folder, Enum.Material.Metal)
	World.part("RailSouth", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(262, 1.5, 1), Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50), Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 5.5), folder, Enum.Material.Metal)
	-- Loading dock at the west end where new brainrots appear.
	World.part("Dock", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(8, 3, 14), Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 50), Vector3.new(-131, 1.5, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Wood)
	-- Exit gate at the east end where unsold brainrots leave.
	World.part("ExitGate", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2, 6, 12), Color3.fromRGB(150, 60, 60), Vector3.new(131, 3, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Metal)
	return belt
end

-- One safehouse pad: a raised floor, eight stand slots in two rows, a
-- sign, a roof deck above it (the dry spot in a tsunami) and a ramp up
-- to that roof.
local function buildBase(folder, index, position)
	local pad = Instance.new("Folder")
	pad.Name = "Base" .. tostring(index)
	pad.Parent = folder

	local floor = World.part("Floor", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(34, 1, 26), Color3.fromRGB(180, 160, 120), position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), pad, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	floor.CanCollide = true
	-- A coloured border so each base is easy to tell apart.
	local borderColors = {
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90),
		Color3.fromRGB(90, 160, 255),
		Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 120),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60),
		Color3.fromRGB(200, 120, 255),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 200),
	}
	World.part("Border", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(34, 0.4, 2), borderColors[index], position + Vector3.new(0, 1.1, -12), pad, Enum.Material.Neon)
	World.part("BorderBack", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(34, 0.4, 2), borderColors[index], position + Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 12), pad, Enum.Material.Neon)

	-- Eight stand slots: two rows of four.
	local stands = {}
	local columns = { -12, -4, 4, 12 }
	local rows = { -6, 6 }
	for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
		for _, column in ipairs(columns) do
			local slot = position + Vector3.new(column, 0, row)
			local disc = World.part("Stand", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.6, 4.4, 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230), slot + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), pad, Enum.Material.Metal)
			disc.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			table.insert(stands, { position = slot + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0), pad = disc, occupant = nil })
		end
	end

	-- Roof deck above the stands: the dry spot when the wave comes.
	local roof = World.part("Roof", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(30, 1, 22), Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110), position + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0), pad, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	-- Four posts holding the roof up.
	for _, dx in ipairs({ -14, 14 }) do
		for _, dz in ipairs({ -10, 10 }) do
			World.part("RoofPost", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1, 11, 1), Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 130), position + Vector3.new(dx, 6, dz), pad, Enum.Material.Metal)
		end
	end
	-- A ramp up to the roof on the side facing the conveyor. The end
	-- toward the belt sits low on the ground and the end toward the base
	-- rises to the roof: the tilt leans toward the belt.
	local ramp = World.part("Ramp", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(6, 0.6, 16), Color3.fromRGB(150, 130, 100), position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), pad, Enum.Material.Wood)
	local towardBelt = 1
	if position.Z > 0 then
		towardBelt = -1
	end
	ramp.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 6, towardBelt * 16)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(38 * towardBelt), 0, 0)

	local sign = World.makeSign(pad, position + Vector3.new(0, 1, -11), "Base " .. tostring(index))
	return { index = index, position = position, floor = floor, stands = stands, roof = roof, sign = sign, folder = pad }
end

-- Harbour decoration: crates, barrels, palm trees, lamps and a stack
-- of shipping containers near the east dock.
local function buildDecor(folder)
	local crateSpots = { Vector3.new(-100, 0, -70), Vector3.new(-96, 0, -66), Vector3.new(100, 0, 70), Vector3.new(104, 0, 66), Vector3.new(-60, 0, 80), Vector3.new(60, 0, -80) }
	for i, spot in ipairs(crateSpots) do
		World.part("Crate" .. tostring(i), Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(4, 4, 4), Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 60), spot + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Wood)
	end
	local barrelSpots = { Vector3.new(-110, 0, 40), Vector3.new(-108, 0, 44), Vector3.new(110, 0, -40), Vector3.new(108, 0, -44) }
	for i, spot in ipairs(barrelSpots) do
		World.part("Barrel" .. tostring(i), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(2.5, 2, 2.5), Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 50), spot + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Metal)
	end
	-- Palm trees along the beach edges.
	local palmSpots = { Vector3.new(-120, 0, -85), Vector3.new(-40, 0, -85), Vector3.new(40, 0, -85), Vector3.new(120, 0, -85), Vector3.new(-120, 0, 85), Vector3.new(120, 0, 85) }
	for i, spot in ipairs(palmSpots) do
		local trunk = World.part("PalmTrunk" .. tostring(i), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(10, 1.2, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 60), spot + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Wood)
		trunk.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 8)
		World.part("PalmTop" .. tostring(i), Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(5, 3, 5), Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 80), spot + Vector3.new(0, 11, 0), folder, Enum.Material.Grass)
	end
	-- Lamp posts so the island reads at a glance.
	for i, x in ipairs({ -100, -50, 0, 50, 100 }) do
		World.part("Lamp" .. tostring(i), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(8, 0.6, 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60), Vector3.new(x, 4, 20), folder, Enum.Material.Metal)
		local bulb = World.part("LampBulb" .. tostring(i), Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6), Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 150), Vector3.new(x, 8.5, 20), folder, Enum.Material.Neon)
		bulb.CanCollide = false
	end
	-- Shipping containers stacked near the east end.
	World.part("ContainerA", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(12, 5, 5), Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 200), Vector3.new(115, 2.5, 60), folder, Enum.Material.Metal)
	World.part("ContainerB", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(12, 5, 5), Color3.fromRGB(200, 90, 60), Vector3.new(115, 7.5, 60), folder, Enum.Material.Metal)
	World.part("ContainerC", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(12, 5, 5), Color3.fromRGB(90, 180, 90), Vector3.new(100, 2.5, 60), folder, Enum.Material.Metal)
	-- Buoys bobbing in the sea outside the walls.
	for i, spot in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-60, 0, -130), Vector3.new(60, 0, -130), Vector3.new(-60, 0, 130), Vector3.new(60, 0, 130) }) do
		World.part("Buoy" .. tostring(i), Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, 2.5), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40), spot + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), folder)
	end
end

-- The merchant stall near the conveyor, and the tall lookout deck in
-- the middle of the island for watching the wave come in.
local function buildLandmarks(folder)
	-- Merchant stall: a counter and a striped awning.
	World.part("StallCounter", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(10, 3, 4), Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 70), Vector3.new(-40, 1.5, 24), folder, Enum.Material.Wood)
	World.part("StallAwning", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(12, 0.6, 6), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), Vector3.new(-40, 6, 24), folder, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	for i, dx in ipairs({ -4, 0, 4 }) do
		World.part("StallPost" .. tostring(i), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(5, 0.5, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(80, 60, 40), Vector3.new(-40 + dx, 3, 26.5), folder, Enum.Material.Wood)
	end
	-- Lookout deck: a high platform with a ramp, the best view of the belt.
	local deck = World.part("LookoutDeck", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(18, 1, 14), Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 120), Vector3.new(0, 14, 34), folder, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	for _, dx in ipairs({ -8, 8 }) do
		for _, dz in ipairs({ -6, 6 }) do
			World.part("LookoutPost", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1, 13, 1), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 140), Vector3.new(dx, 7, 34 + dz), folder, Enum.Material.Metal)
		end
	end
	local ramp = World.part("LookoutRamp", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(6, 0.6, 18), Color3.fromRGB(150, 130, 100), Vector3.new(0, 7, 44), folder, Enum.Material.Wood)
	ramp.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 7, 44) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(38), 0, 0)
	return deck
end

-- Build the whole island and hand back every reference the services
-- need: the belt, the six bases, the merchant spot and the lookout.
function World.build()
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "BlitzWorld"
	folder.Parent = workspace

	-- Bright morning light over the harbour.
	local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	lighting.ClockTime = Data.CLOCK_TIME
	lighting.Brightness = 2
	lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 150)
	lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 180)

	buildGround(folder)
	local belt = buildConveyor(folder)
	buildDecor(folder)
	local lookout = buildLandmarks(folder)

	local bases = {}
	for i, position in ipairs(Data.BASE_POSITIONS) do
		bases[i] = buildBase(folder, i, position)
	end

	return {
		folder = folder,
		belt = belt,
		beltStart = Vector3.new(Data.CONVEYOR_MIN_X, 2, 0),
		beltEnd = Vector3.new(Data.CONVEYOR_MAX_X, 2, 0),
		bases = bases,
		merchantSpot = Vector3.new(-40, 0, 24),
		lookout = lookout,
	}
end

return World

-- Brainrot Blitz -- server bootstrap.
-- This script starts the whole game: it creates the remotes the client
-- talks through, builds the island, then starts each service in the order
-- they depend on each other. Money first (everyone asks it for cash),
-- then the plots, the conveyor, stealing, shields, waves and the merchant.
-- Nothing here builds the world itself; that is World's job.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local BrainrotData = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))
local World = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("World"))
local MoneyService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MoneyService"))
local BaseService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("BaseService"))
local ConveyorService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ConveyorService"))
local StealService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("StealService"))
local ShieldService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ShieldService"))
local WaveService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("WaveService"))
local MerchantService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MerchantService"))

-- The remotes. Events the client fires go up; events the server fires go
-- down; the one function answers a question on the spot.
local remotesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
remotesFolder.Name = "BrainrotRemotes"
remotesFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function event(name)
	local e = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	e.Name = name
	e.Parent = remotesFolder
	return e
end

local function func(name)
	local f = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = remotesFolder
	return f
end

local ctx = {}
ctx.Data = BrainrotData
ctx.Remotes = {
	BuyMerchant = event("BuyMerchant"),
	SellCarried = event("SellCarried"),
	PlaceCarried = event("PlaceCarried"),
	UpgradeStand = event("UpgradeStand"),
	ToggleShield = event("ToggleShield"),
	DoRebirth = event("DoRebirth"),
	PushState = event("PushState"),
	PushWave = event("PushWave"),
	PushShield = event("PushShield"),
	OpenShop = event("OpenShop"),
	RequestIndex = func("RequestIndex"),
}

-- The island first, then the services that live on it.
ctx.World = World.build(ctx)
MoneyService.start(ctx)
BaseService.start(ctx)
ConveyorService.start(ctx)
StealService.start(ctx)
ShieldService.start(ctx)
WaveService.start(ctx)
MerchantService.start(ctx)

-- The index menu asks which characters this player already owns, so it
-- can tick them off in the catalogue.
ctx.Remotes.RequestIndex.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local owned = {}
	local plot = ctx.Bases.getPlot(player)
	if plot then
		for _, slot in ipairs(plot.stands) do
			if slot.model then
				local key = slot.model:GetAttribute("CharacterKey")
				if key then
					owned[key] = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local list = {}
	for key in pairs(owned) do
		table.insert(list, key)
	end
	return list
end

print("[Brainrot Blitz] server ready: island, plots, conveyor, shield, waves, merchant.")

-- BrainrotData: the shared catalogue for Brainrot Blitz.
-- Every character, tier, price, income rate, mutation rule and economy
-- constant lives here so server and client always agree on the numbers.
-- The characters are ordered from the cheapest to the most expensive.

local BrainrotData = {}

BrainrotData.TIERS = { "Common", "Rare", "Epic", "Legendary", "Mythic" }

-- One entry per character. `body` is the main body colour, `accent` the
-- colour of the character's signature feature, `caption` a short joke
-- shown under the name in the index menu.
BrainrotData.CHARACTERS = {
	{ name = "Tung Tung Tung Sahur", tier = "Common", price = 50, income = 3, body = Color3.fromRGB(139, 90, 43), accent = Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 30), caption = "Ketuk-ketuk sahur!" },
	{ name = "Boneca Ambalabu", tier = "Common", price = 75, income = 4, body = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 200), accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 170), caption = "Boneka paling imut." },
	{ name = "Trippi Troppi", tier = "Common", price = 110, income = 6, body = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 60), accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90), caption = "Ikan tropis ceria." },
	{ name = "Lirili Larila", tier = "Rare", price = 180, income = 10, body = Color3.fromRGB(60, 190, 170), accent = Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 120), caption = "Gajah kaktus berduri." },
	{ name = "Frigo Camelo", tier = "Rare", price = 260, income = 14, body = Color3.fromRGB(170, 220, 245), accent = Color3.fromRGB(120, 170, 220), caption = "Kulkas unta yang dingin." },
	{ name = "Chimpanzini Bananini", tier = "Rare", price = 380, income = 20, body = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80), accent = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 50), caption = "Monyet pisang lincah." },
	{ name = "Brr Brr Patapim", tier = "Epic", price = 550, income = 30, body = Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255), accent = Color3.fromRGB(230, 245, 255), caption = "Dingin sampai menggigit." },
	{ name = "Ballerina Cappuccina", tier = "Epic", price = 800, income = 45, body = Color3.fromRGB(245, 225, 190), accent = Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 110), caption = "Balerina kopi yang anggun." },
	{ name = "Cappuccino Assassino", tier = "Epic", price = 1100, income = 60, body = Color3.fromRGB(80, 50, 35), accent = Color3.fromRGB(40, 25, 18), caption = "Kopi yang berbahaya." },
	{ name = "Orangutini Ananasini", tier = "Legendary", price = 1600, income = 90, body = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40), accent = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 60), caption = "Orangutan nanas raja hutan." },
	{ name = "La Vaca Saturno Saturnita", tier = "Legendary", price = 2400, income = 130, body = Color3.fromRGB(170, 130, 220), accent = Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 90), caption = "Sapi Saturnus bercincin." },
	{ name = "Tralalero Tralala", tier = "Mythic", price = 3800, income = 210, body = Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 255), accent = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255), caption = "Hiu legendaris tiga sepatu." },
	{ name = "Bombardiro Crocodilo", tier = "Mythic", price = 5500, income = 300, body = Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 80), accent = Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 50), caption = "Buaya bomber paling ganas." },
}

-- Mutations: a small slice of spawns comes out Diamond (three times the
-- income) and a slightly bigger slice comes out Gold (twice the income).
BrainrotData.MUTATION_GOLD_CHANCE = 0.10
BrainrotData.MUTATION_DIAMOND_CHANCE = 0.04
BrainrotData.MUTATION_GOLD_MULT = 2
BrainrotData.MUTATION_DIAMOND_MULT = 3

-- Starting money and stands.
BrainrotData.START_CASH = 150
BrainrotData.START_STANDS = 4
BrainrotData.MAX_STANDS = 8
-- Each extra stand costs more than the last, growing with the square of
-- how many extra stands the player already bought.
BrainrotData.UPGRADE_BASE = 250
BrainrotData.SELL_RATE = 0.5

-- Rebirth: each rebirth lifts every income by half again, and the price
-- of the next rebirth grows with how many rebirths are already done.
BrainrotData.REBIRTH_BASE = 12000
BrainrotData.REBIRTH_MULT = 1.5
BrainrotData.REBIRTH_STORE = "BlitzRebirthsV1"

-- The conveyor belt runs along X in the middle of the island.
BrainrotData.CONVEYOR_MIN_X = -131
BrainrotData.CONVEYOR_MAX_X = 131
BrainrotData.CONVEYOR_SPAWN_EVERY = 3.5
BrainrotData.CONVEYOR_SPEED = 4.2

-- A shield lasts a while, then needs a long cooldown before it can be
-- raised again. The cooldown is counted after the shield ends.
BrainrotData.SHIELD_DURATION = 26
BrainrotData.SHIELD_COOLDOWN = 48

-- The tsunami cycle: first wave, warning, sweep, then the gap to the
-- next wave.
BrainrotData.WAVE_FIRST_AT = 52
BrainrotData.WAVE_WARN_FOR = 14
BrainrotData.WAVE_SWEEP_FOR = 8
BrainrotData.WAVE_GAP = 54
-- Standing higher than this keeps a player dry during the sweep.
BrainrotData.WAVE_SAFE_HEIGHT = 10

-- The six safehouses: two on the centre line, four in the corners.
BrainrotData.BASE_POSITIONS = {
	Vector3.new(0, 0, -51),
	Vector3.new(0, 0, 51),
	Vector3.new(-82, 0, -51),
	Vector3.new(-82, 0, 51),
	Vector3.new(82, 0, -51),
	Vector3.new(82, 0, 51),
}

-- The island itself: a harbour rectangle in bright morning light.
BrainrotData.ISLAND_WIDTH = 268
BrainrotData.ISLAND_DEPTH = 200
BrainrotData.CLOCK_TIME = 10.5

-- Cost of buying the next stand when the player already has `stands`.
function BrainrotData.upgradeCost(stands)
	local extra = stands - BrainrotData.START_STANDS + 1
	return BrainrotData.UPGRADE_BASE * extra * extra
end

-- Cost of the next rebirth when the player already has `rebirths`.
function BrainrotData.rebirthCost(rebirths)
	return BrainrotData.REBIRTH_BASE * (rebirths + 1)
end

-- Income multiplier from rebirths: each rebirth adds half again.
function BrainrotData.rebirthMultiplier(rebirths)
	return BrainrotData.REBIRTH_MULT ^ rebirths
end

-- Roll a mutation for a fresh spawn. Returns "Diamond", "Gold" or "Normal".
function BrainrotData.rollMutation()
	local roll = math.random()
	if roll < BrainrotData.MUTATION_DIAMOND_CHANCE then
		return "Diamond"
	elseif roll < BrainrotData.MUTATION_DIAMOND_CHANCE + BrainrotData.MUTATION_GOLD_CHANCE then
		return "Gold"
	end
	return "Normal"
end

-- Multiplier a mutation applies to a character's income.
function BrainrotData.mutationMultiplier(mutation)
	if mutation == "Diamond" then
		return BrainrotData.MUTATION_DIAMOND_MULT
	elseif mutation == "Gold" then
		return BrainrotData.MUTATION_GOLD_MULT
	end
	return 1
end

-- Look a character up by name. Returns the entry or nil.
function BrainrotData.findCharacter(name)
	for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotData.CHARACTERS) do
		if entry.name == name then
			return entry
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Pick a random character, weighted so cheap ones show up most often.
function BrainrotData.randomCharacter()
	local total = 0
	for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotData.CHARACTERS) do
		total += 1 / entry.price
	end
	local pick = math.random() * total
	for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotData.CHARACTERS) do
		pick -= 1 / entry.price
		if pick <= 0 then
			return entry
		end
	end
	return BrainrotData.CHARACTERS[1]
end

-- Income per second of one character on a stand, with mutation and
-- rebirth applied.
function BrainrotData.incomePerSecond(entry, mutation, rebirths)
	return entry.income * BrainrotData.mutationMultiplier(mutation) * BrainrotData.rebirthMultiplier(rebirths)
end

return BrainrotData

-- probe: scene-audit
-- datamodel: any
-- params: root=workspace
-- purpose: One-pass health check of a place for the traps that most often break agent-built games. Every line is a
--   lead to read, not a verdict.
local root = {{root}}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local counts, leads = {}, {}
local function bump(k) counts[k] = (counts[k] or 0) + 1 end
local function lead(k, inst, why)
	bump(k)
	if counts[k] <= 3 then table.insert(leads, string.format("[%s] %s - %s", k, inst:GetFullName(), why)) end
end
local function inCharacter(inst)
	local m = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	while m do
		if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) or m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
		m = m:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	end
	return false
end
for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
	if d:IsA("BasePart") then
		bump("parts")
		if not d.Anchored and not inCharacter(d) and #d:GetJoints() == 0 then lead("loose", d, "unanchored and unwelded: it will fall or drift") end
		if d.CanCollide and d.Transparency >= 0.99 and not inCharacter(d) then lead("invisible-wall", d, "invisible but collidable") end
		if d.Size.Magnitude > 2048 then lead("huge", d, "very large part: physics/streaming cost") end
	elseif d:IsA("LocalScript") and not inCharacter(d) then
		lead("localscript-in-world", d, "LocalScripts do not run in Workspace unless inside a player's character")
	elseif d:IsA("Sound") and d.SoundId == "" then
		lead("silent-sound", d, "Sound with no SoundId")
	elseif (d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton")) and d.Image == "" and d.BackgroundTransparency >= 1 then
		lead("blank-image", d, "image element with no Image and no background: draws nothing")
	elseif d:IsA("Decal") and d.Texture == "" then
		lead("blank-decal", d, "Decal with no Texture")
	elseif d:IsA("SurfaceGui") and not d.ClipsDescendants then
		bump("surfacegui-unclipped")
	elseif d:IsA("PointLight") or d:IsA("SpotLight") or d:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
		bump("lights")
		if d.Shadows then bump("shadow-lights") end
	elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and d.Enabled then
		bump("emitters")
	end
end
for _, s in game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):GetDescendants() do
	if s:IsA("Script") and s.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Legacy then lead("script-in-replicated", s, "server Scripts do not run in ReplicatedStorage") end
end
for _, s in game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):GetDescendants() do
	if s:IsA("LocalScript") then lead("localscript-on-server", s, "LocalScripts never run in ServerScriptService") end
end
local summary = {}
for k, v in counts do table.insert(summary, k .. "=" .. v) end

if (counts["surfacegui-unclipped"] or 0) > 0 then table.insert(leads, "NOTE: unclipped SurfaceGuis - run gui-overflow if anything shows where it should not") end

-- Brainrot Blitz -- shared character and economy data.
-- The single source of truth for every number the game uses. This module
-- lives in ReplicatedStorage, so the client reads it too: nothing here may
-- call a server-only service. Every value below is my own design choice,
-- picked so the progression feels fair from the first buy to the last.

local BrainrotData = {}

-- Five rarity tiers. The weight decides how often a tier shows up on the
-- conveyor; the color tints the name label and the stand plaque.
BrainrotData.Rarities = {
	Common = { weight = 50, color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 200, 140) },
	Rare = { weight = 27, color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 170, 255) },
	Epic = { weight = 15, color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 140, 255) },
	Legendary = { weight = 6, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90) },
	Mythic = { weight = 2, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 160) },
}

-- Thirteen viral-named characters, cheapest first. Income is roughly a
-- tenth of the price, so a character pays for itself after about ten
-- seconds on a stand; each tier costs about twice the one below it.
BrainrotData.Characters = {
	{ key = "sahur", name = "Tung Tung Tung Sahur", rarity = "Common", price = 45, income = 5, body = Color3.fromRGB(150, 95, 50), caption = "Log drum spirit" },
	{ key = "boneca", name = "Boneca Ambalabu", rarity = "Common", price = 70, income = 8, body = Color3.fromRGB(110, 190, 90), caption = "One-legged frog friend" },
	{ key = "trippi", name = "Trippi Troppi", rarity = "Common", price = 100, income = 12, body = Color3.fromRGB(240, 130, 90), caption = "Curious shrimp cat" },
	{ key = "lirili", name = "Lirili Larila", rarity = "Rare", price = 210, income = 25, body = Color3.fromRGB(200, 175, 120), caption = "Desert wanderer" },
	{ key = "frigo", name = "Frigo Camelo", rarity = "Rare", price = 360, income = 42, body = Color3.fromRGB(170, 215, 235), caption = "Chilly cargo camel" },
	{ key = "banana", name = "Chimpanzini Bananini", rarity = "Rare", price = 520, income = 62, body = Color3.fromRGB(245, 200, 70), caption = "Banana bunch buddy" },
	{ key = "patapim", name = "Brr Brr Patapim", rarity = "Epic", price = 900, income = 108, body = Color3.fromRGB(90, 150, 80), caption = "Forest stomper" },
	{ key = "ballerina", name = "Ballerina Cappuccina", rarity = "Epic", price = 1450, income = 175, body = Color3.fromRGB(240, 140, 170), caption = "Tiny twirling dancer" },
	{ key = "assassino", name = "Cappuccino Assassino", rarity = "Epic", price = 2200, income = 265, body = Color3.fromRGB(95, 75, 105), caption = "Quiet coffee agent" },
	{ key = "ananasini", name = "Orangutini Ananasini", rarity = "Legendary", price = 3900, income = 470, body = Color3.fromRGB(230, 165, 60), caption = "Crowned fruit king" },
	{ key = "vaca", name = "La Vaca Saturno Saturnita", rarity = "Legendary", price = 5800, income = 700, body = Color3.fromRGB(235, 220, 190), caption = "Ringed space cow" },
	{ key = "tralala", name = "Tralalero Tralala", rarity = "Mythic", price = 9800, income = 1180, body = Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 230), caption = "Three-legged shark singer" },
	{ key = "crocodilo", name = "Bombardiro Crocodilo", rarity = "Mythic", price = 15500, income = 1850, body = Color3.fromRGB(120, 140, 70), caption = "Flying bomber croc" },
}

-- Mutations: most spawns are plain; a few are Gold (double income) and a
-- rare few are Diamond (triple income). The chances add up to one.
BrainrotData.Mutations = {
	Normal = { mult = 1, chance = 0.80 },
	Gold = { mult = 2, chance = 0.16 },
	Diamond = { mult = 3, chance = 0.04 },
}

-- The economy. A player starts with a little cash and four stands, can grow
-- to eight, sells for half price, and rebirths for a permanent boost.
BrainrotData.Economy = {
	StartCash = 150,
	StartStands = 4,
	MaxStands = 8,
	SellFraction = 0.5,
	RebirthBonus = 0.5,
	RebirthBase = 12000,
	StoreName = "BlitzRebirthsV1",
}

-- Timings, in seconds (or studs, for the belt). The shield stays up for a
-- while, then needs a long cooldown before it can be raised again.
BrainrotData.Timing = {
	SpawnInterval = 3.4,
	BeltSpeed = 4.2,
	BeltMinX = -131,
	BeltMaxX = 131,
	WaveFirst = 52,
	WaveWarn = 14,
	WaveSweep = 8,
	WaveGap = 54,
	ShieldUp = 26,
	ShieldCooldown = 48,
}

-- The six plots: two on each side and two in the middle, spread across the
-- island so every player has neighbours to raid and room to grow.
BrainrotData.Plots = {
	{ x = -82, z = -51 },
	{ x = -82, z = 51 },
	{ x = 0, z = -51 },
	{ x = 0, z = 51 },
	{ x = 82, z = -51 },
	{ x = 82, z = 51 },
}

local rng = Random.new()

-- Pick a mutation by rolling once against the chances above.
function BrainrotData.rollMutation()
	local roll = rng:NextNumber()
	local acc = 0
	for name, m in pairs(BrainrotData.Mutations) do
		acc += m.chance
		if roll <= acc then
			return name
		end
	end
	return "Normal"
end

-- Pick a character: first a rarity by weight, then any character of it.
function BrainrotData.rollCharacter()
	local total = 0
	for _, r in pairs(BrainrotData.Rarities) do
		total += r.weight
	end
	local roll = rng:NextInteger(1, total)
	local acc = 0
	local picked = "Common"
	for name, r in pairs(BrainrotData.Rarities) do
		acc += r.weight
		if roll <= acc then
			picked = name
			break
		end
	end
	local pool = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(BrainrotData.Characters) do
		if c.rarity == picked then
			table.insert(pool, c)
		end
	end
	return pool[rng:NextInteger(1, #pool)]
end

-- Find one character by its key, or nil when the key is unknown.
function BrainrotData.find(key)
	for _, c in ipairs(BrainrotData.Characters) do
		if c.key == key then
			return c
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Dollars per second one character earns on a stand, after mutation and
-- after the owner's rebirth bonus.
function BrainrotData.incomeOf(char, mutation, rebirths)
	local m = BrainrotData.Mutations[mutation] or BrainrotData.Mutations.Normal
	local bonus = 1 + BrainrotData.Economy.RebirthBonus * (rebirths or 0)
	return char.income * m.mult * bonus
end

-- What a character sells for: half its buy price, rounded down.
function BrainrotData.sellPriceOf(char)
	return math.floor(char.price * BrainrotData.Economy.SellFraction)
end

-- What adding one more stand costs. The price grows with the square of how
-- many stands past the starting four the player already has.
function BrainrotData.upgradeCost(stands)
	local step = stands - (BrainrotData.Economy.StartStands - 1)
	return 550 * step * step
end

-- What the next rebirth costs: a flat base times one more than the rebirths
-- the player already has.
function BrainrotData.rebirthCost(rebirths)
	return BrainrotData.Economy.RebirthBase * ((rebirths or 0) + 1)
end

return BrainrotData

-- probe: sound-audit
-- datamodel: Client
-- params: seconds=4 extra=""
-- purpose: Which sounds will actually play? Collects every SoundId the place refers to (Sound instances, plus ids
--   written in script sources and any comma-separated `extra` ids), loads each one muted and reports the ones that
--   never load. A missing sound raises no error - it is just silent - so "the gun sounds are gone" needs this.
--   It also flags rbxasset:// files that are not stock Roblox content: those live in the versioned Studio install
--   folder, vanish on every Studio update and never exist for real players.
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local ids, order = {}, {}
local function add(id)
	if type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" and not ids[id] then
		ids[id] = true
		order[#order + 1] = id
	end
end
local roots = { workspace, SoundService, game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst"),
	game:GetService("StarterGui"), game:GetService("StarterPack"), game:GetService("StarterPlayer") }
for _, root in roots do
	for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("Sound") then
			add(d.SoundId)
		elseif d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			local ok, src = pcall(function()
				return d.Source
			end)
			if ok and type(src) == "string" then
				for _, ext in { "wav", "mp3", "ogg" } do
					for id in src:gmatch("rbxasset://[%w_/%.%- ]+%." .. ext) do
						add(id)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
for id in string.gmatch({{extra}}, "[^,]+") do
	add((id:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")))
end
local probes = {}
for _, id in order do
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name, s.SoundId, s.Volume = "ForgeSoundAudit", id, 0
	s.Parent = SoundService
	probes[id] = s
end
task.wait({{seconds}})
local missing, localOnly, loaded = {}, {}, 0
for _, id in order do
	local s = probes[id]
	if s.IsLoaded and s.TimeLength > 0 then
		loaded += 1
	else
		missing[#missing + 1] = id
	end
	-- Stock content sits directly in sounds/; a subfolder is something a tool copied into this install.
	if id:match("^rbxasset://sounds/[^/]+/") then
		localOnly[#localOnly + 1] = id
	end
	s:Destroy()
end
local out = { string.format("%d sound ids, %d load, %d do NOT load", #order, loaded, #missing) }
for _, id in missing do
	out[#out + 1] = "NOT LOADED  " .. id
end
if #localOnly > 0 then
	out[#out + 1] = string.format(
		"%d id(s) are local Studio content (rbxasset://sounds/<folder>/...): wiped by a Studio update and absent for players; upload them as audio assets before shipping. First: %s",
		#localOnly, localOnly[1])
end
return table.concat(out, "\n")

-- probe: ui-audit
-- datamodel: Client
-- params: minText=11
-- purpose: Objective UI checks on the live client: text too small to read, elements off-screen or clipped by the
--   window, ScreenGuis that reset on respawn (state lost), duplicates of one HUD. Run it at the target resolution;
--   then still LOOK at a capture - these checks cannot judge taste.
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
local out, names = {}, {}
local small, off, total = 0, 0, 0
for _, sg in player.PlayerGui:GetChildren() do
	if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") and sg.Enabled then
		names[sg.Name] = (names[sg.Name] or 0) + 1
		if sg.ResetOnSpawn and #sg:GetDescendants() > 20 then
			table.insert(out, "RESET " .. sg.Name .. " has ResetOnSpawn = true: rebuilt (and state lost) on every respawn")
		end
		for _, g in sg:GetDescendants() do
			if g:IsA("GuiObject") and g.Visible and g.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
				total += 1
				local p, s = g.AbsolutePosition, g.AbsoluteSize
				if p.X + s.X < 0 or p.Y + s.Y < -40 or p.X > vp.X or p.Y > vp.Y then
					off += 1
					if off <= 5 then table.insert(out, "OFFSCREEN " .. g:GetFullName()) end
				end
				if (g:IsA("TextLabel") or g:IsA("TextButton")) and not g.TextScaled and g.Text ~= "" and g.TextTransparency < 0.9 then
					-- effective size: multiply every UIScale on the way up to the ScreenGui
					local scale, a = 1, g
					while a and a:IsA("GuiObject") do
						local u = a:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
						if u then scale *= u.Scale end
						a = a.Parent
					end
					if g.TextSize * scale < {{minText}} then
						small += 1
						if small <= 8 then table.insert(out, string.format("SMALLTEXT %.0fpx %s %q", g.TextSize * scale, g:GetFullName(), g.Text:sub(1, 30))) end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
for n, c in names do
	if c > 1 then table.insert(out, "DUPLICATE ScreenGui " .. n .. " x" .. c .. " (a script runs twice or the gui is not cleaned up)") end
end
table.insert(out, 1, string.format("viewport %dx%d | visible gui objects %d | small text %d | off-screen %d", vp.X, vp.Y, total, small, off))
return table.concat(out, "\n")

-- probe: whereis
-- datamodel: any
-- params: pattern="Door" root=game limit=30
-- purpose: Find instances by name (Lua pattern, case-insensitive) with class, path and world position. Cheaper
--   than reading the explorer tree, and it tells you which datamodel actually has the thing.
local root, pattern, LIMIT = {{root}}, string.lower({{pattern}}), {{limit}}
local out, n = {}, 0
for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
	local ok, name = pcall(function() return d.Name end)
	if ok and string.find(string.lower(name), pattern) then
		n += 1
		if n <= LIMIT then
			local pos = ""
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then pos = tostring(d.Position)
			elseif d:IsA("Model") then
				local okp, pv = pcall(function() return d:GetPivot().Position end)
				if okp then pos = tostring(pv) end
			end
			table.insert(out, string.format("%-16s %s %s", d.ClassName, d:GetFullName(), pos))
		end
	end
end
table.insert(out, 1, string.format("%d match(es) for %q", n, pattern))
return table.concat(out, "\n")

-- SOFTWARE.

local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Pose={}
function Pose.start(player)
 local joints={}
 local character
 local function bind(char)
  joints={} character=char
  task.spawn(function()
   char:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
   task.wait(0.4)
   if character~=char then return end
   for _,v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
    if v:IsA("Motor6D") and (v.Name=="Right Shoulder" or v.Name=="Left Shoulder" or v.Name=="RightShoulder" or v.Name=="LeftShoulder") then
     table.insert(joints,{joint=v,neutral=v.C0})
    end
   end
  end)
 end
 player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bind)
 if player.Character then bind(player.Character) end
 Run.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
  if player:GetAttribute("Carrying") then
   for _,record in ipairs(joints) do if record.joint.Parent then record.joint.Transform=CFrame.identity end end
  end
 end)
 Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
  local carrying=player:GetAttribute("Carrying")==true
  for _,record in ipairs(joints) do
   if record.joint.Parent then
    local r6=record.joint.Name:find(" ")~=nil
    local right=record.joint.Name:find("Right")~=nil
    local rotation=r6 and CFrame.Angles(0,0,right and math.rad(155) or math.rad(-155)) or CFrame.Angles(math.rad(165),0,right and -0.15 or 0.15)
    record.joint.C0=carrying and record.neutral*rotation or record.neutral
    if carrying then record.joint.Transform=CFrame.identity end
   end
  end
 end)
end
return Pose

-- Showcase switcher for screenshots: shows one UI kit at a time.
-- 1 HUD | 2 Shop/Index | 3 Roll | 4 Skill Tree | 5 Admin | 6 Roles/Nametags | 7 Square Shine | 8 Top Donators | 9 UI Pack | M Limited Store | P Steal Egg | 0 everything
-- L shows / hides the Roblox player list. The main menu is shown alone first; press PLAY to get to the kits.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local MODES = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.One] = { name = "HUD Kit", guis = { "MainHUD" } },
	[Enum.KeyCode.Two] = { name = "Shop / Index Buttons", guis = { "Ui Buttons" } },
	[Enum.KeyCode.Three] = { name = "Roll & Reward Reveal", guis = { "Roll" } },
	[Enum.KeyCode.Four] = { name = "Skill Tree (press K)", guis = { "SkillTree" } },
	[Enum.KeyCode.Five] = { name = "Admin Panel (press F2)", guis = { "AdminPanel" } },
	[Enum.KeyCode.Six] = { name = "Nametags & Roles (press H)", guis = { "RolesPanel" } },
	[Enum.KeyCode.Seven] = { name = "Square Shine Buttons", guis = { "Shop Rebirth UI" } },
	-- the board is 3D, so this mode hides the 2D kits and walks you up to it
	[Enum.KeyCode.Eight] = { name = "Top Donators (walk up + press E)", guis = {}, standAt = Vector3.new(0, 3, -5), lookAt = Vector3.new(0, 3, -45) },
	-- the full UI Pack: its HUD + screens, and walks you to its pads and stalls
	[Enum.KeyCode.Nine] = { name = "UI Pack (walk onto a pad)", guis = { "UIPack", "Roll" }, standAt = Vector3.new(0, 3, 12), lookAt = Vector3.new(0, 3, 34) },
	[Enum.KeyCode.M] = { name = "Limited Store (click the button on the left)", guis = { "LimitedStore" } },
	-- the Steal Egg kit: its HUD and menus, and walks you to its stalls and pads
	[Enum.KeyCode.P] = {
		name = "Steal Egg Kit (walk onto a pad)",
		guis = { "HUD", "RobuxShop", "TrailShop", "GrowingEggs", "ActivePets", "PetFuse", "Index Menu New", "Sell Pets", "FreeGift" },
		standAt = Vector3.new(-178, 3, -21),
		lookAt = Vector3.new(-145, 3, -21),
	},
	[Enum.KeyCode.Zero] = { name = "Everything", guis = "all" },
}

-- the kits' own open keys jump straight to their kit, so K / F2 / H always show something
local OPEN_KEYS = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.K] = MODES[Enum.KeyCode.Four],
	[Enum.KeyCode.F2] = MODES[Enum.KeyCode.Five],
	[Enum.KeyCode.H] = MODES[Enum.KeyCode.Six],
}

-- kits whose own scripts switch their ScreenGuis on at start: keep them in line with the current mode
local STICKY_GUIS = {}
for _, n in MODES[Enum.KeyCode.P].guis do
	STICKY_GUIS[n] = true
end

local KIT_GUIS = {}
for _, mode in MODES do
	if type(mode.guis) == "table" then
		for _, n in mode.guis do
			KIT_GUIS[n] = true
		end
	end
end

for _, coreType in { Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack } do
	pcall(StarterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, StarterGui, coreType, false)
end
local playerListShown = false

local current = MODES[Enum.KeyCode.One]
local inMenu = true

local function apply()
	local visible = {}
	if not inMenu then
		if current.guis == "all" then
			for n in KIT_GUIS do
				visible[n] = true
			end
		else
			for _, n in current.guis do
				visible[n] = true
			end
		end
	end
	for _, gui in playerGui:GetChildren() do
		if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and KIT_GUIS[gui.Name] then
			gui.Enabled = visible[gui.Name] == true
		end
	end
end

-- small mode hint that fades out so it never ends up in a screenshot
local hintGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
hintGui.Name = "ShowcaseHint"
hintGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
hintGui.DisplayOrder = 100
hintGui.Parent = playerGui

local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
hint.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
hint.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -12)
hint.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(640, 30)
hint.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
hint.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
hint.TextTransparency = 1
hint.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
hint.TextSize = 18
hint.Parent = hintGui
Instance.new("UICorner", hint).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local hintToken = 0
local function showHint(text)
	hintToken += 1
	local token = hintToken
	hint.Text = text
	hint.TextTransparency = 0
	hint.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	task.delay(2.5, function()
		if token ~= hintToken then
			return
		end
		TweenService:Create(hint, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	end)
end

local function watchMenu(menu)
	local function update()
		local wasInMenu = inMenu
		inMenu = menu.Enabled
		apply()
		if wasInMenu and not inMenu then
			showHint(`Keys 1-9, M and P switch kit  |  K / F2 / H open panels  |  0 = everything`)
		end
	end
	menu:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(update)
	update()
end

local function watchSticky(gui)
	if STICKY_GUIS[gui.Name] then
		gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
			task.defer(apply)
		end)
	end
end

playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if not child:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		return
	end
	if child.Name == "MainMenu" then
		watchMenu(child)
	elseif KIT_GUIS[child.Name] then
		task.defer(apply)
		watchSticky(child)
	end
end)
for _, child in playerGui:GetChildren() do
	if child:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		watchSticky(child)
	end
end

local menu = playerGui:FindFirstChild("MainMenu")
if menu then
	watchMenu(menu)
else
	-- MainMenu may arrive a moment later; keep kits hidden until we know
	task.delay(3, function()
		if not playerGui:FindFirstChild("MainMenu") then
			inMenu = false
			apply()
		end
	end)
	apply()
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or inMenu then
		return
	end
	local mode = MODES[input.KeyCode]
	if mode then
		-- leaving the Steal Egg kit: close its open menu so its background blur goes too
		local stealEggHud = playerGui:FindFirstChild("HUD")
		local closeMenu = stealEggHud and stealEggHud:FindFirstChild("CloseOpenMenu")
		if closeMenu and mode ~= MODES[Enum.KeyCode.P] and mode.guis ~= "all" then
			closeMenu:Fire()
		end
		current = mode
		apply()
		showHint(mode.name)
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		if mode.standAt and character then
			character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(mode.standAt, mode.lookAt))
			-- turn the camera too, otherwise it keeps facing wherever it was
			local back = (mode.standAt - mode.lookAt).Unit * 12
			workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mode.standAt + back + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), mode.lookAt)
		end
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then
		playerListShown = not playerListShown
		pcall(StarterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, StarterGui, Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, playerListShown)
		return
	end
	local openMode = OPEN_KEYS[input.KeyCode]
	if openMode and current ~= openMode and current.guis ~= "all" then
		current = openMode
		apply()
	end
end)

-- probe: world-audit
-- datamodel: any
-- params: root=workspace gap=1 overlap=0.35 reach=40 skip={} max=25
-- purpose: Placement audit of a built world: anchored pieces with nothing under or beside them (floating), pieces
--   whose parts stand inside another piece's parts (a tent in a tower, stones through a wagon), and attachments
--   far from their part (set by world position before they had a parent). A piece is a direct child of root, or
--   of a Folder under it. Every line names the piece and a position; every line is a lead, not a verdict. Names
--   in skip (Luau patterns) are left out of the floating check and listed, so a skip never hides silently.
--   Run after every world rebuild, then still look at a capture.
local root = {{root}}
local GAP, OVERLAP, REACH, MAX = {{gap}}, {{overlap}}, {{reach}}, {{max}}
local SKIP = {{skip}}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local last = os.clock()
local function breathe()
	-- execute_luau holds Studio's main thread until it yields; yield on elapsed time.
	if os.clock() - last > 0.05 then
		task.wait()
		last = os.clock()
	end
end
local function where(p)
	return string.format("(%.0f, %.0f, %.0f)", p.X, p.Y, p.Z)
end

-- Pieces ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local pieces = {}
local function moving(inst)
	if inst:IsA("Model") then
		if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(inst) or inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
local function collect(container)
	for _, c in container:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("Folder") then
			collect(c)
		elseif (c:IsA("Model") or c:IsA("BasePart")) and not c:IsA("Terrain") and not moving(c) then
			table.insert(pieces, c)
		end
	end
end
collect(root)

local function partsOf(piece)
	local list = {}
	if piece:IsA("BasePart") then
		table.insert(list, piece)
	end
	for _, d in piece:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 1 then
			table.insert(list, d)
		end
	end
	return list
end
local function anchored(parts)
	for _, p in parts do
		if p.Anchored then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
local function boxOf(piece)
	if piece:IsA("BasePart") then
		return piece.CFrame, piece.Size
	end
	return piece:GetBoundingBox()
end
local function skipped(name)
	for _, pattern in SKIP do
		if string.find(name, pattern) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 1. Floating: no ray below the footprint meets anything within GAP, and nothing touches the box ----
local floating, skippedNames = {}, {}
for _, piece in pieces do
	breathe()
	local parts = partsOf(piece)
	if #parts > 0 and anchored(parts) then
		if skipped(piece.Name) then
			table.insert(skippedNames, piece.Name)
		else
			local cf, size = boxOf(piece)
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { piece }
			local bottom = cf.Position - Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0)
			local hx, hz = size.X * 0.4, size.Z * 0.4
			local held = false
			for _, o in { Vector3.zero, cf.RightVector * hx, -cf.RightVector * hx, cf.LookVector * hz, -cf.LookVector * hz } do
				local from = bottom + Vector3.new(o.X, 0.5, o.Z)
				if workspace:Raycast(from, Vector3.new(0, -(GAP + 0.5), 0), params) then
					held = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not held then
				-- Hung on a wall or tied to a neighbour: anything else inside the slightly grown box holds it.
				local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
				overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { piece }
				held = #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf, size + Vector3.new(GAP, GAP, GAP) * 2, overlapParams) > 0
			end
			if not held then
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(bottom, Vector3.new(0, -2000, 0), params)
				local drop = hit and (bottom.Y - hit.Position.Y) or math.huge
				table.insert(floating, { piece = piece, at = bottom, drop = drop })
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 2. Inside each other: part pairs from different pieces whose boxes share more than OVERLAP of the smaller ---
-- Estimated in both parts' frames and the smaller estimate kept, so a rotated thin wall does not swallow
-- whatever stands beside it.
local function corners(cf, size)
	local h = size / 2
	local out = {}
	for _, sx in { -1, 1 } do
		for _, sy in { -1, 1 } do
			for _, sz in { -1, 1 } do
				table.insert(out, cf * Vector3.new(h.X * sx, h.Y * sy, h.Z * sz))
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end
local function sharedIn(a, b)
	-- volume of a's box shared with b's box as seen axis-aligned in a's frame
	local h = a.Size / 2
	local lo, hi = Vector3.one * math.huge, -Vector3.one * math.huge
	for _, w in corners(b.CFrame, b.Size) do
		local l = a.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(w)
		lo, hi = lo:Min(l), hi:Max(l)
	end
	local dx = math.min(h.X, hi.X) - math.max(-h.X, lo.X)
	local dy = math.min(h.Y, hi.Y) - math.max(-h.Y, lo.Y)
	local dz = math.min(h.Z, hi.Z) - math.max(-h.Z, lo.Z)
	if dx <= 0 or dy <= 0 or dz <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return dx * dy * dz
end
local function worldBox(cf, size)
	local lo, hi = Vector3.one * math.huge, -Vector3.one * math.huge
	for _, w in corners(cf, size) do
		lo, hi = lo:Min(w), hi:Max(w)
	end
	return lo, hi
end

local boxes = {}
for _, piece in pieces do
	local cf, size = boxOf(piece)
	local lo, hi = worldBox(cf, size)
	table.insert(boxes, { piece = piece, lo = lo, hi = hi })
end
table.sort(boxes, function(x, y)
	return x.lo.X < y.lo.X
end)
local partCache = {}
local function cachedParts(piece)
	-- each entry: { part, lo, hi } with the part's world bounds, computed once
	local p = partCache[piece]
	if not p then
		p = {}
		for _, part in partsOf(piece) do
			local lo, hi = worldBox(part.CFrame, part.Size)
			table.insert(p, { part = part, lo = lo, hi = hi })
		end
		partCache[piece] = p
	end
	return p
end
local function touches(x, lo, hi)
	return x.lo.X < hi.X and x.hi.X > lo.X and x.lo.Y < hi.Y and x.hi.Y > lo.Y and x.lo.Z < hi.Z and x.hi.Z > lo.Z
end
local function within(list, lo, hi)
	-- only the parts of one piece that reach into the other piece's bounds
	local out = {}
	for _, e in list do
		if touches(e, lo, hi) then
			table.insert(out, e)
		end
	end
	return out
end
local inside = {}
for i = 1, #boxes do
	local A = boxes[i]
	for j = i + 1, #boxes do
		local B = boxes[j]
		if B.lo.X > A.hi.X then
			break -- sorted by min X: nothing further along can touch A
		end
		breathe()
		if B.lo.Y < A.hi.Y and B.hi.Y > A.lo.Y and B.lo.Z < A.hi.Z and B.hi.Z > A.lo.Z then
			local worst, at = 0, nil
			local candB = within(cachedParts(B.piece), A.lo, A.hi)
			for _, ea in within(cachedParts(A.piece), B.lo, B.hi) do
				for _, eb in candB do
					local pa, pb = ea.part, eb.part
					local va, vb = pa.Size.X * pa.Size.Y * pa.Size.Z, pb.Size.X * pb.Size.Y * pb.Size.Z
					local small = math.min(va, vb)
					if small > 0.5 and touches(ea, eb.lo, eb.hi) then
						local shared = math.min(sharedIn(pa, pb), sharedIn(pb, pa))
						local ratio = shared / small
						if ratio > worst then
							worst, at = ratio, (if va < vb then pa.Position else pb.Position)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if worst > OVERLAP then
				table.insert(inside, { a = A.piece, b = B.piece, ratio = worst, at = at })
			end
		end
	end
end
table.sort(inside, function(x, y)
	return x.ratio > y.ratio
end)

-- 3. Stray attachments ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
local stray, attachments = {}, 0
for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
	if d:IsA("Attachment") and d.Parent and d.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
		attachments += 1
		local part = d.Parent
		local off = (d.WorldPosition - part.Position).Magnitude
		if off > part.Size.Magnitude / 2 + REACH then
			table.insert(stray, { a = d, off = off })
		end
		breathe()
	end
end

-- Report --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local leads = #floating + #inside + #stray
local out = {
	string.format(
		"WORLD-AUDIT %s: %d pieces, %d attachments under %s (gap %.1f, overlap %.2f, reach %d)",
		leads == 0 and "clean" or (leads .. " leads"),
		#pieces,
		attachments,
		root:GetFullName(),
		GAP,
		OVERLAP,
		REACH
	),
}
local function section(title, list, line)
	if #list == 0 then
		return
	end
	table.insert(out, string.format("%s (%d):", title, #list))
	for i = 1, math.min(#list, MAX) do
		table.insert(out, "  " .. line(list[i]))
	end
	if #list > MAX then
		table.insert(out, string.format("  ... %d more", #list - MAX))
	end
end
section("FLOATING", floating, function(f)
	return string.format(
		"%s bottom at %s, %s",
		f.piece:GetFullName(),
		where(f.at),
		f.drop == math.huge and "nothing below" or string.format("%.1f studs above what is below", f.drop)
	)
end)
section("INSIDE", inside, function(o)
	return string.format("%s / %s share %.0f%% near %s", o.a:GetFullName(), o.b:GetFullName(), o.ratio * 100, where(o.at))
end)
section("STRAY ATTACHMENT", stray, function(s)
	return string.format("%s %.0f studs from its part, at %s", s.a:GetFullName(), s.off, where(s.a.WorldPosition))
end)
if #skippedNames > 0 then
	table.sort(skippedNames)
	table.insert(out, string.format("SKIPPED from the floating check (%d): %s", #skippedNames, table.concat(skippedNames, ", ", 1, math.min(#skippedNames, MAX))))
end
return table.concat(out, "\n")

local function label(name,size,pos,anchor,fontSize)
 local l=Instance.new("TextLabel") l.Name=name l.Size=size l.Position=pos l.AnchorPoint=anchor or Vector2.zero l.BackgroundTransparency=1
 l.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(244,248,255) l.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.fromRGB(19,28,48) l.TextStrokeTransparency=0.12 l.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold l.TextSize=fontSize or 20 l.TextWrapped=true l.Parent=gui return l
end

local wave=label("Wave",UDim2.new(0.6,0,0,56),UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0),Vector2.new(0.5,0),19)
local tip=label("Instructions",UDim2.new(0.72,0,0,55),UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,-10),Vector2.new(0.5,1),14)

local serial=0
remotes.Notice.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(message)
 serial+=1 local current=serial notice.Text=message
 task.delay(4,function() if current==serial then notice.Text="" end end)
end)
require(script.Parent.Menu).mount(gui,player,remotes.Action)
require(script.Parent.CarryPose).start(player)

 local hum=character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
 workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Custom workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject=hum
 player.CameraMinZoomDistance=8 player.CameraMaxZoomDistance=38
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(camera)
if player.Character then task.spawn(camera,player.Character) end

 wave.TextColor3=phase=="CALM" and Color3.fromRGB(244,248,255) or Color3.fromRGB(255,199,101)

end)

local W=require(script.Parent.World)
local B={plots={}}
local accents={Color3.fromRGB(27,192,190),Color3.fromRGB(250,115,93),Color3.fromRGB(85,144,247),Color3.fromRGB(197,119,247),Color3.fromRGB(103,200,92),Color3.fromRGB(248,177,56)}
function B.build()
 for index=1,6 do
  local x=({-82,0,82})[(index-1)%3+1]
  local z=index<=3 and -51 or 51
  local origin=CFrame.new(x,0,z)*CFrame.Angles(0,z<0 and math.pi or 0,0)
  local folder=Instance.new("Model") folder.Name=string.format("Safehouse%02d",index) folder.Parent=W.root
  local plot={index=index,origin=origin,model=folder,slots={},barriers={},activeUntil=0,cooldownUntil=0}
  local function p(n,s,pos,col)
   return W.part(folder,n,s,origin*CFrame.new(pos),col)
  end
  p("Deck",Vector3.new(26,0.8,40),Vector3.new(0,0,0),W.ink)
  -- Solid lower and upper walls retain the collision of the glazed ribbon.
  for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
   p("Side lower wall",Vector3.new(1,5,40),Vector3.new(side*12.5,2.9,0),W.white)
   local glass=p("Collision window",Vector3.new(1,3.25,37.6),Vector3.new(side*12.5,7.025,0),accents[index]) glass.Transparency=0.78 glass.Material=Enum.Material.Glass
   p("Side upper wall",Vector3.new(1,0.95,40),Vector3.new(side*12.5,9.125,0),W.white)
   p("Front wall",Vector3.new(9.5,9.2,1),Vector3.new(side*7.75,5, -19.5),W.white)
   for _,endZ in ipairs({-19.4,19.4}) do p("Corner pillar",Vector3.new(1.2,9.2,1.2),Vector3.new(side*12.4,5,endZ),W.ink) end
   p("Canopy wing",Vector3.new(14,0.6,33),Vector3.new(side*6.5,10, -2),accents[index])
  end
  p("Rear wall",Vector3.new(26,9.2,1),Vector3.new(0,5,19.5),W.white)
  p("Door lintel",Vector3.new(6,2.1,1),Vector3.new(0,8.55,-19.5),W.white)
  p("Service canopy",Vector3.new(27,0.6,9),Vector3.new(0,11.5,15.5),W.steel)
  W.sign(p("Name board",Vector3.new(19,2.2,0.25),Vector3.new(0,10,-20.1),W.ink),string.format("SAFEHOUSE %02d",index),accents[index])
  local zone=p("Delivery zone",Vector3.new(6,0.12,9),Vector3.new(0,0.47,-11),accents[index])
  local board=p("Delivery board",Vector3.new(8,1.4,0.2),Vector3.new(0,2,18.8),W.ink)
  W.sign(board,"DELIVERY / WAVE SHELTER")
  plot.shieldTerminal=p("SHIELD",Vector3.new(2,3,2),Vector3.new(-4,1.9,-17),accents[index])
  W.sign(plot.shieldTerminal,"SHIELD")
  plot.upgradeTerminal=p("EXPAND BASE",Vector3.new(2,3,2),Vector3.new(4,1.9,-17),W.gold)
  W.sign(plot.upgradeTerminal,"EXPAND BASE")
  local slotIndex=0
  for row=1,4 do for _,col in ipairs({-8,8}) do
   slotIndex+=1
   local pos=Vector3.new(col,0.8,({-11,-4,3,10})[row])
   local stand=p("Stand "..slotIndex,Vector3.new(4.5,0.8,4.5),pos,slotIndex<=4 and W.aqua or W.steel)
   plot.slots[slotIndex]={part=stand,cf=origin*CFrame.new(pos+Vector3.new(0,0.4,0)),item=nil,inTransit=false}
  end end
  local spawn=Instance.new("SpawnLocation") spawn.Name="Home spawn" spawn.Size=Vector3.new(4,0.2,4) spawn.CFrame=origin*CFrame.new(0,0.6,6) spawn.Transparency=1 spawn.CanCollide=false spawn.Neutral=true spawn.Parent=folder plot.spawn=spawn
  table.insert(B.plots,plot)
 end
end
function B.claim(player)
 for _,plot in ipairs(B.plots) do if not plot.owner then plot.owner=player player.RespawnLocation=plot.spawn player:SetAttribute("Plot",plot.index) return plot end end
 return nil
end
function B.get(player)
 for _,plot in ipairs(B.plots) do if plot.owner==player then return plot end end
end
function B.isSheltered(plot,position)
 local v=plot.origin:PointToObjectSpace(position)
 return math.abs(v.X)<12.2 and v.Z>-19 and v.Z<19 and v.Y>=0 and v.Y<13
end
function B.free(player)
 local plot=B.get(player) if not plot then return end
 for _,slot in ipairs(plot.slots) do if slot.item and slot.item.model then slot.item.model:Destroy() end slot.item=nil slot.inTransit=false end
 plot.owner=nil plot.activeUntil=0 plot.cooldownUntil=0
end
function B.freeSlot(player)
 local plot=B.get(player) if not plot then return end
 local cap=player:GetAttribute("Capacity") or 4
 for i,slot in ipairs(plot.slots) do if i<=cap and not slot.item then return slot end end
end
function B.refresh(player)
 local plot=B.get(player) if not plot then return end
 for i,s in ipairs(plot.slots) do s.part.Color=i<=(player:GetAttribute("Capacity") or 4) and W.aqua or W.steel end
end
return B

-- CritterMotion: makes the herd look alive on each client. Every critter's visible body hangs off
-- its anchored root by a Motor6D named Gait; this module sets that joint's Transform each frame from
-- the critter's Gait attribute: a bouncing trot on the Cattle Drive, breathing, swaying and the odd
-- happy hop in the pens, a frantic wriggle while carried by a rustler, and a tumble on the lasso.
-- Nothing here replicates: the server only moves roots, the client adds the wiggle.
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local CritterMotion = {}

CritterMotion.RANGE = 220 -- studs from the camera beyond which critters stand still

type Tracked = { model: Model, gait: Motor6D, phase: number, size: number }

local tracked: { [Model]: Tracked } = {}

local function track(model: Instance, tries: number?)
	if not model:IsA("Model") or not model:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		return
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	local gait = root and root:FindFirstChild("Gait")
	if not gait or not gait:IsA("Motor6D") then
		-- its parts may still be on their way from the server
		if (tries or 0) < 5 then
			task.delay(0.4, track, model, (tries or 0) + 1)
		end
		return
	end
	tracked[model] = { model = model, gait = gait, phase = math.random() * 10, size = model:GetScale() }
end

-- Where the body sits relative to the root this frame, for one gait.
function CritterMotion.pose(gaitName: string, t: number, phase: number, size: number): CFrame
	if gaitName == "trot" then
		local stride = t * 9 + phase
		local hop = math.abs(math.sin(stride)) * 0.6 * size
		return CFrame.new(0, hop, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(stride) * 0.08, 0, math.sin(stride * 0.5) * 0.06)
	elseif gaitName == "idle" then
		local breathe = (math.sin(t * 2.2 + phase) + 1) * 0.07 * size
		local look = math.sin(t * 0.55 + phase) * 0.35
		local k = (t + phase * 3) % 7
		local hop = if k < 0.5 then math.sin(k / 0.5 * math.pi) * 1.3 * size else 0
		local wiggle = if k < 0.5 then math.sin(k * 40) * 0.12 else 0
		return CFrame.new(0, breathe + hop, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, look, wiggle)
	elseif gaitName == "carried" then
		return CFrame.Angles(math.sin(t * 13 + phase) * 0.25, math.sin(t * 11) * 0.4, math.sin(t * 16 + phase) * 0.35)
	elseif gaitName == "fly" then
		return CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 5, math.sin(t * 7) * 0.5)
	end
	return CFrame.identity
end

local function animate()
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local eye = if camera then camera.CFrame.Position else Vector3.zero
	local t = os.clock()
	for model, entry in tracked do
		local root = model.PrimaryPart
		if not root or not model.Parent or not entry.gait.Parent then
			tracked[model] = nil
		elseif (root.Position - eye).Magnitude < CritterMotion.RANGE then
			entry.gait.Transform = CritterMotion.pose(model:GetAttribute("Gait") or "idle", t, entry.phase, entry.size)
		end
	end
end

function CritterMotion.startCritterMotion()
	for _, model in CollectionService:GetTagged("Critter") do
		track(model)
	end
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Critter"):Connect(track)
	CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("Critter"):Connect(function(model)
		tracked[model :: Model] = nil
	end)
	-- A critter rescaled while carried gets its new size the next time it is tracked.
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(animate)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(2)
			for model, entry in tracked do
				entry.size = model:GetScale()
			end
		end
	end)
end

return CritterMotion

local World = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService").Modules.World)

--// ++ Main Script ++
local EntityService = {}
EntityService.Entities = {}

--// There are no difference between :GetOrAddEntity() & :GetOrAddTag(), I just differed it for clarity while scripting. 
function EntityService.GetOrAddEntity<T>(self : typeof(EntityService), name : string)
	local entity = self.Entities[name]
	if entity then return entity end
	
	self.Entities[name] = World:entity()
	return self.Entities[name]
end

function EntityService.GetOrAddTag<T>(self : typeof(EntityService), name : string)
	local tag = self.Entities[name]
	if tag then return tag end

	self.Entities[name] = World:entity()
	return self.Entities[name]
end

function EntityService.GetOrAddComponent<T>(self : typeof(EntityService), name : string)
	local component = self.Entities[name]
	if component then return component end

	self.Entities[name] = World:component()
	return self.Entities[name]
end

return EntityService :: typeof(EntityService) & {
	Entities : {}
}

--!strict
-- Client entry point: input and presentation only. It shows what the server published and sends
-- intents; it never decides a reward, a price or a result.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Net = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Net"))
local Rules = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Rules"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local doAction = Net.event("DoAction")
local buyUpgrade = Net.event("BuyUpgrade")

-- ---- HUD --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Built once. ResetOnSpawn = false, or the HUD is destroyed and rebuilt on every death.
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Hud"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Name = "Panel"
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -24) -- bottom centre: clear of the top bar and the thumbstick
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 132)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
panel.Parent = gui

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder -- a layout made in code sorts by Name unless told otherwise
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
layout.Parent = panel

-- Keeps the panel usable on a phone in portrait instead of running off both edges.
local limit = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
limit.MaxSize = Vector2.new(360, 160)
limit.Parent = panel

local function label(name: string, order: number): TextLabel
	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = name
	text.LayoutOrder = order
	text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24)
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	text.TextSize = 20
	text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
	text.Parent = panel
	return text
end

local function button(name: string, order: number): TextButton
	local control = Instance.new("TextButton")
	control.Name = name
	control.LayoutOrder = order
	control.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 44) -- 44 px: the smallest target a thumb hits reliably
	control.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 120, 246)
	control.BorderSizePixel = 0
	control.AutoButtonColor = true
	control.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	control.TextSize = 18
	control.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	control.Parent = panel
	return control
end

local coinsLabel = label("Coins", 1)
local actionButton = button("Action", 2)
local upgradeButton = button("Upgrade", 3)
upgradeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 90)

gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ---- state -> screen --------------------------------------------------------------------------
local power = Config.Upgrades.Power

local function render()
	local coins = (player:GetAttribute("Coins") :: number?) or 0
	local level = (player:GetAttribute("Power") :: number?) or 0
	coinsLabel.Text = `Coins: {coins}`
	actionButton.Text = `Collect +{Rules.rewardFor(Config.BaseReward, level)}  [E]`
	if level >= power.MaxLevel then
		upgradeButton.Text = "Power: MAX"
	else
		-- Shown for the player's benefit only; the server computes the real price again.
		upgradeButton.Text = `Power {level} -> {level + 1}: {Rules.upgradeCost(power.BaseCost, power.Growth, level)}`
	end
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Coins"):Connect(render)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Power"):Connect(render)
render()

-- ---- input -> intent --------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Activated fires for mouse, touch and gamepad alike; MouseButton1Click does not.
actionButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	doAction:FireServer()
end)
upgradeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	buyUpgrade:FireServer("Power")
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then
		return -- the player is typing in chat or pressing a button
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		doAction:FireServer()
	end
end)

local function round(inst: GuiObject, radius: number, stroke: Color3?, thickness: number?)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	corner.Parent = inst
	if stroke then
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		s.Color = stroke
		s.Thickness = thickness or 3
		s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		s.Parent = inst
	end
end

	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
