local toastCount = 0
-- A message slides in on the left and fades after a few seconds.
function Hud.showToast(view: View, message: string, color: Color3)
	toastCount += 1
	local label = text(view.toasts, {
		LayoutOrder = toastCount, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38), Text = message, TextColor3 = color,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 28, 14), Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	round(label, 10)
	pad(label, 10, 4)
	local slide = Instance.new("UIScale")
	slide.Scale = 0.6
	slide.Parent = label
	TweenService:Create(slide, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	local shown = view.toasts:GetChildren()
	if #shown > 7 then
		for _, c in shown do
			if c:IsA("TextLabel") and c ~= label then
				c:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end
	task.delay(5, function()
		if label.Parent then
			TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
			task.wait(0.5)
			label:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local function attr(name: string, default: any): any
	local v = player:GetAttribute(name)
	if v == nil then
		return default
	end
	return v
end

local function clock(seconds: number): string
	local s = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", s // 60, s % 60)
end

-- The next-event pill and the event banner, from the calendar's Workspace attributes.
local function refreshEvents(view: View, now: number)
	local kind = Workspace:GetAttribute("EventKind") or ""
	local phase = Workspace:GetAttribute("EventPhase") or "calm"
	local endsAt = Workspace:GetAttribute("EventEndsAt") or now
	local raidEta = attr("RaidEta", 0)
	local look = Hud.EVENTS[kind]
	if look and phase ~= "calm" then
		view.eventPill.Text = look.icon .. "  " .. look.name .. (if phase == "warning" then " INCOMING" else " NOW") .. "  " .. look.icon
		view.eventPill.BackgroundColor3 = look.color
		view.banner.Visible = true
		view.banner.BackgroundColor3 = look.color
		local left = math.max(0, math.ceil(endsAt - now))
		view.banner.Text = string.format(if phase == "warning" then look.warn else look.active, left)
		-- the banner throbs while it counts down
		view.banner.Rotation = if phase == "warning" then math.sin(now * 8) * 1.2 else 0
	else
		local nextKind = Workspace:GetAttribute("NextEventKind") or ""
		local nextAt = Workspace:GetAttribute("NextEventAt") or 0
		local nextLook = Hud.EVENTS[nextKind]
		if nextLook and nextAt > now then
			view.eventPill.Text = "NEXT: " .. nextLook.name .. "  " .. clock(nextAt - now)
			view.eventPill.BackgroundColor3 = if nextAt - now < 10 then nextLook.color else PANEL
		else
			view.eventPill.Text = "THE PRAIRIE IS QUIET"
			view.eventPill.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL
		end
		view.banner.Rotation = 0
		if raidEta > now then
			view.banner.Visible = true
			view.banner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 20, 40)
			view.banner.Text = string.format("RUSTLER INCOMING %ds - LOCK YOUR GATE!", math.ceil(raidEta - now))
		else
			view.banner.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

-- "2/3", or "$1.2K/$5K" for an earnings contract.
local function progressText(c: { [string]: any }): string
	if c.kind == "earn" then
		return Cast.formatCash(c.progress) .. "/" .. Cast.formatCash(c.goal)
	end
	return c.progress .. "/" .. c.goal
end

-- Re-reads the contract board when the server sends a new one.
local function refreshContracts(view: View)
	local raw = attr("Contracts", "[]")
	if raw == view.lastBoard then
		return
	end
	view.lastBoard = raw
	local ok, board = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, raw)
	if not ok then
		return
	end
	for i, row in view.contracts do
		local c = board[i]
		row.frame.Visible = c ~= nil
		if c then
			local done = c.progress >= c.goal
			row.text.Text = (if done then "DONE! " else "") .. c.text .. (if c.goal > 1 and not done then "  (" .. progressText(c) .. ")" else "")
			row.reward.Text = c.reward
			row.reward.TextColor3 = if c.cash == 0 then Color3.fromRGB(40, 130, 40) else Color3.fromRGB(150, 90, 10)
			TweenService:Create(row.bar, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(c.progress / c.goal, 0, 1), 1) }):Play()
			row.frame.BackgroundColor3 = if done then Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 170) else Color3.fromRGB(250, 236, 205)
			if done and not row.done then
				local pulse = Instance.new("UIScale")
				pulse.Parent = row.frame
				pulse.Scale = 1.12
				TweenService:Create(pulse, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
				task.delay(0.6, pulse.Destroy, pulse)
			end
			row.done = done
		end
	end
end

local function refreshGuide(view: View)
	local step = attr("GuideStep", 1)
	local info = Hud.GUIDE[step]
	view.guide.Visible = info ~= nil
	if info then
		view.guideTitle.Text = string.format("TRAIL %d/4 - %s", step, info.title)
		view.guideHint.Text = info.hint
		for i, dot in view.guideDots do
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = if i < step then GREEN elseif i == step then GOLD else Color3.fromRGB(110, 80, 50)
		end
	end
end

-- Per frame: rolls the cash counter toward the real value and refreshes every readout.
function Hud.refreshRanchHud(view: View, dt: number)
	local now = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local cash = attr("Cash", 0)
	if view.lastCash >= 0 and cash > view.lastCash then
		view.cashScale.Scale = math.min(1.25, view.cashScale.Scale + 0.12)
	end
	view.lastCash = cash
	view.cashScale.Scale += (1 - view.cashScale.Scale) * math.min(1, dt * 10)
	view.shownCash += (cash - view.shownCash) * math.min(1, dt * 8)
	if math.abs(cash - view.shownCash) < 1 then
		view.shownCash = cash
	end
	view.cash.Text = Cast.formatCash(view.shownCash)
	local boost = attr("Boost", 1)
	local perSecond = attr("Income", 0) * boost
	view.income.Text = "+" .. Cast.formatCash(perSecond) .. "/s" .. (if boost > 1 then "  x" .. boost else "")
	view.income.TextColor3 = if boost > 1 then GOLD else GREEN
	view.rebirths.Text = string.format("REBIRTHS %d  x%.1f", attr("Rebirths", 0), attr("Multiplier", 1))

	local lockedUntil = attr("LockedUntil", 0)
	if lockedUntil > now then
		view.gateButton.Text = string.format("GATE LOCKED %ds", math.ceil(lockedUntil - now))
		view.gateButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 50, 40)
	else
		view.gateButton.Text = "LOCK GATE [L]"
		view.gateButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 70)
	end
	local cost = attr("RebirthCost", 20000)
	local ready = cash >= cost
	view.rebirthButton.Text = if ready then "REBIRTH NOW! [R]" else "REBIRTH " .. Cast.formatCash(cost) .. " [R]"
	view.rebirthButton.BackgroundColor3 = if ready then Color3.fromRGB(200, 90, 230) else Color3.fromRGB(150, 70, 190)
	view.rebirthButton.Rotation = if ready then math.sin(now * 6) * 2 else 0
	view.rebirthBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(cash / cost, 0, 1), 1)
	view.pens.Text = string.format("PENS %d/%d", attr("StallsUsed", 0), attr("StallsOpen", Cast.BASE_STALLS))
	local luckUntil = attr("LuckUntil", 0)
	view.luck.Text = if luckUntil > now then "LUCKY HORSESHOE " .. clock(luckUntil - now) else (if attr("Luck", 0) > 0 then "DRIVE LUCK +" .. attr("Luck", 0) else "")

	refreshEvents(view, now)
	refreshContracts(view)
	refreshGuide(view)

	local carrying = attr("Carrying", "")
	view.carry.Visible = carrying ~= ""
	view.carry.Text = "CARRYING " .. string.upper(carrying) .. " - RUN IT HOME!"
end

-- A big reward pop from the middle of the screen ("+$500 BOUNTY!", "LUCKY HORSESHOE!").
function Hud.bigPop(view: View, message: string, color: Color3)
	local label = text(view.pops, {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.42), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(620, 70),
		Text = message, TextColor3 = color, Rotation = math.random(-4, 4),
	})
	local s = Instance.new("UIScale")
	s.Scale = 0.2
	s.Parent = label
	TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, 0, false, 0.9), {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.3), TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
	}):Play()
	task.delay(2.1, label.Destroy, label)
end

-- Floats "+$N" over each critter in your own stalls: the money you see ticking up. Pops bounce in,
-- take the critter's mutation or rarity colour, and turn gold with a "x2" during Golden Hour.
function Hud.popIncome(view: View)
	local rebirths = attr("Rebirths", 0)
	local boost = attr("Boost", 1)
	for _, ranch in Workspace:GetChildren() do
		if ranch:IsA("Model") and string.sub(ranch.Name, 1, 5) == "Ranch" then
			for _, critter in ranch:GetChildren() do
				if critter:IsA("Model") and critter:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId and critter.PrimaryPart then
					local id = critter:GetAttribute("CritterId")
					local mutation = critter:GetAttribute("Mutation")
					mutation = if mutation == "" then nil else mutation
					local amount = Cast.incomeOf(id, mutation, rebirths) * boost
					local color = if boost > 1 then GOLD else Cast.mutationTint(mutation) or GREEN
					local height = critter:GetExtentsSize().Y
					local pop = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
					pop.Size = UDim2.new(3, 36, 1.2, 14)
					pop.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, height * 0.75, 0)
					pop.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(2.5, 0, 4)
					pop.AlwaysOnTop = false
					pop.LightInfluence = 0
					pop.MaxDistance = 140
					pop.Adornee = critter.PrimaryPart
					local label = text(pop, {
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = "+" .. Cast.formatCash(amount) .. (if boost > 1 then " x" .. boost else ""),
						TextColor3 = color, Rotation = math.random(-8, 8),
					})
					local bounce = Instance.new("UIScale")
					bounce.Scale = 0.3
					bounce.Parent = label
					pop.Parent = view.gui.Parent
					TweenService:Create(bounce, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.15 }):Play()
					TweenService:Create(pop, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, height * 0.75 + 5, 0) }):Play()
					TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, 0, false, 0.6), { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
					task.delay(1.05, pop.Destroy, pop)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- The ranch's own ProximityPrompt look: a wooden tag with the key, the action ("Lasso $25",
-- "Rustle!") and the critter, and a rope bar that fills while you hold the key.
function Hud.showRanchPrompt(prompt: ProximityPrompt): BillboardGui
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "RanchPrompt"
	gui.Adornee = prompt.Parent :: Instance
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 78)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 5)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	card.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	card.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL
	card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
	card.Parent = gui
	round(card, 12, BRASS, 3)
	local key = text(card, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52), Text = prompt.KeyboardKeyCode.Name,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0, BackgroundColor3 = CREAM, TextColor3 = WOOD, TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
	})
	round(key, 10)
	local isRustle = prompt:GetAttribute("Rustle") == true
	text(card, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(184, 38), Text = prompt.ActionText,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = if isRustle then RED else GOLD,
	})
	text(card, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 44), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(184, 22), Text = prompt.ObjectText,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne,
	})
	local rope = Instance.new("Frame")
	rope.Name = "Hold"
	rope.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -9)
	rope.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 5)
	rope.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(196, 150, 90)
	rope.BorderSizePixel = 0
	rope.Parent = card
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	return gui
end

function Hud.fillRanchPrompt(gui: BillboardGui, seconds: number)
	local rope = gui:FindFirstChild("Hold", true) :: Frame?
	if rope then
		rope.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 5)
		if seconds > 0 then
			TweenService:Create(rope, TweenInfo.new(seconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 5) }):Play()
		end
	end
end

Hud.RED = RED
Hud.GOLD = GOLD
return Hud

-- RanchAudio: every sound in Rot Ranch, made in-game. There are no uploaded audio assets: the ranch
-- plays Roblox's own built-in samples (a short tuned pluck, a thud, a boom, wind) at different
-- PlaybackSpeeds, so a pluck pitched by semitones becomes a banjo, a bass and a bell. On top of that
-- it sequences an original boom-chick western soundtrack (bass, banjo rolls, a lead tune, hoof
-- clip-clops), plays the short cues the server sends (lasso, cash, lock, rustle, rebirth, mutation
-- sparkle, rustler whistle, trampled sting...), loops the stampede rumble and the Dust Devil's wind,
-- and ducks the music under every warning.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local RanchAudio = {}

-- The built-in samples. "pluck" is a clean tone at G4 (392 Hz) that decays in a fifth of a second.
local SAMPLES = {
	pluck = "rbxasset://sounds/volume_slider.ogg",
	thud = "rbxasset://sounds/action_jump_land.mp3",
	boom = "rbxasset://sounds/impact_explosion_03.mp3",
	wind = "rbxasset://sounds/action_falling.ogg",
	whoosh = "rbxasset://sounds/action_jump.mp3",
	oof = "rbxasset://sounds/oof.ogg",
	splash = "rbxasset://sounds/impact_water.mp3",
}
local POOL_SIZE = { pluck = 24, thud = 8, boom = 3, whoosh = 4, oof = 2, splash = 2 }

RanchAudio.TEMPO = 118 -- beats a minute; the sequencer steps in eighth notes
RanchAudio.MUSIC_VOLUME = 0.55
RanchAudio.SFX_VOLUME = 0.9

local pools: { [string]: { Sound } } = {}
local cursor: { [string]: number } = {}
local musicGroup: SoundGroup
local sfxGroup: SoundGroup
local loops: { [string]: Sound } = {}
local musicOn = true
local ducked = false

local function semis(n: number): number
	return 2 ^ (n / 12)
end

local function makeGroup(name: string, volume: number): SoundGroup
	local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
	group.Name = name
	group.Volume = volume
	group.Parent = SoundService
	return group
end

local function makeSound(sample: string, group: SoundGroup): Sound
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.SoundId = SAMPLES[sample]
	s.SoundGroup = group
	s.Parent = group
	return s
end

-- Plays one note of a sample: n semitones from its own pitch, at a volume, in the music or sfx group.
function RanchAudio.note(sample: string, n: number, volume: number, music: boolean?)
	local pool = pools[(if music then "m:" else "s:") .. sample]
	if not pool then
		return
	end
	local key = (if music then "m:" else "s:") .. sample
	local i = (cursor[key] or 0) % #pool + 1
	cursor[key] = i
	local s = pool[i]
	s.PlaybackSpeed = semis(n)
	s.Volume = volume
	s.TimePosition = 0
	s:Play()
end

-- Plays a little phrase: a list of { delay, sample, semitone, volume } steps.
local function phrase(steps: { { any } })
	for _, step in steps do
		local at, sample, n, vol = step[1], step[2], step[3], step[4]
		if at <= 0 then
			RanchAudio.note(sample, n, vol)
		else
			task.delay(at, RanchAudio.note, sample, n, vol)
		end
	end
end

local function arpeggio(notes: { number }, gap: number, vol: number, start: number?): { { any } }
	local steps = {}
	for i, n in notes do
		table.insert(steps, { (start or 0) + (i - 1) * gap, "pluck", n, vol })
	end
	return steps
end

local function join(...: { { any } }): { { any } }
	local all = {}
	for _, list in { ... } do
		for _, step in list do
			table.insert(all, step)
		end
	end
	return all
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The soundtrack: "Rot Ranch Reel", in G. Semitones are counted from G4 (0).
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local CHORDS = {
	G = { root = -24, fifth = -17, tones = { 0, 4, 7 } },
	C = { root = -19, fifth = -12, tones = { 5, 9, 12 } },
	D = { root = -17, fifth = -10, tones = { 2, 7, 11 } },
	Em = { root = -15, fifth = -8, tones = { 4, 7, 11 } },
}
-- Four-bar phrases; each bar is one chord, eight eighth-note steps long.
local PHRASES = {
	{ chords = { "G", "C", "D", "G" }, lead = nil },
	{ chords = { "G", "C", "D", "G" }, lead = {
		{ 7, nil, 4, 7, 12, nil, 11, nil }, { 9, nil, 12, 9, 5, nil, nil, nil },
		{ 7, nil, 11, 14, 11, 7, nil, nil }, { 4, 2, 0, nil, nil, nil, -5, -1 },
	} },
	{ chords = { "Em", "C", "G", "D" }, lead = nil },
	{ chords = { "Em", "C", "G", "D" }, lead = {
		{ 16, nil, 14, 12, 11, nil, 7, nil }, { 9, 12, 16, nil, 14, nil, 12, nil },
		{ 11, nil, 7, 4, 7, nil, 12, nil }, { 14, nil, nil, 11, 9, nil, 7, nil },
	} },
}
local ROLL = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 2, 3, 4, 3 } -- a forward banjo roll over the chord (4 = root an octave up)

local step = 0
local nextStepAt = 0
local twinkle = false

-- Plays one eighth-note step of the reel.
local function playStep()
	local barIndex = step // 8
	local beat = step % 8
	local phraseIndex = (barIndex // 4) % #PHRASES + 1
	local bar = barIndex % 4 + 1
	local p = PHRASES[phraseIndex]
	local chord = CHORDS[p.chords[bar]]
	local lead = p.lead and p.lead[bar][beat + 1]
	-- boom: bass on 1 and 5, alternating root and fifth
	if beat == 0 then
		RanchAudio.note("pluck", chord.root, 0.9, true)
	elseif beat == 4 then
		RanchAudio.note("pluck", chord.fifth, 0.75, true)
	end
	-- chick: a quick strum on the off-beats
	if beat == 2 or beat == 6 then
		for i, n in chord.tones do
			task.delay(i * 0.012, RanchAudio.note, "pluck", n - 12, 0.22, true)
		end
	end
	-- the banjo roll (softer under the lead)
	local t = chord.tones
	local rollTone = ROLL[beat + 1]
	local n = if rollTone == 4 then t[1] + 12 else t[rollTone]
	RanchAudio.note("pluck", n + 12, if lead then 0.12 else 0.26, true)
	if lead then
		RanchAudio.note("pluck", lead + 12, 0.42, true)
	end
	-- hooves: a clip-clop on every step
	RanchAudio.note("thud", if beat % 2 == 0 then 9 else 13, if beat % 2 == 0 then 0.22 else 0.14, true)
	-- Golden Hour: bells sparkle on top
	if twinkle and (beat == 1 or beat == 5) then
		RanchAudio.note("pluck", t[(beat // 2) % 3 + 1] + 24, 0.25, true)
	end
	step += 1
end

local function startSoundtrack()
	local eighth = 60 / RanchAudio.TEMPO / 2
	nextStepAt = os.clock() + 0.5
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now < nextStepAt then
			return
		end
		-- if we fell far behind (window dragged), skip ahead instead of machine-gunning notes
		if now - nextStepAt > 0.5 then
			nextStepAt = now
		end
		nextStepAt += eighth
		if musicOn then
			playStep()
		end
	end)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Loops and ducking
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function loop(name: string, sample: string, speed: number, volume: number)
	local s = loops[name]
	if not s then
		s = makeSound(sample, sfxGroup)
		s.Looped = true
		loops[name] = s
	end
	s.PlaybackSpeed = speed
	if not s.IsPlaying then
		s.Volume = 0
		s:Play()
	end
	TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.8), { Volume = volume }):Play()
end

local function stopLoop(name: string)
	local s = loops[name]
	if s and s.IsPlaying then
		local fade = TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(1.2), { Volume = 0 })
		fade:Play()
		fade.Completed:Once(function()
			if s.Volume < 0.01 then
				s:Stop()
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function duck(on: boolean)
	if on == ducked then
		return
	end
	ducked = on
	local target = if not musicOn then 0 elseif on then RanchAudio.MUSIC_VOLUME * 0.22 else RanchAudio.MUSIC_VOLUME
	TweenService:Create(musicGroup, TweenInfo.new(if on then 0.4 else 1.5), { Volume = target }):Play()
end

-- Watches the event calendar: ducks under warnings, rumbles for the stampede, howls for the twister.
local function followEvents()
	local lastSiren = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local kind = Workspace:GetAttribute("EventKind") or ""
		local phase = Workspace:GetAttribute("EventPhase") or "calm"
		local raid = (game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RaidEta") or 0) > Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		local danger = (phase ~= "calm" and kind ~= "goldenhour") or raid
		duck(danger)
		twinkle = kind == "goldenhour" and phase == "active"
		local now = os.clock()
		if kind == "stampede" and phase == "warning" then
			loop("rumble", "boom", 0.32, 0.35)
			if now - lastSiren > 0.5 then
				lastSiren = now
				local high = math.floor(now * 2) % 2 == 0
				RanchAudio.note("pluck", if high then 12 else 7, 0.55)
				RanchAudio.note("pluck", if high then 0 else -5, 0.4)
			end
		elseif kind == "stampede" and phase == "active" then
			loop("rumble", "boom", 0.42, 0.9)
			if now - lastSiren > 0.11 then
				lastSiren = now
				RanchAudio.note("thud", math.random(-6, -2), 0.7)
			end
		else
			stopLoop("rumble")
		end
		if kind == "dustdevil" and phase ~= "calm" then
			local wobble = 0.55 + math.sin(now * 1.3) * 0.08 + (if phase == "active" then 0.12 else 0)
			loop("wind", "wind", wobble, if phase == "active" then 1 else 0.55)
		else
			stopLoop("wind")
		end
	end)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Cues from the server
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local lastRare = 0
local CUES: { [string]: (any) -> () } = {}

CUES.welcome = function()
	phrase(arpeggio({ 0, 4, 7, 4, 12 }, 0.11, 0.5))
end
CUES.lasso = function(data)
	local rank = if type(data) == "table" then data.rank or 1 else 1
	phrase(join({ { 0, "whoosh", -2, 0.7 } }, arpeggio({ 0, 4, 7, 12 }, 0.06, 0.45, 0.05)))
	if rank >= 4 then
		phrase(arpeggio({ 16, 19, 24 }, 0.06, 0.4, 0.3))
	end
	if type(data) == "table" and data.mutation then
		RanchAudio.mutationSparkle()
	end
	if type(data) == "table" and data.fresh then
		phrase(arpeggio({ 12, 16, 19, 24, 28 }, 0.05, 0.3, 0.55))
	end
end
CUES.land = function(rank)
	phrase({ { 0, "thud", -4, 0.9 }, { 0.02, "pluck", 12, 0.35 }, { 0.12, "pluck", 19, 0.3 } })
	if type(rank) == "number" and rank >= 5 then
		phrase({ { 0, "boom", 8, 0.35 } })
	end
end
CUES.cash = function()
	phrase({ { 0, "pluck", 24, 0.1 }, { 0.05, "pluck", 28, 0.08 } })
end
CUES.coin = function()
	phrase(arpeggio({ 19, 24, 31 }, 0.045, 0.45))
end
CUES.lock = function()
	phrase({ { 0, "thud", -8, 1 }, { 0.09, "thud", -2, 0.8 }, { 0.12, "pluck", -5, 0.5 }, { 0.2, "pluck", 0, 0.5 } })
end
CUES.lockHeld = function()
	phrase(join({ { 0, "thud", -6, 0.9 } }, arpeggio({ 0, 7, 12 }, 0.1, 0.45, 0.05)))
end
CUES.rustle = function()
	phrase(join({ { 0, "whoosh", -5, 0.7 } }, arpeggio({ -12, -11, -8, -12 }, 0.09, 0.45, 0.05)))
end
CUES.alarm = function()
	phrase(arpeggio({ 12, 7, 12, 7, 12, 7 }, 0.12, 0.5))
end
CUES.delivered = function()
	phrase(join({ { 0, "thud", -4, 0.8 } }, arpeggio({ 0, 4, 7, 12, 16 }, 0.07, 0.5)))
end
CUES.rebirth = function()
	phrase(join({ { 0, "boom", -3, 0.6 } }, arpeggio({ -12, -5, 0, 4, 7, 12, 16, 19, 24 }, 0.07, 0.5)))
	task.delay(0.7, function()
		for _, n in { 12, 16, 19, 24 } do
			RanchAudio.note("pluck", n, 0.4)
		end
		RanchAudio.mutationSparkle()
	end)
end
-- The rustler's whistle: a fast slide up and a falling tail, "fweee-oo".
CUES.whistle = function()
	local steps = {}
	for i = 0, 12 do
		table.insert(steps, { i * 0.022, "pluck", 12 + i, 0.32 })
	end
	for i = 0, 7 do
		table.insert(steps, { 0.4 + i * 0.03, "pluck", 24 - i, 0.3 })
	end
	phrase(steps)
end
CUES.tag = function()
	phrase(join({ { 0, "thud", -6, 1 }, { 0, "oof", 4, 0.6 } }, arpeggio({ 0, 7, 12, 19 }, 0.08, 0.5, 0.08)))
end
-- The fail sting: a sad "wah-wah-wah-waaah" (repeated notes so the last one hangs).
local function sadTrombone(start: number)
	local steps = {}
	for i, n in { 4, 3, 2 } do
		table.insert(steps, { start + (i - 1) * 0.32, "pluck", n - 12, 0.6 })
	end
	for i = 0, 9 do
		table.insert(steps, { start + 0.96 + i * 0.06, "pluck", 1 - 12 - (i % 2) * 0.4, 0.5 - i * 0.03 })
	end
	phrase(steps)
end
CUES.trampled = function()
	phrase({ { 0, "oof", 0, 0.9 }, { 0, "thud", -10, 1 } })
	sadTrombone(0.25)
end
CUES.fail = function()
	sadTrombone(0)
end
CUES.deny = function()
	phrase({ { 0, "pluck", -12, 0.45 }, { 0, "pluck", -11, 0.45 }, { 0.09, "pluck", -12, 0.35 }, { 0.09, "pluck", -11, 0.35 } })
end
CUES.stampedeWarn = function()
	phrase({ { 0, "boom", -8, 0.8 } })
end
CUES.stampede = function()
	phrase({ { 0, "boom", -4, 1 }, { 0.3, "boom", -7, 0.8 } })
end
CUES.goldenWarn = function()
	phrase(join(arpeggio({ 0, 4, 7, 12, 16, 19, 24 }, 0.07, 0.35), arpeggio({ 7, 12, 16, 19, 24, 28, 31 }, 0.07, 0.3, 0.7)))
end
CUES.golden = function()
	phrase(join({ { 0, "pluck", -24, 0.8 }, { 0, "pluck", -12, 0.7 } }, arpeggio({ 0, 4, 7, 12, 16, 19, 24, 28 }, 0.05, 0.45)))
	RanchAudio.mutationSparkle()
end
CUES.dustWarn = function()
	phrase(join({ { 0, "boom", -12, 0.5 } }, arpeggio({ 1, 0, -1, 0, 1, 0 }, 0.18, 0.3)))
end
CUES.dustDevil = function()
	phrase({ { 0, "whoosh", -10, 0.9 }, { 0.15, "whoosh", -12, 0.8 } })
end
CUES.allClear = function()
	phrase(arpeggio({ 0, 4, 7 }, 0.12, 0.35))
end
CUES.contract = function()
	phrase(join({ { 0, "thud", -4, 0.7 } }, arpeggio({ 7, 12, 16, 19 }, 0.08, 0.5), arpeggio({ 24, 28, 31 }, 0.05, 0.35, 0.36)))
end
CUES.guide = function()
	phrase(arpeggio({ 12, 16, 19 }, 0.09, 0.4))
end
CUES.rareOnDrive = function()
	if os.clock() - lastRare > 3 then
		lastRare = os.clock()
		phrase(arpeggio({ 24, 28, 31 }, 0.06, 0.18))
	end
end

-- A quick high glitter: mutations, rebirths, Golden Hour.
function RanchAudio.mutationSparkle()
	local steps = {}
	for i = 0, 9 do
		table.insert(steps, { i * 0.035, "pluck", 24 + ({ 0, 4, 7, 12, 16 })[i % 5 + 1], 0.22 })
	end
	phrase(steps)
end

-- Plays a named cue (unknown names are ignored).
function RanchAudio.play(name: string, data: any?)
	local cue = CUES[name]
	if cue then
		cue(data)
	end
end

-- M toggles the soundtrack (sound effects stay on).
function RanchAudio.toggleMusic(): boolean
	musicOn = not musicOn
	local target = if not musicOn then 0 elseif ducked then RanchAudio.MUSIC_VOLUME * 0.22 else RanchAudio.MUSIC_VOLUME
	TweenService:Create(musicGroup, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { Volume = target }):Play()
	return musicOn
end

-- Builds the sample pools, starts the reel and the event watcher. Call once per client.
function RanchAudio.startRanchAudio()
	musicGroup = makeGroup("RanchMusic", RanchAudio.MUSIC_VOLUME)
	sfxGroup = makeGroup("RanchSfx", RanchAudio.SFX_VOLUME)
	for sample, size in POOL_SIZE do
		local sfx, music = {}, {}
		for _ = 1, size do
			table.insert(sfx, makeSound(sample, sfxGroup))
		end
		if sample == "pluck" or sample == "thud" then
			for _ = 1, size do
				table.insert(music, makeSound(sample, musicGroup))
			end
			pools["m:" .. sample] = music
		end
		pools["s:" .. sample] = sfx
	end
	startSoundtrack()
	followEvents()
end

return RanchAudio
